name: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas

reviews.title: Nice suite
reviews.text: Location was centralized and within walkable distance of the strip. We were able to pick up Uber next door at the Flamingo, which was convenient. The suite was spacious, clean and updated. Our room was quiet for the most part except for one night of late night revelers returning to their room above us. The front desk was helpful with suggestions and directions. They do provide two bottles of water per person each day, but you do have to go down to the front desk to get them, which was a small hassle. Our housekeeping staff missed one day so we did have to call to make sure they did come the next day for sure. The showerhead was leaking, but fixed right away. I would most likely stay at this property again as it fit our needs well.

reviews.title: Perfect location with rooms that save money
reviews.text: We just did 7 days here. I’ve stayed many times when we had timeshare but found we could book in now.The location is superb, just a few minutes stroll into the flamingo. You have access to the flamingo pool but that’s a pool party every day it’s very loud but we quite enjoyed it you just don’t get much rest in the day due to it. There was always a queue so we didn’t go to it we just used the one at this hotel and it was great.You have a fridge and kettle and stuff in the rooms which is a lifeline now vegas has gone so expensive. We popped to severn eleven each day just a short walk but having the kitchen made this possible and saved a fortune. The rooms are beautifully done, once the flamingo pool stops at 6pm it’s so quiet you wouldn’t think you were so close to all the action. I just think it makes it the perfect place here.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Zero hot water
reviews.text: Room is very nice and clean. Great location. However room 1037 has zero hot water in shower. I called on October 30 at 10:30 pm to inform them. When the manager on duty called me back he just wanted to introduce himself after the maintenance man left. He wanted to let me know they’re working on it. I asked when it would be fixed? He didn’t have an answer. Got snarky and said it could be the next day and he’d pass my concern off to the next manager in the morning. The amount of money I paid to have an ice cold shower and still not compensated for still no hot water in the morning. That night (Halloween) I still had cold water. I called and it fell on deaf ears again. Thank god I could use my parents shower in the meantime.

reviews.title: Flamingo going gone
reviews.text: This hotel is on a perfect location on the strip with all major casinos around. The hotel is very quiet in comparison to the casino hotels. The lobby is very quiet and sometimes nice feeling to return to some calm. Overlooks the sphere and adjacent to the flamingo hotel whose pool facilities you can use - beware Linux’s loud music all afternoon so not quite relaxing pool time! There are some parts of the hotel that feel very 90s the lifts are ancient thigh the rooms are well equipped. I had a. Suite which has lounge area, fridge, washer dryer, microwave, hob, lounge area, large bedroom, a bath big enough for three and a large shower. The hotel doesn’t really offer any great dining or bar facilities but there’s plenty outside the doors on the strip!After 5 days I moved to try a casino hotel.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: The unit was large and nicely furnished.  Good location on the strip.  The only negative comment that we had was the "loud music" that was played all day at the adult pool.  We could not relax there so did not use the pool.  This was a "party pool".

reviews.title: Girls Trip 2 Bedroom walkable to Sphere
reviews.text: We stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club at the Flamingo in a two-bedroom suite. It was perfect for our group of friends, giving us a nice combo of shared space and privacy. It’s right next to the Flamingo hotel’s lively pool, which is loud during the day, but we had no issues sleeping at night. Heads up: there’s no on-site bar or food service, but the Flamingo is next door for that. We were there to hit events at the Sphere, and the walk was super convenient. We also loved being right across from Hell’s Kitchen. One note: housekeeping accidentally left a bit of cleaning product in the toilet—sudsy surprise!—and I couldn’t figure out the bathtub stopper situation. Overall, comfy beds and a good stay!

reviews.title: Great place except for flamingo hotel pool noise next door
reviews.text: We have been going here for years.  The staff are one of the best in a hotel/resort that I have experienced.  Location is great and in proximity to many activities.Only drawback and the reason for 4 instead of 5 stars overall is the booming noise from the Flamingo ridiculously loud 9am to 6pm what they call music.  We had trouble sitting out at our pool for the noise was overpowering and after an hour we both left with headaches.  I cannot wait for the day they tear the flamingo down and rebuild.  That way for two years the noise will stop.

reviews.title: Excellent experience, business trip
reviews.text: I stayed here to attend a multi-day expo at the Las Vegas Convention Center via RCI timeshare exchange. Had a very nice 1 bedroom unit with kitchen. Was very nice to have the electric water kettle for making hot water for tea (not a coffee drinker) and a microwave/air fryer combo to heat up leftovers, etc. Quiet unit for relaxing after a long day. Easy and close access to both the Linq promenade (for food options) and the monorail (to get to the LVCC). Nice grounds and back patio area. I didn't get a chance to try out the pools. The onsite marketplace was convenient for grabbing a quick breakfast, lunch or beverages.

reviews.title: Nice but a little inconvenience of no room se4v8ce or bar
reviews.text: Rooms were great centrally located,the double door was a little bit of a hassle it is a quiet place but no breakfast no bar had to go out and get food

reviews.title: Totally spoilt by loud music daily 7 days a week during summer.
reviews.text: We were here for 2 weeks & the amenities were great BUT the whole experience was spoilt by the constant daily loud music 7 days a week. you could not sit quietly anywhere not even your room without the loud music blaring, very maddening & a total put off for ever coming here from March to October.

reviews.title: I Want My Money Back
reviews.text: It is an absolute disgrace that this "resort" doesn't warn you about rave music going 11  hours a day until you are checked in and they have your money. The bass is so strong that the walls shake. And then have the nerve to offer "to have earplugs sent up to my room" like I'm going to wear them all day. A complete and utter joke, except it's not funny. I wish I could leave zero stars. DO NOT RECOMMEND

reviews.title: Turn down the music
reviews.text: There was constant loud music from 9-6pm, 7 days a week, it was very maddening & spoilt a good vacation as we thought the apartment amenities were great. It is a shame the resort does not do something about the noise, we won't be back.

reviews.title: Loud music going unaddressed.
reviews.text: There is constant loud music played from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM each day from the Go Pool at the Flamingo Hotel directly in front of the outdoor facilities of the vacation club. You are unable to use the outdoor hotel facilities because of the loud music and even your hotel room is inundated with it. Complaints to staff and management go unaddressed. They state that since it is not on their property they cannot do anything about it. Only offer ear plugs! Do not stay here if you want a relaxing time or any peace and quiet between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM, seven days a week.

reviews.title: Constant noise (music) ruins a great hotel -
reviews.text: I give it a 3.5 It’s a good location. Maybe even a great location. Access to the Strip is easy (once you figure it out) It is within reasonable walking distance to Sphere, Shops at Venetian, and popular places on the Strip. It is impressively clean and everyone is friendly. We have a great view of the pool and the multiple pools at the Flamingo, with lots of palm trees and well landscaped grounds. There is NO on site restaurant as the web side states. There is ‘store’ that is not always open but is well stocked with helpful items from breakfast, snacks and sodas/juices. So, what can ruin a perfectly good hotel experience? NOISE! The Flamingo, within a golf chip shot from this place, has a DJ play rap, hip-hop, and other recordings that are supposed to be music - SO loud our windows vibrate! Music blasts from 8:30am until 6pm ish. The only place in our 1 bedroom I could not hear the ‘beat’ was in the shower. Today is Sunday, I wish I could record what I am hearing right now. Now, if you are not like us, and you like this ‘music’ and can block it out, then this is the place for you. We met some of our hotel neighbors (unexpectedly) at an event last night and they have the same issue. They are avoiding being on property until after dark…. (They have friends who picked a different Hilton!) Wish we had friends here! Sorry, we will not be back unless things change.

reviews.title: Worst experience!
reviews.text: This is the worst location in Vegas and my worst experience in the Hilton group!First the hotel is old and outdated, second there is no breakfast, just a market place selling disgusting processed food, third service is bad: you asked for housekeeping every day and they don’t come. Their excuse is that they’re short on staff, and last but not least, the pool next door has a DJ from 8am till 7pm and it’s so loud that you can’t relax in your room (the walls tremble), let alone by the hotel pool. You can’t hear yourself thinking and have a conversation with someone. And forget about reading a book. It’s unbearable and unacceptable!

reviews.title: Excellent, clean, unbeatable location, but bad your credit card collections system
reviews.text: Very good, but beware of its credit card charging system, at check-in your card passes and after two days and block access to your unit and make you go to reception to redo the original charge with a second card, and that procedure is tedious and impractical

reviews.title: Nice property and great location.
reviews.text: Better than a hotel room and centrally located.  The only downside was in the summer the music from the pool area can be annoying, mostly due to the low frequency boom boom boom.

reviews.title: Fun and Relaxing
reviews.text: Had a Fantastic time at the resort. Would recommend to all.  Pool was very nice and a lot of fun in the area to visit other events

reviews.title: Warning: Enter at Your Own Risk.
reviews.text: If you enjoy broken AC that roars like a jet engine, sinks that clog from water, and walls that shake from the deafening pool party noise at the Flamingo complex, this is your dream spot. Bonus features include: a fake “friendly” invite to a sales pitch that turns into an interrogation, surprise $60 charges for services you already paid for, and a refund process that could qualify as an Olympic sport in passing the buck. Five days here felt like five years—save your money (and sanity) and stay literally anywhere else.

reviews.title: Good but noisy
reviews.text: Overall, the stay at this hotel was very good. Location was perfect. The king suite was grande, with all the amenities such as washer and dryer, kettle, coffee mashine, microwave, dishwasher, kitchen, fridge. Very clean throughout our stay  Amazing views of the pool. But.. at day the noise from the pool is unbelievable. If you leave the hotel and come back after 6 p.m it is fine. If your goal is partying at the pool then it is also fine. Also, there is no breakfast. Just a muffin and coffee. Which is also fine if you know beforehand. But if you pay extra for breakfast and then you find out what's in the deal then it is not nice. But being that close to strip, having fridge, kettle and washing mashine along with an amazing suite has kept us satisfied enough.

reviews.title: Hilton Flamingo
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, a homely feeling. Perfect location to the strip, access to the Flamingo pool which is adults only,  the resort have their own pool for all family members. Staff very nice and attentive.

reviews.title: Radio too loudy
reviews.text: Nice property and friendly staff.  The Flamingo Hotel next door has a pool party every day / all day and they blast the music.  You can hear it in your room even if your room is on a top floor.  If you’re hoping for a relaxing and restful stay, this will negatively impact your use and enjoyment of the property.  I feel bad for people who bought into this club.

reviews.title: Lovely resort but LOUD LOUD LOUD
reviews.text: Our 3rd time at this resort and never again. The rooms were spacious and comfortable and well equipped but the noise from the adjoining Flamingo pool was so loud we ended up leaving 4 days early. The extremely loud music went 9-10 hours a day. Staff were aware but said there was nothing they could do. There was no chance of a sleep in. Not even the TV could drown out the noise.

reviews.title: Good and Conveniently located property.
reviews.text: Being Conveniently located property we were able to move around nearly at all nearby attractions on foot except downtown Fremont Street. Booked through RCI,  one bedroom suite had full facilities of kitchen, washing machine, dishwasher etc. Can accommodate four adults . The private pool was very convenient and easily accessible. New renovated Go pool next door of Flamingo hotel is allowed entry to us also . Party atmosphere and loud music was somewhat enjoyable.Overall an excellent location and enjoyable trip

reviews.title: Spacious Apartment in a Great Location
reviews.text: Well equipped, spacious apartment. King size bed was very comfortable. Located close to The Strip, taxi and Uber rank, and the monorail. The Flamingo Casino pool was noisy but didn't bother us as we were out of the apartment most of the day.

reviews.title: Be carefull with the position of the room, chose to not see the poll, musica every day start at 9am
reviews.text: Always with loud music from the pool and front door shock. Some stange guy in the check in didnt find my name so i can check in in my room.

reviews.title: Consider adjacent Hilton Flamingo pool noise
reviews.text: Staff and service was excellent! A++  However, the adjacent boom-boom noise from the new Flamingo Hilton pool complex from 9am to 6pm was wow. Turned up TV like white noise, Made cell calls from toilet. First time we ever called the police to see what were our options regarding the very high noise levels in the rooms.  Recommend going here only when the adjacent pool is closed.

reviews.title: Uninhabitable Resort
reviews.text: My wife and I reserved a stay at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas from May 30 to June 4, 2025. However, due to excessive, continuous, and disruptive noise during our stay, we were forced to check out early on June 1, 2025, and incur significant expenses securing alternative accommodations. We could not even talk inside our unit!

reviews.title: Clean and friendly! Great location!
reviews.text: Great location! Very friendly staff and a super clean room. Everything was perfect. We did have a room overlooking the pool. The music from the Flamingo pool nextdoor was extremely loud- but they do close at 6pm. If you are looking to take an afternoon nap, I would request a room on the other side of the hotel. We would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Clean and friendly! Great location!
reviews.text: Great location! Very friendly staff and a super clean room. Everything was perfect. We did have a room overlooking the pool. The music from the Flamingo pool nextdoor was extremely loud- but they do close at 6pm. If you are looking to take an afternoon nap, I would request a room on the other side of the hotel. We would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We stayed one week in a 2-bedroom lock off which was spacious and well appointed. Midway through our stay the Flamingo GO Pool opened. The music they play is quite loud, but it only plays from 10-6. Keep this in mind if you want quiet during the day. The location was excellent, only a few minutes walk to the Flamingo casino and Linq Promenade which offers affordable dining. In the unit we loved the huge bathrooms and the bed was so comfortable. The staff were always friendly and very accommodating.  I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

reviews.title: Unbearably loud DJ 9 AM to 6 PM seven days a week
reviews.text: I’m really sorry to give this lovely hotel such a low rating. The hotel itself does not deserve it, and it is not even the fault of this hotel that this unbearably loud DJ (but rather the old flamingo hotel that shares property.)It is really hard to describe the noise and vibration level. Perhaps if you’ve ridden the earthquake ride at Universal, you would have a little sense of it, except that is temporary and this goes on for nine straight hours every day.Guests can and should avoid this property anytime the pool is open which, I guess is four or five months a year. Unlike guest, who can avoid it, the front desk, staff faces the DJ tower just across the pool and our subject to it during their entire working day. I truly wonder if OSHA requirements for noise level are being violated.

reviews.title: What goes on in Vegas…should be shared
reviews.text: Fantastic stay!  Great location and accommodations, over too quickly!  Loved the extended pool hours!  Wonderful stay!,

reviews.title: Deafening Flamingo Go Pool Music
reviews.text: This is a perfect location.  The rooms are spacious and clean.  The only drawback is from Mid March thru September the Flamingo Go Pool music from 9-6:00 is deafening!!  The speakers face the HGVC and the windows vibrate from the intense techno music.   So if you are one who likes a nap or quiet time DO NOT stay here.  The HGVC on the Las Vegas Strip is a great property and quiet —— but it is not a central location.  (2 miles from Flamingo, Bellagio, Cesars)

reviews.title: Family vacation.
reviews.text: Great location for the strip, close enough to the Flamingo but nice and quiet for older family.Would definitely recommend and will be back.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The staff were fantastic.  They made sure everything was good for my whole stay. The location of this property is behind the Flamingo hotel.  Easy access to the monorail.  The monorail station is right there. The pool area was closed for refurbishment.  When it is done,  it will be another great amenity to this property.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay wonderful room. Staff was more than helpful. Leo went above and beyond helping us with a delivery. Parking lot was great and free, just be advised park in reserved for Hilton Vacations area.Take advantage of local buses, they come every 10 minutes or so, $8.00 gets you a 24 hour pass.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Just loved our week here at the Hilton.  We used the pool area and really enjoyed it.  The unit was a two bedroom that was really two one bedroom apartments.  We were there as two couples and each had our own space.   Lots to do in the area.  Can't wait to come back

reviews.title: The finest resort hotel
reviews.text: Located in the most popular part of the Strip, it is easily accessible and most attractions are within walking distance. It does not face the strip, so it has a quiet and calm atmosphere. The room is equipped with a full kitchen and washing machine, and you can soak in the hot spring feeling with a large bathtub. I wanted to live in this hotel with a good view.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort 💯 5 service for sure
reviews.text: Love this resort and we will definitely return Highly recommend to anyone.Choose Hiton Grand Vacation

reviews.title: why stay here?
reviews.text: First things first.... who in their right mind wants to stay at a so-called resort, pay a resort fee, and then find out there’s no on-site restaurant — not even a quick-service option — and no coffee station!!! It’s disappointing and, honestly, feels like a blatant cash grab.Upon walking into the property, I was greeted by a stale lobby and a sticky floor like someone had mopped it with dirty water. Think sticky dive bar floor... except there’s no bar here.To be fair, the check-in process was smooth, possibly because I’m an HH Diamond member. It was on par with any standard Hilton property.  Nothing special, but no complaints there.The elevator? Old, with crust around the buttons that have definitely seen better decades.I will give credit where it’s due: the room and bathroom were larger than average, which was a welcome surprise. Unfortunately, that alone doesn’t make up for the lack of basic amenities and the tired condition of the property overall.

reviews.title: Excellent Location in Vegas
reviews.text: This resort is across the pool from the main Flamingo Hotel & resort, so easy access to the strip, restaurants and casino.

reviews.title: Made Vegas stay palatable
reviews.text: Not a big fan of Vegas, I just was in town for a series of shows at the Sphere and this place fit the bill perfectly for what I was looking for.  Walking distance to the Sphere (maybe half a mile), clean, quiet, safe, non-smoking.  It’s very close to the strip and the Linq promenade for dining and other entertainment.  It’s a good room with microwave and fridge.  The staff shines.  I needed a length of stay adjustment and is was handled expertly, correctly and whoever left the notes on the reservation explained it perfectly so that there was no issues.  When checking out Brisa (sp?) at front desk instinctively knew to offer me a facilities pass so I could use the hotel amenities until my midnight flight.  The pool area was a great place to relax - I almost forgot I was in Vegas.  If ever in town again, this would be my first choice to stay.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite timeshare resorts to stay at but this particular visit was not as great due to the Flamingo Go Pool being close while under construction.

reviews.title: Excellent option
reviews.text: Very good location, of the lobby in 3 min you are in the Flamingo and in about 5 more in the strip, it is something expensive, as well as your daily fees, which is like paying any parking of the strip but it is worth, very large the room, there is dining room with 4 chairs and like 4 armchairs, the kitchen comolet, large jacuzzi and double vanity 👍🏼

reviews.title: Great rooms housekeeping and facilities
reviews.text: Great connecting rooms giving a real two bedroom apartment feel.  Housekeeping cameDaily and we’re really attentive so very pleased.The two rooms were amazing sizes and the kitchen has full facilities the washer and dryer being a godsend and saving hours at home washing.  The hotel is basic but has everything we needed. The pool and hot tub are great but cannot imagine the noise when go pool is back open.  Hotel staff all friendly reallyHelpful would definitely return it’s an ideal location

reviews.title: Fantastic resort.
reviews.text: We stayed for 7 days in a one bedroom unit. Fantastic location with an easy and safe 3 minute walk to the Flamingo. All staff gave exceptional service with easy and quick check in. Great value for the quality provided.

reviews.title: Great location, very spacious rooms
reviews.text: Had 5 nights here with a group of friends; very comfortable stay in spacious well appointed rooms. Getting a little dated regarding decor, but no complaints in that. Major renovations and noise at 6.30am on the pool area outside wasn’t so appreciated…Would stay again for the price and location balance of factors. Good parking nearby also

reviews.title: Resort Fees at Timeshare Properties are a Big Rip-Off
reviews.text: Beautiful property but they've caved into the Las Vegas disease of charging a resort fee. Since this is a timeshare property, adding a resort fee is charging twice.

reviews.title: Good with a catch
reviews.text: Overall the hotel is nice, clean and seems to be maintained in spite of being a bit older. Staff was all helpful and friendly. My disappointment was the description on the hotel site stating there is an on-site restaurant. Technically I guess you could call the little convenience store a restaurant since they put a table in the corner, but otherwise it's just a little convenience store where you can pick up some decent coffee and other supplies from about 6am until early afternoon. If you want food that doesn't involve room preparation from a microwavable package, you'll have to go offsite.

reviews.title: Perfect off-strip hotel
reviews.text: I had stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacation by the Flamingo 3 years ago and decided to go back.  The room is spacious with everything that one needs, especially if you want to make your own food.  The fridge is a bit small for a family of 4 but perfect for a single or couple.  Coffee machine, microwave, sink, dishes, cutlery, everything that one needs to manage breakfast or a quick lunch in the room.Towels, soaps, shampoo all standard fare.   Blackout drapes, large bathtub as well as separate stall shower.  In the morning from am till 13:30 they operate a small coffee shop with various foods one can buy for breakfast or snacks.Even though I had paid in advance for a 7 night stay, and had requested checkin by  14:00, I was only given the room at 14:45 since they only guarantee room checkin by 16:00.  Since this is a time share hotel, I assume priority is given to people with a timeshare vs standard guests.

reviews.title: Dated but spotless clean and a good location.
reviews.text: The 1 bedroom was spotless clean and very comfortable. Fully equipped kitchen and large bathroom with bathtub to unwind. The whole hotel is a bit dated but everything was super clean !There is a pool area that is under construction over at the Flamingo Hotel but I did not hear anything from the construction site. The small hotel pool at the HGV was open though. There is also a small convenience market but it has only limited opening hours and a very small assortment of items.It is a very short walk over to the Flamingo Casino & Hotel with shows, Starbucks, bars, and food options. Few minutes over to the Boulevard with the High Roller Wheel and perhaps a 15 minutes walk to the Sphere. It is overall a good location and usually guests can also use the Go Pool at the Flamingo Casino/Hotel (under construction at the moment).

reviews.title: Great location on the strip
reviews.text: The accommodation was perfect. The room was so spacious and had a decent kitchen. With a washing machine, dryer and a big bath.  We never had any issues with noise. Location was great with lots of casino's close by and the strip. A pleasant stay and would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.text: Cleanliness is exceptional, kitchenette, washer and dryer, beautiful suites. The fitness center is spotless and offered everything we needed. Beds and furniture cozy and clean. The staff is SO accommodating!!! Free bottled water and movie rental. They made us feel like we were at home, only better!

reviews.title: Great location on the strip.
reviews.text: I have been staying here for the past several years when I come to Las Vegas for my professional conference. The location is so perfect and the resort is clean and well run. I like that there is no casino in the same building as that makes it seem more restful. But it is just steps from all the action on the strip. Highly recommended

reviews.title: LV Gem
reviews.text: We stayed 2 Weeks in an Updated 2B/2B ADA Condo. Both King Bedrooms had beautiful large Bathrooms but small step in showers.  The Entire Staff was always Cheerful. This quiet Property felt safe & is well maintained. Easy traverse thru the Garden &  The Flamingo to the Strip or the Linq makes this a great location.

reviews.title: Car was stolen - was offered thoughts and prayers
reviews.text: I stayed at this property to attend a work conference and enjoy some time with my family. My vehicle was parked in the shared garage owned by flamingo with spots leased by HGV which we were told to park in. One evening I left to go to our conference dinner to find my car missing. I went to the front desk to inquire on their protocol for such events and was met with I don’t knows and wow that never happens. I initially hoped I was towed so I asked the front desk for tow company information to which they had no idea and told me to walk back to parking garage and look for a sign with information. The front desk attempted to contact their supervisor for 30 minutes while my wife waited in the lobby and I walked the parking garage but at no point during the time we waited was a supervisor ever reached. Security was also never called to assist with anything. While we sat in the lobby the front desk try to Hail Mary contact various departments within Flamingo but never got ahold of anyone and were not very transparent on what they were attempting to achieve. After 45 minutes of waiting around I walked to Flamingo to flag down in house security to see what answers they had to which officer shipman (sp?) was extremely helpful and quite honestly the only competent person we dealt with up until this time. After he did his own search of the garage and wrote his report we were instructed to call Metro to file a police report to which we did and we met in front of the hotel. It wasn’t until we were already half way through our police report that the HGV security approached us and asked what was going on but made it clear they were never alerted to a vehicle theft. Reports were made with Metro and HGV. The following afternoon I went to the front desk to talk to some sort of supervisor or manager to better understand their protocol and see where the ball was dropped. I met with Wilfredo Rodriguez ( the guest services director). Upon coming to meet me he immediately apologized for the circumstances before I could get a word out. Mind you at no point did he ever try to contact us about the situation but obviously knew the situation had occurred. I asked what their protocol was and what was actually achieved by his staff during the time frame I was waiting. He told me he was in constant contact with his front desk staff and security however during our 45 minute wait we were told repeatedly that their boss wasn’t answering and they couldn’t get ahold of anyone. Mr. Rodriguez continually deflected the blame onto Flamingo and their parking enforcement and said they would work better with them for the future. I also asked why there was no protocol in place for stuff like this and he just said I don’t know and we will use this as a learning experience for himself and his staff. My family was stuck stranded with no vehicle, no car seat and instead of going to the conference we came here to attend we were stuck doing any and all legwork to get things sorted out and find a way home. Zero options or resolutions were offered. Just apologies and deflection. Thank you Mr. Rodriguez for your thoughts and prayers. Your lack of empathy and inaction made what should have been a fun vacation and conference an absolute headache. At the very least some sort of recommendation for rental cars or compensation should have been provided rather than a “not our problem” attitude. Rest assured we will never stay here or recommend this property to anyone without our business or social network. We look forward to talking to corporate about this.

reviews.title: Quiet hotel close to The Strip
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Big rooms, very clean.  Great views in all directions.  Off the beaten path, so it was very quiet.  Easy access to The Strip through Linq Promenade, which has lots of food and shopping.  Pretty centrally located - we walked everywhere!

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time…….
reviews.text: What can I say - no food - no coffee - no pool (under construction without notice) - resort fee for the pool under construction - no offer to make it right?I am learning that Hilton has placed their name on soo many properties - maybe no one has bothered to inspect this placeWho in the world wants to stay at a resort - get charged a resort fee and the amenities are all closed?😳

reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT, STAFF & LOCATION!
reviews.text: Just had the best week at this location!  The room was perfect - updated, clean and the location was awesome!  The staff was amazing and checked in (texted) twice daily to see if we needed anything.  We will definitely go back and would definitely recommend!  ZERO complaints!

reviews.title: Week in January
reviews.text: A great location on the centre of the Las Vegas strip. Modern, spacious rooms. Very friendly staff and quick check-in process.

reviews.title: Perfect spot to stay.
reviews.text: Great place. Super friendly staff. Amazing location near everything. Good sized rooms and very tidy. Could not have been happier with our stay. If you come to vegas and are looking for a start at a reasonable price, with lovely staff as then come here.

reviews.title: Great value . Clean rooms but horrible parking
reviews.text: The rooms are very upgraded and a spacious with amenities especially for family with children unfortunate the pool was under the maintenances. The biggest downside is the parking. The first three floors are dedicated for VIPM priority and there was hardly any other parking space remaining and only six floors total. The hotel doesn't offer any entertainment but it is adjacent to flamingo.

reviews.title: We expected more, disappointed!
reviews.text: We had high hopes for this hotel.  While it was very spacious, the approach was not great.  It was very hard to navigate to the entrance.  You park in the Flamingo parking desk and then cross some busy drives to get back to a very dirty walkway at the back on the Flamingo pool.  During the day there is always a loud party, which is to be expected.  It is a loud winding walk to get to the main party of the strip.  Overall the stay was just disappointing.  It is not give us the wow that other vegas trips have.  Really wished we hadn’t tried this one.The interior of the room was nice and big but we weren’t in there that much.  The bedding was very basic and not that comfortable - pillows were really bad!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel on Las Vegas strip with spacious room and friendly staff
reviews.text: Friendly and accommodating staff. Spacious, clean guest room with shower and a bathtub and plenty of closet space. Nice selection of morning pastries etc at coffee shop . Young lady at coffee shop very nice human being. Front desk staff stay in touch with us during the stay and we’re checking on us while husband was not feeling well. Hotel location is perfect, in the middle of the strip with close access to monorail.

reviews.title: Great location and overall resort
reviews.text: The location is pretty much in the center of the strip but located behind the Flamingo so you don't hear all the noise from the strip. Our room was in the main tower and was recently updated. Not sure if the RCI pics are outdated or if some of the rooms still need to be updated but ours was nice and we were happy with the room.

reviews.title: A nice home away from home-but construction sucked this time
reviews.text: This hotel is usually my go-to when I’m in town for extended stays for work, especially during trade shows. The rooms are spacious, apartment-style, and clean, making it a comfortable choice. However, the ongoing construction was a major issue this time—it was loud and went on all night, making it impossible to get a good night’s rest. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning to this property until the construction is completed.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: Hotel was perfect location and I t was nice being away from the madness. Rooms were spacious. You can walk through the flamingo hotel to get onto the strip which is useful. It’s a none smoking hotel which was also good. They gave us vouchers for x2 bottles of water a day which was really useful. There was no resort fee either which other hotels include secretly which I thought was very good. Would definitely stay here again if I went to vegas.

reviews.title: A Fabul0us Res0rt in Las Vegas!!!!!!!
reviews.text: We highly rec0mmend this really great res0rt in Las Vegas because it is in a really great l0cati0n 0n the  strip near the High R0ller and the Linq Pr0menade. The guests r00ms are beautiful and extremely clean as well as well dec0rated.The entire staff here is amazing!!!!

reviews.title: Best Quiet Location!
reviews.text: This is one of the best locations for a resort if you want to be close to the Strip and a monorail station but far enough to have some peace to rest at the end of your day. I booked a two bedroom suite for my family-in-law (two couples). It was perfect for them, which gave two entrances to their rooms (after entering the first entrance), which gave them privacy at the end of the day. The walk to the Flamingo hotel and the Strip is a mere 5 mins walk or you can jump onto the monorail station (2 min walk) to go to either ends of the Strip. Everything you need was provided. Comfort of the bed and pillows weren't the best for us, but everyone has a preference and wouldn't put it against the resort.

reviews.title: Construction 24/7- horrible noise
reviews.text: Construction 24/7 outside - so loud we could not sleep. We could not enjoy the pool area outside because of the loud demolition equipment right next to the pool area. It was not disclosed when booking or checking in. When I said we could not sleep because of the constant noise, nothing was said or done. We were thankful we were only there for 2 nights. I expected better from a Hilton Grand Vacation property.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Loved the resort and location. Would highly recommend. The beds were wonderful, the oversized tub. Our ability to make our own coffee and breakfast before venturing out for the day. Will stay here again.

reviews.title: Construction noise and dust
reviews.text: STAY AWAY!!  The GO Pool next door is being demolished. There are numerous excavators, bobcats, backhoes and jackhammers working 24 hrs per day. Lots of noise and dust. Room was very nice, but would not stay there until project is completed.

reviews.title: Excellent stay with just 1 complaint!
reviews.text: Excellent apartment, absolutely loved it. Location is spot on, right on the strip with everything close by, monorail/sphere/strip all in walking difference. Booked through Airbnb and we was extremely pleased with our room, very big and modern. Had a jacuzzi Bath in the room which we didn’t use as we wasn’t there for too long, but great to have. Can’t fault the hotel/apartments at all.Our only issue was the guy at the reception which dealt with us after “check in” to give us a “welcome package”. We just took a 6 hour drive from LA to vegas and really didn’t need the welcome package part. After letting him know 5 times that we’re exhausted and just want to check in and go to our room (my girlfriend being pregnant too), he insisted on us having their “freebies” which just seemed like a complete and utter catch, apparently because we booked through air bnb, we was SOOO lucky and we get a credit card with $150 dollars free on it. Then we were questioned why are we only staying in vegas for 3 nights but in a very forceful way. I won’t name the workers name as I’ve already done this via air bnb, and the reason why I’m leaving these reviews is just to try and help the company learn from this as there will be lots of tourists like us that will not want this when they arrive to check in. So it’s more to try and help the hotel better on this front, but that’s the only complain from me!

reviews.title: Fantastic property with excellent location!
reviews.text: We just had a fab week at this hotel. Location is perfect , 2 mins walk from the Linq promenade with its myriad of shops bars and restaurants and a couple of mins walk to the Flamingo Hotel which brought you out straight onto the centre of the strip! We had a one bedroom suite which comprised of a spotlessly clean open plan kitchen and living area and a large bedroom with adjoining large dressing/bathroom area with 2 separate sinks/vanity areas with good quality hairdryer (ladies I know these things are important to know)  and light up mirrors. Every amenity was provided including an iron and ironing board separate washer and dryer complete with detergent that was replenished after use, ample dishes/glassware and a large fridge freezer which was perfect for keeping drinks cold and storing ice from the ice machine down the hall. We attended 2 concerts in the Sphere and Dolby live and this property was perfectly located for both. 10 mins easy walk to the sphere and 3 stops on the monorail (located at the flamingo) for Dolby live . We were a little nervous before arrival after reading reviews about noise from the adjacent Go pool at the flamingo 🦩, but were delighted to find it had already closed for the season so the room was extremely peaceful and we experienced no noise at all from other guests. It is also entirely non smoking and has a beautiful garden/pool area which is ideal for relaxing in away from the hustle and bustle of the main strip. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking to be close to the centre of the action but needing a peaceful retreat to return to at the end of the day. As a final added bonus resort fees are only 25 dollars a day compared to almost twice that quoted by some other properties and includes complementary bottles of water each day. We won’t be staying anywhere else when we return to Vegas!

reviews.title: Vegas Sept vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful property with incredible location to everything!Love that it takes literally two minutes to walk to the promenade and great food choices like in & out burger, Gordon Ramsays fish and chips and also live entertainment like the piano bar at Harrahs.Fast and friendly check in Nice pool with great music My favourite place to stay when I’m in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text: Close to strip , quiet at night , days can be noisy if Flamingo Go pool open . Rooms spacious , comfortable bed, all rooms overlook pool area . Definitely would stay again .

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean & Close to the Strip
reviews.text: My husband & I stayed here for my conference which was held at Caesar's Palace.   I was able to walk to Caesar's about 15 min. away.   The HGV is in a great location.  We had booked a king room.  It was a good choice for us since the room had a small kitchen with a coffee pot, microwave, refrigerator, a toaster, plates & utensils.   This way we could do breakfast in the room, have coffee & save our leftovers from eating out.   We were close to the Linq Promenade which had a number of restaurants (recommend Virgil's ) as well as the Ferris wheel.    The pool & hot tub were nice but the music from the Flamingo Hotel was loud.   There's a nice shop in  HGV where you can get coffee, snacks, sandwiches, beverages, etc.  Parking was in a garage nearby & was free.   All of the staff were excellent!

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: I have been going there with my wife for almost 20 years.  It is clean, well staffed and maintained, updated when needed.  One of the high points are the staff, their greatest asset.  The front desk will accommodate your special requests if possible.  We love staying there.  The two cons are the parking garage and the noise from the Flamingo Pool.  On the dot at 12 noon , thump thump thump starts.  You cannot sit out at the HGV pool without getting a headache from the noise.  You cannot carry on a conversation at the pool.  It totally destroys the experience and admittedly prompted us to try other HGV properties in LV where we may frequent more in the future.  The parking garage:  The bar code cards dont work some of the time.  Nothing is intuitive.  Cars cant get out and they back up into the garage.  Too much valet reserved parking which never gets used forcing you up one to two more floors.  There should be someone stationed there at all times for help and for security.  On several occasions, homeless were blocking the stairs, eating and it was hard to get by them. Not the sort of image and situation you want to project.  Late at night it is a desolate place.  Would be nice to have some security there.  The problem with parking and the pool:  I do believe that the Flamingo and HGV Flamingo are both owned by Caesars so dont expect anything to change. My happiest day will be when then announce the demolition of the Flamingo to build another super resort in its place.  At least the din of music will stop for several years and be replaced by construction noise which will be an improvement over the decibel drunk DJ at the pool.

reviews.title: Nice but noisy
reviews.text: The hotel is in a good location. It’s a few minute walk to the monorail which gives you access to the convention center and downtown. The lobby is unassuming, the elevators are old, but the spacious rooms are clean and tasteful. The one problem was that if you want to enjoy  your room anywhere between 9am and 5:30pm there is a very loud and deep throbbing music that plays at the pool, which is directly out the window of all of the rooms. The front desk said there’s no rooms that are away from the music and they offered earplugs.  Earplugs are of no use.

reviews.title: Quiet and spacious hotel close to the Strip
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel right off the strip.  It's a suite hotel and has a full kitchen.  The rooms were very clean and spacious.  Housekeeping keeps everything stocked and the front desk is helpful.  You have your own hotel pool, but can also us the GoPool at the Flamingo hotel.  The parking is free which was a bonus.  The hotel is quiet and well designed.  It's also steps away from the Monorail, the High Roller wheel and a street filled with great restaurants which are moderately priced.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Arrived on a Friday afternoon. Upon checking in they said since we were diamond hilton members they were upgrading our room to a suite. Room was amazing. This hotel is in a perfect location. It’s right next to the linq and it has outdoor dining and bars and shops. It’s across the street from the bellagio and ceasers palace. And the grounds are beautiful. They have flamingos 🦩 and a bunch of other birds turtles 🐢 and an amazing pool. Highly recommend. Great for families.

reviews.title: Great Hotel & Location
reviews.text: We have just returned from a lovely 6 night stay here. As Hilton gold card members we were upgraded to a third floor suite. This meant we had a large bedroom with comfortable large bed and huge TV and safe, en suite bathroom & separate shower room with Crabtree & Evelyn lotions, lounge with another large TV and DVD player - we had voucher for DVDs that we could get in reception. There was a full kitchen including dishwasher and large coffee machine with coffee replenished every day when the room was cleaned. It was a bonus to have a washing machine, even supplied us with small Tide powder. The air conditioning was very efficient and it was great to come into after a morning exploring - it was 40C outside! I had read reviewed about the noise from the neighbouring hotel’s Go Pool but we could hardly hear it in our room. It was a different story outside but only from 1000hrs to 1800hrs and our hotel pool was lovely to sit round and enjoy the music. There was complimentary access to Go Pool but it did not appeal. The one surprise with our pool is that there was no poolside shower outside nor in the gym changing room! We spoke to staff about this & were advised that they had been removed due to lack of use. This did mean that although the hotel allowed us to use the pool once we had checked out on our final day we could not shower before our evening flight. This was disappointing. Checkout is at 1000hrs but Carlos the manager agreed to late check out 1230hrs. We were able to leave our luggage securely and went to lunch and stayed indoors. All the staff were lovely and pleasant to deal with. At the time of booking we did not realise this was a timeshare hotel and we were regularly asked to attend a talk but as this did not interest us we did not bother & they were fine about that. There is a small shop & cafe open in the morning. It is nice to be in non smoking environment without a casino. The hotel is amazingly close to the Strip and despite the heat we walked most places. We did use the monorail to get to MGM to see Ka (highly recommend) and the bus to get to Fremont St and the shopping outlet mall. It was a short Uber ride from the airport to the hotel. However Uber do not pick you up from hotel but Lyft will, so we used them for the return trip to the airport. We are planning to return to Las Vegas as part of a fly drive holiday & will consider staying here in view of its amenities, great location and the free car parking it offers.

reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: One of our party had a medical emergency while we waited for our room. The Staff’s response was very reassuring, great job following their protocol while still being compassionate. Security Crew was great. Rooms and grounds were very clean and a great smoke free stay close to the Sphere. Thank you.

reviews.title: Great staff great location
reviews.text: The staff was Super friendly, all areas were very clean, the location is perfect its in the middle of everything walking distance. Pool areas were great very safe to walk. The rooms had everything you may need to cook super comfortable and the bed are so cozy.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This hotel is beautifully kept. Outside, inside, rooms, and all. The hotel lobby lacks cool air, so when you need to escape the outside lobby is not it. However, the rooms have great air. Extremely close to the monorail, maybe 1 min. King bad was comfortable and pillows are very plush. Pool area is very quiet but over all good. I would definitely come again

reviews.title: Clean and Friendly
reviews.text: Family friendly resort. One of our top 3 best resort. Very clean and friendly. From the trash room to the pool, they’re always clean. The resort has a gym and a sauna. Not a lot of resort have a sauna. No need to rent a car because everything is close by. Literally, 8-10 minutes from the strip and LINQ Promenade Absolutely love this resort. Will definitely come back again with my family. ♥️

reviews.title: A great alternative away from the big casino hotels
reviews.text: If you are looking for a slightly quieter hotel with great rooms, this is the right place! Great location to the Sphere and the High Roller, both within walking distance. The rooms are well equipped with Small kitchenette and large bathroom with shower and bathtub.

reviews.title: Great property
reviews.text: The service at this property is excellent! The room was beautiful and having a kitchen saved us so much money. There is some noise from the Go Pool (club pool at the Flamingo) from 12pm-6pm everyday but it wasn’t a problem for us. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Outstanding staff all around. Great location. Great suites for families.
reviews.text: Large suite for our family and toddlers was great. So helpful to have them sleep in another room and still be able to be up without waking them up. Kitchen with full fridge and dishwasher was a plus and the in unit laundry was perfect so we didn't have to pack as much.All staff was extremely helpful and kind. From the front desk to the bellman to the cleaning crew, all were attentive, kind, and go above and beyond. For example Carlos, the night manager, was so helpful that he let us borrow his own personal phone charger when one of my family members forgot their iPhone cord. So kind and looking to help and make the stay as great as possible. All in all a great stay for families with amazing staff. Also close walking distance for everything.

reviews.title: First Time in Vegas
reviews.text: I would recommend this location to anyone.  Conveniently located, transportation was close to Monorail, Taxis and walking distance to many locations. The Staff ware friendly and helpful. The rooms were large and clean with full kitchen and all amenities.  I would stay here again when visiting Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent accommodation
reviews.text: The Flamingo Hilton Grande Vacations Club Las Vegas exceeded our expectations. Very comfortable room. Equipped with all good quality home items. Free parking is available. Private pool. Allows access to the Flamingo pools. Excellent location near the Strip. I recommend and intend to return!!!

reviews.title: Excellent location and resort
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL
reviews.text: Beautiful simple hotel, very well maintained, very quiet as it has no casino and you do not see that riot of people coming and going, it is ideal for families. We stayed 5 people, hired 2 adjoining rooms that communicated with each other forming an apt complete 1 room with 2 large beds and a sofa bed and the other room with a king bed, dining room with sofa bed, full kitchen oven, dishwasher, washer and dryer, etc.It really is how they look in the photos on the hotel page.The staff is very friendly, the cleanliness, the market, everything excellent.The location is ideal, you get well in the middle of the strip.I would return without hesitation

reviews.title: Great stay in a great location!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay at the Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo.  We had booked two units (a 2 bedroom and 1 bedroom) and they were a great size and configuration for our family.  The hotel staff was excellent, and messaged often to see if there was anything we needed.  They were incredibly responsive with all of our requests, bringing extra towels and addressing a leaking shower when we asked about it within minutes.  The bellmen were very helpful with bringing up groceries and deliveries.  The free parking and proximity to the Tesla supercharger couldn't be beat.  This location could not be beat.  Staying right near the flamingo, we had easy access to the Flamingo, monorail, Caesar's Horseshoe/Paris and withing a short walk of the Linq Promenade and Planet Hollywood.  The private pool at the HGV was open until 10 which was nice when it was so hot.  We had access to the Flamingo pool as well, although the kids were a little less impressed since the bulk of their pool is 21+ (which is to be expected in Vegas).  Overall we had an absolutely great stay here and I would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone!

reviews.title: Mmy Vegas Experience
reviews.text: No complaints of any kind. Loved everything about this place. Comfortable sleeping & the staff were very sufficient.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: A really great location just off the strip. I was trying to avoid staying at a casino hotel and walking through all the smoke. This HGV location was a great choice -- I was pleasantly surprised. The room was in good shape and comfy, the gym had a good selection of equipment, and it was really quiet in the evenings. Perfect! It would be great if the hotel shop had longer hours, but that's minor. I was traveling solo, but would recommend this for families too. The pool was heated and not crowded like the resort pools tend to be.

reviews.title: Great location, nice rooms
reviews.text: This small, non casino property is all about location. An easy walk to the strip, The Sphere and The Linq.  Like other reviewers mentioned, the noise from the Flamingos pool is intense. We were on the 17th floor, and even with ear plugs were unable to drown out the base beat in the afternoon. If you need to work from your room, or sleep during the day, this might be a problem. Otherwise, the rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable and bathrooms are fine. We will stay here again.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: This facility is well kept, staff is very friendly and helpful, centrally located within the Strip, easy to walk anywhere needed.

reviews.title: The worst hotel I have ever stayed in.
reviews.text: Absolutely the most horrific hotel I have ever stayed in.  The smell is beyond awful, the rest is worse.  I'm required to write 200 words for this review, and I don't even have anything else to say.  Avoid at all costs, anything is better than this.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: The location is great, free parking, friendly staff. The noise from the pool music can be draining,but it doesn't last long and is done early. The resort amenities nice.

reviews.title: It’s a NO for me!
reviews.text: The good: Location on the strip is perfect. Rooms are beautiful and clean.  Love the kitchen.  Meals in Vegas are pricey so it’s nice to be able to buy some groceries and eat right in your room.  Walmart will deliver the groceries so it’s super convenient.  The bad:  The GO pool plays SUPER LOUD MUSIC from 10 to 6 daily.  We were on the 16th floor and it was impossible to take a nap during those hours.  It’s fine if you don’t plan on being in your room at that time but c’mon this is a nighttime town and  naps are nice to prepare for the evenings out.  Some of the units may not be as affected as ours was, but because of the noise WE WILL NOT STAY HERE AGAIN.

reviews.title: Always a great place to stay.
reviews.text: As owners we visit this facility annually from UK. The suites are wonderful and have everything you need.  Especially, we like the opportunity to use the BBQ’s around the pool area. We spend ten days there when we visit and the time goes so quickly.  The staff are wonderful especially reception and bellhops.  Have to say that Marcelo in the pool area is outstanding. He has so much pride in his job and a total credit to the company. The only person who seems sullen and unhelpful year after year is the elderly lady in the Market Place.  She really has a dreadful attitude and seems out of place for the friendly vacation resort. Rooms are great, well equipped and parking opposite at the Flamingo Casino is free.  Can’t wait for next year and hopefully by then a certain person will have had some customer training.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel! Great Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: This place was amazing! At first I thought I would be staying at the regular flamingo but this was a way better experience. The hotel is just a short walkway away from the flamingo pool and casino. And of course you have access to the 21+ pool and the kiddie pool from the flamingo. The hotel was cute and quiet (except for when the pool party was happening) and everyone was super friendly. Leo took care of me and my family the whole trip and he was amazing and professional. I had a big family trip and they made sure we got all 3 of our rooms together and we were able to see the Sphere from the outside of the hotel room. The shower was amazing and the water got really hot really fast which was perfect. I would definetly come back here when I go back to vegas. I usually stay in a hotel with. Casino but this was almost better since the casino it right next to us. And we dont have to ruckus of crazy drunk people and cigarette smoke everywhere.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
reviews.text: This resort is a well located property offering all facilities including its own pool. Our 1 bedroom apartment was generous in size and was well maintained. The property offers centre posion to the strip enabling easy walking distance to most attractions

reviews.title: The Best Vocation in Flamingo Hilton Grand Vocation Club , Las Vegas
reviews.text: the great point was a room with separated enviroments and modern furniture .The hotel localization is near all the things you need near Strip . There are a park free around Hotel .

reviews.title: Great Location, Nice, Clean Resort
reviews.text: We loved the location of the resort as it was very close to everything on the strip.  We stayed in 2 BR/2Bath and had plenty of space.  Our rooms were very clean, updated and spacious and had everything we needed. Staff was very attentive and friendly.  We will be staying there again.

reviews.title: HGV at the Flamingo needs work
reviews.text: As an HGV owner, have been staying at HGV at the Flamingo for years and cannot help but notice a few deteriorations.  Rooms are fine-comfortable.  Don't even mind the loud music from the Go pool.  Location is great! Areas for improvement: pool bar closed during the pandemic and was never brought back-epic fail because people come to have fun and enjoy cocktails around the pool.  BYOB is fine but not the same experience as having cocktails served. Martina is long gone but she was phenomenal.  Find another Martina!  Thee  odor from the grease pit at the Flamingo is horrible around the pool.  My husband did a look see and noticed the cover for grease trap is cracked and emitting horrible odor. Pressure needs to be put on Flamingo to get that repaired.  The stench is unbearable at times.  Health violation I am sure.  No restaurant on sight which is fine but the snack shop is only open until 1:30 in the afternoon!  Needs to be open all day.  And Sharon in the snack shop needs to get a personality-soooo rude and unwelcoming.  Please Hilton-step up your game.  As owners, we pay a lot of money for your resort packages.  This does not feel like a resort at all anymore-just a conveniently located hotel.

reviews.title: Great Resort, Close to the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: We stayed in two 2 BR units. It was perfect for our family trip! Location is perfect. The units were clean and comfortable. Beds were great and kitchen has all the needed items. Parking is across the driveway. Handicapped parking is right outside the main door. The resort staff was very kind and helpful! We will stay here again!

reviews.title: Lovely and quiet
reviews.text: Perfect hotel for a quieter stay in Vegas. It was much nicer than the ‘wild party scene’ of the flamingo next door. The rooms were lovely and big, comfy bed, great showers, kitchen adequate but only had a microwave to do any cooking. Everything was spotless, lovely and quiet. Pool was beautiful unlike the one next door. Very short walk to the strip just a couple of minutes. Good parking, good check in / check out - no queues. Would definitely recommend for those who like a more grown up feel and not looking for the alcohol infused pool party!

reviews.title: FANTASTIC...for ole folks!!!
reviews.text: If you want calm, convenience and a good deal...this gem is next to the Flamingo hotel but a block off the middle of the strip.  It is ideal for "older" guests.  You can walk to many restaurants and sites on and off the strip.  There is no casino (therefore no cig smoke) inside so the lobby is uncongested with quick access to the desk.  All staff were remarkably friendly and welcoming, offering 2 free bottles of water daily and a discount card for various restaurants/sites.  We used it to visit the mob museum.  The pool is small but we never saw it packed, plus you have access to the Flamingo party pool which plays loud music from ~10am-5pm.  It was heard from our room but easy to tune out and not disruptive.  I think most rooms are suites with a kitchenette and usual appliances including a washer and dryer.  There is a sitting space next to it with a sofa bed and large TV.  The bedroom is separate with a large bathroom with 2 separate sinks and huge jetted tub.  Housekeeping is sparse since it's considered a resort not a hotel.  We're green and  didn't need anything for a 3 night stay although housekeeping did offer service once.  All Uber pickups are at the Flamingo area which is less than a 2 minute walk from the lobby thru the pool, longer from outside the lobby front.  However, a few may drop you off at the front.  Once you're acclimated, you may ask the driver to make a quick right turn toward the lobby before arriving to the Flamingo drop-off.  Since there are many Hiltons, BE SURE to select the one associated with the Flamingo Hotel on the app.  Give yourself extra time when using Uber at dinner time.  The nice restaurants [Fleming's and Redwood Steakhouse (awesome cioppino!!!!!)] we arrived at between 5-545 had many tables open.  I'm sure the famous ones are busier at that time.  There is a marketplace offering various small items including a few flavors of Starbucks coffee.  I didn't see a bar so not sure if available.  Now, a BIG tip for ladies.  Be sure NOT to let their hairdryer touch you if you're wearing a shirt made of thin acrylic or similar material.  My wife did that and burned a few small holes in her shirt, BIG tip, no? :)  As a retired couple, we wanted a calm setting with great access to many sites.  A relatively good rate was a bonus.  We were very impressed with this Hilton and plan on staying here again.  Cheers!

reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.text: The resort was a quick walk to the strip.  The unit was very clean and spacious.  We order groceries from a nearby grocery store and had them delivered with no issues.  Staff was very courteous and helpful.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort but with " Noise Issues"
reviews.text: Well a  great resort in a fantastic  location. But the adjoining Flamingo adult "GO POOL" for adults is something to be reckoned with your stay here.  From Noon to 5:00 PM they play very loud booming, sometimes obscene  music. Forget taking a nap in your room. I would bring kids here or in the Flaming Hotel.

reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation-5 star xperience !!
reviews.text: We just returned from a wonderful week at HGV Club Flamingo Las Vegas. The staff were courteous , accommodating and professional. They did everything possible to insure that we had everything we needed. Our unit was very clean and attractively decorated. It felt like a home away from home. We loved it. We plan to make this our go to place to stay when visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: All VIP
reviews.text: We loved the ease of enjoying all the amenities, the very comfortable rooms, the access to all of downtown Las Vegas and that it still kept everything private.

reviews.title: Here we go again
reviews.text: We returned once again to HGV Hilton @ Flamingo and happy to say nothing has changed still a great location mid along the strip and far enough back from the street to be peaceful.  The place was decorated for Xmas, the staff was very friendly and the rooms clean and comfortable. Great stay all the way again.

reviews.title: This Hilton is an Excellent place to stay. We have stayed at 7 time share locations in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: We just stayed here last week for 7 nights in the 2 Bedroom Suite. This was our 2nd stay here with suite upgrades being done since our last visit. Everything was EXCELLENT! The size of the suite was great for 4 adults. The air conditioning was perfect with separate controls for each bedroom. The beds were super comfortable for a good night's sleep. The full kitchen was perfect with all the major appliances (that worked well with no issues) for having breakfast in the morning and then being able to take off for the day as well as having cold beverages and snacks in the evening. The suite was nicely clean with Housekeeping coming by mid week to do a bedding / towel change and touch up cleaning. The staff was very helpful and a shout out to "Fontaine" at the front desk for the excellent service! The onsite pool is heated which is good for this time of year. The location of this Hilton is Fantastic as it is central on The Strip. There is a covered parking ramp building on site. Be prepared for a $25 + tax daily Resort Fee which is also mentioned on their website, The only con and "no fault of the Hilton" is the music noise from the pool located at the Flamingo Hotel Casino. It gets loud from about 8:30 am - 5:00 pm and seems to get cranked up louder during Friday to Sunday. We will stay here again. Peter MaliniakAlberta, Canada

reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. The front desk staff especially, Leo are wonderful. The location is great, in the middle of all the fun. The rooms were very nice and comfortable. The only negative was no napping was possible. The bass from the pool music was very loud. If I had the right ear plugs it might have been better.

reviews.title: Great stay in the middle of the action!
reviews.text: This resort is a gold crown award winner for a reason. The customer service was on point. Check in smooth and with a smile. They made you feel like they were happy you were there. Every time you walked in the property door we were greeted. After each desk interaction question, we were asked if we wanted water. I was asking about a grocery store close by and the lady at the Experiences desk suggested doing grocery delivery!  We had a two bedroom unit. One thing that is really nice is the two units are joined together with a foyer. The foyer has another locking door to the hallway. So if you are sharing your lodging each side can separately control their temperature and can enter exit without bothering each other. The beds were comfortable. Huge bathtubs! Kitchen was very well appointed. Just very comfortable. As other reviews mentioned, you can hear the bass from the music played at the Flamingo Go pool. We were on the 11th floor. At first, I thought it would be annoying, but it ended up not being that big of deal. They would turn music on at 9:00am and you could hear it but not too much. At noon, the DJ kicked it up a notch. It all shut down by 6:00pm. I brought ear plugs just in case and never used them. Other than the bass noise, the building was one of the quietest properties I have ever stayed in. You could not hear anyone above us or in the hallway. They have their own pool that is open until 10:00pm. You hear the "Go" pool dance music from 9 - 6 but peaceful after that.

reviews.title: A quiet place in a hectic city.
reviews.text: We stayed during the week and it was a calm, quiet oasis. It is smoke free and doesn’t have a casino in the building but is a very short walk to the flamingo. The kitchen had any appliance needed so we could have a quiet breakfast or dinner depending on how our day went. Any staff we had contact with was helpful and pleasant.

reviews.title: Outdated and loud!
reviews.text: Music so loud for hours on end that the windows of the unit literally shake. The clientele of the attached Flamingo is sketchy at best.

reviews.title: Love, love, LOVED!!
reviews.text: In late March I chose the Flamingo Vacation Club to celebrate my sister friend's Bachelorette party. From my interactions with the front desk before arrival to arrival, the staff was warm welcoming and inviting. Leo, Vrisa, and their manager Will were so intentional about ensuring a great stay. I had to print somethings off (in a very specific way) and they did everything in their power to help me make this the perfect bachelorette weekend. The newly renovated rooms were beautiful and the deep soaker bathrooms were a dream. I recommend this stay for anyone staying for any celebration or family excursion in Vegas!

reviews.title: Renovated, cosy hotel near Strip
reviews.text: We stayed in 1-bedroom unit and we liked it! The apartment was renovated, spacious, kitchen was well updated and overall the unit was cosy and worked well for us. Location was very good, not in the middle of the busy Strip, but in short walking distance from the Strip. Good experience!

reviews.title: Big Rooms
reviews.text: Excellent rooms with suite layout (full kitchen & table). Friendly staff & nice pool area. Only complaint was no breakfast for Honors members. Location convenient to many restaurants & attractions on the strip (but hotel is NOT on the strip).

reviews.title: Great Stay at Hilton Flamingo
reviews.text: Stayed at this property in April 2024 in a 1 bedroom suite.  One of the nicest stays I’ve had in Las Vegas (my 6th visit).  I was a little concerned it was not on the strip but it’s directly behind the Flamingo so distance off strip is negligible! Short walk to Linq and Caesar’s across the street.  It was a nice change to have access to a kitchen.  It had a full sized fridge which is an upgrade to the mini fridges in most standard rooms. Loved having two sinks and the bathroom setup was ideal with two separate entrances.  Would stay here again .

reviews.title: Central to Everything
reviews.text: Great location and smoke free! The rooms were great for a family with one room being the living room and kitchen with a bedroom and huge jetted bathtub and the other room a quiet oasis with a deep tub and comfortable bed. The pool was great since our kids are too young for the Flamingo’s Go Go party pool. The monorail is right there and the Highroller and Linq Promenade are next door.  Seeing the Sphere change is incredible and very close to the property. We will stay here on our next visit without question!

reviews.title: Great view, great staff, beautiful rooms.  We will definitely be staying here again.  Close to the strip.
reviews.text: Great view, great staff, beautiful rooms.  We will definitely be staying here again.  Close to the strip.

reviews.title: Easy access to anywhere on the Strip!
reviews.text: We like the location of the Flamingo Hilton Grand Vacations, which is adjacent to the Flamingo Hotel and Casino.  It is also adjacent to a Monorail station; which is a wonderful plus.  Get a multi-day Monorail pass and go to the Stratosphere for dinner or MGM for lunch.  The Strip is your oyster!  We liked having the little store and the smaller pool, which was much more mellow that the Flamingo Casino pool.  Centrally located.  Easy access to restaurants.  A gem.

reviews.title: Great Location and Nice Resort
reviews.text: We were very happy with this resort.  The location was excellent, right next to the LINQ Promenade.  The units are very nice (we had a 2 bedroom) and the staff was always helpful with our requests.  One of our guests said the sleeper sofa in the studio was very uncomfortable.  Our only complaint was the music coming from the pool area of the Flamingo Hotel next door.  Overall, we were very happy here and would highly recommend it for a nice resort in an excellent location.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Overall this was a great place to stay and super central! We requested in advance to be away from the Flamingo Go Pool due to the other reviews about noise and this was honoured. The first few days weather wasn’t great so it wasn’t open but once it warmed up and the party started we could hear it but not too bad from our room (304). Apartment has a well equipped kitchen and easy to get Uber eats delivered. Water pressure was great for the shower. Maintenance team came quickly for issue with lights and DVD player issues (it was replaced there and then!). It’s not a smart TV so no Netflix etc but the DVD selection is new movies. Sofa bed was good but they won’t give a duvet/comforter for sofa bed only blankets which were static. Room was a bit dusty in places (bedroom telephone, clear light shades in kitchen and shower bathroom floor). Uber/taxi at flamingo few mins walk, if you use Lyft they pick up outside Grand Vacations. Bus stops and monorail not far! We went to the timeshare sales talk (we got $125 visa gift card and $50 dining/attraction voucher - not bad for a rainy day that would have been wasted) Roger and Joseph were not pushy and I was honest it wasn’t something affordable at the moment but if you’re a frequent traveler it was a good deal! At check in they give water voucher but can get water from reception wherever. On our first night we went to Jays Market which is walking distance just for the basics - next day we got an Uber to Target & Albertsons but you can also get the 202/CX bus - use the Transit app) All the staff were lovely and helpful during our whole stay!

reviews.title: If you stay on Las Vegas Strip this the place!
reviews.text: Everything at this Hilton location was handled in the best possible manner! The location on the strip, access to the Monorail are excellent.  The Staff met our every request in a very professional manner.The suite was very spacious and comfortable.

reviews.title: Unbearable noise
reviews.text: Noise from the pay to enter pool music was unbearable even from the 16th floor.  I’m not normally bothered by noise, but this was totally unacceptable. I’d never stay here again for that reason alone. Otherwise the hotel was fine and the location is good. It’s right by the monorail station and there’s lots to do within easy walking distance.

reviews.title: Fun with the Flamingos
reviews.text: Enjoyed staying here, although as a senior could not get around with poor vision, as in the past.  The employees on the front desk were the best and so were the bellmen and anybody you call for service, they were johnny on the spot.  I appreciated the early check-in because I was dog tired after the redeye flight from Detroit.

reviews.title: False advertising, no housekeeping, sewer smell....oh my!!
reviews.text: I read the first few pages of reviews before I booked this hotel and there were great reviews.  I only booked this hotel because I thought I was getting a 2 bed/2 bath/2 sofa bed suite for my family as we like to have our own sleeping spaces.  The website is very misleading because this is NOT A SUITE!  It was just 2 rooms next door to each other.  I would not have minded if there was a door in between but there wasn't.  You had to go out one room and use your key each time you wanted to go to the other side!  We also did not get housekeeping services and were supposed to because we were paying cash.  Another issue was the sofa beds were the worst I have ever seen-they were unusable.  They were so thin and you could feel the springs.  My teenagers wound up sharing a bed which is exactly what we were trying to avoid by booking this "suite".  The rooms were renovated and clean but lacked functionality.  There was no garbage in the kitchen, no hooks for towels in bathroom, bathtubs had no privacy.  The worst part of our stay was the strong sewer smell in both rooms.  When I returned home from my trip I went on TripAdvisor again and this time I searched reviews for "sewer".  OMG so many reviews came up going back many years with complaints of a sewer smell!!  I am even more annoyed now because the hotel is obviously aware of this issue and does not fix the problem.  I was staying in the north tower so I don't know if it's only in that tower or not?  I complained about housekeeping and the smell upon checkout and was reimbursed my resort fee because we didn't get housekeeping.  I was told they would notify engineering about the smell.  We were only in Vegas for a day and a half.  If it was a longer stay I definitely would've tried to get another room.
