If I knew this was an on going problem I would have made a bigger deal about it at checkout.   So disappointed!!!

reviews.title: Peaceful gem in a great location!
reviews.text: This place is a gem! It's so nice to NOT stay at a mega-casino-resort hotel, yet have access to the best features (like the pool), especially when traveling on business. Friendly staff, QUIET hotel, sparkling clean room, and a mini-kitchenette.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: This place is great.Location is very convenient for the strip, and located mid-strip so you're right "in the thick of things".The suite was very clean, modern and really well equipped suites.The staff were friendly and accomodating.I'd go back for sure.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.text: Very easy check in, helpful staff. The location was in close proximity to the strip and many restaurants and casinos. The suite was amazing and very clean. I highly recommend staying at this property if you don’t like staying at casinos. Hot tub, full kitchen, laundry, separate sleeping quarters. Excellent accommodations for a very affordable price !

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The location to the strip is great.  A short walk to all of the action,  restaurants and attractions and yet a quiet refuge as well.  Rooms are very spacious, very clean and reasonably priced. Having a full kitchen very convenient for coffee and breakfast without having to dress. Staff was great and welcoming as well.

reviews.title: Great Property!
reviews.text: Location is fantastic. Middle of the strip, easy walk to the Linq, easy access to roads if driving. Anything you want/need is close. Staff was great, onsite market was well stocked and they took us in when closed to get some items.

reviews.title: Comfortable accommodations in a good location.
reviews.text: I’m a HGVC member and typically go to Vegas once a year.  We used to stay at Elara but have chosen Flamingo as our first choice.  The primary reason is because the staff is so nice and accommodating.  It’s also in a very good location and has a pretty pool with covered patio tables and grills.  I wish they would re-open the pool bar but I understand that maybe they don’t do enough volume to justify.   The convenience store actually has a decent selection and the woman who works there is very nice.  My only hope is that one day they do a more complete update to the shower. The vanities as well as kitchens have been nicely updated, sofa bed very comfortable but the shower / commode room is getting a little nasty. Resorts get tired and this one is no exception but it’s still a solid 4/5.

reviews.title: If you are traveling with family, stay here!
reviews.text: My husband and I brought my dad to Las Vegas for his 80th birthday to visit the strip, Grand Canyon and Zion National Park. Could not have been more pleased with this hotel. Leo was extremely helpful at check in and made the process seamless. Our adjoining rooms were clean, quiet and well appointed. Housekeeping did a wonderful job refreshing them daily. The concierge desk, I wish I could remember the attendant’s name, was so helpful and attentive to our every question. My husband and I have been to Vegas many times but wanted to stay some place a little more quiet since we were traveling with my father. If you are traveling with family, you can not go wrong with this hotel! Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Vegas and beyond
reviews.text: We had a great week.  Close to the casinos and center of the strip.  Free parking for our rental car.  The staff was so helpful and friendly.  We drove to several national and state parks.  Absolutely an amazing week.

reviews.title: You Can’t Do That !
reviews.text: Arrived to a nice friendly lady who checked me in.All the normal check in information was provided.I went to my room and it was very warm (78) even though the AC was on and set to 65, Windows don’t open, so I tried powering on/off the AC, but no change. It was running, but it was not cooling. Outside was only 60.I decide to go to reception and when I entered the lift I see a very discreet notice saying that due to plumbing work, there would be no AC; Saturday, Sunday & Monday (at least) :O 3 of the 4 nights I would be there !When I mentioned this to reception their first reply was; Yes, because we are making plumbing repairs. Second response; We can give you a fan …. My response …. please transfer me to another HGVC.Initially they said they would refund my points/cash booking and I could make a new reservation. I politely told them this was not acceptable and they needed to arrange a transfer. 20 minutes later I was on my way to the Elara.I find the ‘effort’ to keep this issue undisclosed when checking in, was very deceitful !

reviews.title: location nice
reviews.text: Had to pay a daily fee of $25 since we were RCI exchange.   We are also a Hilton honors member but used RCI for the exchange.  I have never been to a resort who charged me.  I am already paying for my week on top of it adding another fee.

reviews.title: Excellent Property
reviews.text: This location is one of the best. Resort staff is wonderful, it is very clean and accessible. We love the heated pool and the hot tub that was actually HOT!  I do wish the on-site market had better hours.

reviews.title: Nice suite and property with convenient proximity to the Strip.
reviews.text: I came out for a week long training that was being held in Ceasars Palace. The location was far enough away from from the Strip so I wasn't bothered by the noise or lights, but close enough I was able to walk to multiple locations of interest off Las Vegas Blvd.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Great location. Clean settings and nice staff. If the downstairs cafeteria can open longer hours that will be a plus(only opened till 1pm when we were staying). Will stay in Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas again next time when visiting Vegas. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Hilton grand vacations at the Flamingo
reviews.text: The room was great with fabulous views. Shower pressure was poor. The expensive resort fees charged here were surprising. We’d stayed there before and never charged resort fees. Over $300 AUD per week. It seems Vegas is still in recovery mode and tourists are paying for it.

reviews.title: Best Hotel I ever stayed in .
reviews.text: Location excellent,  staff excellent,  extremely clean , exceptional work done by cleaners . Very peaceful and excellent night's sleeping . A 10 out of  10 experience.  Will book again next year . Can't wait to stay here  again .

reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.text: Clean, spacious and comfortable! Great location! Horrible LOUD pool music, but it ends at 5:00.One of their bellman, Gigs, made our stay even better by his smile and friendliness.Enjoyed the smaller family pool! Stayed away from loud, crazy party pool, the Go Pool.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Excellent resort in the middle of everything. We can’t wait to come back. The staff was fantastic and the resort was amazing and very clean. We were on the flamingo property and we only heard the music while we in the pool. We could not any noise while in our room. It was great!

reviews.title: Great spot.
reviews.text: Spent a week on an exchange in a two bedroom unit.  It appears to be recently updated and was very clean.  Staff (front desk and bell staff) were very accommodating and personable perhaps with the exception of the young man who actually checked us in. He only seemed interested in us giving up a two bedroom which we had booked and when we choose to keep what we booked he seemed disinterested in us.The bass pounding from the adjacent Go Pool at the Flamingo could wear on you.  It is very central to the strip; just removed enough to escape the crowd.

reviews.title: Excellent Location in Las Vegas Area
reviews.text: The Hotel is perfectly located in Las Vegas Area, close to everything but not inside the casinos, with the commodity to have a kitchen and the freedom to prepare meals and have beverages inside the room

reviews.title: Great place! But well…
reviews.text: It’s a shame. This place, the rooms, amenities, staff… all top notch. Really. No complaints. It’s just the pool music is relentless. It’s like a jackhammer in your head. Also, they put their pool conveniently next to the place where the building next door off gases their sewage. Yeah. But if you have no plans on staying there all day or using the pool, it’s wonderful.

reviews.title: Best Stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: This was without a doubt the best place we have ever stayed at in Las Vegas, and we will definitely be back!The location is absolutely perfect... a block off the strip, through the Flamingo and right by the Linq Promenade and the High Roller observation wheel.  The free parking was great - in the garage shared with the Flamingo, with a pass to scan to get in and out.  We had the 1 king-bed suite which was AWESOME.  King bed, bathroom with soaking tub, separate shower and 2 large vanities.  The kitchen area was fully stocked and had a full fridge, stove, convection/microwave, and sink.  The view was good (we had a pool view), but the location was truly the best.  A short walk to the strip and you're in the center of everything, and you could even hop on to the monorail at the Flamingo station very easily.The service was impeccable... Leo at the front desk was great at check in after a long day of travel, and all of the staff was friendly and helpful.  The free water was a nice touch for days with long walks!  I know some others have posted about the noise from the pool, which you can definitely hear.  However, that's pretty much during the daytime only, and we were out and about so we really had no issue with that.  At night, it was quiet and perfect for getting a great night's sleep after a long day.We will never look elsewhere anytime we come back to Las Vegas.  This place is a definite gem and beats any hotel/casino on the Strip for sure. Thanks to the Hilton Grand Vacations Flamingo staff and team for such an amazing property and for a great stay for our vacation.  5-stars for sure!

reviews.title: A GREAT RESORT
reviews.text: I have stayed at this resort many times.  It only gets better each time.  The staff is great especially Leo at the Front Desk, he is a treasure. The location is wonderful just off the middle if the Strip.  Very convenient.

reviews.title: Awesome staff, excellent location, lots of noise
reviews.text: The staff is excellent - everyone I interacted with was incredibly friendly and considerate. The rooms are excellent - our suite was spotless, the full kitchens are a nice feature and the sofa bed is comfortable. Our suite had 2 doors that require a key card for entry, I liked that our suite did not open directly into the hallway. You share the mini-foyer with a neighbor though, and you can hear your neighbors coming and going very loudly. The location is excellent - right behind the Flamingo, with a Metro stop. There is a garden path from the hotel lobby that will take you to the Flamingo valet circle; at that point you either have a short walk through the Flamingo's casino or down an alley to reach the strip; I recommend the casino as the alley had a lot of traffic and smelled bad. The big issue - the noise. This hotel owns the fact that you can clearly and loudly hear the Flamingo pool's club music all day from 9am to 6pm; the front desk told me on check-in about the music, they were very up-front about it. However, after the Flamingo's pool music stopped, around 7pm I started clearly hearing a different source of loud club music; I have no idea where it was coming from but it lasted until about midnight. I was staying in the southern-most tower facing the Flamingo & Drai's, for reference.The noise is the only downside that I experienced in this hotel, but it is a big one. The fact that everything else was excellent is why this review has 4 stars and not lower.

reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: When visiting Vegas the strip is exciting but when you need that resort feel to relax and get away from it all this is the place to come to. Our rooms were beautiful and well maintained. Beautiful pool area. We will return.

reviews.title: Perfect and very quiet 2min from the Strip
reviews.text: Very good hotel, located 2 minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, with much more tranquility than any casino hotel on the Strip, which is appreciated after an intense day of sightseeing. The reception staff are very friendly and attentive, they provide water every day.The room was comfortable and very spacious. Clean. Free parking next door, something also very important in this area since the prices are otherwise very high.Outdoor and heated pool in case you go outside of the summer season.Without a doubt to repeat!

reviews.title: Great holiday, great house
reviews.text: Great house near the Linq. Great room, washing machine, dryer, bathtub, shower, fully equipped kitchen (dishwasher, stove, microwave-grill, fridge with freezer (ice cubes). Parking nearby. The pool is small but nice. The service there is amazing! Small snack shop that seems to have everything. Simply recommended! We would be happy to come back anytime.

reviews.title: HGV Flamingo has something for everyone
reviews.text: Love the  hotel, love the location.  Rooms were nice, just a couple of things that would be better.  1) The cooling seemed intermittent, I am very heat senstitive and 73-74 too hot. 2) When someone was going into adjacent room, it sounded like they were in our room. Sound proof door to room a little, 3) washer very noisy, sound proof door a little would be nice. Staff was EXCELLENT.

reviews.title: Top Notch Place Stay
reviews.text: Located close to monorail, The Linq and Flamingo.   Units are newly remodeled so extremely clean and well kept.  The staff is very welcoming and always friendly.  The location is just steps away from mid-strip.   The pool area is nice.   If you want party atmosphere you have access to the Flamingo pool.

reviews.title: Everything you need is here! I can't wait to stay here again.
reviews.text: This location was peaceful and quiet, yet a short walk from everything. It felt like home. It has a full kitchen including washer/dryer and dishwasher.  The staff was wonderful and helpful. Plenty of space too.  Hilton thought of everything!

reviews.title: Loud Pool Music and Strong Sewage Smell
reviews.text: Loud techno music from the Flamingo pool 100m away. I am unable to watch TV in my room during the day because the noise is SO BAD. Sewage smell every so often in the room. Not sure what causes it, but it’s overpowering to the point of having to leave the room. Suite itself is nice and the location is great but the room is used to sleep and leave before the loud music starts and the room starts smelling like sewage. As a HGVC owner, I Much prefer the HGVC Elara or Strip location. Even the Trump is a better option. Definitely will NOT be back.

reviews.title: Excellant
reviews.text: stay at this resort. you will not be disappointed. Everything from beginning to end was excellent. one of the best RCI resorts we have stayed at. The room was updated and very clean. The pool area was big enough but not real crowded. would come back again and again. Everything you could want in a trip to Las Vegas

reviews.title: Best place to stay .
reviews.text: We usually stay at a casino when visiting Vegas , best decision to stay. We will always stay here now . We had studio, very nice everything we need. Coffee pot , fridge , microwave and toaster , so enjoyed our beautiful room . Best front desk staff . GINA was so nice , helpful and kept in touch everyday on our needs . ❤️❤️

reviews.title: Hilton @ the Flimingo
reviews.text: Room was beautiful.  Gym was unusable.  Most parts roped off.  The Negative was the music by the Flamingo pool.  Starts at 8 and ends at 8.  You hear it in your room all day long.  There was also a smell of garbage at the pool  The rooms were beautiful and updated.  The service at the front desk was helpful and very friendly.  it was nice being right in the center of the strip.

reviews.title: Pool and Parking
reviews.text: While the customer service was great, and the actual location was also great, the parking situation (which I know is a huge problem) was not acceptable.  Also, the Flamingo Hotel and Casino's pool's music (Hip Hop I guess) was extremely annoying.  Not for their pool hours being restricted, somewhat, being outside near the HGV was not acceptable for the noise.  I do not know if there is adequate parking that each guest could be assigned a specific spot?  Driving from level-to-level searching for a parking spot and/or near the elevator was unacceptable (especially for elderly needing the elevator) that was a mechanical disaster (with only one of the two elevators being operational) and only working in one direction and buttons being inoperable.

reviews.title: Relentless daytime noise !!!
reviews.text: As numerous other reviewers have said here, do not stay at this hotel if you want any kind of peace and tranquillity. The level of noise from the adjacent Flamingo pool party venue is nothing short of obscene ! The volume and bass levels are utterly ridiculous and shake the windows. There is no way at all to relax either by the Hilton Grand Vacations pool or in your room as the noise from the pool party permeates everywhere and it starts around 09:00 and doesn't finish until 17:00 at the earliest ! It completely ruined the holiday for my partner and I. Had we read previous TripAdvisor reviews more closely we would have stayed somewhere else.Another negative is the fact that the HGV must have the slowest Wi-Fi of any hotel I've ever stayed in !

reviews.title: Great experience at the flamingo, Hilton grand vacations
reviews.text: It is centrally located on the strip. The rooms are clean, nice and spacious. They have their own private pool, but access to the flamingo go pool which is quite nice. My parking was complementary which was quite nice. But what made this trip so excellent was the staff. They were kind considerate, and helpful.

reviews.title: Thoroughly enjoyed!
reviews.text: Room as pictured.  Great front desk service.  Location was great right in the middle of the strip.  Note:  It isn't actually the Flamingo on the street but a building right behind it.  Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Vacation Spot on the Las Vegas Blvd Strip
reviews.text: Very Convenient to the Strip as it is on the Flamingo property.  It is right next to the Flamingo Station on the Monorail.  Only negative is be prepared for the extremely loud music coming from the Large Flamingo Pool from 9:00AM to 6:00PM.  It closes at 6:00PM and is very quiet after that.

reviews.title: Las Vegas heat of summer
reviews.text: Love the location - back of the Flamingo property so in the centre of LV BLVD.  Lots of F1 construction at the time, but close to the monorail, good onsite parking (but we and numerous others had issues with  cards exiting parking garage).  yes, there is daytime noise from the GO pool between 9 am and 5 pm, especially when the base is turned up from Noon to 4 pm.  But you do get free access to the pool.  We liked the onsite pool just as much, and we could bring our own drinks and had a few BBQ's.  Great staff on check in.  There is a $25 day resort fee as well, the Gym looks new, small but good equipment for 2 to 4 people.  Kitchen could use a few more plates etc, we had to bring over items from the lock off unit.  A/C worked well in each unit.

reviews.title: Great hotel and highly recommended for its excellent service.
reviews.text: I don't usually give 10 but in this case they earned it.Hire the hotel with breakfast and the reality is that the hotel does not have breakfast, because they are fully furnished apartments. Even so, when I checked in and explained that I had booked with breakfast, they recognized the mistake and allowed us to spend up to 45 USD per day (there were 3 of us) in a store that is inside the hotel. This is what I call Customer services. Special recognition to the manager and the new person (he was doing his training) at the time of check-in and also to Gigs, who always helped us.On the other hand, the room is huge and very well equipped, nothing is missing, even if you want to cook.It also has a swimming pool

reviews.title: We felt comfortable and everything worked out
reviews.text: Well-furnished rooms, valet parking works in the multi-story car park opposite (also for large GMC SUVs) / kitchen was easy to use, even for cooking and frying - you're right in the center / fully centrally air-conditioned via ventilation - also quiet at night / nice beds and large TVs, decent bathrooms (one with a bath and one with a shower - two mirrors with two washbasins - a bit combined next to each other and a toilet) / spacious / very good facilities overall / pool is quite loud during the day due to the bass / windows cannot be opened / 4 elevators are quick to get to / stairwells and lobby are fairly basic / simple view (pool to the back / stairwell and entrance side of a train track + Ferris wheel + colored hemisphere of the new event arena)

reviews.title: Excellent for laid-back stay
reviews.text: Pros: We loved location, the pool was never too crowded, decor has been refreshed. There are little secret paths in/out that making getting to Line promenade and Horseshoe a quick walk. Instacart for groceries worked out well.Cons: Beds are too hard.  Living area needs an ottoman and better couches.  Couch was a hard block to sit on.  One tower is a bit of a walk.  There is daytime noise from next door go pool and the music.  There was also power washing of the pool that started everyday at 6:30am.  We still liked our stay.  It just not ideal if you can't walk some, want daytime quiet or like to hang out on the couch.

reviews.title: Too many A/C and plumbing issues!
reviews.text: We just stayed at the HGV Flamingo hotel. After unpacking and repacking to change rooms 3 times we finally were moved to an acceptable room. Not a way to start a relaxing vacation. The first rooms were 85 degrees or hotter. The hallways had to be close to 100!  The hotel is extremely hot! The next room had plumbing issues. Soap bubbles flooded the bathroom floor as they came bubbling out of the toilet on multiple occasions. So after packing and moving again, we finally got to a room in which we had to use 2 box fans to keep the room between 73 and 76 degrees.  No service of any kind at the HGV pool; the only pool with service is the Flamingo Go Pool which was extremely overcrowded since it’s open to the public.

reviews.title: Great room for two people
reviews.text: We had a great stay.  The only things that would make it better would be a free breakfast and a better coffee maker.  Our beds were comfortable and the bathroom setup was perfect.  The hotel staff was superb!  It would be better if the market place had better hours.

reviews.title: Nice choice but
reviews.text: I had a very good experience at this location. The rooms are very nice, clean, and spacious. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. The property is in  a good location within walking distance to the heart of the Strip. Free parking is included and the resort fee is low.  When I go to Las Vegas, I don’t like to stay in the casinos, so this was an excellent choice. The only caveat  is that the rooms are very loud during the day. The good thing is that the music stops by around 5 PM and  then the room is very calm and peaceful. It was very quiet at night. I did get back to the room a little early during the day and wanted to take a nap, but the noise was very bothersome.  So long as you don’t think you’ll be in the room during the daytime, this  is an excellent choice.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations Flamingo
reviews.text: The resort is in the middle of the Las Vegas Strip right next to LINQ and Go Pool.  Overall, our experience are great.  Great customer service.  We are on the 14th floor and you could hear the Go Pool DJ.  It’s a faint sound and it doesn’t bother us.  There is no restaurant on site, just a market place with very minimal inventory and it is quite expensive.  Nothing so spectacular on the rooms, a typical studio.

reviews.title: Excellent cozy room and perfect location
reviews.text: Cozy and excellent rooms with a perfect location and few feet away from Mono Rail. However, the most bothering was the loud music from Flamingo Hotel Pool, the nasty music was extremely loud. If the loud music is ignored, then the property is 5/5 rating.

reviews.title: VEGAS 23
reviews.text: Nice place to stay behind the strip. Clean and comfortable, close to everything. Parking is free in garage with a short walk back. There are 5 handicap parking spots out front. They give each unit 2 free waters a day. The Flamingo GoPool day party music shuts off at 6pm leaving it peaceful for the evening. Louder on weekends then weekdays. Needs more lighting and cloths storage in rooms.

reviews.title: Best location
reviews.text: Location is right in the strip. Clean and convenient. The bed is a little firm. But the place is beautiful. Pool is amazing. Instacart and Walmart delivery  is what we used to our groceries. Walking distance to all casinos

reviews.title: Nice hotel with load music from Flamingo hotel
reviews.text: The hotel has good location. The rooms are quite nice and the service and attention from the front desk is quick and accurate. But there are minuses like very load music from Flamingo that can be heard in room, especially low tones - you hear bum, bum in your room. The other minus was poor TV reception - very often it looked like worn-out DVD. So, if you are looking for quiet time it is not there.

reviews.title: Perfect Home Base For Trip To Vegas
reviews.text: This was a perfect home base for our trip to Vegas.  The location is right in the heart of the strip.  It’s on the Flamingo property, but not connected.  The monorail stop is right outside the front of the hotel and Uber/taxi stops were very close.  Hotel itself was very quiet though the Flamingo pool got loud during the day.  Everything in the unit was clean and in great shape and the beds were quite comfortable.  Having the full kitchen and laundry helps with meal costs and packing.  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Nice vacation
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay at the Hilton vacation club at the flamingo. The staff are really nice. The rooms are really clean and beautiful. The beds are very comfy. It’s also close to the strip and lots of casinos, shopping, restaurants across the street and really all over the place. It’s a really great location.  Really recommend it.

reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: This is now on the top of our list of places to stay in Vegas. Friendly staff and great location with easy access to the strip. Free parking via the Flamingo parking garage and use of the Flamingo “Go Pool” are a big plus. Comfortable room and secure grounds.

reviews.title: Nice accomodations; avoid the timeshare sell.
reviews.text: We have been long-time HGVC owners and this is the first time we stayed at the Flamingo property. The accomodations were very nice. We were traveling with another family and had a two bedroom unit, which allowed my husband and I to have the studio apartment and the other family had the one-bedroom, with living room. We enjoyed having our own pool, which was quieter than the Flamingo pool next door. We did get constant loud base music from that pool but it ended at 6pm each night. As owners, though, our experience was greatly impacted by the hard-sell we got prior to arriving and than at the facility. It felt like the typical timeshare hard-sale, which we really didn't appreciate. That alone will have us thinking twice before returning.

reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: Very clean, great location right off of the strip and nice staff.  Maybe the best place I have ever stayed at! Great pool and spa area too. The pool does back up to the pool at the Flamingo resort, and they play loud music during the day, but that doesn’t start until 10:00 am and ends around 5:00.

reviews.title: Choose another location.
reviews.text: Shocked that Hilton would have this in their collection of properties. The pool at the Flamingo is loud and rattles the windows. The entrance is hard to find. Furniture is as uncomfortable as I’ve ever sat in. And there were random hairs in my bathroom sink. Not mine, as I have longer curly hair. Not my husband, as he has short grey hair. To me they look like rodent hairs. They were there both mornings. Totally creeped me out and won’t ever stay there again. On the positive side, we liked the location. When we decide to come down to the strip again, we’ll be staying at the Elara.

reviews.title: Staff are helpful and welcoming
reviews.text: Once we narrow down the location and general amenities for a trip, the hotel experience is about the team who work there - reservations, front desk, housekeeping and grounds keeping. We are impressed with the team at the Hilton GV Flamingo, particularly Fontane at the front desk and the housekeeping team. The proximity to the Flamingo has big pluses with restaurants and a pool view and some minuses with the pool noise. We had empathy for the front desk crew as there were 2 nights of our stay where the Flamingo Go Pool had private events that meant the music went hours later - but that's on the Flamingo not on this hotel. The staff here are exceptional and the atmosphere is very welcoming and inclusive - other guests looked like they were very comfortable here, and we were, too.

reviews.title: Not a great experience
reviews.text: Although there a very few amenities at this hotel, no restaurant or bar, the hotel itself is clean and the staff is very nice.  The problem is the extremely loud music the comes from the Flamingo Hotel Pool.  There is a DJ plating extremely loud pounding music that goes non stop all day. The music begins at 10 am and does not stop until 6 pm. You can not enjoy the pool at the hotel or get away from it in you room. You still hear the loud pounding music all day long, even over your own music or tv.  It is so bad we would not stay here again, even though it is a really good location and nice facility.

reviews.title: Vegas 2023
reviews.text: Utilizing RCI we stayed at Hilton Vacation Club Flamingo. The staff was friendly and helpful. Our room was clean, only big issue we had was the pocket door didn’t work that closed off the toilet and shower from the sink. Since there was another sink and just the two of us we found it easy to work around. The location of the resort is walking distance to so much. We walked to all the casinos both directions over our time there. There is a full kitchen so we cooked up our breakfast each day before heading out. The pool music does start around 10am, solid beat which did not bother us since we were usually getting ready to head out for the day anyway. Music we found out stopped somewhere between 30-45 min before pool closing, which was 6pm.Highly recommend Hilton Grand Vacation Club Flamingo.

reviews.title: Beautiful property and rooms
reviews.text: We took our 15 year old grandson and stayed here and had a wonderful suite. We loved the rooms but honestly, the booming hip hop coming up from the Flamingo pool from 10am to 5pm everyday is awful. It’s so loud it shakes the room.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Loved our visit.  Very nice facility.  Great staff.  Very clean and roomy.  Excellent location for accessing strip via foot or mass transit. Only downsides, facility market is small and closes early afternoon also it does not sell alcohol.  If you like an adult beverage at the pool, bring your own, no pool bar.One big downside, the Flamingo Casino “Go” bar is adjacent to this property.  Very high volume dance music from 9:30 ish till 6:00 daily.   The bass is so loud it vibrates the windows, can be irritating if you are looking for a little peace on vacation or have day sleepers or nappers.  One note, the “Go” pool is “European style” (topless) which may offend some folks.

reviews.title: HGVC Flamingo - Too many changes
reviews.text: So disappointed in the visit.  First trip back to this location post pandemic used to come every year at this time but this HGVC has made many change that are not for the best.  No longer offer valet parking, will so many guest from CA this is a big disappointment, they now offer about 2 dozen reserved spots that you use for $30/night. Marketplace - had limit hours pre-pandemic but at least you could still get a late lunch item or an evening snack, but now they close at 1:30pm.  So unusual for a hotel not to have somewhere to buy a bottle of water. Pool area - the pool had new furniture but the pool bar was closed and signs say no outside alcohol. Think I might have to look for a new Vegas location.

reviews.title: Great hotel, great location....BUT!
reviews.text: The Hilton GVC Flamingo is a great hotel in the perfect location. The Strip is a 5 minute walk away as is the monorail. The staff are really helpful and friendly, no queue at check in!The only down side, and the reason we wouldn't go back, is the noise from the Flamingo's pool party; the Hilton overlooks the Flamingo's pool and every day, from 9am to 5pm, there is extremely loud music. Our room was on the 11th Floor and we could still hear the music. It's such a shame. The Hilton's pool is lovely but again you can't relax until after 5pm. To be fair, we were aware of this before we booked, but hadn't appreciated how noisy it would be. If pool parties and loud music are your thing, the Hilton really is the perfect hotel; I believe the parties only go on in the Summer months, so if you're travelling out of season then definitely go for the Hilton, but I would advise you check before you book!

reviews.title: Vegas Baby!
reviews.text: Hotel is in a great location, beautiful rooms, plenty of room, Hilton's pool was heated which was nice after walking all day. One block from hotel is the best food in Vegas- Battista's Hole in the wall, Italian food,

reviews.title: Loud during day but great place
reviews.text: It is a great place and location. During the day music from go pool is loud but stops by 6. Rooms are huge and comfortable.Walk to strip is close many things to do and see.Be sure to get a players card in casino so you can get benefits.

reviews.title: Great location and resort
reviews.text: This resort was a great experience.  Centrally located with well appointed rooms that were some of the cleanest I have ever seen!  Traveling with a group of friends, we were in a 2 bedroom with ample room to spread out and enjoy our stay.  Whenever we called the desk for anything it was right there at our door. (please tip these people, they work hard). I liked the fact that you needed a key to access the elevators, no shady people wandering the halls.  The only small criticism I have is that you needed a bellman for the luggage cart so on check in day there was a wait.  Again, please tip these people.  For those reviews that complain about the pool at the Flamingo and the noise, here's my 2 cents.  It is stated up front that you will hear the music and yes the base.  Can't say I loved it, but it is during the daytime and in Vegas you should be out enjoying the sights.  Don't slam the resort over this as it should not be a surprise to you.  If you are looking for a quiet spot to sleep, read, relax, this might not be your resort, but you would miss out on a fantastic location and resort

reviews.title: Not worth returning
reviews.text: This was our 7th trip to Las Vegas, 4th stay at a Hilton Grand Vacations Resort, and first time at THIS property. Would not stay here again! Let's start with the Negatives (and there are many)!1: Behind the Flamingo Hotel (which made location only highlight of the stay) -- the Flamingo Adult Pool plays L-O-U-D MUSIC (DJ daily 10-6), so loud, the walls vibrate in the HGVC) 2: Beds as hard as a rock! Felt like we were The Flintstones sleeping on rocks; linens very thin and cheap.3: Towels are cheap and thin -- this is a HILTON? More like a Days Inn quality.4: TP and Tissues cheap and thin too -- really Hilton? Not where to cut corners to save $$$.5. Uber doesn't stop here!! Not the Hotel's fault, but they were like "just walk over to the Flamingo to pickup Uber". We had to text the driver EVERY TIME to tell them where we were located. No problems returning to the HGVC but the staff told us to use Lyft instead (not an option for us). 6. We had a 2 Bedroom unit, which isn't a single unit, but two separate units beyond a common entry door. We had to get maintenance to provide door stops to keep the front doors open all week long so we can come and go between the two units (only one had the full kitchen/laundry). Not a deal breaker, just something others should know about if you are getting a 2 BR. Now the positive: Location! Location! Location! When you exit the property, turn left and head to the High Roller (big Ferris wheel) and then you can walk to the Promenade at the Linq, where there's great food places, bars, and entertainment venues.

reviews.title: Best Resort!
reviews.text: Nice resort hotel that is literally located not to far from the strip. The cleanliness was top tier. The staff was ver nice and accommodating. Although the parking was very confusing, when I talked to the front desk clerk they made sure parking was accessible and free!

reviews.title: LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION
reviews.text: Great place location wise ..... the music at the pool was mostly rap or techno .... not my cup of tea.... We like Disco, Dance, top ten and throw in some oldies.... The stall was outstanding especially LEO ....they have a 25 a day EXTRA fee for nothing .... even the time share people .... I guess it's VEGAS

reviews.title: HGVC Ecellent Choice!
reviews.text: Excellent stay from start to finish.  Located just behind the Flamingo Hilton with easy access to the strip.  The resort  staff is friendly and efficient, property is well maintained inside and out, rooms are  amazing, newly renovated and updated.

reviews.title: YOU CAN FEEL THE BASS PUMPING THRU YOUR ROOM
reviews.text: Pool noise was constant from 9 am to 5:30 pm. YOU CAN FEEL THE BASS PUMPING THRU YOUR ROOM. If you are not in your room during these hours it would be a nice place to stay.  However, if you need to do any work or want to relax, do not stay here.

reviews.title: Great location and amenities
reviews.text: Located right next to the Flamingo and an easy 5 minute walk to the casino and Uber/ taxi pickup area. Great size room with full kitchen, seperate bedroom with spa bath and super comfy bed. All staff are extremely courteous and an on site mini mart with Starbucks coffee. Resort is located in centre strip location.

reviews.title: Flamingo Grand Vacations LV
reviews.text: We stayed for a long weekend with our daughter’s family in a two bedroom suite. We were greeted by Leo, who was a joy. He politely explained all the services of the hotel and some Las Vegas tips. Kim, Fontaine and Analeigh along with Leo checked on us by text to see if we needed anything. The hotel had a lovely light scent throughout that was so refreshing compared to walking into any hotel with a casino. We found it very clean. The beds were so comfortable and the black out curtains allowed us to sleep until our grandkids came barreling in. We would recommend if you want to be close to everything with clean air and some extra room. We only had to walk a bit to gamble or to have a nice dinner. If only we had won a bit of money. Hahaha. Thanks for a great stay.

reviews.title: Very Good location to major Casinos walking distance
reviews.text: Very Good location walking distance to major casinos (Ceasars, Bellagio, Paris). There was a chemical smell at the hallway leading to the unit like chlorine. The kitchen was smaller than expected but did it's job. There was no std oven but microwave that was a convection oven combo. There was a big bath tub that my wife and six year daughter can fit together. For some reason I was getting static shocks maybe because of my clothing and the carpet. Parking was included otherwise was like 18 and 23 per day but was a bit of walk to get from the parking lot. Our RCI Exchange fee was higher than normal and there was a resort fee also. But the location was very good and would stay again at this location. And dvd rental was also included. Some days was noisy because of the music from the strip keep hearing the boom boom boom from the subwofer a bit annoying only because we like to sleep in until late.

reviews.title: Stay Here!
reviews.text: Love this place!! From the moment we walked in to our very last day was perfect. ALL of the staff was welcoming and accommodating. I had a 2-bedroom unit and it was great being 2 separate units. The updates were done beautifully. And the location is great. Next time I'm in Vegas, I'll stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: This property was a pleasant surprise to me when I arrived. The room was clean and lives up to the standards I expect when going to any property at Hilton Grand Vacations. The staff was courteous and very professional how they manage this property. I was there on a work trip and was very satisfied that I was able to have most of the comforts from home. I highly recommend this property to anyone that is traveling to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent quality resort
reviews.text: We have been staying in a 2 bedroom apartment for over 2 weeks now and have found the resort management and staff to be more than helpful. The apartment has a lockoff for the second bedroom and all rooms are extremely clean and housekeeping deserves a special mention as any item requested is promptly delivered. The next thing to commend this place is the convenience store come coffee shop where again the staff go out of their way to be helpful. If you are looking for a calm oasis with its own small private pool and gym but still in the centre of the Strip this is the perfect place for you to stay.

reviews.title: All the comforts of a one-bedroom apartment, right near the strip and Caesars Forum
reviews.text: I stayed at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club at the Flamingo while attending  a physics conference held at Caesars Forum and was completely thrilled with my choice. The walk to the Forum was quick and easy, about five minutes or less. A stairway leading up and across the street, then down directly into the Forum Plaza, made it quick and easy. I loved having a king/one-bedroom suite rather than just a simple hotel room.  I prepared a healthy breakfast and packed a simple lunch each morning, so convenient, no need to brave long lines or survive on fast food like most people at the conference. The kitchen had a full-sized frig, a glass electric cooktop, a dishwasher, a toaster, and a microwave-convection oven, plus pots and pans and other cooking tools, cups, plates and utensils--everything I needed. With a washer-dryer in my suite, I was able to pack light and  do a load of wash mid-week. There was a jacuzzi in the suite but I didn't take time to try it.The staff were very friendly and helpful and let me check in early at about 12:30PM, even though check-in is officially 4PM. The hotel lobby has no casino and is delightfully sunny and smoke-free, with comfortable sitting areas. There is a convenience store in the hotel open each day until 1:30PM. Prices for grocery items are comically high; a dozen eggs were priced at $13.95 and other items were similarly marked up, but hey, it's really convenient. I picked up a few other supplies from CVS and Walgreens in the neighborhood.I had read in other reviews that noise can be a concern at this hotel. Lucky for me, the weather was cool and the nearby Flamingo "GO Pool" remained closed--no loud music-- so my room (facing the pool) was wonderfully quiet and peaceful 24/7. I wondered if rooms facing in the direction of the "High Roller" Ferris wheel might have noise issues, but from my room on the other side of the building, I couldn't hear a thing.Wifi at the hotel was excellent, no issues at all.There were a few minor concerns.  I found the mattress a little hard, not terribly comfortable, and improvised a solution using the extra bedding intended for the fold-out couch. I stacked the extra blanket and mattress pad into a cushioning layer and wrapped a sheet around them to make a DIY mattress-topper. Another concern is availability of electric plugs at the bedside. If you need more than one, bring a plug splitter or an extension cord. The hot water in the shower was warm enough, but I would have liked it just a little warmer. Regarding transportation: Uber and Lyft are not generally allowed to drop off or pick up passengers at the front door of the hotel. Instead they use a ride-share location just around the corner by the entrance to the Flamingo.I will definitely plan to stay here again if I need to attend another conference at Caesars Forum. But because of the potential for noise issues, I might look for another Hilton property if I come during a season when the GO pool is open.

reviews.title: GREAT Property & AWESOME Staff
reviews.text: "THE" Girlfriend, my lovely bride of 30+ years, LOVES Las Vega and me not so much! Over those 30+ years, we have stayed at 25+ properties (on, off, and near) the Strip.We agreed, this HGVCF property (off the strip) was Perfect and the staff (Front Desk, Housekeeping, Bell Desk, Concierge, Maintenance) were Awesome. Extra Special Thanks to Seandae (Front Desk), the 16th floor Housekeeping Team, and Steve (Maintenance) for EXCEEDING the Expectations of a business traveler who spends 120-150 nights per year in hotels across America.Our one bedroom-king suite was spacious, well appointed, and very comfortable. It felt more like an apartment than a hotel room. We cooked, ate, and entertained like we were at home.LOL... Half-way through the trip, "THE" Girlfriend had started suggesting and planning a return to HGVCF in 2024. This was one of the few times I offered No Objections or Resistance.

reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: Resort is in the perfect location within walking distance to Linq Promenade with restaurants and shops, and also monorail and many Strip casinos.  The staff is friendly and helpful and resort views incredible..

reviews.title: Enjoyed more than Caesar's
reviews.text: Wonderful room; friendly helpful staff; easy check-in/out; some complimentary items--coffee; waters ... Then we moved to Caesars cuz work was paying--and were disappointed by all the above. Wished we hadn't left Flamingo with our enormous soaking tub and apartment sized room!

reviews.title: Incredible place to stay. Top notch customer service!!
reviews.text: Great customer service!!  Great location was perfect if you want to spend time on the strip.  Safe and close to everything you could want to do!   Gated as you come and go. Staff very accommodating to make sure needs were met .

reviews.title: Close to strip and all the fun
reviews.text: Unfortunately the bed was not comfortable… too hard. The hot tub was body temperature but the room was clean, spacious and comfortable. Everything was like brand new. They thought of everything for all the comforts of home. The staff was super friendly and helpful. I would stay there again

reviews.title: Las Vegas Timeshare
reviews.text: Had to pay daily Resort fee; for what? The Flamingo GO pool was closed the entire time we were there!  The staff was friendly enough and they did give us 2 bottles of water each day; was that reason to pay hundreds of dollars for a resort fee that we do not have to pay at our home timeshare...

reviews.title: Best stay so far!
reviews.text: The staff were so friendly and helpful any and every time asked for. The amenities were top notch and the condition of the rooms have been super also. I'm with kids of ages between 2 to 10 year olds. They all loved it so much also.

reviews.title: Only threats from staff no apology
reviews.text: Horrible horrible Front Desk staff !! I had a 2 bedroom suite. My room key was not working & I went to the front desk 4 times asking access to my room. When I raised my voice ( no profanity) the front desk staff said “ you be careful !) no apology for the wasted 4 journeys to & from my room to the front desk just “be careful !”  I checked out one night before the check out date because I feel threatened for me & my minor daughter .

reviews.title: VEGAS 2022
reviews.text: Wasn't pleased that my room wasn't ready at arrival.  Paid for seven days, was told when plans changed don't we will have your room ready when you arrive.  Had to wait until normal check-in even tho I arrived two days late.

reviews.title: Hilton for The Win
reviews.text: I took my bestie for his 40th birthday to Las Vegas and I was very pleased at how much I loved this property. I throughly enjoyed the hotel and the staff (Leo) was very friendly and helpful with making sure our stay was fantastic. I am definitely staying here again when I travel back to Las Vegas. Thank you, Hilton Grand Vacations Club Flamingo Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Outstanding Staff
reviews.text: This HGVC accommodation has staffed their hotel with friendly, knowledgeable people.  Their focus is on making people feel welcome and comfortable.   The rooms were spacious and well appointed with amenities useful for our 4 day stay.

reviews.title: Great place to stay with all home amenities.
reviews.text: It was new or remodeled. Convenient location. And had washer dryer and  a cooktop plus microwave convection. our room overlooked the flamingo pool which was closed. But the smaller Hilton garden  vacation club one was open.

reviews.title: Feared for our life.
reviews.text: The fact that me as a sixty year old man was verbally and physically attack by some one who was not a guest was not acceptable. There was no just cause for that behavior. Not only did I fear for my own well being but also my wife. I must commend the employees to some degree by creating a barrier between the person who was belligerent and laid hands on me.I feared for my life and the life of my wife. The person used language to the fact of ending my life and did not know what he had in his pockets but the threat  was real. The person got in out of the back entrance by the Tram stairs. If security is not tightened up DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT THIS PLACE. Besides that it was a great place. Clean, great employees, nice views, but you would not want to risk your well being.

reviews.title: What's That Smell?
reviews.text: First off the location is perfect! it's right there in walking distance of the greatest strip attractions. Gonna get right to the problem though. The room smelled like a sewer. I'm not telling euphemisms or exaggerating here trust me, it smelled like rotten eggs cooked in raw sewage, after 20 minutes, my 12 year-old was getting dizzy. Told front desk, said a manager would contact us. Manager called and asked my husband, does it smell like sewage? He said yes so she said they'll send someone up. Hold on? How'd she'd know about the sewer smell? That's very specific. I went to read the reviews of this place, there are hundreds of bad reviews for the Hilton Flamingo, across the internet some going back as far as 5 years, that mention the sewer smell. Google it, Hilton Grand Resorts Flamingo Smell, see for yourself. All these people went through this game with the front desk too. So they'll say, oh no it smells, weird, but we're booked at capacity, you can't change rooms, we'll send up housekeeping. Hoping that you'll suck it up. So I went to the front desk and said the smell is unbearable, I need a new room, she said oh it smells? sorry we're booked, can't change rooms. So I said, I read the reviews, apparently this is a problem here, some of the rooms have a raw sewage smell which is dangerous and unhealthy! So she did some more research and suddenly we had a new room on the opposite side of the hotel that didn't smell like a sewer.  It's not just of the whiff of rotten eggs, it's literally hydrogen sulfide coming into the rooms. It's so unhealthy to breathe. Is the Hilton intentionally exposing people to toxic fumes? I don't know but I won't ever return.

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text: I relied on the Hilton website to pick out a resort hotel to accommodate the 4 of us.  I picked a two bedroom suite at the Hilton Grand Vacations Flamingo because the description and pictures looked perfect.  Much to my dismay we arrive to find the two bedroom suite is actually two separate suites and the only common area is the small foyer between the two rooms.  I also picked this hotel because of all the beautiful peaceful pictures of sitting areas under palm trees and a gorgeous pool where we could relax.  Turns out most of those pictures are on the Flamingo Hotels grounds and are only available seasonally.  The only good thing about the stay was the comfy beds.  Very expensive bad decision to spend my birthday in!

reviews.title: Would not stay again
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. Employees were. It helpful at all and rude. No one available to answer questions. You had to stand in checkin line everytime to get help.  Our phone did not work and no one offered to fix.  I could not call to get luggage delivered to room. Had to go pick up myself.  Pool not open.  We were charged resort fee for each day and a $50 hold even though pool closed and charged for nothing.  Overpriced.  Would not stay again even though good location

reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.text: One bedroom was very clean and comfortable. Unit comes with a full kitchen, pull out couch in living room and a washer dryer combo. They offer two free water bottles a day for guests nice touch since other hotels charge an extreme amount for that(PS I sometimes got more than two a day, they were pretty relaxed about it). Hotel is right next to the las Vegas Monorail very convenient if you do not plan to rent a car. The only negative is the parking. You have to park in the Flamingo parking garage on the 4th floor. They do offer premier parking right in front of the property at $30.00 daily but subject to availability. Otherwise its a low key place if you want to be in the action of the strip and stay somewhere kind of quiet. Hotel has no restaurant but the LINQ premade is walking distance with many food options. Overall nice place to stay.

reviews.title: Great central Strip location
reviews.text: Peaceful stay without noisy pool next door.  It is closed for winter, what a nice time to be here.I had in room coffee maker problem, the front desk sent a staff to help promptly.The 1 bedroom is well maintained, quiet and comfortable.The grounds and lobby are clean, furniture worn in places, staff is helpful.The store has limited hours and less selection than in past stays.I tried to use elevated crosswalk to get to Bellagio, escalators were off across Flamingo Rd.  I will try a different route.

reviews.title: Great Stay and Saves You Money
reviews.text: Prefect location on the strip, anything you needed or asked for was provided.  With a full equipped kitchen and the Marketplace where you could purchase food, it saved us quite a bit of money.  In addition, we only had to take 3 days clothes because there was a washer and dryer in the unit. Staff was friendly and helpful in all ways.

reviews.title: Drain stench and noise
reviews.text: I’ll start with positives: the location is great if you want to be right on the strip, the suites are spacious and have all the things you need like a fridge freezer, dishwasher, cooking facilities etc. The TVs are also good.But there are a lot of downsides. Firstly, the stench coming out of the drains that permeates the bathroom. It’s so strong it’s pretty much unbearable. It’s one of the worst things I’ve ever smelt and it didn’t go away no matter what we did. The sofa bed is like sleeping on wonky rocks, it’s horrible, and the bedding is also horrible. We booked months ago yet we were told on check in that they only had this room left so we are unfortunately on the ground floor directly next to the FlaminGO pool. There are super loud thumping bass pool parties all day every day, so forget sleeping off jet lag or having a lay in because it’s literally impossible. It’s so loud it’s unbearable. I have no idea why they thought shoving anyone in this room was fair. The air con is also super loud and rattles.Paying $1000 for the privilege of the stench of human excrement, constant noise and zero sleep is kind of a joke to be honest.Don’t bother.

reviews.title: Amazing customer service - thank you!
reviews.text: This is an employee / customer service rating.We booked to stay at the HGVCF Las Vegas, but when we arrived (16 September), we realised that our travel agent had booked the wrong dates and they were booked out for our intended stay. It was late in the day and we had our two kids with us (our eldest in a wheelchair), so we were a bit frazzled / upset and the Manager on duty was the loveliest man. He did everything he could to assist us and even gave us a collection of food and drinks for the kids while we waited for our travel agent to find us some accommodation. I wish I wasn't so frazzled and remembered his name as he showed such kindness, professionalism, compassion and was the epitome of great customer service. Thank you so much! You are a rare individual and we are so grateful for your hospitality and kindness.

reviews.title: Our Second Visit and Even Better!
reviews.text: The units are awesome and have recently been redone.   The staff is one of the most friendly and helpful we have ever encountered.   The location is perfect if you plan to spend time on the strip.   Just a short walk to all the fun. It is very secure.   You need a room key to use all entries other than the lobby.  You even need a key in the elevator, which we really appreciate.   This was our second stay and plan to return!  We chose to pay a daily fee to park right at the resort.   Otherwise you have to park in the Flamingo Parking lot, which is still close.

reviews.title: Mixed emotions, Greatest Staff ever!
reviews.text: Mixed emotions.  My wife has been coming here since day 1, 25 years ago. Me with her for 15 years.  Every year I write the same.  The Flamingo hotel next door starts with the thumping music in their pool at 9am,  It proceed to a loud thump at noon and by 3pm till closing at 5pm it shakes the counter in our room.  We complain but next year consideration to another Hilton property is a definite possibility.  Enough of this.What I wrote above is bitter sweet for we love everything else about this property especially the staff, you will find none better anywhere.  I am sad about this but it is not a restful vacation.  You cannot sit out at the HGVC pool for the incessant overly loud music on the other side of the hedges and fence coming from the Flamingo who cater to another completely different demographic.

reviews.title: Perfect except for the music volume at the adjoining hotel's pool
reviews.text: Couldn't ask for better accommodations. Staff was very friendly and professional. Any time we needed supplies for the room, they were delivered instantly. The location is great, steps from the main strip, the promenade, ferris wheel, and places to eat. My *only* complaint was the volume of the music at the Flamingo Go pool next door. I had vowed to never stay here again because of this (the windows in our room vibrated and you couldn't even hold a conversation at the HGVC private pool), but I learned that during off-season, that pool isn't open, so I'll just plan my stays accordingly.

reviews.title: Great resort without a casino
reviews.text: This is my second visit to this resort. Really love the location next to The Linq Promenade. Also having a full kitchen and washer/dryer is very convenient. As I don’t gamble I also appreciate the quiet with no on-site casino, and the small pool area away from the partners at The Flamingo, although you can’t avoid their DJ and music during the daytime. Also appreciate the small convenience store/cafe to buy baked goods and basic snacks and drinks. No restaurant here but being steps from The Linq with numerous options makes up for that.

reviews.title: Would love to go back
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived the customer service was excellent.  The condo we stayed in was perfect for a small birthday celebration to getting ready for our daughters wedding in Las Vegas.  The pool and spa were a cozy spot to relax and enjoy the sunshine and family.

reviews.title: Vegas Baby
reviews.text: Resort is close to the middle of the strip.  Easy walk to the Linq Promenade.  Has it's own pool so you don't have to deal with the bigger Flamingo pool crowd (but that is available if you want it).  Pool is open all year.  Do the High Roller if you can (I don't like heights but it was very comfortable).  Battista's Hole in the Wall is good food, free wine and reasonably priced-short walk from resort.  Silverado at the Southpoint Casino was a quite good and reasonably priced steak house.  Carlos and Charlie's at the Flamingo is very good for breakfast.  Also good for breakfast is the Egg and I.  You have to drive there and there are a couple but it was quite good.  Saw a show called The Rat Pack is Back (excellent) at the Tuscany Casino.

reviews.title: Too noisy. Loud, VERY loud daytime music from adjacent property pool.
reviews.text: I haven't even checked out and I know I'll never stay here again. Can't get any rest or relaxation in your room during the day because of the Flamingo pool music.   It's loud and annoying.  Thump thump and bang bang.  Too noisy for me!!!  Wont ever stay here again.

reviews.title: 2bedroom suite was amazing. Perfect location!
reviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom suite and enjoyed our stay that much, we extended! The rooms were as pictured on the website but the space felt bigger than expected which was a nice surprise. Kitchen was very well equipped with a big fridge in the main kitchen and a kitchenette with smaller drinks fridge, kettle and coffee maker in the second bedroom.The location was perfect. It was a 5min walk to the strip, an easy and quick drive to the airport, outlet malls, Walmart and Wholefoods and having parking included was very convenient. We were travelling with teenagers and chose this hotel because it didn't have a casino. We enjoyed the Hilton pool and Flamingo family pool as well as the indoor spa and small but adequate gym. Music from the Go pool was great and added to the atmosphere.All employees we interacted with were superfriendly and professional. No negative points and definitely a hotel I'd recommend. Thank you for an amazing stay!

reviews.title: We loved it here!!
reviews.text: Stayed for 5 nights Sept 11-16. We love everything about this hotel. Check-in was so quick, probably about 3 minutes and we were off to our room. We booked a 1 bedroom suite and it looked exactly like the pictures. Spacious bedroom with a large Jacuzzi and a separate toilet and shower and 2 spacious vanities with Crabtree and Evelyn products, plus a pullout sofa bed in the living room area. The kitchen was fully equipped with a full size fridge , microwave, oven, dishwasher with 5 detergent, coffeemaker (bring your own filters) and all the dishes, paper towels, cutlery, pots and pans you need if you want to do your own cooking. We just liked it for making coffee in the morning and the fridge for keeping water, beer and cream cold. There is a full size washer and dryer with a box of soap to do 1 wash. The walk to the strip was a 4 minute walk at the most. There is also a liquor store 1 block away. We bought cream for coffee and beer (2.50-3.00 a can) at the Walgreens in front of Harrah's. Beer was also 3.00 at the liquor store. We never used the pool area but a lot of people did, it looked nice and as for the music from the Flamingo pool we really didn't find it that loud  we never were in our room during the day and it does shut off by 6 pm. This is a smoke free facility and it smelled good all the time and the room smelled ,looked and felt clean. They do not send a housekeeper in daily unless you request it. Didn't bother us as we were OK with not having somebody in our room everyday. Ice machine on each floor and you get vouchers at check in to get 2 bottles of water each day at the front desk.  Staff were all so friendly and helpful. We would return to this hotel and the location is nice to be in the heart of the strip.

reviews.title: Great spot, but it is loud
reviews.text: I loved this hotel for the value and the location. Our "one king bed" room as booked on hotels.com had a full kitchen, jacuzzi, laundry, it was a massive room and unexpected to be that spacious. It was lovely and clean. Leo at the front desk was quick and easy for checking in. It's tucked just off the strip but very close and easy walking distance to Linq and strip. The worst part was the noise from the Flamingo Go Pool. It was a great party, you are able to join with your HGV room key. Open from 9-6 with blasting music, it was fun and we were in Vegas to party anyway so the noise was to be expected. And never at night, very quiet at night there. But don't plan on napping or having peace and quiet during the day time hours during the pool party.

reviews.title: Noisy and over-rated
reviews.text: Having previously stayed at a Hilton Grand Vacations Club resort in Waikiki, we were looking forward to our stay at the HYVC Flamingo in Las Vegas but were extremely disappointed. Bell staff ignored our arrival then disappeared, leaving us to drag 3 heavy suitcases down a long corridor to our first (ground) floor room.The view from our window of the pool when we arrived was pleasant, but the next morning the noise from the Flamingo Resort pool next door started at 10 am and continued until 6 pm. A week of constant loud heavy bass noise, 8 hours per day, was very unpleasant. There were some days when we were away from our room, but on others we wanted a quiet day, but found the noise so bad that we couldn’t venture outside to use the pool. It’s possibly a sign of our age (we are in our 70s) but our vacation was spoiled by the noise.Shortly before the end of our stay, we tested positive for Covid-19. We advised the front desk and a manager Will looked after us very well. We wanted to stay for the rest of our quarantine period, but we’re told that they were fully booked for the following week. I find it strange that at least one apartment isn’t kept in reserve for emergencies. Luckily, through our own searching, we were able to find alternate accommodation.

reviews.title: If You Hate Noise During the Day Stay Elsewhere
reviews.text: This resort is very comfortable and I love the proximity to the monorail, which is my choice to use to get around. When not appropriate, then I use Uber. The beds and pillows are extremely comfortable and I like having a walk in shower versus a tub. The only downside, which is not exactly the fault of the Hilton Resort is that the Flamingo Casion Hotel pool is right next door. Starting at 9am the music and the deep bass beat are about as annoying as can be. So if you like peace and quiet, within reason at a pool, you may want to consider another Hilton Grand Vacation Club  in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: LOUD MUSIC….Nice hotel
reviews.text: The hotel itself was great… clean staff very accommodating no issues The music from the flamingo go pool was unbearable! The windows in our room vibrated from 9 to 6 every day even ear plugs didn’t help. There was no escape feel sorry for the people who actually own the units I will not be returning to listen to loud obnoxious music !!!

reviews.title: Kev
reviews.text: Great area very central very clean and great staff ,would recommend this place to anyone looking for a place to shop,eat and injoy the night life,rooms are very spacious and clean.and great if you wish to stay in and cook tea

reviews.title: Great for vacations and business trips
reviews.text: Less than a 10 minute walk from the Las Vegas Strip, the Hilton Grand Vacation – Flamingo was an amazing experience during my stay. The staff at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club – Flamingo exceeded my expectations. I stayed for a work trip, and it turned into to a vacation of sorts. At one point I needed to wash clothes as I didn’t account for the previous stop on my drip being humid. That was not problem as the front desk had detergent. It took me about 1.5 hours to finish the load of wash. This really the barometer for evaluating performance, when things don’t go according to plans. My room was immaculate and had a view overlooking the pool and the Go Pool (which is separate from HGVC – Flamingo).  It had both USB and regular plugs, this was immensely helpful along with the large mini fridge. The Go Pool is a pool party that runs till about 5 PM and is about $10 to enter. It fills up quick so get to the Go Pool early.The service from the front desk, bell staff, and housekeeping was superior and they made me feel like it was my home away from home. My flight was late in the evening they provided me with a facilities key so that even after I checked out I was still able to use the pool and other amenities. The bell staff swiftly helped me when I need to retrieve items from my bags after I checked them. Hilton Grand Vacations Flamingo also has partnerships with various tourism spots along the Las Vegas Strip. From Maverick Helicopter tours, the Eiffel Tower Observation Deck at Paris, the High Roller Observation , to Alexxa’s Las Vegas, and more!  Parking was complimentary, but for guests it appeared their were premium spots for $30 a night. Unsure if this is connected to the Hilton Honors tier or not. Also, the Las Vegas Monorail Flamingo / Caesars is right behind the property. It was about a 15 minute walk from HGVC Flamingo to Caesar’s Palace, Paris, and the famous fountains at the Bellagio.

reviews.title: Loud music and sewer gas
reviews.text: The co-located "Go-Pool" at the Flamingo Hotel has music extremely loud from 12 noon to 6 pm, and makes staying in the room to escape the heat horrible.  Also, when using the Hilton pool the smell of sewer gas is quite strong, and made staying there intolerable.

reviews.title: Clean and friendly
reviews.text: The location is excellent and the staff is very pleasant.  Minor appliance problems that were mostly resolved.  Beds are comfortable.  Recent upgrades to the property.  Although we're not party people it sounded as if the pool was a blast!

reviews.title: Suites behind the Flamingo
reviews.text: Suites located behind the Flamingo. Stayed here with a group of 5 girls for a bachelorette weekend and it was a good spot. It was quiet so you can get some rest after clubbing, and there was enough space for people to share beds/use the pullout couch. There was a little kitchenette and fridge if you were so inclined to cook. Paid parking is available. There’s a pool. They provide you with vouchers for two Evian water bottles that you exchange at the front desk. This was booked through RCI, the timeshare. It was hard getting a hold of the front desk when I called with my cell, but using the landline in the room connected immediately. There’s a hold of $100 on your credit card when you first check in.

reviews.title: Grand Hilton Flamingo
reviews.text: Note:  If you take a taxi from the airport, please make sure you tell them not to go the highway,   it is 25 more to do that.    Anyway, we had a great time. We had a one bedroom with a kitchen.  The bed was so comfy!  we had a view of the pool and the pool at the flamingo!  holy cow, the people.  the kitchen had all the things you would need.  the rooms looked like it was just renovated.  the marble counters were great!  we had no car so we did Uber eats and had our groceries delivered.  much cheaper than a taxi.  The pool was good.   I didn't feel like they cleaned it enough.  but that is me.  The security was great.  the Bell hop was wonderful and the staff was incredible.  they made our stay even better

reviews.title: No option to relax
reviews.text: 7 days a week loud music with mega bass that shakes your room ……shakes your body….from pool party outside No option to escape this no matter where your room will is located. You will have to actually leave the property to get away from  this. Laugh it off 2 days …….but try to live with it for over 7 days ….it starts to make you mad. We will not be coming back. The absolute worst part is that you don’t have a choice or option to get away from the loud mega bass thumping aside from leaving the property and room you paid for. This point alone should cause Hilton to act.

reviews.title: 3 night stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is a beautiful place to stay in Las Vegas. We got a warm welcome and the apartment was simply fantastic.  We cooked every night and the added bonus of the stacked washer dryer was wonderful. There was a little pack provided with dish soap, dishwasher tablets and a dish cloth. There is a lovely pool and gym. My only reason for not giving 5 stars is the noise from the pool at the adjoining hotel (The Flamingo) which is in no way connected to the HGV. The Flamingo hosts a 'day club' and the bass from the pool music vibrated the windows. Though the HGV seems to have decent sound insulation, you can't remove the dull background thud of the bass from the Flamingo next door. Utterly ridiculous.  Music does stop at 5pm but until then, if you want to sit around  the pool at the HGV, take your noise cancelling headphones.

reviews.title: Great staff, location, and rooms!
reviews.text: Was in town for a convention at the new "Caesar's Forum". This hotel is in the perfect location for access to the forum, the strip, and the monorail.  The staff was fantastic, very friendly and accommodating, and the recently remodeled rooms are excellent!  the only drawback was the Flamingo pool party music from 12-5pm, the bass is comically louder than I was expecting in the room, but honestly -- this is Las Vegas.  I had several conference calls and nobody on the other end heard it.  I will definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Beautiful renovated unit in a great location!
reviews.text: The property was newly renovated and our unit was beautiful overlooking the large Flamingo pool. The location was excellent,  close to the High Roller wheel,  the fun Linq Promenade and the strip. We would definitely go back there again.

reviews.title: Very good location in Family
reviews.text: We stayed 1 week.The stay is located between Flamingo Hotel and Roller. Very good location. There is a free parking lot located at 2 minutes by walk from stay.Great service.You have access to Flamingo Pool. For reminder, there are 2 pools at Flamingo : 1 for adults only over 21y and 1 for family. Otherwise, you have this one at this hotel, with jaccusi, very nice and more quiet.

reviews.title: Noise
reviews.text: They play music at the pool and it is so loud all you hear is base blaring not a good relaxing place.Notified front desk and finally got a respond 3 days later.  Had to change dates due to airline cancelling my flight so I notified resort of change they told me they didn't have a room for me and they would have someone call me which never happened I got notified by text that my new room was available I had to book a room at another hotel for that night and was inconvienced again I complained to front desk about the music and there answer was to contact rci resorts to see if they had any openings.

reviews.title: Great stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: I would definitely stay here again.  It was so nice to be slightly off the strip and not have a casino in the hotel.  It made the place so nice and quiet and relaxing (and smoke-free!).  It's a great central location on the strip.  You can get to everything easily, but also get away easily.  The room was spacious and updated.  My brother and his family stayed in one of the one bedroom suites and it had a kitchen, which was nice for when you want to bring in food.  The staff were friendly and there is a small market in the lobby, where you can purchase breakfast, coffee, snacks etc.  We did not use the pool, but our room overlooked the Flamingo pool, which you have access to, if you're of age.

reviews.title: Bed bug found in room but dismissed
reviews.text: Overall the rooms were really nice. That said, when a single bedbug was clearly identified and brought to the attention of the staff, other than having a quick inspection, they simply dismissed our concern. Even though we had a bedbug captured in a bag and images of it that clearly identified as such. We were trying to cast aspersion against the hotel or management but we simply wanted them to have a look - but they were not interested in looking. If I were the management I would probably imagine doing the same, but that doesn’t solve the problem for future guests.

reviews.title: Perfect location to enjoy the heart of Vegas
reviews.text: Perfect location to enjoy the heart of Vegas.  Unit was spacious and updated. Vegas is a busy and complicated  city. Park you car and walk to all the best hotels, restaurants, shows  and sites on the strip.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: This was a newer or renovated facility that was very clean and spacious.  The location is perfect! Right across from Caesars and near all the attractions. The building is next to the Flamingo with access to all of their facilities.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo
reviews.text: Not a fan of lock outs -otherwise ok but sitting area small.Store open only until midafternoon and very understocked.Pool was merky-decided not to swim in it.If you do not like noise from DJs do not go

reviews.title: WSOP 2022
reviews.text: This place is close to everything minutes from Ballys/Paris. Great pools hot tub was awesome. Super clean rooms. Every employee were simply happy friendly and informative. This location is super central and around the middle of the strip. I would recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: The hotel was super nice and clean. Room was very spacious. They accommodated everything we needed with no problem.The workers was always nice and smiling. I love everything about the hotel and the room.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: The Hilton grand vacations club flamingo is an excellent small hotel  with excellent service. Our 2 bedrm lockoff was spacious, clean , modern , and had a great view of the pools . Everything is within walking distance to the Las Vegas strip. We loved our stay there and will certainly return in light of the fantastic service provided and the facilities we experienced.

reviews.title: Satisfied
reviews.text: The staffs are very friendly and nice. Facility and the room are very clean. It’s close to everything. Everything you need is all there. We cooked our own breakfast. And the kitchen is very neat and equipped of everything you need. If I go back to Vegas again, I will stay here again.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was good. What was not good was the go pool. The music began at 8:30 in the morning and did not stop until 6 o’clock at night. The bass was so loud that the windows vibrated in the room. If you wanted to sleep in that was not an option.

reviews.title: Nothing like Hilton
