reviews.text: No RestaurantLimited water bottlesLoud during daytime due to old glass in window Clean with not polluted air since it does not have gambling machines and casino(only advantage).Good location for convention center and mono railPaid outrageous price for what the hotel offersInly a starsbucks i side with some snacks

reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.text: We stay here every year, apart from during Covid when we were unable to travel from the UK.     As many mention, the downside is the ridiculous noise that comes from the Flamingo Hotel Pool.  Apparently the ‘ Strip’ has no noise regulations, so there is little that the HGVC can do about it.  It’s is a nuisance,  but the rest of the complex and room facilities more than make up for it.  We have a two bedroom suite with a full kitchen and washing machine, dryer.   The vacations pool and hot tub/ spa are never crowded. There is a distinct lack of umbrellas around the pool, but there are five very nice gazebos if you are down early enough.   The poolside bar was closed during May, it seems that this is no longer used.    Beds are very comfortable, the place is clean and the newly refitted rooms are a great improvement.If you are one to party late in Vegas and lay in during the morning, this is probably not one for you. But if you are prepared to endure the racket from next door, there aren’t really any negatives.  Five minutes and you are on the strip facing Caesar’s Palace. It just suits us perfectly, enjoy the pool in the morning, and all the comforts of home in the apartments and extremely central for the evenings. Staff are great, nothing is too much of a problem. If you have a car, the car park used is the main Flamingo one on the fourth floor.  Climbing stairs can be a bit tiring in the heat, but  there is however a lift if you walk round to the front of the car park. The Deli/ Shop is greatly reduced, there for emergencies but better to use a CVS just up the strip, or if you have a car a Target/ Albertsons within ten minutes drive.  Then enjoy the BBQ’s around the pool.    Perfect for us and many others as you see the same faces around the pool year after year, but not one for late risers.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE POOL NOISE ALL DAY !!!!!! DO NOT STAY HERE !!!!!
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!  Music from pool I so loud from 9am to at least 6pm that you can't even hear the TV in your room over it with the TV volume way up. So basically it is so loud from the pool that you can't possibly sleep past 9am if you wanted to and you basically can't stay in to use the room between 9am and at least 6pm. We are checking out and throwing away the rest of our week here because the pool noise is just so ridiculous. We didn't think the earlier reviews could be serious about it being so loud and annoying, but they were right. Nothing else about the resort makes it worth the crazy loud noise. And, no room in the resort is immune from the noise because they all face the pool area with the speakers pointing directly at them. RIDICULOUS to even rent these to people without a huge disclaimer.  Also, they opened the pool to anyone who wants to pay an entry fee to use the facilities, so the pool is ridiculously crowded with outsiders on top of all of the hotel and HGVC guests using it. Miserable experience, don't make the same mistake. Too many other good places to stay in Las Vegas. Stay elsewhere.

reviews.title: Five Nights and Five Shows
reviews.text: The renovations are completed (nothing is pink).  Every room looks just like the pictures on their web page.  Every room over looks the pool.  High floors get a peek-a-boo view of pieces of the strip lights.  The Flamingo Hotel Pool Party music is loud, but they start off softer from 9am to around noon, then they crank it up.  It is distracting at the condo pool, but tolerable.  The north end of the main building and the north tower rooms do not hear much music inside.  We were on the north end, main bldg, 4th floor.  We were not bothered by the music.  The location is great.  There is a gate in the fence to the Flaming hotel that opens with your room key.  You can grab a cab right there, or go through the Flamingo hotel to the Linq.  Easy walk to the Linq, Harrahs, and Belagios.  The rooms are very nice,  Bring regular coffee filters for the coffee pot.  They sell stuff downstairs, but it is pricy.  The service was great.  Free parking on the 4th floor of the Flamingo hotel parking garage.

reviews.title: Consistent Excellence !
reviews.text: This was a return stay for us  at Hilton GV at the Flamingo. We have always enjoyed our previous time here, so we decided to return. We were warmly greeted by Leo at the front desk. His excellent customer service and pleasant smile made us quickly forget the tiring 4 hour plane ride. He was so helpful and accommodating. He truly made us feel welcomed. The hotel is very clean and the rooms were beautiful and newly renovated. We had a wonderful stay and cannot wait to return !!!!

reviews.title: GREAT LOCATION, CLEAN AND UPDATED PROPERTY
reviews.text: The location is just off the strip, with access to a monorail, near to food, casinos, etc. staff is really nice.  ADA room is farthest from elevator! pool is small but adequate. flamingo privileges are a bonus.

reviews.title: Our “go to” destination in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great property directly behind the Flamingo Casino and Hotel in the heart of the strip. Staff are amazing and go out of their way to make you stay as good as it can be. Suites are roomy and well-appointed - the 2 bedroom includes laundry and full kitchen. Be aware that the resort overlooks the Flamingo pool and the heavy bass of the music being played during the day actually vibrates surfaces in your room. If you spend your days out you won’t be impacted.

reviews.title: Solid location
reviews.text: This is a great location on the strip and a little removed from the “craziness” of Vegas.Our room was beautifully appointed and I was even pleasantly surprised to find a washer/dryer in the room. It was very quiet -We could’ve thought we were the only ones on the floor! Only cautions are the marketplace is only open until 1:30pm everyday and does not sell alcohol. Also, the pool bar is not open which was disappointing. Overall, this is a solid, clean location in a good place on the strip.

reviews.title: Hilton needs to step up here
reviews.text: We have stayed at HGV Flamingo many times. We love the location and the fact that the pool is open all year round and until 10:0 PM.  However, the negatives are beginning to stack up.   The pool was closed one day for repairs during our stay with no advance notice and only alternative offered was the obnoxiously loud Go pool at the Flamingo-NO THANK YOU!  The music is unbearable once the DJ gets started mid day.  Also, the onsite food mart is only open now from 6:30 to 1:30 and the employee takes a lunch for 30-45 minutes so it is closed for a while even with the limited hours.  Twice there were no towels at the pool at the beginning of the day and we had to go to the front desk to request towels be brought out for everyone.  My biggest complaint is the pool bar as yet to reopen since Covid.  We bought in to Hilton Grand vacations because we were told we were purchasing  a resort experience.   We used to be able to order drinks and food around the pool.  Now, you are on your own. This place no longer feels like a resort-just a hotel with nice rooms.   The amenities are dwindling.  Very disappointed.

reviews.title: A excellent place to stay on the strip
reviews.text: The accommodations were very clean and affordable.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  If you want a quiet place right behind the center of the strip, with everything close to all the action, this is the place to be!

reviews.title: Pounding Pool music from the Flamingo is out of Control
reviews.text: There’s no way to have a relaxing stay here or enjoy the outdoor pool area. The adjacent Flamingo pumps the booming bass music so loud directly at the pool and outdoor area whereas your headphones can’t even soften it. Good luck having a conversation and good luck trying to avoid a pounding headache. You can hear the booming bass anywhere inside as well and all the windows rattle.  Front desk has no way to deal with it and they refuse to refund resort fees. Be warned, we read other reviews and though they must be from folks maybe exaggerating, but no it is absolutely the case of being extremely loud. With this said, the staff and accommodations are nice, no complaints here. Note there’s no on site bar or food, except for a market open in the morning only. Sorry, but my recommendation is to not stay here - don’t make the mistake we did.

reviews.title: Enjoy the bass from the excessively loud pool party everyday!!
reviews.text: No a place for a relaxing chill in the afternoon, or for that matter at any time during the day.  As others have said, don’t expect to sleep late or take a nap in the afternoon to prepare for a night out.  The music from the Flamingo pool is ridiculous.  First time and last time here for us.  Thanks for no heads up HGV!

reviews.title: HGVC at the Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: The resort is great, good location even if you don’t have transportation. The staff were amazing especially Kim, Fontaine, Jose and Debra. The only negative was the “Go Pool” music for us but it is only open 10-6 so no real bother.

reviews.title: Don’t stay there if you value quiet time during the day
reviews.text: Hilton Flamingo GVC is a miserable place to stay for couples seeking a relaxing, quiet daytime experience. The constant, booming sounds emanating from the adjacent Flamingo Hilton pool penetrate your eardrums until about 9 pm. No warning was given at booking either. Furthermore, parking is inconvenient and there is no place to even hang your towel after a shower.

reviews.title: WE WERE ROCKED LIKE A HURRICANE!!!!!
reviews.text: What a great resort. Long pool/jacquizi hours, we received a spacious room, fantastic location. The hotel was was close to Giordonos, Port of subs and Ellis island. Spectacular views to be had and extra special care was given by Kim at the front desk.

reviews.title: Expectations exceeded
reviews.text: Positive experience started at Check In.  Leo was informative, courteous and friendly.   Suite was exactly as portrayed in photos. The one minor concern we had was addressed immediately.  Easy access to the “Strip”.  Would Highly recommend.

reviews.title: What a wonderful place to stay
reviews.text: Super Clean, Very Accommodating and Attentive. Thank you for a great stay. So close to many fun attractions. We could see the Bellagio Fountains right from our rooms. So beautiful. The pool was refreshing and the hot tub was very relaxing. We really liked that the pool stayed open later than the other pools.

reviews.title: Nice clean place
reviews.text: We rented a 2 bedroom. Glad we didn't have kids with us since the 2nd bedroom was a separate room with no access to the master suite. I think the tub had been used but not cleaned as there was some nasty white stuff that bubbled up as I filled it. The staff was very friendly and tried to be of help if you had questions. There is a very high-priced market located in the hotel although it is only open from 6 am to 1 pm. The parking ramp is a nightmare but it is close to the resort. we had a view of a pool with very loud music thankfully it was only open until I think 5 pm.Don't overlook the fact that after you pay for the rental of the place you still pay resort fees on top of that (7 days came to a total of $198.99)

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: I wasn't looking for a resort stay or an excessively large hotel that required a 10-minute walk from the front door to the room, especially after walking up and down the strip most of the day.This hotel is a bit off the beaten path, but for this visit it was actually the perfect location. A short walk to the strip or a short walk to the high roller, which is also home to many shops, restaurants and bars, I was able to get to everything I needed on foot. This hotel being immediately adjacent to the Flamingo hotel and casino, which is also attached to the Las Vegas tram provides another option for transportation down the strip within arm's reach.The private pool was closed during my stay, but the very large pool area attached to the flamingo resort is also available to guests. I found the cafe very useful during my stay, especially when I needed my coffee in the morning.The rooms are very comfortable, unfortunately those rooms facing the resort pool come with an annoying level of music and bass every day from 8am to 530pm. Fortunately I was out during those hours each day but will keep this in mind for any future bookings.Cheers!

reviews.title: The pool music will invade your soul
reviews.text: After traveling for 23 hours via 2 flights and a 3 hour stopover, I arrived at the hotel at 11:20am for my 8 night stay.   The frontdesk said there was nothing available and I would have to wait - official checkin is 16:00.  I tried to explain how exhausted I was and after waiting 2 hours they offered me a handicapped room or wait another hour for hopefully a room opening up.  I took the handicap room which was basically the same room but with wider doors.The rooms are large and clean and come with all necessary towels and soaps. The fridge doesn't have a freezer section.  I should have checked before buying  ice cream.    There is no breakfast and no option for any sort of breakfast so one  has to go out and buy food for breakfast.  By the bathroom sink there is no cup. Not plastic or glass when brushing your teeth.  Kinda strange.  For a hotel that assumes that everyone will be eating in their room (all rooms have kitchenettes), they only provide two very small trash cans - one in the bathroom and one in the front closet.If they only provided plastic bags clients could bag their garbage and take it to the  chute down the hall.The power outlet by one bed doesn't work so best to check the power outlets since they don't all work.  After a long day at the casino, I came back to my room at 17:30 to  find it hadn't been cleaned.  I called the front desk and asked for housekeeping. I was told they had already gone home.  Turns out even though their site says daily housekeeping - that means you need to ask to have your room cleaned.  It is not done automatically and they won't tell you that upon check-in.But I would say the worst aspect of the hotel is the connection to the Flamingo and specifically the Flamingo pool.  From 9:00-18:00 they blast thump-thump music at the pool which easily permeates the double-paned glass.  Do not expect to sleep during the day if you had a late night.  If you like to party all night and sleep in till noon this is not the hotel for you.  At night all is peaceful so you can get a good nights sleep.

reviews.title: Family Time
reviews.text: We always have such a great time and the staff is so accommodating. They always let you know if there's anything you need or want that they are there for you. Your comfort is their top priority. I have been a Hilton owner for 25 years and very happy with Hilton.

reviews.title: Very convenient location, family friendly atmosphere
reviews.text: We really enjoyed how close this property was to the monorail station and the strip. It was still far enough to be quiet and give us peace when we were ready for a break. The pool was small but also not crowded like the neighboring pools. The room was very spacious and felt more like a condo than a hotel room.

reviews.title: FABULOUS FLAMINGO VEGAS STYLE
reviews.text: It's been 10 long years since we were here last and this time we had a 2 room suite and brought a friend. We were all so very happy with our rooms, bathrooms, kitchen, kitchenette and living room. The view of the pools was beautiful. The hot tub and pool we used more than ever. The fact that this hotel is right in the middle of all the action has always made it the perfect place to be for us. The staff and HGV Flamingo is 2nd to NONE. THEY ARE FABULOUS!!!!

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: The newly renovated rooms were elegant and lovely! The grounds were beautiful and the staff helpful and friendly. The location is great too because it's in the middle of the strip, close to everything and very convenient.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem at rear of flamingo pool area
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a suite this is definitely a hidden gem. You get all the benefits of staying on the strip without the price tag or the noise. There’s a walkway for a hind the pool of the flamingo that takes you to the entrance of the Hilton grand vacations. It’s a small property that is immaculate and the staff is very accommodating. They allowed us to check in six hours early and we were greeted with several bottles of cold water to take up to a room as well as vouchers for more water for each day of our stay. You cannot access the guestroom floors without a key card so only guests can get up onto the floors which is a nice security touch. They have a pool area of their own that is quiet and relaxing as well as some gardens and play areas. There’s also a small coffee shop and grocery store if you want to stock up on some staples. If you use the main entrance it takes you out just under the highroller and you’re within walking distance of Batista’s Hole in the wall which is a great Italian food choice. I cannot say enough good things about the staff everyone was beyond accommodating and friendly and the rooms were spacious and anything you needed was brought to your room immediately.. They even thought of the little things like complimentary toothbrushes and toothpaste .. They provided shaving cream and razors for someone in our group at no additional charge. In the price for a one bedroom suite with a full kitchen was less than you would’ve paid for a just room at one of the hotels on the strip. We will definitely be staying here our next trip out to Vegas.

reviews.title: Condo-style hotel in the mid-strip area
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacations - Flamingo is a condo-style hotel in the center strip area. The rooms have kitchens, and some have washers and dryers. Rooms are dated. Affordable, practical, comfortable enough, but not interesting or exciting. Housekeeping is limited to 2 free cleanings per week. I believe you can pay for more. Wi-Fi's slow. You can stream video, but probably not high def. There's a dumb semi-hidden resort fee, even though there isn't much of a resort and most of what they did have was temporarily closed. It's on the same block as the Flamingo, but not really part of the resort. HGV's resort fee doesn't get you anything at the Flamingo. The hotel's in an awkward location. You need to walk through some back alleys to get in/out. There's some noise from the Flamingo pool. Loud music starts at 8 am, gets louder around 9-10. Not an issue for me, but would be for light sleepers. This place is a timeshare, which explains the lack of maintenance.

reviews.title: Family Wedding - Awesome Destination!
reviews.text: We are owners of Hilton Grand Vacations.  Our first purchase was at the Flamingo.  We haven't stayed there in recent years, but this year we had points to use and booked a 4-week stay.  After our son and his fiancee decided to visit us and get married, it became a family gathering.  We expect a lot when we stay at a Grand Vacations location, but this visit exceeded our expectations by far!   We had 32 guests, 26 family members who stayed with us at Grand Vacations.  It could have been a crazy time, with everyone coming and going on different schedules, with different needs, but the amazing staff at the resort handled every reservation and interaction  with grace, good nature and treated everyone like truly valued guests.  They all loved the accommodations, the access to everything Vegas related.  We had a lovely ceremony at the Flamingo Wedding Chapel, followed by a brief champagne reception near the pool area.  We've had many beautiful family vacations at Hilton Grand Vacations, but being able to gather family and friends for such a joyous event after the past two years, is probably the best yet!

reviews.title: Fantastic find! We’ve stayed multiple times.
reviews.text: So clean and spacious! We enjoy having a kitchen to buy staples. Then we can splurge on nice meals occasionally.We are very close to all the attractions and don’t need to rent a car. Newly renovated rooms have very high end finishes.

reviews.title: Best location in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at the Hilton Grand at the Flamingo. Great location next to the Monorail. This made it easy to get anywhere I needed to get. Will definitely come back in the near future. Would highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: The room was fantastic!
reviews.text: Great accommodations and great location to fun on the strip.  Seemed like a very small crew at all times, but wonderful to not have someone trying to sell us more points.  The newly remodeled rooms were beautiful

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The location of the property was excellent, the view out the windows were great and the trip itself was well needed! Very welcoming staff and rooms were very clean, was able to fill my 4 day vacation with so much due to being directly on the strip!

reviews.title: Birthday Weekend
reviews.text: Resort is in an excellent location close to the strip. Service was great also. Rooms were very clean and updated. With in walking distance to many restaurants and bars. Also easy access for the tram. Will stay here again.

reviews.title: You must be kidding to call this a Gold Crown Resort
reviews.text: From the moment you drive up you can tell this is not the quality of a gold crown resort. Outside looks old and plain not elegant. Inside, no luggage carts are available to guests so you must use their bill service at a cost! The elevators are old and rickety and each time do you use them you don’t know if your key card will correctly read or not. Inside the room, I found a Kleenex dispenser with no Kleenex in it, towels that were thin and rough rather than thick and plush like you would expect of a gold crown resort. The room came with a stacked washer and dryer but the dryer was broken, the ironing board was there but no iron, and the bed was hard. And the kitchen included a combo microwave/convection oven/air fryer but no microwavable dishes or containers were provided and there were no instructions for how to use as a convection oven.  In summary, this resort does not live up to its status as a gold crown resort.

reviews.title: BEST FAMILY Clean Hotel Right in the action
reviews.text: We loved this location as it was near all the buzz and hype but you were able to get away with in a minute to a non smoking, clean hotel.  The staff was SUPER AMAZING!!! I have not had customer service like this since I stayed in a five star a long time ago.  The room was chic and clean.  The bed super comfortable!  I didn't wake up with a back ache so that will tell you something.  We loved our stay!

reviews.title: Management Worked to Correct a Poor Situation
reviews.text: I had previously posted a 2/5 rating of the property from a stay in December.  Management went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of.  We will book a future stay to give this property another chance.  Hats off to the staff for reaching out to speak with me and correcting the problem.  Will stay again once the renovation is complete.

reviews.title: Wonderful holiday vacation
reviews.text: We spent 9 days at the timeshare and had a wonderful Christmas and New Years the rooms and facility were perfect for the 4 of us. Everything was clean and staff were very helpful and friendly. It was nice to be on the strip but not caught up in the long lines we saw in the hotels. It was quiet but close to everything we wanted to do. The monorail access is very convenient to this location too. We will definitely come back and recommend it to anybody wanting to visit Vegas

reviews.title: Unforgettable vacation in a nice resort
reviews.text: Very clean.The employees are nice.We will go back again if theres a chance.W e stayed in the 15th floor overlooking the swimming pools Very nice view.if you need anything just call and they are fast in bringing to your room.It is free to rent one movie everyday.They also give two bottles of water everyday.

reviews.title: My Review
reviews.text: (1) Hotel entrance is on Linq Lane, not Las Vegas Blvd. Drop-off your family/luggage, and you get a barcoded in-and-out ticket for the Flamingo Hotel's garage. Garage has no elevator and spaces are tight. You walk across the road shared with the Flamingo Hotel guest drop-off area. I found Google Maps' street-view very helpful to prepare myself find this place. (2) Our room was nice and recently renovated, but you'll hear renovation construction noises during the day. The appliances were new. The bath tub is huge (no jets). We had a view of the Flamingo Hotel and pool. (3) I like the option to text for housekeeping requests and general questions. (4) The staff was great, check-in was easy.

reviews.title: Happy Owner Home
reviews.text: I love the location of the HGVC Flamingo. For decades I’ve stayed at the Flamingo hotel to play poker and it took almost 30 minutes to get out the building. Not an easy task now with a service dog. The Flamingo Hilton Grand is prefect because a short two minute walk and I’m on the Flamingo property and in less than 5 minutes on the casino floor. I love the intimacy of the property and the staff. Christian and Arnold at the front desk always welcome me and my service guy back by name and make us feel like we are back at home. This visit a kid tried to touch my service dog and the property advocated for us given they have seen him many times and know his training. The South tower is closest to the casino but furthest from front desk. It’s a smaller property so when I say furthest I mean a 3 minute walk to front desk is far. The main tower has upgraded rooms but all the rooms are awesome. We personally love and prefer the South tower for the easy in and out access to the Flamingo and outside. The free DVD rental is a plus but no Netflix on the tv or other entertainment so bring an HDMI if you want that additional access. Also if you like Starbucks it’s a quicker easier and more economical choice to go across the street to the Westin vs. the Flamingo promenade. We will be back!

reviews.title: Clean, updated accommodations and friendly, efficient staff
reviews.text: The staff were friendly and efficient. Our microwave stopped working and was promptly replace with a new one. The service from housekeeping was quick when we asked for additional toiletries and towels. The unit was clean and fresh. The location to the casinos was perfect!

reviews.title: Comfortable room
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom unit. Very comfortable and great layout. Very disappointed nothing was available to purchase…no snacks, drinks, etc. Uber/Lyft often had a hard time finding the entrance for pickup.

reviews.title: Best hidden secret
reviews.text: Property is located close to everything.  Staff was very polite.   It’s quite enough and close to casino.   I don’t like staying in the casino hotels.   So here I feel safer.  It’s a stop on the monorail system, so gives you easy access to the strip.

reviews.title: better than expected
reviews.text: new unit everything well stocked.  Employees all went out of their way to be helpful. only negative resort fee 25 per day while most other timeshares do not charge. would go back because the units were excellent

reviews.title: Amazing stay!!!
reviews.text: The stay at the Hilton was great! Super friendly staff, great accommodations, great location!! This hotel does not have a casino and is non-smoking which is amazing!! If you would like to gamble, the flamingo is a 2 minute walk from the lobby of the hotel! It’s the perfect place for all to stay!! Quiet and out of the hustle of the strip but close enough that it doesn’t ruin your experience!

reviews.title: HGV at the Flamingo
reviews.text: Excellent property with easy access to the strip. The hotel food mart was not open, which would have been helpful, but other stores are easily accessible. The room had beautiful views of the Flamingo with views of the lush gardens

reviews.title: Best Stay Ever
reviews.text: This was the best place we've stayed at in Vegas (and I come here often) The staff is unbelievably hospitable.  Upon our arrival we were checked in my Amalla (sp?) and Kim, who gave us an amazing room.  We were lucky that our room was ready early.  They were so friendly and helpful at the front desk. Debra at the grand vacations desk was also incredibly friendly and told us all about the discounts we can get at participating restaurants and activities.  Km made us feel so welcome. She is from Hawaii as are we, and it was so nice to be met with such aloha.  The hotel is at a great location, right by the monorail. There is the promenade nearby, with lots of shops and restaurants to choose from.  It is right behind the Flamingo, away from all the hustle and bustle of the strip.  The entrance was never crowded.  I am definitely staying at this HGV the next time we come back!

reviews.title: Excellent location; quiet rooms, just off the strip
reviews.text: If you are visiting Vegas, but really not into the smoke filled casinos, this is an excellent alternative. Located just off the strip, it is centrally located and within walking distance to most casinos. The monorail which services the entire strip stops within a block. The rooms were exceptional, comfortable, clean and spacious. In addition, the customer service was outstanding every step of the way. Gina at the front desk checked us in and her assistance was over the top. She made herself available to us the entire stay and was always smiling and friendly each time we crossed paths. I can't say enough about her. Other staff members were equally friendly and engaging. Even our room service attendant saw us on the street and said hi and asked how our day was going. The facilities are excellent; I used the workout facility twice and we were able to enjoy the pool and hot tub as well. We don't generally go to Vegas very often, but now that we know about Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo, we will certainly be back for shows and will exclusively stay there.

reviews.title: Subpar Facility
reviews.text: You would think the Flamingo location would make finding this facility easy, but that was not the case.  The entrance is beyond a long line of dumpsters.  Our room was nice enough but the resort itself was a big disappointment.  Never again.  There are far better choices than HGVC Flamingo.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Friendly service, clean room and excellent location..Many location were in short walking  distance . We will definitely stay again..Parking garage is a little frustrating ,but disabled parking was available on a first come basis…and Flamingo casino was a very short walking distance

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Clean and quiet rooms.  Location is excellent with the monorail and access to great casinos.  Linq street was great for family.   Be sure to ask for the experience card that gets you 20% off many restaurants.

reviews.title: HGVC - Flamingo
reviews.text: We stayed in a renovated part of the property, beautifully done! We like the proximity to the strip, and appreciate the nice quiet atmosphere of this property. It is also right on the monorail line for added convenience.

reviews.title: Not at the Flamingo
reviews.text: This property is not in the Flamingo resort. It is next-door and a little obscure, making it difficult to get rideshare or taxis.  Check-in is not until 4 PM And check out is at 10 AM. The store is not open, no coffee station, no bar. It is like the Spirit Airline version of resorts. The rooms are nice but there was toothpaste on the wall in the bathroom and water still in the coffee reservoir. Not certain what the air freshener smell is at the HGV’s, but it is overwhelming and not necessarily pleasant. Does anyone else have trouble booking resorts or RCI? or using the dashboard? It is a quagmire for us.

reviews.title: Great smoke-free environment
reviews.text: Perfect for those who need clean air. It’s an older hotel, but clean with a great staff. It is NOT attached to the Flamingo, so don’t try and check-in there. From the airport use Lyft or catch a cab. Those are your only good options.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: This is a great location to the strip yet far enough away to enjoy peace and quiet when you want it. Hotel staff is great and very helpful, housekeeping very thorough. Outside setting is great to enjoy

reviews.title: Outstanding Room
reviews.text: We stayed here for three days (Wed-Thu-Fri) in November of this year and couldn't be more pleased with our experience.This is a timeshare property and as such doesn't have all of bells and whistles you might associate with a "regular" Vegas hotel.  However, it is directly adjacent to the main Flamingo Hotel and Casino Resort property located at the heart of the strip.  The main Flamingo tower faces Las Vegas Blvd and behind it are its gardens and extensive pool area.  The Hilton tower is located on the back side (east side) of that area and looks directly down on it.  All rooms face inward toward the pool and garden, so the view is fantastic, especially from the upper floors.  If you need to visit a gift shop, get a car rental, or go to a restaurant or casino, just walk to the other side of the pool area to the Flamingo.There are three towers to the Hilton facility, all facing in toward the pool and gardens.  At the time of our stay the rooms were undergoing a floor-by-floor renovation in the main tower.  We were able to get a newly renovated one-bedroom suite and it was fantastic.  The floor space was huge for two people.  The main room was a combined kitchen/dining/lounge area with plenty of seating and full windows across the end of the room overlooking the pool/garden.  The couch appeared to be a fold-out bed (double size) which would be perfect for kids or a 3rd adult.  The kitchen was fully equipped with fridge/freezer, range, microwave, dishwasher, and a full set of dishes.  The bedroom was located to the side, with its own windows, a king bed, and desk area.  To the rear of the sleeping area was a vanity and a 2-person jacuzzi tub.  Another separate bathroom area had its own vanity, shower, and toilet.  Overall, the size of the room was the most impressive aspect.  Plus, being newly renovated, the place positively sparkled.  The whole facility was exceptionally maintained.Normally guests of the Hilton would have use of the Flamingo pool area, but it had just closed for the season the week before we arrived.  We were able to use the Hilton’s own smaller (heated) pool and hot tub, and a small exercise facility.The whole facility was super-quiet.  They even had a posted "no party" policy.  So if you are looking for a room to party in, this might not be the place for you.  But if you want a room for rest and recuperation before hitting the strip, it's perfect.The front desk staff was top-notch, super helpful, answered all of our questions, and got us a taxi to the airport on our departure.Our room rate was just under $150 a night (closer to $200 with fees and taxes) but for the location, views, and size of the room, we found it to be a great value.  We would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Not as good as expected
reviews.text: I was expected more from the place when I booked my reservation.  Here is an overview:Rooms - large rooms but they are dark.  The lamps have light bulbs that are maybe 40 watts and there are only 3 lamps.  Plus the bathroom lights and light when you enter also have dim lights.  They really need to spend a little money to get better lighting.  I don't think it would cost them much money if they got 100 watt light bulbs for their lamps.  Bathroom sink and shower are small.  Coffee is not good - bring your own and use their coffee maker to brew.  Also, bring your own coffee creamers, they only offer the powdered creamer.  Not enough sweet & low either.  They do have a safe but the battery was dead so I had to ask them to replace the battery which they did the next day.   Room was quiet every night which I liked.  The cleaning crew was good.  Microwave and fridge worked well.  My beverage's were always cold.Exercise room - they have Precor ellipticals and a Precor exercise bike which I like.  They looked new and they are both high end.  Two negatives - the dispenser for the sanitizing wipes is always empty and they do not have a cold water dispenser.  Bring your own water. They do have towels.  The exercise room is a little warm so you will work up a good sweat.Front desk - they did a good job.Other amenities - they really should offer coffee in the lobby area.  Every hotel I have been too this year has done this. Very cheap on their part not to do this.No place to eat here so be prepared to go out for breakfast (plenty of places nearby).

reviews.title: Very good experience
reviews.text: Do not hésite to go there, it is a nice, safe and quiet place. The apartment is big, well equipped and very confortable. The bed coach is very confortable too. We really enjoy the place. I am impressed.

reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo was an excellent place to stay. We had a king suite with kitchen, living room, bar area, bathroom/shower and toilet with separate double tub area and separate sink areas by both the tub and shower area. Also, had washer and dryer.  The staff was super. Could not have asked for a better experience.  Highly recommend this place for a great vacation!

reviews.title: HGV wonderful time - again
reviews.text: Excellent rooms- perfectly clean, well maintained. Staff at front desk extremely accommodating- both day and evening. As usual we felt at home . The location is unbeatable as we could walk to many of the casinos, restaurants and hotel on the central strip.

reviews.title: What? Coffee shop and sundries store still not open!
reviews.text: This forces you to drive miles to buy groceries and walk a long distance for a good cup of coffee. For someone who uses a cane, this is a big inconvenience. Also there was construction/maintenance going on above our unit with loud hammering starting at 9AM most mornings of our six night stay.

reviews.title: Much needed vacation
reviews.text: From beginning to end of trip everyone there was very friendly and accommodating and the room was very clean.  It’s ice that this is a family friendly hotel with no a party policy.  The casino is just steps away so it is a really quiet and pleasant place to stay if you don’t want all the noise.

reviews.title: Great Location, Clean and welcoming!
reviews.text: Such a great place, directly on monorail for easy access to all of Vegas. Nicest room I have stayed in while traveling to Las Vegas Will always bring staying at an HGV property when I travel to Las Vegas

reviews.title: Couple Retreat
reviews.text: Love this resort. Great location, love the rooms, quiet pool area. Always my go-to when I’m in Vegas.  With Covid, I was disappointed the Marketplace was not open. Overall happy with my stay and will be back again.

reviews.title: Fun time with no issues
reviews.text: Read reviews before I arrived so I was aware that check in is different than the Flamingo Hotel registration.  The signage could be better.  It is a bit confusing to find your way behind the hotel to get to HGVC.  We stayed in the North tower which has a back door close by the Linq Promenade next door.  The South tower will be closer to the Flamingo Hotel entrance.  The pool and spa were clean and close to the North tower rooms.  The rooms were clean and equipped with the bare basics in the kitchen.  The staff were quite friendly and good with directions.  There is a lot of walking to get almost anywhere.  The corner where the Flamingo is located is the best location on the Strip.  You can walk to Paris, Bellagio, Caesars and the Linq.  Also the monorail runs quite near the HGVC.  A nice place to stay.

reviews.title: Pandemic Trip
reviews.text: Be sure to bringBe sure to stop for groceries if you are staying for a week.  The Marketplace is closed and no valet parking available.  Full kitchen no longer has an oven but microwave has convection cooking available.

reviews.title: Not good a all
reviews.text: Not a good place for old people who have problems getting around it requires a lot of walking. Everything is located in the Flamingo Hotel there is nothing in the (HGV) Hilton Grand Vacation no one tells you that up front.

reviews.title: Perfect for a business trip! Clean!
reviews.text: I loved my stay here. After a long day at the conference,  it was great coming back to a quiet and clean room. I enjoyed not having to walk through casino to get to my room but being close to the strip.

reviews.title: Great location right behind the Flamingo pool
reviews.text: The location is great; it’s a 25 minute walk to Aria and 15 to the Venetian.  The monorail station is right out the front door.  The High Roller is a 2 minute walk and Gordon Ramsey Fish and Chips about 5.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.  The condo itself is spacious with all the necessities including a washer and dryer in the two bedroom unit..  Unfortunately the showers on both sides had easy to see mold in them.  Who knows how long it had been since they had been cleaned.  When I called the front desk they sent someone up immediately to clean them.  Additionally, when I moved the living room chair to use the sofa pull out bed, there were all sorts of candy/food underneath it—obviously it hadn’t been vacuumed there in a while.  The sofa bed was ok—not the best ever, but also didn’t feel the springs underneath.  If the unit had been cleaner, it would have received a higher rating.

reviews.title: Would stay here again
reviews.text: Very friendly and accommodating staff. They did not have a breakfast option due to Covid. Great location on the strip. Nice big pool and a private pool area. Rooms were clean. It was very quiet even with the pool music going. There is a monorail stop right at the hotel which was a huge plus!!

reviews.title: Great location and superb staff.
reviews.text: The location of this timeshare is great.  It is a short walk to the main boulevard and near many restaurants.  The pools are very nice and the staff is very responsive.  The timeshare is located near the base of the big observation wheel and near one of the stops of the monorail.

reviews.title: This resort is very, quiet, and there is a lot privacy. Yet is is very close to all the Lads Vegas strip activities. You
reviews.text: This resort is very, quiet, and there is a lot privacy. Yet is is very close to all the Lads Vegas strip activities. You

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Our one bedroom unit was amazing.  Two sink areas.  Bedroom separate from living room.  Staff amazing.   Friendly and helpful at all times.  A short walk to the strip.   You can use their pool area or Flamingo pool which was more of a party crowd.  Would definitely return.

reviews.title: I Expect More
reviews.text: The property is convenient to the monorail and behind the Linq and Flamingo hotels.  Both of those facilities are worn out and seedy.  Experienced lots of noise from occupants in adjacent room during the majority of my stay.  Coffee pot was dirty and the courtesy amenities (shampoo, lotion, etc.) had been used by another occupant prior to my stay.  Courtesy coffee in the room was horrible.  The staff are friendly and professional.  Location is convenient to the strip.

reviews.title: Location and luxury.
reviews.text: Nice rooms and excellent location at a short walking distance from the Strip and all the famous casinos. The rooms are quite noisy during the day because of the craziness going on in the public pool . Luckily this doesn’t start before 9.00/10.00 am and stops around 5.00 pm . The nights are very quiet .

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Softball tournament and family reunion. Everyone was professional and polite. I appreciated the cleaning service and location. Even though it was in the middle of everything, it was nice and quiet. Thank you

reviews.title: First time to Vegas
reviews.text: Location couldn't be better.    Pool at Flamingo next door was great and included with our stay.  Biggest issue was, it seemed most drivers in the area didn't know where the main drop off area of the hotel was so we would either explain it and hope they figured it out or just walk to the Flamingo where they could easily navigate to.

reviews.title: Great location and wonderful accommodations.
reviews.text: I stayed here for a trip with my sisters September 13-18th. The pool was really nice and clean but the pool bar was not open and the music from the Flamingo pool was quite loud. Think cool club music. The room was spotless and had two huge vanity areas which was great and not typical for a one bath-one bed unit. We were also next to the tram station which made getting around easy. I’d stay here again without question.

reviews.title: Been there for years
reviews.text: Nice quiet place.checking in and out very easy.Very clean rooms very nice.kitchen and washer and dryer.Sports book and casino next door.Near most attractions on strip.mono rail near to take you to many places

reviews.title: Great Place To Stay!
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Beautiful view. Overall great place to stay with your family and friends! We will be back! Safe place to be. Good location. Nice walking areas. Beautiful landscaping. Nice that you can walk over the Flamingo and casino.

reviews.title: Vegas Alive and Waiting
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Flamingo is located behind the Flamingo on the Strip.  So check in is very confusing!!  Other than waiting in the line up for 45 mins.  to then discover I was in the wrong hotel, my check in at the right location went very smoothly.  The staff was awesome and the location was perfect.

reviews.title: Conveniently located but music from GO Pool too loud
reviews.text: No matter which room you stay in, the club music BLARING from the GO Pool at the Flamingo is TOO much. It starts playing at 8am!!!! The actual pool club doesn't open until 9am so why they start playing at 8am?! When I stayed here 6 years, there was no GO Pool so there was no noise issue. They need to either turn it down a couple of notches on volume, or turn down bass level or start playing at 9am.They didn't tell us that hotel was under renovation so we got power tools & hammering right above our heads. It was not good so we repacked and changed rooms from 9th fl with views of the pools and part of Vegas skyline to 3rd fl where we overlooked walkway. GEEZ. And you have to pay for housekeeping if you wanted your room cleaned. Something like $33 per cleaning... Wow.

reviews.title: Professional and friendly staff
reviews.text: I would of rated it 10 Because The employees at the Hilton Grand Flamingo were professional and friendly etc. Though There was a major issue with the party that was staying in the attached room next to us. Thank you for your time, Teresa And Jesus Hernandez

reviews.title: 8am wakeup whether you want it or not!
reviews.text: Nice hotel, clean rooms, but be prepared to get woken up every morning at 8am when the Flamingo pool starts cranking loud music.. the thudding bass you can hear and feel.. no consideration for people still sleeping at that time.. i wouldn’t stay again

reviews.title: Beautiful resort at a great location
reviews.text: Lovely resort on a great location, very close to the strip and many restaurants and many entertaiment shows. Service was excellent, highly recommend this resort not only for the location but also for the service .

reviews.title: Location and resort as a whole.
reviews.text: We love this resort. Unfortunately the cleaning in the room was bad. This was also the first timeshare in Vegas where we had to pay resort fees and we have stayed at many. I  was very unimpressed to say the least. Paying for something they usually give you for free is not cool.

reviews.title: nice, clean, safe hotel
reviews.text: hotel is very close to the strip, could walk there in 5 mins.  Paid extra to park up front since there was no valet - was much cheaper than a valet!  Was upgraded to a one bedroom suite which was great and had a washer/dryer

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: Had a great time very clean, great atmosphere , perfect location, very cost effective .. pool was great, landscaping groomed well, overall great stay .. really enjoyed my stay HGV flamingo is definitely recommended

reviews.title: Great Location, Outdated Facilities
reviews.text: I will say the service was the best part of our staying on my girl's trip.. Otherwise, the facility is very run down with the exception of the lobby area which is very nice and updated. The cabinets in our hotel room were broken in multiple areas and there was a slight film on them as though they were not wiped down thoroughly. The location was also very convenient and right in the middle of the strip. You do have to walk through the flamingo though to get to the hotel from the strip. Fontaine and Christian were super nice and helpful.

reviews.title: Great Hilton Property
reviews.text: The property itself was beautiful and everything we need for a place in Vegas. The only reason I didn't rate it higher is because there wasn't really any above and beyond the extras but I also don't feel they are necessary.

reviews.title: $40 Housekeeping Fee????
reviews.text: I have spent probably over a thousand nights in hotels, and I have NEVER in my life seen a housekeeping fee! Well I just saw one!When checking in, they presented me with the attached document that I had to sign confirming whether I wanted housekeeping for a $39.08 plus tax fee or whether I'd prefer to decline it....  This is in addition to the room rate and daily resort charge.....  Even as a Hilton Diamond, I have zero expectations especially for a Hilton vacation property, but a housekeeping fee??? Really???

reviews.title: Spacious room
reviews.text: We stayed in a studio, king size bed, and a sofa bed. Big room and bathroom, big tub, microwave and refrigerator. The jacuzzi and dry sauna on the lobby’s floor is clean and not crowded at all. Very comfortable living. Walking distance to Flamingo hotel and Strip, where you can find various restaurants with reasonable prices.Walking distance to High Roller. The ride is about $38, we enjoyed the beautiful night view of Las Vegas from the top of the high roller.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo
reviews.text: It’s a nice hotel. We have stayed here many times in the past. We have usually loved it, but this time we were a little disappointed. The front desk was not all that helpful. The convenience store had closed down and all they had in the lobby was an overpriced pop machine that only took cards. Maybe it was due to Covid restrictions. This time I will give them a pass. To be a Hilton Grand Vacations Owner as well as having Diamond status, I was a little disappointed to say the least!

reviews.title: My review

reviews.title: Filthy
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacation on the strip was filthy, vomit on the toilet and a complete lack of amenities. They will not service your room unless you pay extra but they don’t provide enough towels for your stay. The temperature of the hotel was completely unacceptable from the lobby to the hallways which likely exceeded 85 degrees while the room never went below 75 at night and 78 during the day. It was pretty miserable. My wife requested a vanity mirror to do her makeup the front desk told her none were available however when the maid came to clean up the vomit in the bathroom she was able to quickly obtain a vanity mirror without trouble. Wish we had stayed in a casino hotel at least food options would have been available as well as reasonable room temperatures. This location doesn’t allow for easy access to the strip.

reviews.title: Great Location While Visiting National Parks
reviews.text: The hotel is a good location. It's a quiet hotel. We thankfully weren't here during the day because the loud pool parties at the Flamingo can be obnoxious. Those end at 6pm. After 6pm was quiet around the pool at the Flamingo. Parking is convenient because it's reserved. The garage is chaotic. Flamingo guests are driving wherever to get a spot to park. Be alert or you will have a fender bender. The wifi could be better. I wasn't able to stream any shows. They buffered. Just was able to check my emails and play games.

reviews.title: Worst Experience HGV
reviews.text: This Hilton Grand Vacation is a let down. The room is old with popcorn ceiling , old furniture that feels like a cheap motel. …The desk clerk on our first night was very unhelpful and rude. Loud noise from the pool party at the next building (Flamingo hotel) that you can’t find any quiet room in this tiny narrow hotel. If you’re a night person, the loud sound will wake you up early every morning. Every Hilton that we had stayed at has always let us check out late (noon) but this place will not, forcing us to check out at 10am after not having a good nights sleep for the entire stay. The message we got “I am very sorry we weren't able to extend a late check-out. “We will be happy to store luggage and allow you access to the pool if needed. -Ramon, Owner Concierge “ We had a meeting today to consider upgrading our Hilton ownership, but after this stay, we’re second guessing the ownership that we have ! Very disappointed !!!

reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: It was amazing. Location is perfect and I felt very comfortable with my family. I am bummed that I had to pay a daily resort fee on top of the payment with RCI, but I would pay it again. It was well worth it.

reviews.title: Getaway
reviews.text: Resort was busy upon arrival.  Check in was handled in a timely manner.  We had been here before and we enjoyed the stay even more.  Undecided about the daily fee charge.  Location was excellent and able to walk to everything we wanted to see.

reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
reviews.text: My wife and I were exhausted by the Las Vegas hot weather. We arrived at hotel early in the morning, we did not expect to get at that time. Analeah the guest service agent offered us early check in, we could rest our feet, so kindly. Analeah and her associate Gina are very friendly and professional, giving us all the information we need. The room was very clean and comfortable. We would love to stay in this hotel again .

reviews.title: Great time was had by all
reviews.text: Me, 3 daughters and their families all were very happy here.  Staff was friendly and very helpful.  Rooms were clean, quiet and in good shape.  Small pool was just what we needed (as compared to the huge, busy at the Flamingo next door).  A bit hard to find, but once you find it location is great.  2 daughters went to Flamingo first where check-in was a mess.  I knew not to do that, and was checked in within minutes without lines.  Free parking hint - go to 5th floor and then go down - LOTS of parking on 4th floor on the way down.  Easy walk to the strip and lots of food places.

reviews.title: Grand Vacations Means Huge Family Vacation
reviews.text: I don't want to be too negative, so will list the positives first.  If you are looking for an "apartment" type stay, this will work.  Many rooms have kitchens and extra beds.  The pool area is not large, but very nice.  Lots of storage in the rooms!!  There were loungers, umbrellas, outdoor chairs/couches, grills and picnic tables.  Yes, really more like renting a condo with limited amenities.We paid a resort fee for every night, for....  It says unlimited movies, but, that means you have to check out a DVD at the desk.  Room cleaning, 1 time in an 8 day stay (we could pay like $30 a day for more).  Rooms are very outdated (almost back in style now...very 70's retro...but smelled of dust and sprinkle on carpet cleaner, the bedskirt had an Ombre look, due to the stains).  The Bath towels (3...wow 1 extra for the first 4 days, thanks) were thin and scratchy like a YMCA.  The Bed was very uncomfortable and sagging in the middle.  Lots of different pillows, so that was nice.  Also lots of storage!!Our room was semi-connected to another room, so we had to listen to 2 doors slam shut every time the people next door left.  Room over-looks the garden... yay...this really means... heavy rock music thumping from the Flamingo Hotel Go Pool starting at 9 AM.  (I came here to vacation and get up at like noon... : )     The power in half of the room went out the first two days (while we were gone, so we were not overloading it).  No perks for Hilton Diamond Rewards Members.  The little market is not open yet, but a DVS is within about a 5 min walk to get water and other necessities.  Hilton needs to do a major upgrade or a major discount.  GO Pool is cool if you like too hang out and drink, but super overcrowded as they offer paid access.The Monorail is just outside the hotel so easy access..Staff was very friendly and desk personnel were very helpful (the person at the "concierge" desk did nothing)

reviews.title: Owner satisfaction, well done
reviews.text: The flamingo is the best located Hilton property in Vegas, there are easy entry from any direction, the pool access to its own plus the Flamingo pool provides an advantage no other location has and plus these pool locations are very private with little viewing by non members

reviews.title: Nice quiet oasis on the strip
reviews.text: Tucked between the High Roller and the Flamingo, this Hilton offers a high quality stay without all the noise and bustle of the strip. We found the accommodations perfect for our family weekend. There are plenty of amenities within walking distance and we found the staff friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Great Hotel in the Middle of a Cesspool...
reviews.text: I loved the room and the staff, but the guests at the Flamingo Hotel pool next door, which is shared, were loud, vulgar, crude, the cigarette and pot smoke wafted over the whole area, and their drunken behavior and total domination of the pool area made it very unfriendly and impossible to use for families.  The obnoxious thumping music coming from the pool area penetrated the hotel walls from 8:30 am to 6 pm, which made the room uncomfortable during the day.  In order to come and go from the hotel one must pass through the cesspool that is the Flamingo, alleys and sidewalks with pools of vomit along the path, or a urine scented garage.  This is such a nice facility and it is a shame that it is located as it is.

reviews.title: Las Vegas girls trip
reviews.text: The facility is in an excellent location on the strip-right in the center of the strip and right next to the monorail stop. The staff was very pleasant  and entire facility is a well maintained facility.  The rooms were fantastic. We especially enjoyed we were able to use both pools on the grounds.  One is private just for the Hilton guests and the large pool for the Flamingo Hotel guests was gorgeous!

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Took family members and we had a two bedroom suite. Was perfect. Close to great spots and the strip! Would definitely stay there again. Super convenient to the Linq area with lots of food options, the High Roller and zip lining.

reviews.title: Another Great Stay at HGVClub Flamingo
reviews.text: Our week long stay at the HGVC was great.  The location perfect.  Only a short walk to catch our Uber Ride and was able to leave our car parked for the week.  The Staff was great and the room clean and updated.Due to Covid we were not able to use the Luggage Cart which made it difficult to get our luggage to the room in 1 trip.  We were on the road for 2 weeks and needed to change out and do laundry.  No problem we made due and our stay was still great.

reviews.title: Close to strip
reviews.text: quiet and clean and close to the strip. late arrival not a problem. free parking in flamingo garage. easy access to strip. didn't use the pools but looked inviting. bed comfortable. nice having washer and dryer to go home with clean clothes. Would recommend.

reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here
reviews.text: The rooms do not go down past 76 degrees, our hotel room door did not lock, and they did not honor my friends and family discount. The employees whom i spoke to regarding these problems were not interested in resolving them.

reviews.title: Nice Resort in Convenient Location
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay.  We used the private pool because the Flamingo GO Pool had very long lines and was too crowded.  A few issues with no bell person being available and not allowed to use luggage cart at check in.  I would stay at this resort again.

reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: Excellent service & immaculate facilities felt very comfortable with all the cleaning protocols established. Hilton staff professionalism was outstanding, very friendly, and helpful. I Will make this my place to stay during my visits.

reviews.title: Staff at front desk was very rude.
reviews.text: Although, the accommodations where nice and the hotel is located in a perfect area the Staff at front desk was very rude Jorge and Kim where rude while checking in and out where not welcoming at all and had horrible customer service.

reviews.title: Location, Location, Location
reviews.text: Friendly staff, large rooms, great location, pretty clean except for the shared parking garage (but that was convenient). I rated it four stars because there’s room for improvement (heat lamps in baths, coffee in lobby,... however, nothing to stop me from going back :)

reviews.title: More of a Hampton without the perks.
reviews.text: We stayed here for a long weekend for our Anniversary. We chose this location due to its proximity to the strip...The good? It’s close to the strip, a short walk around or through the Flamingo puts you across the street from Caesar’s Palace. Also nice was the room interior, nice kitchen and corner bath, large TVs etc. guests are able to use the flamingo pools as well. The bad? It’s not a resort. We were charged $25 a night for a resort fee for absolutely nothing. The pool was slightly larger than the Hampton Inn pool we were at a couple of weeks ago. There is no shop to buy even snacks. There is no breakfast, not even a coffee pot out (they leave one packet of coffee in the room). The only thing we received were two bottles of nasty bottled water which I get as a diamond member anyway. The gym was the same as any other Hilton brand hotel, functional but nothing special and only open 6am to 6pm.There isn’t really a view, I guess I can see the mountains past the buildings and the inner workings of the wheel thing, but still pretty minimal. If you do want your room serviced, they charge you an extra $40.00.How was this a resort? It was like a hotel pimple on the back of the Flamingo. Other than the concierge that all but ignored us, the staff was very nice and accommodating. There are better deals on the strip. I went here out of loyalty to the Hilton brand, I should of looked elsewhere, the points aren’t worth it.

reviews.title: Central Location yet tranquil
reviews.text: Center of the Las Vegas strip, attached to a large casino which can be completely avoided.  Our pool was surrounded by tables and grills that we took advantage of several times during our stay.  There was a view to the Flamingo's Go Pool, which is accessible if desired.  The monorail stop is right next to the resort- though it wasn't back in service yet.

reviews.title: Never judge a book by it's cover
reviews.text: Beautiful resorts , very nice rooms and great service...however there is a $25.00 per night resort fee they added which adds up to 175.00 in addition to the exchange fees. Also if you are a night owl , don't stay here...very loud music at starting at 8:00 am. We had a car , so we had "free parking " next door at garage, but it is a very long walk and lots of stairs when elevators don't work.

reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.text: We arrived at 2am and received excellent service the moment we checked in! Although it’s not a luxury property, it’s high quality for the staff! Our room was great and bed was so comfortable. We will definitely stay here again and again. We love the Flamingo!i

reviews.title: Definitely Recommend!!
reviews.text: Rooms were clean, kitchen had everything we needed from cooking things to cleaning. We asked to not have our rooms cleaned donde we were only there two nights. And everything was walking distance! I’ll be coming back soon!

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: This place is in the best location on the strip.  It is right in the middle of everything and steps away from the Linq Promenade.  I was worried about not being in a Casino resort, but you are linked to the Flamingo.  The rooms are HUGE!  We were able to spread out and be comfortable.  It was nice to have a FULL kitchen as food on the strip is quite expensive.  Also, a washer dryer allowed us to pack light and leave room in our suitcase for shopping items to bring home.

reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.text: We booked this for a last minute getaway.  This was the first time staying at the hotel and we were very happy.  The location to the strip was good.  Short walking distance to everything.  The hotel was quite and the rooms were large and clean.  The pool area was on the small side but it was a nice place to relax.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: Small size condotel!  Great for family and friends.  Walking distance to strip.  Enough distance away from crowds to enjoy your own company or company with family and friends.  At the pool, there are cabanas and grills to cook and enjoy your pool side meals or bring back to the room!  We BBQ’d steaks and it was great!  Thank you

reviews.title: Great property, Excellent location!
reviews.text: Property is adjacent to the High Rollers Farris wheel, the Las Vegas Monorail, the Vegas Strip, and the LinQ!Parking lot is shared with the Flamingo Hotel. It’s close to all of the action without all of the smoke. The property has a heated swimming pool which is great for families!

reviews.title: Definitely recommend!
reviews.text: The room was amazing and we had a 2 person tub that was perfect! The location was just right and the room was beautiful! Definitely will be staying there again and recommend staying! Staff was so friendly and welcoming also loved the free DVD machine!

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We would of loved to had reserved this Hotel from the beginning of our trip . Extremely satisfied with room and all the amenities! My family and I loved this hotel and will definitely be back again . Great place !

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location to stay, it is close to the center of the strip and easy to get to Las Vegas blvd.  the best thing about the hotel is it is quiet and a short walk away from the noise and is a bit of a sanctuary to get away if needed.

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: Good location,basically a block off the strip.   We had a combination of 1 bedroom suite with attach studio.   Suite contain everything that you would expect.  Both units had large garden tubs.  The suite garden tub could easily accomodate 3 people.Swimming pool was heated.  I believe we had access to the Flamingo pool as well but since the weather was not warm and the Flamingo pool was not heated, we didn't utilize.  Gym is limited.

reviews.title: Great option
reviews.text: We had six night in Vegas. Three at the Paris hotel and three at the Hilton. The Paris was a nightmare- horrible service and the windows were disgusting and could barely see the Effie tower. We were pleasantly surprised at the Hilton (diamond members and stay a lot of Hilton). Rooms were excellent with the separate sleeping and kitchen. Massive bathroom with dual sinks. Very clean. Easy access to the Linq promenade for numerous restaurant options. It’s not directly on the strip but after three nights at the Paris we enjoyed the quiet.

reviews.title: Family Get together
reviews.text: We met our daughter & her husband here & they had never been to Las Vegas   We had a great time & can’t wait to return. They live in Delaware & we live in Florida!  We were sorry there weren’t any shows to speak of, so we did some exploring outside of Las Vegas

reviews.title: In depth review
reviews.text: I stayed here from 1/31-2/13. I booked here based off having a separate bedroom, full kitchen, and in room laundry. When arriving the GPS got me near the hotel but after turning around I found the garage. You have to park on the 4th floor. The garage was mostly empty when I arrived but it quickly fills up on the weekends. The walk from the garage to check in was concerning. The elevator takes you to the front of Flamingo and not the Hilton so the stairs is the best bet. There’s no sidewalk from the garage to the front of the hotel. Once you have a room key you can enter the side of the building which is much safer. Front desk staff was very friendly. I am Diamond with Hilton but your status doesn’t mean anything at the Grand Vacations properties. There is a $25 a day resort fee which most hotels near the strip have. This fee is supposed to be for the amenities you get but with covid the amenities are minimal. I asked about the fee and was told it includes 2 bottles of water a day, 30 minutes of long distance calls a day, free DVD rental, and free WiFi. Every hotel I have been to in the last 10 years has free WiFi. I think the fee is ridiculous but I was traveling for work so it wasn’t my money. I was given a room on the 5th floor of the taller tower. My room was directly in front of the elevators and had a view of the roof and the pools. I was concerned the noise would be too much but with flamingos pool closed and weekdays being low volume it was pretty quiet. I only heard the elevators on the weekend. The room had a separate bedroom, kitchen with a dining table, bathroom with a separate room with the toilet and shower, the tub is in the same room as the bedroom but that didn’t bother me traveling alone. The kitchen had most of the amenities of home and I cooked a couple of meals easily. There was an option of daily housekeeping for a fee but I opted for the every 4 days option. I actually didn’t need housekeeping but they called every 4 days to see if I wanted the room cleaned. I had the do not disturb sign up so I appreciated them calling. They replenished my towels and laundry detergent. The hotel shares a very green backyard with the flamingo and I found it to be a relaxing walk. There’s plenty to do in the outdoor mall area of the flamingo. I wouldn’t stay here again if I was traveling for work but I would definitely stay here for a vacation. The parking while free is still a pain. Tip- back into your parking spot because people drive like idiots in the garage. If you want a simple room with amenities of home close to the strip then book here. All of the staff was professional and friendly. My rate was $104 during the week and $120 on the weekend before resort fees etc.

reviews.title: Quiet Hotel
reviews.text: This was a great choice for a solo trip. I stayed in an one-bedroom suite. The room decor was very dated. However, my room overlooked the Go Pool at the Flamingo. That honestly is the best feature of the resort; the free access to the Go Pool. The HGVC pool is small and lackluster. As guests of HGVC, there is a dedicated line to enter the Go Pool which really helped with the limited capacity due to COVID. Guest services were pleasant and helpful. If you’re looking for somewhere quiet or traveling with children this is a great option.

reviews.title: WOW!!! 6 week stay at what has become our Home away from home
reviews.text: This is our 2nd year in a row to stay here for 6 weeks. Our expectations have been exceeded again!! I can’t say enough about the awesome staff and how they make you feel like family! With COVID precautions in place the entire staff has gone above and beyond!! From the smiles behind the masks to every little detail down to remembering you. Many thanks to the entire staff! Analeah, Fontaine, Christian and Kim have been awesome! Gina is like a special family member to us and takes great care of us! You have all spoiled us and raised the expectation bar so high!This is a reflection of the GM Lisa, who leads this awesome staff! Love this resort and the entire staff!Jeff and Keri

reviews.title: Flamingo Hilton Time Share
reviews.text: Loved the location but very disappointed in the condition of the 2 bedroom villa.  Will not stay there again.  This previously was a high end resort but has not been kept up. The lobby is nice but the room was dusty, furniture run down, towels threadbare. Coffee maker useless.

reviews.title: Great time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed in HGV flamingo.  Although the 2 bedroom unit is quite small for 6 people, we did enjoy the stay.  The location is very convenient and near to Las Vegas strip, either taking a walk on the street side, or going inside Flamingo and exit in Las Vegas Boulevard.  Because of the Pandemic, the facility maintained all CDC guidelines (face mask inside ALL facilities and streets).  The hotel suite is clean, and provided us with basic kitchen and Laundry supplies

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: We went to vagas for our anniversary week, From the moment we arrived to the hotel the staff was very friendly. The room was so clean. We felt like the housekeeping staff really took there time cleaning our suite . It had such a great feel to it.

reviews.title: More good then bad things to say
reviews.text: We stayed in a 1 bedroom suite for 5 days for my sons 10th birthday, we had 2 adults and 2 kids....everything was really nice, the bed were comfy, the pull out bed was what you would expect for a couch bed! the flamingo go pool you can hear from the room during the day and the music was quite disturbing for those wanting to sleep in late. however the view of the pool from the hotel window at night made it tolerable! It was nice having a kitchen and being able to cook meals during our stay, however the venting system is horrible, it’s not vented so it sucks the smoke up and blows it right back out making it extra Smokey, also one of the kitchen drawers was stuck and utensils were left in there, so we were out a few items, which I didn’t mind because I brought some stuff from home! I also disliked if friends came to my hotel, I had to walk down and meet them because they would not use the elevator to go up without a room key! I think that’s common for Vegas hotels tho! We Loved the walking distance to the high roller it’s visible from the hallway windows from the hotel and other close by activities like the secret gardens and easy access to the strip but away enough From the craziness of the strip with the kiddos! Overall the experience was more great then bad! I have more good things to say then bad, we Would def stay again!

reviews.title: Great building and location
reviews.text: there pool system needs to be fixed before I go there again. as a guess I shouldn't have to wait in a line along with non- guess who can pay to enter the pool and have my picture I.D  if I have a Key Card to enter the pool area through the first gate, elevator, and my room.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vocation Flamingo
reviews.text: My family stayed for 5 nights. We had 2 king bed connected rooms. The price was reasonable, actually considering the size of the room and the features that are great for families, the price was more than fair. I loved having the full kitchen, was able to save money by putting a grocery to cook breakfast or lunch/dinner and keeps snacks handy for the kids; eating out for everyone for every little thing can get very expensive. The rooms were clean and spacious. Staff was great. Very pleasant and friendly. Staff very accommodating to best of their ability as well. There is no casino, but right outside your door you are surrounded with many. So you're not missing out on anything. Besides, I'd rather go out to the hustle and bustle of Vegas life, then come back to a more peaceful sleep place. They have a small family pool, but you have access to the larger flamingo pool next door...only a few steps a away...literally. The location is perfect...your surrounded by all of the main hotels on the strip. Parking garage not far, across the street. My only issue was trying to locate the hotel, my GPS had me all over the place. Its located behind the flamingo, but front desk help me find it over the phone. Overall, I loved it. I have no complaints. If I return on another family vocation, I will stay there. I definitely give this place a 5 star and is highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great Rooms, disappointing Pool
reviews.text: We stayed here the first and last day of our week long trip to Grand Canyon/ Bryce/ Zion park visits. (2 adults and 2 boys, ages 16 and 17). We flew into Vegas, and the hotel was a quick 15 minute drive from the rental car area. Convenient 15 min parking in front of the Grand Vacation entrance. We were greeted by Gina who did a great job checking us in - very personable. We were able to check in early, as room was available, which was great because it was the only time we would be able to enjoy the pool since we were leaving the next morning. The rooms were great - spacious with excellent layout. They were adjoining rooms, one with a full kitchen. Bathrooms were newly renovated and super clean. Housekeeping staff was super friendly when we passed them in the halls. Comfortable beds, great view of the pool. One disappointment was that the big, beautiful pool with waterfalls and loungers was only available on a virtual wait list and for guests over 21. The grand vacation pool was nice but very small for the number of guests using it. We followed instructions to get onto the virtual wait list for the big pool, but received message that they had reached capacity on both days we tried. If we had been staying the full week and not gotten in, I would have been extremely upset. But for our short stay, the small pool sufficed. Be aware that the pool is located right beside the alley to the big Flamingo hotel where trash is apparently kept. Our first stay on Saturday we did not smell it, but the 2nd stay the following a Friday, the odor was so strong we ended up moving to the upper deck lounge area away from the pool. Due to Covid, the bars and snack huts were not available, but they did allow us to bring in our own beverages and food, as long as it was not glass. My husband ran to the liquor store at the corner where he found beer for us and Gatorade for the kids. There were others that had glass bottles; there was no one monitoring the pool area. There were also 2 older ladies blasting Cardy B vulgar songs along with Rap on their portable speaker. Extremely annoying and rude, in my opinion.
