The big Flamingo pool caters to the young 21+ crowd, playing dance music with deep bass from 8am until closing. If you have small children, this may be an issue for sleeping. Overall, great property, centralized to great restaurants and the strip, along with the Linq and beside the High Roller Ferris wheel.

reviews.title: Thanks
reviews.text: Our stay at HGVC Flamingo in Las Vegas was excellent as always mainly because of the owner concierge staff.  Gina, Fontaine, & Analeah are very efficient and very pleasant human beings.   They all go an extra mile for their guests.  Say hello for us when you go visit.  Edward & Eva Takenaka

reviews.title: Excellent hotel and facility
reviews.text: This is an excellent hotel.  Out room had a kitchenette, a washer and dryer and double sinks in the bathroom with a nice tub.  It is about seven minute walk to restaurants and two casinos, the Flamingo and Bally.

reviews.title: Flamingo, want pool, good luck
reviews.text: Rooms were fine, but if you want the pool, forget it.  The reservation system is awful.  You send a text at 10, they text you back and give you 10 minutes to get there.  Than if wrong shorts, your not getting in.  Telephone service is not good in some parts of hotel, so I did not get our text until 20 minutes after our time to get in.  Had to go to relatives pool at Lexor and to Lake Mead one day, but still had to pay the $42.00 resort fee.  Won't ever stay here again.

reviews.title: Friends trip
reviews.text: The hotel was clean, but since there really was no amenities I was very disappointed they still charged the resort fee. We couldn't get in the Flamingo pool, their pool was crowded, so we never used the pool. Food store was closed. They had no amenities so why charge a fee! My sons stayed at Caesars for free because of Covid. I had to pay a hefty exchange fee plus the amenity fee and spent more. Disappointed!

reviews.title: My Hilton Grand Vacation at the Flamingo
reviews.text: I rented 3, 2 bed room units for myself and Family. It was really nice but the Vents for the mini kitchen Just don't cut it!! it did not take the out the smoke from the unit instead it just circulated around and made the whole unit smokie. I had to call housekeeping for some fans to help with the smoke in the room from cooking !! The microwave is not the correct size for the ventilation it was too big and too close to the stove !! a possible fire hazard !!!!

reviews.title: Great experience during the pandemic
reviews.text: Had stayed away from this resort due to the noise complaints in the reviews, however being that the Day Club at the Flamingo is limited because of the pandemic, we gave it a shot and happy that we did. Very friendly staff, clean rooms and property. The Marketplace and outdoor pool hut were not open during our stay so no food on site. Plenty of restaurants in walking distance. Only complaint s that homeless people like to hop the pool fence and use the pool. Security handled the situation twice. I feel the property should close the gate and require card access to get on the property from the Flamingo. Being that this is a 1 in 4 property through RCI, we will have to wait 4 years to use again but definitely would come back.

reviews.title: Think twice!
reviews.text: Think Twice...The Big pool has a 300 swimmer limit, out of 3,600, because of covid.  You sign daily on lime and wait.  WE NEVER got to swim the entire week!  Also, they closed the BBQs here.   Think twice about this summer.

reviews.title: Avoid or you will be harassed for the rest of your life
reviews.text: I stayed here in February, 2020 while attending a meeting at Caesars. I am a Lifetime Hilton Diamond Member and booked this over the app as a hotel room, the same as I've done many times at Elara and HGV at the Convention Center. Overall it should get 4-5 stars. It's great having a suite with a washer and dryer! In fact I am a big fan!  But...ever since that time...I have received persistent calls from Hilton Grand Vacations, RCI, Ultimate Vacations and others trying to sell me a timeshare.  I never went on any timeshare tour or presentation and I never received points or any incentive. The boiler room callers are rude, they continually promise to take me off their call list but they don't, sometimes they hang up, and they've even insisted the "fine print" when I checked into this property signed away "any rights" under the Do Not Call act. But every time they point to this one stay at the Flamingo HGV as their "lead."  I also learned every one who checks into this property, even if for two nights as a hotel room...gets assigned a "marketing number."  This could be an excellent property but their violation of my privacy and constant harassment land them "negative stars" in my book.

reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text: Went on our since COVID, enjoyed our stay but Vegas was definitely not the same.  No shows, everything closed at 7pm, most pools closed.  It was a very disappointing trip but our stay at the Hilton was great for my family.  We had a two bedroom, and it allows some privacy for both.  Can’t wait to go back when everything opens back up.

reviews.title: Resort Really??
reviews.text: Check your room carefully, ours was not very well cleaned, hair in the shower and on the floor by the door. Urine or yellow cleaning fluid was left on the toilet seat. Dishes were in the dishwasher, coffee pot did not work, only one load of laundry detergent was available, no softener. first room we had had a white dusty like film on the surfaces, parking has no elevator you have to climb 4-5 flights of stairs, no Valet service, very little handicap parking available. The Concierge is very helpfull and went beyond his duty to get us in a room late at night/morning.

reviews.title: Wonderful quieter opportunity
reviews.text: We decided to take a post COVID19 trip to finally travel again.  I was very pleased with our choice to stay at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club at the Flamingo.  We traveled with our 18 year old triplets and it was away from the crowds of the casinos.  We enjoyed a two bedroom suite.  We were impressed with the quality of the sofa bed mattress for one of our kids.  It was very comfortable for her.  The rooms were spotless and we felt that the Hilton GVC at the Flamingo took extra measures for safety and cleanliness.  I highly recommend this property.  I will be returning to this resort!

reviews.title: Dirty and smelly
reviews.text: We checked in at the Hilton Grand Vacation on 6/17/20. The front desk staff were very friendly, but the hotel shows a lot of wear and tear. When we arrived at our suite on the 10th floor, we were hopefully that the stay would be decent because the hallway was cleaner than the other areas we had seen so far. That hope turned to despair when we entered our room when the smell hit us like taking a right hook to the nose. It smelled like 100 cats had been in the room and used it as a litter box. It may have been a mold or mildew smell, but whatever it was gave me a headache and made me nauseous. The carpets were matted and stained. It looked like one of the rooms you would expect to get if you booked through a discount site, but my husband is a Hilton Honors diamond member and we booked directly on the Hilton website. My husband went down to the front desk to report the odor and ask for another room, but was told that the hotel had no other rooms available. They sent a member of the security staff up to determine the cause of the odor. As soon as he walked into the room he acknowledged the odor and said that he agreed that it was terrible. He told us that normally they would try one of their usual methods to remove the odor, but he didn’t think any of them would work in that room.  I will say that Christian at the front desk was extremely friendly and helpful. He cancelled our reservation and refunded our stay because we had to find another hotel that had availability for 3 nights at 9 o’clock at night on the day we needed to check-in. Christian was the only good experience we had at this property. We definitely would not recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Location or Comfort, not both
reviews.text: I am going to start by highlighting some of the con's to this location.  If you have seen the reviews that say this is a quiet resort it is because they most likely stayed before March 4th.  The Flamingo's pool opened up for the season on March 4th and makes having a quiet room between 9 am and 6 pm difficult.  My wife and I were located on the 9th floor and could hear the music from the pool pretty clear.   Also as a HGV owner and Diamond member the constant up sale got old quick.  On our four day stay we got 4 phone calls, and stopped 6 times by the experience desk.   The room itself was nice but the mattress felt cheap for a Hilton.  It was only a five year old mattress but it felt like a twenty year old mattress with no support.  It was so uncomfortable we looked at changing to the Elara.    As for the pro's is the location.  The location is prefect and makes getting to everything super easy.  The front desk staff was very friendly and helpful.  If you don't plan on being in your room during the then this is the location for you.

reviews.title: Great place - plan to stay again.
reviews.text: Site employees are very nice and helpful. Suite is comfortable, kitchen is well equipped, and there were enough hangers in the closet(s)!  Location is  just behind the Strip, so easy walking access to everything.

reviews.title: Kind and welcoming staff
reviews.text: Was there with my Mother to celebrate her Birthday. Great staff and a perfect location. We'd come back to this property. It is a walking distance to lots of attractions which is important for an elderly person.

reviews.title: Quiet relaxful nook in the heart of the strip.
reviews.text: Unbelievably quiet little nook in the heart of the strip. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves relaxing by the pool in the late morning early afternoon and would then go down to the strip for dinner, drinks and even a couple Cirque du Soleil shows.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Excellent service...Just one thing why not have room service as in having our beds made, trash out for also customers of 3 day stay? Best service over all. Super satisfying with out stay at this location

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: HGV at the Flamingo is nicely situated on the larger Flamingo hotel and casino complex. It is also next door to the Linc experience which has done nice restaurants and bars.  The rooms are nice although the curtains and upholstery is a bit dated.  It is right at the center of the strip in walking distance of Caesars, Paris, Bellagio, and the Venetian.  Recommended.

reviews.title: HGV Flamingo
reviews.text: What a great location!  At the back of the Flamingo property, it is right off the Strip.  We ‘Ubered’ from the airport to the property, and had short walks to all of the shows and restaurants.  The HGV hotel is right next to the monorail stop, and I thought that this would be a bonus, but we never needed to ride it.  The HGV pool was open, but the Flamingo pool was not in late February.  The pool water was very warm, but the air was cold during our stay.  That did not deter my children from using the pool.  The Marketplace in the hotel served great Starbucks coffee and made all the typical barista drinks.  They also made some great sandwiches and egg dishes.

reviews.title: Excellent Resort!
reviews.text: We couldn’t have been more happy with the resort, staff, facility & amenities. Great experience and we can’t wait to travel back next year! Short walk to a bunch of amazing attractions and restaurants.

reviews.title: Very clean & great location
reviews.text: Wonderful location.  Remodeled rooms look great.  Jacuzzi jets did not work during 3 day visit but excellent trip. Housekeeping performed wonderfully & were very helpful. Had issue with barista sneezing/coughing without covering face all over coffee cups before filling.  Needless to say we asked for our money back & left.

reviews.title: HGV Flamingo!
reviews.text: HGV Flamingo resort is lovely and very convenient.  Large lobby and nice bar and decor.  Rooms are large and well appointed.  Nice abstract art in the rooms with lots of color.  Floors were clean and well maintained.  Kitchens in good shape and very user friendly!

reviews.title: Non service
reviews.text: Unfriendly staff. We had to wait to check in.  My wife needed to use the rest room while we waited.   You need a damn key card!!! And had to wait to ask didn’t make sense!  And when we finally got to talk to someone the treated us like we were the problem.

reviews.title: Reservation snafu unresolved...
reviews.text: Booking made a mistake on my reservation and left my business group short on rooms. I do not like the Grand Resort Branch. Feels like a different Hilton chain. Very disappointed in the experience. As a loyal customer I was shaken.

reviews.title: Perfect condo on the strip!
reviews.text: Friendly, helpful, courteous staff. Clean, safe, convenient location. Directly behind The Flamingo on the strip. Quiet rooms. Concierge was very helpful in getting us a scooter rental for our mother. Will definitely return & highly recommend. You won't regret it.

reviews.title: Quiet & good location, but tired, grimy decor & high-pressure timeshare sales
reviews.text: Quiet & good location, but tired, grimy decor. We were also attacked immediately after check-in (following a 10-hour travel day) and pressured into an unpleasant timeshare presentation, which we reluctantly agreed to because of empty promises of 2 nights free future hotel stay (it turns out 40,000 points will barely cover 1 night); a nice lunch (dry, tasteless wraps and cheap packets of cookies); and the promise that they would drop us off at the Mob Museum immediately following the 90 minute (actually 2.5 hour) presentation. Nope... they would only bring us back to the hotel. HORRIBLE experience - don't fall for it like we did.

reviews.title: Central location. Close to everything.
reviews.text: We had a blast in Vegas. HGV is like an oasis of quiet and serenity amongst the lights and action. Casino was too smoky. The buffet lunch was outstanding. Room was well equipped and fit two active twenty somethings and a couple boring seventies with space enough and an adequate kitchen.

reviews.title: business stay
reviews.text: The Hilton is a great place to stay close to everything ,its clean and tidy and well looked after ,will be staying here again many times as it ticks all the boxes i am looking for when i come to Las Vegas

reviews.title: Excellent accommodations and service
reviews.text: It was great to have a suite with full kitchen this close to the Las Vegas Strip. Five-10 minute walk to the Strip. The staff were welcoming, pleasant,professional and helpful.The rooms were clean and very pleasant. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Unhappy Smells
reviews.text: Terrible experience not treated like a Hilton's Honor Member. The room smelled and I did complain but they only had a room on the first floor across from the parking lot or I had to pay an upgrade charge which with Hilton Honors should have been free. Disappointed.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacation resort
reviews.text: Very efficient staff, loved the marketplace, good prices, not overpriced.  also love that they give you bottled water. We had to leave the resort due to family emergency, the check out process was very fast and courteous, and was credited back charges

reviews.title: clean and close to attractions
reviews.text: Walking distance to strip and many attractions make this location prime. Rooms can be a bit noisy making night time sleeping risky for families with small kids. Access to resort felt a bit like a back ally to a pub at night!

reviews.title: Everything was excellent
reviews.text: Perfect location in the middle of the strip but without the "casino" hustle bustle. Staff was excellent and the Marketplace was extremely convenient with reasonable prices. We would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Definitely recommend this Hotel for families!
reviews.text: Our stay here was very comfortable. We had everything we needed and our room was very spacious. Definitely recommending to family and friends. Great view from room and front desk was extremely helpful. Def staying here again!

reviews.title: A  prime location
reviews.text: Great location, clean traditional decor and quite spacious.  Located on the North of the Strip.  Right in the heart of The Linq near Caesars and Bellagio.  Close proximity to The Wynn, Venetian and Palazzo.

reviews.title: Resort fees are a joke
reviews.text: $25 a day for 30 mins of long distance and 2 water bottles!  Ridiculous!  Pool and hot tub were closed and once asked about resort fee front desk neglected to give us our welcome packet.  Very disappointed HIlton on your lack of customer service!

reviews.title: Could have been any of the HGVC resorts.
reviews.text: This review is about Hilton Grand Vacation Club's sales. I am putting it here because we just stayed here. My wife and I recently stay at the HGVC Flamingo, in Las Vegas. Never been to Vegas; so we thought we would get away for a few days. Everything about this property was just fine; great location, quiet, friendly staff. We were asked if we wanted to go to  an update meeting with the sales group to find out what is new with HGVC. It's basically a sales pitch to buy more HGVC points. We agreed and got a free dinner and show for our time and also discounts for many other shows.We met at a different HGVC location in Vegas and sat down with a lovely saleswoman. We were honest with her about our experiences with HGVC and the fact that we just got back from Cabo San Lucas and bought more Fiesta Americana Vacation Club points. We explained that we felt that we get so much more with our FAVC points then we do with our HGVC points. The saleswoman pointed out to us that we have not been in for an account review in many years and that was Hiltons fault; not ours. We were told that had we been kept updated; we probably would own by now many more HGVC points . We asked to be educated on what we have been missing.When we bought HGVC  back in 2007; Hilton was really pushing the club resorts that they have built and are building. We were told that the best way to use our annual points was to stay at an HGVC. The next best way to use our points was to search through Hilton; RCI's inventory of resorts. Yes, we could exchange our Hilton points for RCI points and the best part about it was that Hilton has already selected which RCI resorts where up to Hilton's standards. I have later found out that I can search non approved RCI resorts and have Hilton book them for me. the only down side is that I would be booking at my own risk as to the quality of the resort. The last way that we were told to use our annual HGVC points was to convert them to Hilton Hhonors points and stay at any Hilton brand of hotels around the world. We were told to use this option last, because it was the least bang for your points. It takes many Hhonors points to book a hotel room. So, we have stayed away from that option for years.So, here is the turn on what HGVC thinks that I and everyone else that owns HGVC points should do. Now that Hilton has bought so many other hotel brands and turned them into the Hilton family; we should have been buying more points every year and building up an inventory of Hhonors points. So what we were told not to do in 2007; is somehow the best thing to do with my points. Sorry I was not kept up to date with the program all these years; but I should start buying points now and get with the new program. They were shocked when I told them no thank you and that if I could get my money back from my purchase in 2007; I would. It's funny how the points to purchase today are so expensive; but the points I already own are worth very little. So please; don't contact me with any offers to buy my points. I get enough of those calls and emails already.

reviews.title: Convenient and smoke free!
reviews.text: Heading to a convention in Las Vegas and dreading having to deal with all the casino smoking? Stay here! With the Monorail stop just steps away, it could not have been easier to get to the convention center. And it’s a short walking distance to the Forum Shops at Caesar’s. Or, if you want to go into a casino, the Flamingo is part of this property on the other side of the pool. Great location and super friendly staff. Only negatives were some allergy flare ups when the ventilation system kicked on, and some electrical outlets were not working.

reviews.title: Great location, dated interior, on monorail stop, on the strip.
reviews.text: Part of the s Flamingo grounds. Attached to the monorail station. Near Linq and the big wheel. Great location, dated interior, on monorail stop, on the strip. Call ahead to understand room amenities. Bring food and beverages. Eat at Batistas Hole In The Wall it’s next door and great.

reviews.title: 6 week stay.... awesome location and staff!!
reviews.text: Here from 12/29-2/8 and everyone has been awesome and very friendly!! Wanted to make sure and recognize the people who are the heartbeat of this timeshare/hotel and make it special!!The entire Front desk staff- Christian, Michell, Sandy and Fontaine all are awesome! Gina is very awesome at her job and goes above and beyond!Valet’s- Eric, Gerardo and Jesus are all awesome!!Bellman- Christian is awesome!We’re part of the way through our 6 week stay and we feel that everyone is so personable and great!!

reviews.title: Not great, not bad
reviews.text: You can spend the same amount of money elsewhere and have a better experience. If you're an HGV owner, I recommend to stay at the Elara. If you need to be near the Flamingo or the Linq for whatever reason, it's a fine option.

reviews.title: Right on the strip!
reviews.text: Prime location, great service, very secure and very clean. Also. Accommodating with extra waters and hot chocolate. And 20% off some local places. The only thing we didnt like was the door to the people next to us was very loud. They were opening and closing in the early a.m. and it kept waking us up.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: What an excellent location! Three minute walk from the lobby to the Flamingo entrance. Everything was clean. We had a nice view of the Flamingo pool area, and the mountains in the background. I'm very pleased with the stay.

reviews.title: Very Good Service & clean rooms. I came for a business conference and did not use much of the facilities.
reviews.text: Very Good Service & clean rooms. I came for a business conference and did not use much of the facilities.

reviews.title: Tired Bird
reviews.text: HGVC rooms are also solid, and the location here is great. You are literally a one minute walk from the monorail and just a few minutes from the strip. The room was fine but you can tell things are getting a bit worn here. A good option for a non-casino stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic New Years Eve
reviews.text: New Year's Eve was fantastic at this centrally located property with fireworks across the street at Cesers Place, and all around us. Almost all shows and things to do were in walking distance.  We did not get a rental car and did not need one.  My daughter was a little disappointed with age limits of 21 instead of 18 but enjoyed the shows.

reviews.title: New Year's in Vegas
reviews.text: We thought the HGV at Flamingo was a wonderful room with a great central location.  We had easy access to all of our favorite locations and services and the room was extremely comfortable and well decorated.

reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text: The building was tucked away behind the Flamingo so you were still close to the strip but away from the noise. Close to the Linq and all the restaurants and bars as well.  Easy to walk to for sure. We didn't need a car the entire trip. Uber was easy to catch up at the Flamingo (although I do wish they would pick us up at the condo, the drivers would drop us at our condo)

reviews.title: Gem in the heart of "The Strip".
reviews.text: Smack in the center of the strip with all the best action within walking distance. Truly Hilton Class resort right where you want in the heart of all the action.  Stayed here during bg the Christmas and New Year's of 2019/2020 with the family.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location ...major Casinos.Monorail..Nice rooms.quite..No waiting for check-in and check-out.Lots of restaurants on Flamingo Road.Golf courses around 20-25 minutes.Airport very close.Walking distance to Flamingo Casino.

reviews.title: Christmas vacation
reviews.text: We have been coming to this resort for 15 years and have always been very impressed with the quality of service and of the accommodation.We particularly like the location which is within walking distance of all the best hotels and attractions.

reviews.title: A perfect casino free hotel just behind the Flamingo
reviews.text: I prefer to stay in non casino hotel when staying in Vegas and this is a good option just a block from the strip. Great service, a bit weak breakfast but otherwise ok. The gym was fairly small but good enough for a solid workout

reviews.title: Nothing worked.
reviews.text: During our stay both the pool and spa were being renovated.  At no time did they alert us to this fact, prior to our arrival.  During one day of our stay they shut our hot water off from 9:00 to 7:00pm.

reviews.title: First timer
reviews.text: First time to Vegas, the Hilton was a good location to strip and link area for food and fun. Pool wasn't open so we didn't get to use it. Would like to visit again when pool open and no Construction going on. Good location for sure.

reviews.title: Quality rooms and pretty quiet.
reviews.text: We moved here after a bad experience at the Tropicana.  The room was clean and pretty quiet.  Comfortable bed, nice hot showers. The parking is a small hike, and their is currently some construction out front and all around the pools.  Lots of dining within a 10-20 walk.  I would gladly stay here again next time we are in the area.  Their are no restaurants on the property.  Just a small shop with snacks etc.

reviews.title: Nicely Appointed and Maintained Resort
reviews.text: No matter which one you stay at here in Las Vegas, HGVC always provides exceptional accommodations and service.  The room I was assigned was well appointed with furniture, decorations, and kitchen accessories.  The bed was comfortable as was the furniture in the living room.  Most notable was the professionalism and willingness of the resort staff to be of service.  Both check in and check out went smoothly.  The Marketplace, located on the ground floor, provides most food items one would need while staying here.  Valet parking is available for a fee and, if you choose to park your own car, it's free in the nearby Flamingo parking garage.    Always a great resort to stay at.

reviews.title: Exceptional Place to stay!
reviews.text: Staff and facilities are awesome.  I could live there!  Customer service was excellent and everyone is so helpful! I love staying at Hilton Grand Properties. The rooms are very spacious and always very clean.

reviews.title: Stay at the Grand Flamingo Hilton
reviews.text: Grand Hilton review through RCI.  Parking was less than satisfactory as the facility was located a distance from the sleeping rooms.  Handicapped guests were robbed of parking by construction supplies and vehicles.  The resort fees were unexpected.  Construction was in progress which increased the noise level.  Facility was lovely and the facility employees were exceptionally great.    Rooms were spotless.

reviews.title: Unforgettable Experience
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacation at the Flamingo is the best place to stay in Las Vegas,Nevada especially if you are going as a family or a group.Location is at the center of the strip therefore it is the best area to stay.All employees are respectful and accomodating.The 2 bedrooms that we stayed is very spacious,very clean and comfortable.All furnitures are updated and comfortable.Kitchen is complete with utensils,plates and pots.

reviews.title: Location location location
reviews.text: Best staff. Large rooms and location is perfect on the strip. Been staying there for over 13 years and wouldn’t change. There’s no casino but it’s just a 2 minute walk to the Flamingo and Linq hotels.....

reviews.title: Very functional
reviews.text: Really nice hotel, rooms fully equipped with a full kitchen. Really spacious, very comfortable bed with amazing pillows.2 comp bottles of water each day was a nice touch. All staff really helpfulThere is a bus stop located just outside (Duece) Great for getting up and down the strip. We did a 3 day pass for $20 this was well worth it as they run 24hrs a day

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: The location is great you can walk the strip if you like, several shopping and restaurant around.The Parking was the only problem since is share with the Flamingo.  The staff was very helpful and pleasant.

reviews.title: One bad egg can ruin the whole trip!
reviews.text: Honestly, the trip started out good with the limo driver and the room quality. The overall experience for me could have gone better. Maybe I am bitter with the attitude of the front desk employee at check out and the manager did assist in making it right, but only after I spent time arguing. I personally don't feel an owner, guest or anyone should be made felt like they need to stand up there and argue. I really wish my first time there would have been exceptional. I have gotten better service at other Hilton properties for being a Diamond member or for just choosing that hotel for my stay and here I was treated like a nobody. Yeah, I asked for an hour late check out and front desk employee said "We are sold out we can do that" when I stated I was not ready she said "Well we can charge you $50 for a late check out". I stated I did not want to pay that in order to pack then she arguably said I'll go get the manager as if she was done dealing with me. I checked in at 4pm so asking for an additional hour at check out did not seem as if it would destroy the building. I have worked front desk before and I know what happens and the stress, but I think the priority should be making guest feel welcome and cared for. I completely understood the remodeling and the pool, but if grand vacations is gonna have bitter front desk they should not associate themselves with Flamingo for the sake of the hotel.

reviews.title: Rude staff, Dirty sandy place.
reviews.text: Terrible views.  Charges that we were unaware of.  Nothing in the unit that we needed.  Construction noise.  Terrible parking.  Charge for parking.  Could not find our reservation even when we handed them a printed out conformation.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: This is the place to stay if you want location but dont need the high roller gambling experience. Staff is professional and friendly. Steps from the Flamingo and the Linq, yet you dont feel the intensity of being directly on the strip.

reviews.title: HGVC at the Flamingo
reviews.text: HGVC at the Flamingo is well maintained, has a great staff and good amenities.  Valet and Concierge services are excellent, the rooms are clean and modern.  The location is terrific for walking and has monorail access to other locations.  The small market is a great convenience.

reviews.title: First Class resort
reviews.text: Excellent resort.  Our unit was well equipped and spacious.  Useful small in hotel store for necessary items such as bread, milk and a lot more besides.  Two free bottles of water per day.  Conveniently positioned in the middle of the Strip.

reviews.title: Water shuts off on Thanksgiving morning
reviews.text: Well, if you’re a HGVC member, you already know the hotels are decent. And you get a big suite for not a lot. But every time I stay at an older Vegas HGV hotel, there are little problems and signs of age that makes me wonder why I’m paying so much in maintenance fees. This time, the bathroom sinks were dirty, which I can deal with but when, on Thanksgiving morning, the water shut off, it was yet another reminder of the high price of little value.  We had to use our bottled water to brush our teeth, wash our hands and of course, they charge us $6 for the water. We had tried to call the front desk but no one answered. I’m sure we weren’t the only ones calling. We left for the day. When we came back, I asked the front desk if the water was turned on, the two ladies looked at each other as if I was crazy. The security guard minimized my concern by saying “you’re alright”. The idea that the water was turned off for at least an hour (if not more) in the hotel yet the front desk knew nothing about it tells me management either doesn’t download it’s main point people of the happenings of the day or they have a policy of “pretend nothing happened”. When we got back to our room, the water turned on but was black and brown for a few minutes. It was gross. All in all, we are HGVC members that pay a lot for awkward hotel experiences. If we pass on the check in “welcome package” or the “time share presentation”, we get calls and texts over and over and over wondering why. I’ve tried to sell my time share and it’s worth nothing. Yet in the presentation, they try to sell me the same thing that’s supposedly “worth every penny”. What a sham.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had a great  stay at this hotel. Close to the strip about 10 mins of walking and the strip is right there. The staff are very friendly and helpful. We had a 2 bedroom suite with kitchen and laundry and with 5 people that is very comfortable. They have a marketplace in the lobby for simple things. Parking is right across which if you self park its free! Valet parking with a fee. They are behind the Flamingo hotel so a little tip to go across the Linq road and turn left at the first street.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo
reviews.text: I've stayed here several times on an RCI exchange, and it's a beautiful property.  They have a new $25/day resort fee which is supposedly for internet, DVD usage and complimentary bottled water.  I've never stayed anywhere that charges for internet use and I'm happy to pay for bottled water/DVD usage when I use them.  I was told this new charge started in 2017.  It seems unreasonable.

reviews.title: Awesome family vacation
reviews.text: It was an overall awesome experience with my family. Loved the Grand Hilton Flamingo. Our room was so neat, clean and comfortable. The staff was so helpful and friendly. I would definitely recommend here to friends and family. Also, the location was ideal for us.

reviews.title: Great Stay! quite place & close to the strip.
reviews.text: Nothing bad to say about this Hilton HGVC at Flamingo. Close to the strip which is the plus. For whoever drove down there, make sure you go to 15 mins parking right infront of the hotel and check-in first then you will get complimentary parking pass card(Check with Hotel tho probably because I'm club owner) at Flamingo garage and you can park there from floor 4 and up your entire stay. The best location and quite place to stay in LV. But if you are here to enjoy the high floor view or firework on July4/Newyear make sure you stay at the Elara HGVC in presidential suite. But if you are here just to go around the strip or do some gambling without having to pay any parking fees then this place is the right place for you. BTW Gina and your teammates rock, you guys making sure we are getting what we need and making sure we are ok throughout our stay through text and sometimes face to face. Keep up the great work guys. Will see you guys again soon.

reviews.title: Loved this non smoking hotel.
reviews.text: Our room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. It overlooked a palm treed courtyard. The Flamingo was right next door and it was an easy walk to Ceasar's, Harrah's, and the Mirage. Easy access to Uber stop.

reviews.title: Week in Vegas
reviews.text: Fantastic week in Vegas, the weather couldn't have been better high 70's not a cloud in the sky. Saw two shows while there, John Doherty and Madonna, 5 thumbs up for Doherty who played a great set of the old CCR tunes......5 thumbs down for Madonna who didn't start the show until 12:30 am and finish till 3:45 am. Her cavalier additude to the boos and refund chants illustrate her indifference to her fans and her belief that she is imune to public scrutiny. It is sad to think that she is able to treat her fans like they commodities while entertainers like Elton John and Paul McCartney go out of their way to thank their fans for their success.....Hell's Kitchen was once again a great dinner with great service.

reviews.title: Great Flamingo vacation
reviews.text: Great location on the Vegas strip, easy access to the monorail and convention center.  Great rooms and hotel staff. The rooms were clean and equipped with a kitchen which was a great way to save money by buying groceries for meals.

reviews.title: RIDICULOUS RESORT FEE - staff is wonderful, resort fee just ruins it
reviews.text: This isn't a resort.  It's a hotel.  It's a clean hotel with a very good staff - but it's still a hotel.  The ridiculous $200 resort fee for the week is frankly BS.   They give you two bottles of water and a card to rent a DVD.  There's no resort activities - nothing that is remotely worth the ridiculous resort fee.Had it not been for the resort fee I would have left a very high rating because it is clean and the staff is great.   But frankly the fee is a rip off.

reviews.title: Clean and quiet
reviews.text: Beautiful Clean and Quiet property right behind the hustle and bright lights of the strip. Easy access to the High Roller and it's shopping as well as the monorail. Quick walk to the Bellagio fountains, Paris and even City Center.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: These time share units are superior, spacious, very clean; the staff give you prompt service with a smile.  There is nothing the staff won't try, to give you the best service in the world.  The central location on the strip ensures walking is kept to a minimum.  Bear in mind that Vegas has a lot of walking, but being centrally located, really helps.  I would certainly stay here next time I come to Vegas!  Did I say the beds were comfortable!  Yes and that is so important.

reviews.title: Grand time at Hilton Grand Vacations Flamingo
reviews.text: We had 5 people in a 2 bedroom unit and it worked out perfect! Location was great. Lobby was exceptionally clean and staff were friendly and helpful. Check in and out was smooth and arrival to property was easy to find and accessible.

reviews.title: Halloween/ Anniversary weekend
reviews.text: Great location. Friendly staff. Nice rooms. Housekeeping was required and they were very prompt at coming up to the room.I would definitely recommend this resort. Much preferred  to the Flamingo resort.

reviews.title: Carol and Sandy from Glasgow celebrating our 50th Birthdays
reviews.text: When we arrived late at night to the hotel we hot made feel very welcome from the staff hotel and surroundings are spotless clean we had a one bedroom one of the nicest rooms we have had in las vegas was huge everything u needed and spotless amazing views great location on strip would definately return to hotel best we have stayed at very helpfull great information from staff and Alexandra at concierge is wonderfull helped us a lot with information we needed for doin things

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Good location behind Flamingo hotel. Comfortable and clean rooms. Front desk check in fast and efficient. Only problem was got charged for some erroneous charge on bill that I was not advised of. Still not straightened out yet.

reviews.title: Hgv flamingo
reviews.text: Single room was good and conveniently located.  Nice that parking was included.  It was a little complicated to get from hgv to parking or other hotels.  Pool was ok.  Did not see need to use flamingo pool.  Flamingo pool has loud base music which can be heard in hgv rooms.  Furniture was very worn ant toilet lid was disconnected from toilet.

reviews.title: A treasure hidden behind the Flamingo
reviews.text: This is my favourite place to stay in Vegas. The accommodations are clean, spacious and well appointed. Lovely pool area - and it's heated! Love the view from the rooms - a nice mix of trees, pools and architecture. Nice to have an outdoor sitting space with tables and comfy chairs too. Perfectly located off the strip but right in the action.

reviews.title: Vacation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: HGVC at the Flamingo is a great location to stay on the Strip.  The major casinos are all within walking distance and there are lots of restaurants close by.  We stayed in a one bedroom with a full kitchen and the room had everything you could possibly need.  The internet worked great.  The TVs were large flat screens.  The king size bed was very comfortable.

reviews.title: NOISY
reviews.text: The live music at the GoPool in the Flamingo Resort from 9am to 6pm was loud, thumping, and relentless.  It made it miserable to be in the room during these hours. The rooms themselves were wonderful and very comfortable, but unfortunately, because of the noise we won't be back.

reviews.title: Noise during the day but quiet at night
reviews.text: Three nights here in a two bedroom suite (two one-bedrooms suites combined).  Loud music from the Flamingo pool during the day - stops at around 6pm.Very quiet at night as it is off the strip.Parking is free in the Flamingo car park - though it is a small walk.The heated hotel pool was very good and popular with our kids, as well as the hot outdoor spa.  Location is very central with easy access to the strip and its casinos.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel.
reviews.text: We have just returned from a 6 night stay at the Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo. We had the 2 bedroom suite and were extremely happy with the accomodation. The rooms were spacious, modern and clean. The staff were friendly and helpful. The car park is over the road but it is free to hotel guests. The hotel is just off the strip, at the back of the Flamingo. It is located in a central location. It is within easy walking distance to the casinos, restaurants and more. We will definitely stay here again and would highly recommend it.

reviews.title: I love this place but.......................
reviews.text: The place is great.  Staff, cleanliness, maintenance. location.  This is why I come here year after year.  The two problems I wrote about still remain from my 10/18/18 review.  The noise from the Flamingo pool.  I have to think that there are a small percentage of people who like to get a headache and not be able to talk or think with all the monotonous boom  boom boom all day.   It is a detriment to the Flamingo itself for someone other than a 20 something who wants this din.  It is a detriment to the properties around it and will devalue them.  In reading reviews I am not alone.   I am looking at moving to another property just for QUIET.  Secondly, the parking garage is a disaster.  People go the wrong way, park in the wrong spots, and drive way too fast for the situation.  In addition the bar code entrance/exit card not working after 20 to 30 swipes is very annoying..  You hold up cars behind you. There are several other HGV properties here and we may take a look.  Dont want to but I cannot use the HGV pool during the day.

reviews.title: Vegas stay
reviews.text: Great place and service. Due to the proximity to Flamingo casino, please note, check in is in separate building. Little bit far from parking, however it is free. Also the fact, that there is no casino in building is plus.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, but not the greatest location. It's tucked behind the Flamingo off the strip. You do get to use the Flamingo's pool which is pretty nice, but crowded. The hotel's own pool is small but quiet. The staff is great and the concierge got me dinner reservations after I was unable to book them myself.

reviews.title: Loud pool music wasn’t music!
reviews.text: The pool music was a monotone of drum beats and yelling. There was no music. Thank goodness it stopped early evening. We weren’t in the room most days but when we were it was very annoying. Having a washer & dryer was wonderful!

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: The resort is in a great location. The staff was pretty friendly expect of this Asian Bellman. I enjoyed the rooms but could have been a little cleaner. I felt security was great. It would be nice of the resort have a shuttle to pick you up and drop you off at the airport.

reviews.title: vacation at the flamingo
reviews.text: We went to Vegas for the first time and stayed at the newly renovated Flamingo. Rooms were nice and grounds were beautiful with pool and Flamingo garden. Huge casino and offers many restaurants and a food court. Shopping mall in hotel..and location was prime to walking, other hotels and shops, restaurants and casinos! Would go back!

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: This was our second time staying here at the Hilton Grand Vacation @The Flamingo. We love it! The resort is beautiful and the location is perfect. You can walk to pretty much any of the hotels and casinos. If you just want to stay close there is the The Linq Promenade which has a great selection of bars and restaurants. It is pretty much right out the door. (A short walk through the Flamingo casino). I highly recommend a nighttime ride in the High Roller the views were amazing.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: The Hilton Elara was much nicer. Parking garage not convenient. Flamingo tired and drabby. The hotel charged a resort fee which was not justified in our mind. The pool had a lousy food service. Drinks too expensive. All in all won’t be staying here again.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Great property, perfect location, room was very clean and accommodating, bed was very comfortable. Free movies was a nice surprise. And Having the Market place and Starbucks on the property was a nice plus. Only complaint was WiFi in the room was spotty and we had to sit near door to get a good signal.

reviews.title: Fear and Loathing IN Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very cool throwback experience. I got to tell you I really loved the electronic sliding curtains in my room. It was like the movies. The room was super big and newly remodeled. It had a living room space and a bedroom space. Stand up shower and tub. Compared to other rooms in the nearby area they had the most reasonable rates. They offered triple AAA and military/ veterans discounts.

reviews.title: Vegas in September
reviews.text: Great trip! Resort was clean and staff helpful. We took an excursion to Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam offered by Pink Jeep and recommended by Concierge which was a fantastic experience, a must do! Resort was walking distance to strip and activities. The only downside was the room overlooked pool which was a great view but they had a DJ from 1130-6 which made an afternoon nap impossible.

reviews.title: Very nice place and good location near strip
reviews.text: While this hotel is not directly on the strip, it is easy to walk to the strip, and is close to an alley that contains a lot of restaurants and activities such as the giant ferris wheel.  Rooms were reasonably quiet once the bands and DJs at the Flamingo Beach Club stopped playing.  I stayed on the 9th floor, but the music could still easily be heard.  Front desk personnel very friendly, helpful, and clearly very experienced.  Room was very clean and bed very comfortable.  Several heads up items: No breakfast is served like at many Hilton's, but there is a marketplace on site where food and beverages can be purchased.  HHonors members - points are not awarded for stays at this hotel, but each night does count towards Honors status.  A resort fee of $30 is added to your bill.  If you are using Uber or Lyft, there is a pickup zone at the Flamingo casino, but your driver may pick you up at the hotel if you message them.

reviews.title: Good location but average stay
reviews.text: I am a die hard Hilton girl so I always stay at a Hilton Grand Vacation when visiting Las Vegas instead of one of the strip/casino properties. The location of this one is perfect but it was only average in its amenities and service. I’ve stayed at better. It was clean and nice, no complaints there but it lacked a little of the polish and service I’ve grown accustomed to by Hilton. I would stay there again but another HGV in the area would be my first choice

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent Experience! The room was spacious, ready and clean. The staff was very informative and accommodating. The location on the Las Vegas strip made it easy access to great eatery and restaurants.

reviews.title: Perfect place to stay.
reviews.text: Have stayed here many times and we always look forward to returning.  Staff from reception to housekeeping are amazing.. It’s located behind the noisy Flamingo Hotel and five minute walk through to the strip.  The only downside is a racket from the music played at the Flamingo Pool next door, but once you accept that Hilton cannot do anything about that, then it’s just the perfect place to stay.  Nice heated pool and big spa.  The pool is around four feet deep all over, so not suitable for small children.  The clients are generally thirty years plus..  so It’s always a very friendly and relaxed atmosphere.   Rooms are self catering, so you can take food down and BBQ around the pool.      There are two other Hilton locations near or on the strip, but this is the best.Apart from being so close to the Flamingo, this is a faultless place to spend your Vegas vacation.

reviews.title: Our favorite place to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: We love the location, the accommodations and the view of the Flamingo Pool.  The staff is top notch and take very, very good care of us.  We usually request specific rooms (depending on what we are in town for) and have never had our request denied!  There is no guarantee on the request, but they have always come through!

reviews.title: needs updating
reviews.text: We have been owners since 1995.  This trip in Sept was a sad disappointment.  While the service and cleanliness was great the state of our room was not.  It is in dire need of updating.   The room looked to same as when we bought.  The cabinets were marred and the appliances were dented.  We love the location but it does not stand up to the standard of the other Hilton properties.

reviews.title: Couple on holiday from Australia
reviews.text: Had a great stay here at Hilton Grand Vacation.Only negative comment is the loudness of the music coming from Flamingo next door. Not against the music, just the actual loudness of it. Think they should turn the volume down somewhat.

reviews.title: Great location and accommodations
reviews.text: Was able to make reservations for my son and his family with a two bedroom condo. Reserved a one bedroom for my wife and I and a one bedroom accessible for my 80 year old parents. This is a beautiful property and a great location. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: This Hilton property is adjacent to the Flamingo, so it is close enough to the strip without having the noise of the strip. We had a two bedroom unit which was perfect for two couples. Everything was clean, and the staff is friendly and helpful. You can use the pool at the Flamingo, or if you want a more calm and quiet pool area, you can use the one for Hilton Grand Vacation guests only. We enjoyed our stay and would stay here again.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Traded through RCI and was hit with additional resort fee's which is new and is just another way of raising the price . If a resort is part of RCI and has set points or weeks set for excahnge that should bve it.

reviews.title: Great location on the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: This resort overall is very nice. It's located in a separate area in the back of the Flamingo hotel and casino. During the day when the Go Pool at the Flamingo is open it gets loud!! The music can be heard everywhere in the hotel!! So if you go in the Summer be aware of this! Otherwise this is a quiet break from the Strip. There is no restaurant or bar here but it's only a short walk to the Flamingo. The guest rooms could use some upgrades especially the mattress!! Staff were all friendly. We enjoyed our stay!!

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: This HGVC property is very nice, but be prepared for the blaring music from The Flamingo pool next door. They've apparently given the pool over to a third-party "Pool A-Go-Go". It made the owner's pool unuseable for us during the day. Other than that, the property is nice.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Guy at the front desk was so kind and helpful! Great staff! Everyone always smiled and made us feel so welcome! Locked ourselves out once but got help right away haha! Loved the location too! Thank you very much!

reviews.title: Not on the strip
reviews.text: The air on the 8th floor could not keep up with the Vegas heat.  They finally moved us after the room filled with a noxious odor.  The noise from the Flamingo pool made relaxing during the day impossible.

reviews.title: Comfortable Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here as guests of my parents who are timeshare owners of Hilton properties. We checked in at 10pm from a late flight and was efficiently helped by the front desk. As Hilton Honors Diamond members though, we received no perks (i.e., free breakfast, or premium wi-fi). Parking is free across the street in Flamingo's parking garage (you have to park on the fourth floor and walk down flights of stairs to exit garage). Resort was quiet and looked like it caters to an older crowd and the young family crowd. There was noise from the GO Pool throughout the day but we were on the 14th floor and eventually got used to it. But I can see how this thumping of the bass would drive some people crazy. Water pressure was nice and water turned hot pretty quickly when we wanted it from the sink and shower. The only complaint we have is that our bed's comforter blanket needed to be replaced. The filling inside the comforter was lumpy and HARD. It's like the hotel washed it and didn't dry it correctly so that the filling was balled up in places. The lumps were so hard, they actually made little areas that jabbed you. We asked for another comforter and the front desk at first told us they didn't have any extras to replace ours. Eventually they brought one up after we went down and asked and it was just as bad as the first one. We ended up not using one since it was so gross. I attached a picture of the comforter held up to the light so you can see how bad the filling has become. For this to be a Hilton, I expected better quality bed linens!

reviews.title: Resort
reviews.text: Excellent service and accommodations, very pleased with overall experience. Staff very friendly, like home away from home, fast check/in concierge helpful. Always come back to stay in this particular resort, when in Las Vegas so much to do and near everything.

reviews.title: Awesome Resort, Great Location
reviews.text: The resort was wonderful. The room, the staff, the amenities were all excellent.  The close proximity to the GO pool at the Flamingo makes for a less than relaxing outside experience at this resort. However, the noise does not go late into the evening. It is restricted to day time hours.

reviews.title: not happy with explaination of charges that this resort charges.
reviews.text: not told that 25 dollars that the resort automatically charges plus tax on top of the 25 dollars what the charge is for .they only say apon check in there is a resort fee and dont explain what that charge entitles you to.

reviews.title: Great experience at Hilton Grand Vacations Resort by the Flamingo
reviews.text: Great family resort. Very clean and it has all the basic things you’ll need in a resort in the heart of Vegas. Accessible to the strip and to all major highways. I would highly recommend it to families with young adult kids since this location was beside Flamingo’s daily adult pool party. Overall we had a great experience in Hilton resort and will definitely go back. Avoid going to Vegas during summertime if you can’t endure 100+ degrees of dessert heat.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Very clean and well maintained.  Friendly staff and excellent location.  Neighboring hotel plays very load music during the day.  Otherwise a great place to stay.  Up to date appliances and furnishings. Great pool and spay.

reviews.title: Had a good stay
reviews.text: I seldom give five stars, and the only reason I didn't give a five here is the obnoxiously loud music at the nearby pool. Fortunately it stops at 6:00pm unless an entertainer is doing a show at night. Otherwise, my expectations were met. Hotel staff was accommodating, accessibility to the strip is unsurpassed and the hotel was clean. I would stay here again, but will bring some earplugs next time around.

reviews.title: Marks West coast tour
reviews.text: Good location.Room had every thing we needed..reception team very good,water available in lobby, much needed when the temp was over 42 degrees every day. Nice mini maket  on site serving coffee and breakfast items plus vouchers for free water.

reviews.title: Buffet brunch at Paradise Garden Buffet
reviews.text: We all know that when you see a long line at a restaurant, it means that the food is really good or that the staff is really slow. The food at Paradise Garden Buffet is really good and there is plenty of it. Plan on spending about 90 minutes there, including the wait in line. Just relax and enjoy your favorite dishes.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: An unplanned stop in Vegas due to flight delays...excellent and restful stay at this resort. It could have been even better if the music poolside could have been turned down a bit—it was quite loud but did not disturb my nap.

reviews.title: Hilton Las Vegas at Flamingo
reviews.text: Overall very nice resort.  Upside is location and nice units.  Downside is the loud obnoxious music from Flamingo Go Pool that shares a property line.  The music starts early in the morning until early evening. Really,  really LOUD.  Resort should really consider replacing the cheap bath towels in the unit. I use thicker, better towels on my dog.

reviews.title: Awesome property
reviews.text: The Hilton Flamingo is a awesome property with the best location for a time share.  If you want a place that has all the accommodations of home - this is the place to stay.  Plus, just step outside and you are right on the strip with all that it has to offer.  Love that they offered free bottles of water every day of your visit - reminds you to hydrate from the Vegas heat.   Can’t wait to return.

reviews.title: Conveniently Located To The LV Strip
reviews.text: This is a nice hotel conveniently located close to the Strip. The hotel is kind of hard to find because it is situated behind the Flamingo Hotel. It shares the parking lot and outdoor pool with the Flamingo. Do not get confused and try and checkin into the wrong hotel as we did. The Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo is behind the Flamingo Hotel. Very confusing. The good news is that it is much quieter and not as crowded and crazy as the other hotel. It you want loud and crazy this is not the place. To me it was relaxing compared to the rest.Checkin was fast and easy compared to the larger strip hotels. Our room was quite spacious and clean. The only complaint was that they had a maintenance issue and hot water for the tub/shower was not available till the following morning. Being hot and sweaty during the day it would have been nice to take a warm shower before going to sleep.It is close to the strip 1/2 block walk. Easy walk to see many of the other famous hotels nearby. The Ferris wheel and monorail are next door. The parking lot is shared with the Flamingo Hotel. You must get a pass from the front desk so that you can come and go as you please from the parking lot.

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.text: The pool is a joke. Belongs to The Flamingo. You need ID to get in and you have to even buy their water if you want some. Even though they charged Resort Fees (should be criminal) for both rooms we had, would only give me points for 1. Very, very greedy! It's all about how much money they can suck out of you.

reviews.title: Probably won't stay again/horrible experience with the Timeshare tour
reviews.text: The hotel has some positives and negatives.Positives-location, clean, price, beds are comfortable, it's nice to have a kitchenette.Negatives-Septic smell at the pool, noise late at night on the week-ends make it hard to sleep.  (Through the week, it's not a problem)No deck/porch.AVOID THE TIMESHARE/POINTS TOUR!!!  They tell you it's 90 minutes, it's not, we were there for 3 1/2 hours.  We had to wait and wait.  They shuttle you to a different location and basically hold you hostage.  We waited 20 minutes once we got there.  Then the presenter made fun of us after we said we wouldn't buy the timeshare and said "You only got $100 for this tour?  You aren't a good negotiator".  After the tour, we had to wait over 30 minutes for the shuttle so I called an UBER.  It was a nightmare and I doubt I will ever stay at a Hilton establishment again.  Yes it was my choice to go but I only went because they told me it was 90 minutes, not a second more because they know we value our vacation time.  We left at 9:30 (supposed to be a 9:15 and returned to the resort at 12:40)

reviews.title: Fantastic Place to stay
reviews.text: Fantastic place to stay. The location is central to the strip. The staff made the check in and check out process easy. The accommodations were as promised.We had a wonderful time and would stay here again.

reviews.title: OK for 1 night
reviews.text: This Hilton property is located a block away and caters to families / groups with apartment accommodation. Service at check-in and check-out was very good. The apartments are very good, fully equipped and very clean. The hotel pool is tiny, crowded and not very nice. You can use the one from the Flamingo but it is adults only and closes at 6pm. There is constant noise coming from the Flamingo pool - so definitely no possibility for a peaceful afternoon nap. Hilton honors gold/diamond members be aware that at Hilton Grand Vacation properties there is NO breakfast served.

reviews.title: Housekeeping Security Issue
reviews.text: This is my home resort.  I love the location and access to the Flamingo pool.  We got our weekly housekeeping on Sunday, got back to our room and our door was left wide open!  Checked the room and nothing was stolen.  Discussed with the manager Ray who told us would have a full report in the morning.  Discussed with him the next day and was told it was guest key last used.  This was impossible as we were gone all day and our room was cleaned.  He did another report which determined it was housekeeping key last used.  A new manager helped us thd second day who was way more concerned and told us follow up with the housekeeper was done and gave us a resort credit for the inconvenience.

reviews.title: It was very nice.
reviews.text: It overlooks the Flamingo party pool where they play loud music all day. It finally stops around 5-6 pm. Except Friday night where they party till 10-11. Then they lowered the music so all you heard was the limping of the music. At 3 am I called to see if they would call the Flamingo to turn it off. At 4am they finally shut it off. We left Saturday morning. I love nothing better than traveling dog tired. But the resort was clean and everything seemed well maintained.

reviews.title: Close to strip but quiet
reviews.text: LOVE the location.  It’s great to be so close to the strip but not have a casino. While there it feels like a resort, but you can be in the heart of Vegas in 5 minutes.  We’ve stayed there several time and will again.

reviews.title: No working a/c; no breakfast; unclean room, etc.
reviews.text: Our room was hot; we found trash behind the bedroom door and long black hairs in our shower; staff (except for Debra from St. Louis) all seemed like they hated their jobs; Cell service in the hotel was spotty at best; Uber drivers had issues finding the hotel because it’s hidden behind the Flamingo, so that results in additional charges to the rider; no breakfast included; and they only “offer” amenities to people interested in sitting through timeshare seminars.

reviews.title: great party place
reviews.text: the pool for families is very small. They have a larger pool that is 21 and over where they have a pool party every day with loud music starting at 9am. the location is great and if your looking for some where nice to eat batistas hole in the wall has some amazing Italian food.

reviews.title: Love the Location
reviews.text: Great central location behind the Flamingo. Easy 5 minute walk to the strip. While the pool is noisy during the day, it shuts down at 6pm. The windows block a lot of the music. Love the GO pool. Free access and short line for owners! Gets crazy after 1pm. If you are over 50, best to go from 9 - 12!

reviews.title: Good Location and Rooms
reviews.text: Excellent spot just off the strip.Rooms were excellent,large with kitchen facilities.Only downside was the poor,small pool area for kids under 21. Needs a better option than they have in hot temperatures.Overall a good property.

reviews.title: Another great visit
reviews.text: Love HGV at the Flamingo.  Stayed here many times.  Great location right behind the strip.  Rooms are nice and the small pool is great if you like to socialize with other guests. We have met so many great people hanging at the pool.   Martina, the bartender at the pool is the best!  Only complaint is the pool bar is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.  Resort should have a second bartender to cover for Martina on her days off.  Music from Flamingo can get loud but no bother to me.

reviews.title: Week in Vegas
reviews.text: This property exceeded our expectations.  It was very close to the central hub of the Strip but far enough away to be very quiet at night .  We had a 2 bdrm apt which when we checked in found out we had connecting 1 bdrm and Studio .  This suited us perfectly as my husband and I were travelling with our son (21yrs ) and this gave him his own seperate area from us when it suited . The rooms were well furnished , clean and well presented. The kitchen very well equipt.  The Flamingo Go Pool next door was noisy during the day The DJ was playing 10am - 6pm every day but because we were rarely in this was never a problem .  Families with small children may find this more of an issue .  We had a few issues but these were quickly remedied by the front desk staff. Overall find it hard to fault anything about the property.  We had a great stay here , exceeded expectations.

reviews.title: Had a Great Time in the ❤️ of the strip!!
reviews.text: This is a nice location. Nice pool and access to the larger one at the Flamingo. The Monorail station is nearby as is High Roller. Lots of food choices close by. Activities for the entire family. Very friendly and accommodating staff.

reviews.title: Nice hotel but poorly managed
reviews.text: The room was not ready when we arrived after the check in time, the card to park the car only worked to get the car in but not out of the garage, and on the last day the front desk staff changed the checkout time from a previously agreed 12 PM to 10 AM. I will not go back to this place

reviews.title: All Day everyday Party
reviews.text: I wasn't well treated when I checked in and was never told about how the banging music would be happening every day.  You can hear the banging from the base in your condo.  The cleaning staff was great But Eva at the front desk needs some customer services training.  Furniture needs to be replaced. No way is this a Gold Resort.

reviews.title: location, location, location
reviews.text: I have stayed at 4 different HGVC locations in Vegas and none can beat this for location.  I have been coming to this resort for 15 years.  its not the newest, and in all honestly not the most up to date but I will choose it over the Elara or Trump any day of the week for the way I am treated while there.  smaller, 17 floor building where you don't feel like a number, but an actual person.  I will continue to frequent this building every year I am in Vegas because I consider it to be like a second home while I am in the city.

reviews.title: Getting away
reviews.text: Everything was great including room, pool, location, and staff. The only issues I have are with the check-in/out times. Check-in is at 4 p.m. which means most of your day is gone by that point and they work with you when possible. Check-out is at 10 a.m. which is painfully early when on vacation (especially in Vegas) and they couldn't allow a later time.

reviews.title: Great location, beautiful timeshare, great staff!!!  beware of flamingo pool noise.
reviews.text: Loved the units, would stay again if I didn't have to pay extra $200 for daily fees. Music at FLAMINGO pool is loud - and would be acceptable IF they changed the songs - not just PUNK rock all day long.

reviews.title: Great Family Stay with minor setbacks
reviews.text: Pros: Cozy and very clean, centrally located, friendly staff, attached to Flamingo sort of.Cons: Small pool at the timeshare. You can use the pool at Flamingo but that is super crowded and loud. The noise is a factor. The pool area is blasting music all day. Great if you are into the partying scene, but not so great if you have an infant that naps during the day.  Not enough supplies in the kitchen, other timeshares had more variety of dishes and utensils. And parking is a bit of a walk, unless you want to spend $18/day on valet parking. Overall good stay, would consider staying there again.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel with a very loud A/C
reviews.text: Business trip, we got a very good price for an entire week, hotel location is very good, walking distance from several restaurants, and places to visit. Just one thing, A/C was extremely loud, but cool enough to keep the room in perfect conditions. Rooms have a full kitchen, a fridge. They serve Starbucks coffee!!!

reviews.title: Nice suite close to the strip
reviews.text: Family/working trip, more family friendly than most in Vegas, close to the strip and the monorail.  The rooms are nice and the full kitchen helps with picky kids.  Laundry in suite is also a plus.  Staff was friendly and answered my questions to the best of their ability.

reviews.title: Love the HGVC at Flamingo
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the Flamingo Hilton Grand Vacations Resort and I loved it both times. Great location on the Las Vegas strip, and a monorail stop. Very nice and clean rooms. Friendly staff. Nice private pool so you can avoid the huge crowd in the main pool.

reviews.title: Wet beds
reviews.text: I was there in march for a meeting and booked a night in the king suite. As I arrived, the bed was wet and had a a smelly white stain. I think the room-service had some fun with the pre-owner of my room. However, i got a new bed and I liked that kind of fast service. After that, I visited the restaurant. It‘s horrible! I ordered cheese with ham and got a turkey. WTF?Btw. I‘m rich and follow me.

reviews.title: 5 star facility, but a -2 star for the noise coming from the pool area.
reviews.text: I don't feel its a family friendly environment because of the volume of pool music and the type of party activities. You are right next to the monorail.  No need for a car. A lot of places are within walking distance.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: This resort is not a good one if you want a peaceful,  quiet,  restful vacation.   From early in the morning until 6:00 at night, there is the constant boom boom boom loud music from the Flamingo pool.  Won't stay here again.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: I almost don't want to write this review, because then this hotel will become everyone else's favorite hotel!!! This is a non smoking, non gaming, all suites hotel. It's situated to west of the Flamingo Hotel and steps from the Flamingo Monorail Stop. Had a beautiful studio in the North Tower overlooking the Flamingo Go Pool. During the day this pool is rocking, and you can hear the base in your room (not in a bad way though). The Marketplace offers affordable breakfast and grab n go snacks. I usually stay at the Tropicana in a Bungalo room due to the balcony, but this room was way bigger and nicer. The hotel's location is a huge plus. Center strip. It also offers free us of the Flamingo Go Pool, which we didn't take advantage of. I think I found my new home away from home in Vegas.

reviews.title: Good But ..
reviews.text: Fine accommodations as expected at a gold crown resort.  A great location on the strip and good parking.     BUT excessively loud external noise all day long every day!!  May it'd be less on a top floor, but I won't bgo back.

reviews.title: Perfect Location, Nice rooms
reviews.text: The location is perfectly located on the main part of the strip behind the Flamingo.  The monorail is not far from the entrance which is convenient to travel along the strip.  The rooms are very nice as expected.  The air conditioning in my room would not reach the desired set point, but still was cooler than the 108 degrees outside.  The maintenance crew did respond quickly, but it didn't make any difference.  I found the bed mattress to be just a little hard.  Overall we enjoyed the property very much.  The only thing I have a problem with is that they charge a $25 per day resort fee.  This mandatory fee covers the dvd machine we can get rentals from, local and long distance calls, 2 bottles of water a day, and probably a couple other useless things.   To me this is just a dishonest way of getting more money from us.  This a timeshare that has already been bought and maintenance fees have been paid.   We use RCI to trade these timeshares, and Hilton is squeezing more money out of us.  I enjoyed the stay, but the resort fee left a sour taste in my mouth.

reviews.title: HGV@Flamingo is truly a retreat among the Vegas bustle
reviews.text: The property is very close to the Vegas Strip and action, but provides a place of peace.  Over the years Ive stayed at many of the Vegas properties.  Check in and stays at the casino hotels in Vegas puts a visitor on sensory overload with initial sounds of the video slots, crowds, and exposure to smoke.  It was so nice to be greeted multiple times by staff who seemed genuinely pleased that you were entering their property and desired for a hassle less entry.  When beginning a vacation, that is totally appreciated to help transition into relaxation after the airport experience.  This property seemed like an oasis.  Many thanks to the staff for a wonderful stay!

reviews.title: The Best place to stay!
reviews.text: Without a doubt  the HGVC@The Flamingo is the best place to stay  in Las Vegas no matter what the reason for your visit. It's located in the middle of the strip. The property is BEAUTIFUL, the entire staff is friendly and helpful. Once you've stayed here you will NEVER want to stay anywhere else. My husband & I stay at this location at least 3 times a year.

reviews.title: Renter Beware!
reviews.text: First I want to say I love Hilton and am not only an owner, but almost always rent at Hilton.This is a totally lovely resort and a wonderful place to stay. However, BETWEEN 9 AM AND 6PM, THERE IS A POOL PARTY WHICH PLAYS MUSIC SO LOUD, IT IS NOT THE MUSIC, IT'S THE VIBRATION OF THE BASS. THIS TRULY VIBRATES THE WINDOW OF YOUR ROOM AND BONES. YOU CAN'T EXCAPE IT. NOT EVEN WITH HEADPHONES. According to the bell hop, this insane noise can be heard all over the resort. It will give you a headache

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo Las Vegas
reviews.text: High marks for this property and location in Las Vegas. Free parking provided if you have a car, but you can walk to everything, or take the monorail or uber/taxi. Excellent family property, although, I would not recommend taking children under 18 to Vegas.

reviews.title: Worst Hilton experience ever
reviews.text: I've been to a lot of Hilton and non-Hilton hotels but this property did not live to its expectations as a 5-star hotel and part of the Hilton brand. So many things missing especially basic notion of hospitality itself and making the facilities guest-friendly. For the first time, I felt I was not staying at a Hilton hotel.

reviews.title: Vegas Review
reviews.text: I loved the location as we are always spending time in the linq. It had easy access to the monorail which we used.  But if you want quiet surroundings this is not it. Pool DJ stopped at a reasonable hour but if you wanted to nap during the day even earplugs didn’t help.

reviews.title: Definitely coming back!
reviews.text: Loved everything about my stay! Room very nice and clean, great location! Love the big tub inside the room! Next to the high roller, very convient! Great stay if you want to be near the strip but without all the casino action inside.

reviews.title: Hilton at the Flamingo
reviews.text: Very nice suites, having the washer and dryer combo was VERY handy. Be aware that the GoPool Party Pool is in front of this hotel, music starts at 10am and goes to 6 pm. Very good location if you want to have a GREAT TIME at the GoPool but if you need an afternoon nap it may disturb you. Free parking at The Flamingo parking garage. Overall, we will  definitely be coming back to this hotel.

reviews.title: BEWARE IF FEES!!!!!
reviews.text: Nice location but in all the years of exchanging with RCI we have never incurred over 250 dollars for resort fees on top of exchange fees. Granted the fees are explained in RCI BUT when we checked in we were asked for credit card for incidental fees. I specifically asked what were they she said it was just a hold and i replied Oh there should be no charges upon leaving she said correct unless i charged items to the room!!!! BEWARE BEWARE. No granted we also booked a room at desert in vegas two blocks down the street NO CHARGES!!!!

reviews.title: Mostly great...
reviews.text: The Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo has modern and clean rooms and can't be beaten for it's central location in the middle of the strip. There are a few things to be aware of though. When I booked, I used a third party website that used the main Flamingo pool in the promotional pictures. Upon arrival we were told that this main pool (the GoPool) hosted pool parties every days for over 21's. We had 1 person in our group who was not 21 and we therefore could not use the pool.
