We later found out that this is the only hotel that has a pool party every day, considering the pool party was pretty empty every day apart from Saturday, we thought it seemed pretty silly to host pool parties every day when family's could have been enjoying it on the days the pool party isn't so popular, they should just focus on a few crazy pool party days.Family's should also be aware that the pool parties are loud and can be heard from the whole resort including the two family pools, and the DJ's swear a lot so any family's who are sensitive to swearing may want to look to stay elsewhere.Above all the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that there are no showers around the pools and no check out day rooms available to freshen up before leaving. We had to check out at 10am but didn't leave until 4pm, we felt we couldn't enjoy hour last few hours sitting round the pool as there were no shower or changing facilities so we couldn't go in the chlorinated pool, put too much sun cream on or get sweaty as we didn't want to be uncomfortable on our 11 hour flight home. The man on the desk, who I believe was actually the manager, was also extremely rude about the fact they couldn't offer us anything.Overall great for adults, I would stay here again, but they should definitely add some shower facilities or a day room service for guests checking out.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: We love staying here. The people are always so friendly and the location is the best. Your close to some really nice higher end places and close to the more affordable ones. We can’t wait to come back here!

reviews.title: Flamingling Business
reviews.text: This resort was in a perfect location - I felt like it was in the heart of the Strip! Rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable. Staff/service were gracious and helpful in answering questions. Would definitely recommend for business or vacation!

reviews.title: Friendly staff, great experience!
reviews.text: I couldn't ask for anything more.  The staff was great, everyone I talked with was very friendly and courteous.  The location of the hotel was perfect for what I needed, close to good food, casinos and the strip.  I will be back the next time I stay in Vegas

reviews.title: Take the good with the bad!
reviews.text: The room sizes are nice and the suite we had was mostly as described with everything functional.  However, we had two main beefs: 1) The mattress needed to be replaced a few years ago as it felt like laying in a hammock.  Flipping it didn't help - it was just worn out.  2) Certainly the biggest problem is the noise: guests slamming doors night and day, dropping weights in the exercise room at 5:30am, staff moving large laundry carts all morning, and the absolute worst was the extremely loud music from the adjacent "Go Pool" at the Flamingo.  It's so loud that the suite's windows rattled on certain notes.  If you love sitting at a traffic light and feeling the loud bass notes from the sound system in the car next to you, you'll love this place.  However, if you want peace and quiet during your vacation, this is not the place for you.  Sorry Hilton, never again for this property.

reviews.title: Great stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: We visited Vegas for an anniversary trip. The HGVC at the Flamingo was great.  It's just off of the strip and conveniently located within a short walk to the Bellagio, Caesar's, Paris, Planet Holleywood, etc.  We were upgraded upon arrival and received a suite with a king bed (private bedroom), full kitchen, living area, dining area and a huge bath.  The property is 100% non-smoking which was a plus.

reviews.title: Boom boom music for 12 hours everyday!
reviews.text: If you want to party in the Flamingo pool and love heavy bass in your room this is great. If you want a room to retreat from the craziness of Vegas FORGET IT! FROM 10 AM TO 10 PM IT WILL BE NONSTOP MUSIC!!! So just depends on what you need in a room.

reviews.title: great location and free parking
reviews.text: have stayed in the hotel several times. it is a great location behind the flamingo and near the bellagio. it is clean and i was in the north tower and rooms that end in 04 have a nice view. they have a place to get coffee or food called the market place. they make a good sandwich, the pizza looked good but did not try it. it is a short walking distance to the majority of the resorts on the strip. parking is included which is a real treat in las vegas these days. $25 a night to park seemed a bit too much.

reviews.title: Reunion trip to Vegas
reviews.text: Every year our group of coworkers and significant others make a 5 day trip to las Vegas to renew friendships and enjoy fellowship.  The HGVC location is ideal.  We are close to the action and yet can get away for some relaxing time as a group in our accomendations. We have been at this location for 10 straight years.

reviews.title: Some important  Improvements
reviews.text: Two years ago I made the comment/complaint' to the GM (Lisa) that smoking in and around the HGVC private pool and surrounding area should be confined to a 'special area' for smokers (personally I would ban it altogether). Then, I had found some disgusting people were smoking all over the place and even when IN the pool.  Lisa was very charming and said she would do what she could but ground space was limited.  I left not too confident of a result.OK - it took two years but this visit, I was delighted to see my request had been totally complied with - well done to HGVC and to the GM, Lisa in particular - your efforts have made our experiences there much more comfortable, and I am sure others will be delighted too.  Here in the UK - smoking is banned in all public places and areas.One small point though - it needs to be policed better because (as ever) there were one or two disobeying the rule (or didn't know it).  This also applies to folks going down to the pool early, placing a towel and a book on a bed and disappearing until later - worse than the Germans (no offence)???Regarding everything else, the staff were wonderful, as ever, and the room was immaculate and well serviced. Thank you for all of that - highly recommended and very central.The noise from the Flamingo main pool area is almost crippling for old (ever young) folks like us but there is nothing that can be done about that.  It stops at around 5-6 pm when one can enjoy a lovely cocktail in the grounds.Round the corner is a great Italian restaurant - "Battista's Hole in the Wall" well worth a visit (best to book) where wine is served free while you have food on your plate.  Also, next door to that is a very useful corner store (wine/beer etc).We will return again next May.

reviews.title: Always a pleasure
reviews.text: I am an owner at HGV and highly recommend the stay at Flamingo. So central to the Strip and staff great. Will Manages this resort and does an outstanding job to make the stay pleasurable. I appreciated it Will!!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel, and great location. However, the self parking was not so great. Overall, it was an excellent hotel. The pool and the fitness center was great. The front desk manager Will was excellent and very knowledgeable. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: HGV needs a little work here
reviews.text: -pool hours posted 6am opening. First day we could get in but second day key didn't work. When I asked at desk they said hours were 8am and the had ordered new signs. -LOUD music from Flamingo ALL day. Beware if you want QUIET time. -10am check out REALLY. Night desk clerk was very rude when we asked for late checkout. She said she'd make an exception until 11am. REALLY!!

reviews.title: nice place but music from next door is aweful
reviews.text: the Hilton Grand Vacations at Flamingo used to be our favorite place but lately the music from next door is so loud you can not relax at the members pool. You have to shout at people so they can hear you over music. When we told them about it they told us that in Fall and Winter it is not as bad. Well....that because not many people are at the pool in the winter. Not a good answer at all.

reviews.title: North American Tour
reviews.text: Excellent property. Booked a suite here at half the cost of the bigger hotels and yet found the room extremely spacious.Yes we had booked a suite but I mean it was huge. Well equipped kitchen included as well as separate sitting room.Staff were very pleasant and accommodating. Nothing was too much trouble.Excellent location for the Strip.Only downside was the noise from the Pool Party at the "Flamingo" next door during daylight hours

reviews.title: INCREDIBLE NOISE
reviews.text: When other reviews cited the noise from the pool I never thought it could be so loud.  If you stay at this hotel and think you are going to sleep at anytime between 10:00AM and 5:30PM you are greatly mistaken.  The noise from the pool is so loud it vibrated the room.  Sitting in the room during that time period was not pleasant.  There should be a warning about the noise when you make a reservation here.  Unless you are deaf you probably should not stay at this location.

reviews.title: Fabulous Vegas Stay
reviews.text: We recently stayed at this fabulous hotel with our friends. We had a 2 bedroom apartment with adjoining dots. The staff, accommodation and location was brilliant. Being right behind the Pink Flamingo resort meant easy access to the main Vegas strip but was far enough away as to avoid all the noise etc at night.  The other great thing was there is no casino or gambling on site. Definitely would recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!!!
reviews.text: Six of us spent a week here and it was excellent! We found the rooms to be spacious & clean, the staff were professional, friendly & helpful, the pool area had a nice, big hot tub and the location was perfect for being right at the heart of the Vegas strip. There is a path that takes you right to the Flamingo and, from there, you are literally right across the street from Caesar's Palace. You can walk to many of the big-name casinos like the Bellagio, the Mirage, Paris and New York. This was my second trip to Vegas and I know there will be a third and I know I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Awesome property right off the strip
reviews.text: We had a two bedroom unit which was basically two units adjoining via one door. With 7 people in the two units we never really felt cramped. The location is GREAT - very central on the strip and a very short walk to the strip. Easy access to the Linq alley with shops and dining, easy access to the monorail.The pool and hot tub were never crowded and were very clean. It's right behind this pool "club" with music and such so it was almost like we got half the party with 1/100th of the crowd. Really enjoyed this resort and will probably always stay here in when visiting vegas!

reviews.title: Terrible exp[erience
reviews.text: I own property here and very disappointed that my annual dues are being wasted, the staff here needs training. I've stayed here for 15 years and the staff has really gone done hill.   The pool was open for only 5 days of the week.

reviews.title: Could not enjoy swimming pool and being outdoors at resort
reviews.text: The units are great: spacious and comfortable. However, the private swimming pool is tiny for the size of the resort. You do get access to the adjacent Flamingo swimming Pool. The Flamingo swimming pool is a party day club from 10 AM to 5 PM from March to October with music so loud you can't hear yourself talk at the Hilton Grand Vacations premises (grounds, private pool or outside lounging area). The music was so loud, we could also hear it clearly from our unit as well and it made the windows shake. The music selection was good but the volume was so loud, we have never heard anything like that at any all-inclusive resort or timeshare vacation resort (more than 20 different vacations). Hotel manager did provide courtesy access to a swimming pool at another Hilton Grand Vacation property but we still feel we could not enjoy our stay as having to commute to another property to enjoy a relaxing time poolside is not what we had in mind. Only book this resort if you wish to partake in the daytime party scene and will enjoy participating in this alcohol/drug-enhanced swimming pool craziness. We absolutely could not enjoy our stay at this resort and would never go back in the summer.

reviews.title: Great option on the strip. Would recommend.
reviews.text: Friendly staff, clean rooms, access to a  great pool make it a great option.  My only negative comment was that I was disappointed by the fitness room. They have a very small space filled with a few cardio machines and a set of free-weights. That's all.

reviews.title: Flamingo
reviews.text: The hotel was nice and comfortable to stay and everyone was very nice and attentive. I did have trouble connecting to the internet access through the hotel so I used my data on my phone. It was nice to have two places you could swim.

reviews.title: Terrible location
reviews.text: Impossible to get an Uber or food delivery,  no onsite restaurant, no room service, pantry closes too early, rooms are like hospital rooms. Staff was nice, but they realize the hotel is lacking in amenities. They mentioned how close the strip was. I arrived after Midnight on a business trip, I don’t want to hike to the strip!

reviews.title: Great timeshare resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacations couldn't have a better title, it was a grand location, pleasant & helpful staff,clean & comfortable rooms at a super location. What more could anyone ask ? It was a great week at this timeshare for my sister in law and I.

reviews.title: Not Good for Business Travelers
reviews.text: I am in Vegas about 4 times a year for trade shows. I always try to stay at a Marriott or Hilton to get points because I'm usually here for 4 nights and hate to miss out on points by staying at the big casino hotels that require miles of walking. Two weeks ago I was at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club Paradise and really loved it. When I would return to the hotel after dinner each night, I would stop in the Marketplace and get a breakfast sandwich for the next morning so I wouldn't have to get dressed to come down and do that in the morning. It was very convenient and the store had a lot of things. I'm back here now for another show and am staying at the Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo location because it is closer to the Sands Convention Center.  I will never stay at this property again. One reason is HGVC overall. They don't have restaurants other than the pool bar. And it would be nice to have a glass of wine when coming back to the hotel after networking dinners. and have a restaurant to have breakfast. This hotel has the Marketplace but it closes at 7 p.m. That is way too early. The booming music is also difficult when trying to work during the day, but I knew about that ahead of time and have coped with it. Here's the deal breaker. I want to use Lyft to get back and forth to the Sands each day. Some days I need to go twice. Lyft now has a business option that allows you to print all your "receipts" in a one page report. This has made my expense reports sooooo much easier. I love it and this definitely keeps me from using traditional cabs. Well, at this hotel, you can't get a Lyft (or Uber) to come to the main door where cabs drop off. The apps default to the "hotel roundabout" that is a pretty far walk away.  In addition to wanting Hilton points, I don't like to stay at Casino hotels because I can't stand walking through the casinos to get to the convention areas. Long, long walks through noisy places. So staying at other types of hotels is calmer and you can jump in cabs or Lyfts/Ubers and get dropped close to where your trade show is and avoid the long walk. But this hotel is forcing you to walk to a ride share place. That totally defeated the main purpose in staying here. So this morning, I walked around the corner to a restaurant called Battista's. I couldn't summon a Lyft there either. It was forcing  you to walk at least 5 minutes to this other area. So I have just been requesting the rides and then calling the driver and trying to explain to them where to come to pick me up. This was so inconvenient and greatly annoying and stressful. I was late two days in a row getting to meetings at the exhibit hall. At least coming back I was in their car and would direct them. So tomorrow when I go to the Convention Center and come back and around 9 pm when I go to the airport, I will have to use a regular taxi because I am sick of what I've had to go through to do something as simple as get picked up by a car.  If I hadn't had colleagues also staying at this hotel, when I discovered this the first day, I would've moved to another hotel. I feel like they look at the guests as cattle that can be herded to a specific location. What is the difference in calling a cab to pick you up which is allowed, or calling a Lyft through an app? This set up is not customer centric. Mattress also seems old.

reviews.title: Flamingo's hidden oasis of tranquility
reviews.text: On the grounds of the famous Flamingo Hotel and Casino, across from the pool and the small habitat for birds and fish, away from the hustle and bustle of the casino and shops, is this comfortable, quiet, relaxing resort.  Close to everything, yet far enough away for comfort.

reviews.title: Worst Accommodation in 6 weeks of a holiday
reviews.text: The head banging music was just inexcusable, and when i complained they offered me Ear Plugs which I feel is insulting, They then offered me free tickets to a show to compensate. We actually brought our departure date forward by three days to get out of there

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: We stay here often as we are owners.  Beautiful rooms. Comfortable beds and couches. The kitchen is well supplied and the freezer has a ice maker. Plus a washer and dryer.  My only complaint is the constant calls trying to get us to go to a meeting.

reviews.title: Vegas vacation
reviews.text: The facility is located near the airport and on the strip. All of the amenities are clean and close to a variety of shows. The staff is very friendly and courteous. The location was close to food and transportation to downtown Frontier Street .

reviews.title: A Loud music experience
reviews.text: Loud music all day from the Flamingo pool next door. House cleaning does not provide extra tissues, towels or sheets, unless you ask. Water is not free. You are charged thru their Resort fee.Nothing is free. You are paying everything thru the Resort Fee of $25 per day.

reviews.title: Our only place in Vegas
reviews.text: This is the only property we stay at in Vegas.  We always get a one bedroom suite with full kitchen and a washer/dryer.  It’s very nice to take clean laundry home.  The staff is very helpful and friendly.  It’s right next door to the Linq, High Roller with easy access to the strip. Highly recommend HGVC Flamingo.

reviews.title: Not for Fitness Focused People
reviews.text: Smallest gym I’ve seen in years. Now I have to pay $10 a day to workout at Flamingo. If you like to workout do not stay here. You will be very disappointed. Won’t ever stay here again.  Thought it was connected to Flamingo, but guess I was wrong.

reviews.title: Great service, amenities in the heart of Vegas!
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the HGVC at the Flamingo. My wife and I along with an another couple of our friends spent a week in a two bedroom unit.  We had a great time and loved our unit. We were checked in by Will the GM who made us feel very welcome. We can’t say one bad thing about the whole complex from the friendly staff to units themselves. The only negative was the afternoon music from the adult pool at the flamingo. Other than that we would highly recommend the HGVC.

reviews.title: Nice but too noisy
reviews.text: Too much noise from pool area so that we could not stay at the resort during the day. Checked out early- no credit from hotel. Even earplugs did not resolve. Hotel and staff are nice but noise is awful

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Location is fantastic, off the strip but not really.  Parking is included but does not accommodate Van's, they do have a secure lot but didn't let us know until the end. Checkout time needs to be extended. 10 am is extremely inconvenient especially in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Terrible for business trips. Actually, just terrible.
reviews.text: In town for business or a conference? Run. Run far, far away from this hotel. Even as a vacation spot I don’t think it really shines beyond one or two stars...Top reasons this hotel sucks:Blaring music all day and late into the night. There is no escape from the EDM baseline that will rattle your room from 9AM til Midnight or later. Maybe ear plugs would help?The Wi-Fi is spotty. Goes in and out and unfortunately Verizon doesn’t get great service in the rooms.The market closes pretty early and while that isn’t really a big deal, the lady at the register is mean. Mean and scary I tell you.When you leave the do not disturb sign on your door, the maid service will still call the room phone at 9AM to make sure you don’t want room service. Why do they do this? It defeats the purpose. Go away maids!The furniture, for me, was mega dirty. See attached pictures. Sinks and bathrooms and bedding all seemed clean though.The best things about this hotel?A quick walk through the casino and you’re on the strip! ...Oh wait, every other hotel in Vegas gives you that same experience.I guess there is nothing good about this hotel. Run away! Run!

reviews.title: Great Place and good location
reviews.text: You will love staying here as it very close to the strip, its a 5 mins walk from the back to the front, walking through the beautiful gardens with the Flamingo, turtles, fish, pelican and birds. The hotel lobby is clean and very well kept, the staff is also very helpful (be aware of "The experince desk) they get you in for the time share. The room are actually an apartment with a kitchen, lounge, kitchen table,washer machine, dryer, large bedroom with queen size bed, it also has a bath and shower with lots of room. We were on the 15th floor had an amazing view of the pool, its very quiet.

reviews.title: Great place and real nice location.
reviews.text: You will enjoy the stay here as the folks are really nice to deal with.The place is close to all the major hat spots on the strip. The Flamingo hotel is close by to casino and Donnie and Marie show.We have stayed here several times and intend to return.

reviews.title: Enjoyed the easy access
reviews.text: We enjoyed the stay, great location.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  Market hours could have been extended, but other than that it was fine.  Rooms were clean and well kept.  All in all we had a great stay and would go back.

reviews.title: Location perfect for us
reviews.text: We recently had three nights here in a one bedroom apartment, very neat and tidy.Very spacious, a big kitchen, lounge area, two bathrooms, big bedroom , very comfortable. Two big TVs, a laundry, lots of cupboard and robe space .The kitchen was stocked with all the utensils you need to cook your own meals if you so wished, great free wifi . It is right next door to the Flamingo Casino so easy to pop in and have a flutter.You also have access to the Flamingo pool area which is always busy and very noisy with music blaring all day. There is also a pool and hot tub in the Hilton grounds which is quieter. There was free carpark in a carpark just across the road which was good, we never drove the car while staying in Vegas.We were only one block back from the main Strip where all the action is so very good positionThe staff were all good, we really enjoyed our time here, and would be happy to stay here in the future if the case arises.

reviews.title: Noisy, leaky, dirty but great location
reviews.text: The location is great! The service is okay if they actually will address you when standing at a counter reading emails or online. The rooms are spacious but the carpets are so dirty bring slippers. The music from the flamingo pool will tump you into numbness. Load AC units sounded like a broken belt kept thumping over and over. The leak through the smoke detector not a good sign. Rinse out the tub and shower as there is likely hair there.The marketplace closes so early shop early or elsewhere. 6-7 PM like anything in Vegas happens after that. The Hilton vacation desk should be moved away from the front door to the lobby with the tv. The person will ask about the fee gift or purchase everytime you walk by! No no no let me vacation in peace. Time to look elsewhere for a place to stay!

reviews.title: HGVC at Flamingo Review
reviews.text: The issue we encountered was LOUD pounding music all day from 10AM till 5 PM every day. We could not enjoy the pool at the HGVC or our room due to this constant blaring noise. It was a convenient location but I would never stay there again. My request to use a pool at one of the other HGVC properties was never responded to by the manager. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: The resort is a block off the strip and is conveniently situated near many major shows and attractions The Go pool is hopping from 9am till 5 and the music is very loud and caters to the younger generation but the adjacent family pool is more on the quieter side Food at the pools was decent quality and reasonable Just a heads up, you cannot use your room key to purchase any drinks or food at either pool unless you are staying at the Flamingo hotel. You need cash or ID with your credit card. Wish we would have known before having to truck back up to the room. Also need ID plus room key to get into the Go pool.If you’re an afternoon napper like us it’s almost impossible to sleep before 5pm if your room is facing the pool! It’s just way to loud! Guess we’re getting older. lol

reviews.title: In the middle of the Strip
reviews.text: Stayed here for a couple of days on business. This place seems to have a mix of vacationers and business folks. Located adjacent to and behind the Flamingo. Right next to the LINQ so centrally located on the Strip. Guests get to use the Flamingo GO pool which can be fun. Note that the Flamingo pool fills up bright and early. Also the Flamingo pool blasts music which is fun if you hanging out at the pool but can be annoying in your room during the day if you were thinking about sleeping.  The market place has limited hours and is not opened late.

reviews.title: Love this Facility!
reviews.text: Once again Hilton has outdone themselves.  As our family continues to return each Easter for family reunion we continue to enjoy our stay! Rooms, staff, pool area, etc all meet well over expectations. Thank you Hilton!!

reviews.title: Would stay here again in a heartbeat!
reviews.text: Located behind the Flamingo Hotel  and had access to all their amenities as well as the HGVCLUB.Perfect location! Cut through the Flamingo and you are across the street from Bellagio and Caesars Palace.  Monorail has a stop right on the property.

reviews.title: A family overnight for trip to Zion.
reviews.text: The staff was attentive to our special needs for storing expensive bicycles which was an initial worry for us.  They made it very easy.  The layout of the rooms are very much like an apartment and feel large.  They looked to be updated in the year.  A couple of things that this resort does NOT have... a restaurant or comfortable beds.  There is a very nice c-store attached with just about everything you need (processed/prepared) for food and drink.  The mattresses are old and very well worn.  I was very surprised at this as I am Hilton Honors Member and stay exclusively at Hilton.   The pool was small but clean and very comfortable...perfect for our family.

reviews.title: Fabulous Flamingo Fun!
reviews.text: We stayed here for a full week and thoroughly enjoyed our experience. We had the two bedroom unit, which had the entry to an open foyer which had separate entry to each of the bedrooms in the unit. Our friends stayed in the smaller bedroom with a king sized bed, and the room had a dishwasher, microwave and sink. It also had a separate tub outside in the bedroom, and the shower was included in the toilet area, and the unit had a loveseat sofa and two chairs with a small table. Our unit was the larger unit with  a full kichen, dining table for four and a full couch and an easy chair. In the second room there was a king sized bed and easy chair, as well as a sink and jacuzzi tub in the bedroom, and another small separate space with a sink area which had the toilet and shower area. There was a wonderful view of the Flamingo and several hotels from our room. The Flamingo Beach Pool Party had music going in the afternoon, which we could hear the bass in our rooms- but this did not bother us, and all music ended around 6 pm EVERY night. This resort was extremely quiet, we never had any noise from other units. Another bonus was the front desk gave us a ticket for two free bottles of water each day in the small grocery shop downstairs- which was welcome as we paid $18 for a 1 liter bottle of water at the Mandaly Bay! We also took advantage of the food service the the shop- and the food was very good. Breakfast sandwich specials were $ 6.99 with a coffee. One thing to note- they sell alcohol in the shop but it is NOT allowed to be brought into the pool area. They stopped us, and we had to bring back uo to the room. There is a staffed bar at the pool in the afternoon. You will need your key to access the pool as well as the elevator for security.The monorail access was just off the pathway of the resort and we literally was on it within 10 minutes of leaving our room. The Flamingo Resort and Casino was a 4 minute walk from the resort, and brought you to instant access to the Strip. The location was superb. We also took advantage of the Pink Jeep adventures while here, and they picked us up right at the resort. All staff were hospitable, we utilized the services of the concierge, front desk and valet. Our friends, my husband and myself could not say enough positive things about this resort. We look forward to returning again soon.

reviews.title: Excellent staff and customer service, property not so much
reviews.text: First, the staff at this hotel is similar to a 4 star hotel. They are very courteous and go out of their way to meet any requests or inquires. However, the property is very dated and run down. It's clean, but nothing like other Hilton properties I've stayed in. I travel extensively for work, have Diamond status and tend to stay in more upgraded property. But, I thought I was realistic about what to expect. This is a clean property, but that's about it. The "resort fee" of $25 a day is for long distance calls (who doesn't have a cell phone?), movie rental and 2 free waters a day. That's a bit steep for those services. Probably my biggest complaint is that the large, fun pool with the slides and waterfalls - the reason I picked this property-  as I was traveling with my 10 year old- is only open for +21. They have other pools available, but they are not heated and are seasonal only. The other pools are similar to what you would have in a built in backyard pool. I looked back at the description on my Hilton app and NO WHERE does it say that this pool is for +21. Location is good- close to lots of restaurants, but any where you stay in Vegas is close to restaurants and entertainment. They all go out of there way to make it accessible. Again, don't knock the staff, they are doing the best with what they have.

reviews.title: Great place just off the strip
reviews.text: We had a two bedroom lock off.  Both units were clean, and nicely furnished. Nice that the kids could stay in one unit while we stayed in the other. A little peace and quiet!  Location was great being a short walk to the strip, while being far enough away to get a good nights sleep.  Would stay again.

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: We had stayed here several times. Location is the best so we come back again and again. It could use some work but again location is everything.  I would not suggest a handicap room as they are at the ends of the hall ways and the shower gets the floor all wet. I’ve stayed in all kinds of rooms and the 2 bedroom is the best.

reviews.title: The Pros & Cons
reviews.text: Pros: Our 2 BR unit had an entry area with each bedroom having a separate door. The main bedroom had a full kitchen, living room area, washer/dryer king bed,  separate vanity areas.  The other unit was nice with a king bed, efficiency kitchen (sink, coffee pot, microwave, dishes), bath with shower and a soaking tub.    The location was fantastic - adjacent to Flamingo-easy strip access.  Everyone was friendly and ready to accommodate in any way they could.  We rent a car and access was easy off of Flamingo Rd.  Unfortunately, we will not be staying here again....Cons:  1) There is a $25/day resort fee (yes we traded in and we are a weeks trader).  This piece of info was sent to me after the trade was complete as an "Oh, By the way," email.   Not a deal breaker 2)  We would really prefer a unit that had some type of balcony to enjoy our morning coffee.  This is obviously not the resorts fault, just the way it is. 3) The parking is free (with a $25/day resort fee I would expect it would be) however, the parking ramp across the side street for the resort and is quite a ways to walk.  There is valet parking for an additional $18/day (plus you would be expected to tip I am sure)  This was probably a deal breaker.  4) HOWEVER, the real deal breaker for us was the noise at the pool.  We enjoy a bit of quiet time at the pool sometme during the day.  The sun does not start to reach the pool until around midday.  Sometime shortly after that the Flamingo's pool  (attached to this one) starts it's afternoon "party"   The music is loud and is a constant drumming noise.  Not something to relax by - and it goes on all afternoon.  I am, of course, the older generation so if you are the "younger generation" you would be able to enjoy the music without paying to go into the Flamingo's pool area.  Overall, the facility was well kept and everything you would expect from a first-class resort.   Unfortunately for me, the things that I disliked are not something they could have changed.

reviews.title: Great Accommodations
reviews.text: Perfect when traveling with large groups that include children. The 2 bedroom suites are perfect with plenty of privacy for all. Complete kitchens so hungry kids can always have food available at all hours.

reviews.title: Peace and Quite
reviews.text: We go to Vegas every year and love staying here because we can go to all the larger louder hotels & casinos within walking distance and when the day is over we can go back to Peace and Quite NO Bar, NO Noise and NO Casino

reviews.title: THIS IS WHERE YOU WANT TO STAY
reviews.text: We stayed at the Hilton Grand Flamingo for a week.. We were greeted with the fariedliest staff. Everyone had a smile on their face.  Our unit, a 1bedroom condo, was lovely.  It was large, clean and had everything we needed.  The grounds were beautiful and the location excellent. It is located just behind the Flamingo on the strip and is right by the monorail station..Service was excellent, we really hated to leave and can hardly wait to come back to our home away from home.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Perfect location. Middle of the stripEasy walking to shows, casios snd restaurants. Free access to flamingo pool club. Its right next to the giant ferris wheel and monorail. The cab fare to and from the resort is approximately $20

reviews.title: Quiet oasis in midst of Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Rooms are quite nice but our mattress was bad and needs replacing. Building is smoke-free but designated smoking area away from entrances, pathways & pools would be helpful.  $25/day resort fee gets you nothing extraordinary - no clue why it is imposed!

reviews.title: Vegas at the Flamingo Hilton Grand Vacations Club
reviews.text: we stay there quite frequently and we really do like the place, the staffis extremely friendly, they have a deli which opens up a six o'clock inthe morning and has pretty much everything you might need, there arealso laundry facilities on the  17th floor if you don't have a washing machine in your apartment.Unfortunately there is a lot of noise coming from the Flamingo poolfrom noon to 5 o'clock, because they decided to make it a party pool with the music blasting nonstop.Otherwise I have no complaints, it's a delight to walk through thegardens with waterfalls, lush palm trees, a real oasis in the middleof a dessert, except for that hellish music.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: This is our second stay here and we absolutely love it. Close to everything on the strip. Nice to have the private heated pool and hot tub at the Hilton and still have access to the large pool at the Flamingo. Staff are friendly and attentive. Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: quiet in the middle of Vegas
reviews.text: I enjoyed the quiet retreat of the grand vacation club by the Flamingo hotel. The access to the Flamingo pool is a nice touch as well as the quiet, less busy Hilton pool. Great location, close enough to walk to many attractions. A close stop on the monorail so a daily/extended ticket to use the monorail during your time in Vegas for hotels down the strip for shows, dinner, or exploring is a great choice to save your feet and enjoy your stay without pain. Marketplace has limited hours so bring snacks and drinks (CVS isn't too far, I know Vegas doesn't sleep but if you want something and you have walked all day, you would want something in your room, not a Vegas block away, and some close restaurants do close for the evening). Overall, we did enjoy being able to come to a quiet hotel with a comfortable bed, option to rent a DVD, take a bath, and enjoy some quiet before heading to the next day activities.

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: Very clean. Had pack n play and highchair and a market and heated pool on site. Awesome. Recommend to families. Walking distance to flamingo and the linq and in the middle of the strip. No casino or smoking in hotel which is great.

reviews.title: Fun close to the strip.
reviews.text: This was not a relaxing type of vacation, but we enjoyed our stay.  The resort is so close to the strip that we were able to walk to many sites.  The Linq promenade had a fun atmosphere with many places to eat.  The Highroller was more fun than expected and the kids enjoyed zip lining.  The resort itself was nice, but do not expect quiet during the day.  The Go pool, 21 and over, is right outside of the resort and they play very loud music.  We did not mind the music, but something to be aware of if that noise level bothers you.

reviews.title: Great Property and Location
reviews.text: The actual location of this property was a really pleasant surprise - centrally located for walking, at a monorail stop, next to the Linq Promenade, etc. Would definitely recommend this property and would stay here again!

reviews.title: Dont stay here with kids!!
reviews.text: Not up to Hilton standards. Stay elsewhere if you have kids. Sprinbreak was not fun. Kid/Family pool for adults drunks and chainsmokers without kids. Security bowed down to them. Slides are closed. Huge adult only pool. Very tiny family pool open to any swearing drunk.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed at the HGV@Flamingo March 16-23 and really liked it!  The location was great-middle of the strip but back from the strip noise.  It was a little peaceful oasis away from the partying although it was surrounded by the action.  The private pool was great, the property is well kept and the staff was very helpful and pleasant.  We would definitely stay there again if in Vegas.

reviews.title: Will be staying here again
reviews.text: Just didn’t like I had to work 5min to my room from the main entrance. It kept me from wanting to leave out due to the far distance. And there wasn’t a quicker exit from the hotel from my room. The most we could do was walk thru the swimming area but after 10pm it was closed so we just end up walking 5min either way

reviews.title: Perfect Spot
reviews.text: For a first time visitor to Las Vegas, this was the PERFECT location to be as centrally located as possible. Did NOT need to rent a car at all, unless you want to do any sort of excursion activity. Walking distance to virtually anything on the strip, great local transportation options available, buses and monorail system. From there using Uber or Lyft for anything else is super simple!

reviews.title: Centrally located, big rooms
reviews.text: We stayed in a 1-bedroom that had a pullout couch. It's nice to have a kitchen and large living area. The bathroom has 2 separate sink areas great for getting ready. Convenient location to the strip. The hotel itself was very quiet as I couldn't even hear our neighbors however because this resort is also connected to the Flamingo, the music from the Flamingo GO Pool was VERY LOUD. The little store inside the resort had a nice variety of snacks, light food options and reasonably priced Starbucks coffee. Pool for this resort is small but heated and there is a large hot tub. There was plenty of chairs around the pool too. You can also use the Flamingo pool. Staff was great.

reviews.title: Business/Convention Trip
reviews.text: Outstanding hotel. Easy checkin. Friendly and helpful staff. Great accommodations. Conveniently located next to Monorail Station. Only possible negative is the adjacent Tropicana Swimming pool. Loud thundering music in the afternoon until about 6 PM

reviews.title: Hilton Flamingo
reviews.text: We had a 1BR, full kitchen, which is what we wanted, as we were staying for a week, but there is no major style grocery store nearby, a cab would be required if you don,t have a rental. Wasn't a real fan of the resort amenity of 25.00 per day also.

reviews.title: Great stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Resort was as described and the staff was extremely helpful from the Manager to the lady in the shop.. Location was great, easy access to Monorail.  We were able to take side trips to Grand Canyon and Hoover Damn.

reviews.title: Quiet with quick access to the strip
reviews.text: Loved this place! Able to make our own meals in the kitchen, extremely convenient to the strip, clean and well priced! Totally recommend!! Loved the peace and quiet at the end of the day, but still so close we could hit the flamingo casino in minutes:)

reviews.title: Vaca
reviews.text: The room was excellent couldn’t have had it better. But next to the pool with loud music did get a little too much but we were able to deal with it and still have fun. The workers there are reall great they do a great job

reviews.title: Great vacation location in Vegas!
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo provided many perks such as free bottles of water at the in-house market, free movie rentals and most important free parking.  The Flamingo charged $12 per day.The room was clean and spacious.  Appliances were in good condition.  Linens were fine quality (could provide pot holders).Ceasar's Palace, the Billagio, Mirage, Planet Hollywood and Harrah's are all within a 5 - 10 minute walk.  Overall, recommended if you want comfort with closeness to all Vegas sights and activities.

reviews.title: Good decent place
reviews.text: The only thing is there is a first set of doors that you enter before going to your room door. The first set of doors sticks and is loud when somones comes in that you can hear from your room. Also the room door dont shut well. And when the first set of doors open and your door isn't shut all the way, it shuts cuz of the air drafts.

reviews.title: Nice --very timeshare minimal Vegas atmosphere
reviews.text: Everything is very nice.  Rooms are in good condition.  Lobby is nice and recently redone.  It is just a bit boring for Vegas.  View of the Flamingo pool.  Need to walk through the Flamingo or up the street to get to Las Vegas Blvd.  The Flamingo Hotel is a bit worn....   I usually stay at HGVC Elara but it was booked for my dates.  The Elara is beautiful with amazing Vegas views and convenient location....so the HGVC Flamingo was boring and less convenient in contrast.  However, as always, it is nice to have the space and kitchen --so I would still choose it over a hotel.

reviews.title: Unsure how to rate this one
reviews.text: Staff clearly focused on selling Hilton Timeshare. Unfortunately this sucks away your vacation feeling. You say no and you get that loving feeling. I am an owner but sadly told that I wasn’t a paying customer.Please note that comment I just stated I own but I’m not a paying customer lol. Clearly I won’t be investing further.Location and building  are wonderful. Pool staff great and are ready to provide wonderful service. The rest of the staff act like they have been beaten into submission. Ray is apparently not a ray of sunshine.Yes people you are paid to provide service and make people feel happy on vacation, that’s what it about. It’s simple and doesn’t cost anything.Funny how we had an experience and MGM Park went out of their way to assist and take care of our simple issue and Hilton didn’t even answer their phone. Next time I visit it will be MGM. Anyone from Hilton wants to contact me feel free but you better not try sell me anything. And yes soon I’m travelling again through Hilton. So far 50/50 in my experience.

reviews.title: First time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We loved the location, just behind the Flamingo, middle of the strip. It was a nice size room with the kitchenette.  We used the coffee maker everyday. We really appreciated that the property was smoke free.

reviews.title: Pushy Staff
reviews.text: I felt like the staff were all high pressure sales people. I said “no” when they asked me to go to the “update” (sales presentation), and they booked me in anyways. After that I had to say “no” about 5 more times. The staff spoke as if I was crazy for not doing it, but I simply thought my time was more valuable than the discounts they were offering.

reviews.title: Property is very well maintained
reviews.text: We were pleased to return for a visit to this property, and are eager to do so again.  Fontane was so helpful - again - and always went the extra mile.  Housekeeping staff were so attentive and you can tell the property is very well maintained.  We appreciate the extra security measures they've put in over the years, too.

reviews.title: Great Location on the strip
reviews.text: We had an enjoyable time here. The location is great to the strip and the monorail which we rode a lot! The resort staff was very accommodating  and friendly. The little store in the lobby is super expensive. Two bedrooms are shared entry with one bedroom with it's own door with small counter and mini fridge and the other unit has a full kitchen. I loved that there was a washer and dryer in the main unit!

reviews.title: Father and son bonding
reviews.text: Located behind the Flamingo Casino and just off the Strip this facility location is very convenient to the SttiStrip yet gives some privacy from the traffic on Las Vegas Boulevard. The rooms were spacious and clean. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Good hotel, but don't pay extra for breakfast
reviews.text: Stayed 5 nights. Hotel was clean. Service staff were helpful and friendly. I paid extra each day in my room rate for breakfast, which turned out to be an egg, cheese, sausage biscuit. The breakfast was not worth it.

reviews.title: In town for Celine Dion
reviews.text: Short walk across the bridge to Caesar’s Palace. Right behind Flamingo casino and near Bellagio. Clean, quiet, room temperature is a bit touchy. Cold the first days, it snowed earlier. Discount on marketplace foods, still pricey though.

reviews.title: Parking situation is horrible
reviews.text: If you like climbing stairs the you will love staying here. To get to your car you will be climbing up 5 flights unless you want to valet at $18 a day. There is an elevator but it is located about a quarter mile away from the front door of the resort on the other side of the parking garage. The rooms are nice. A two bedroom is not really a two bedroom. It is two units with opposing doors that you can access by leaving one unit and going into the other. Pay attention to the tacked on fees for staying there also. The unit was very clean and comfortable and the bed was very nice. The noise from the pool can be a little bothersome late at night. I have been do Vegas several times through RCI and I will stay someplace else other than this resort next time.

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Great facility with excellent suites. Best beds and pillows ever! Slept great! Enjoy easy access to the Strip and many nearby shows. Free self park available and worth doing since it’s $18/ day for valet parking.

reviews.title: Great stay at HGVC Flamingo
reviews.text: Enjoyed a wonderful stay at this facility. It is very clean and quiet and service was great. Its location on the strip is fantastic, in the middle of it all, yet also tucked away in its own private paradise. Will stay here again.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing
reviews.text: Elite premier membership meant nothing. Poor service, bad management. Had to leave room at 10am to be sent to another room. Didn't get the dirty room until well after 5pm!! 1/3 days wasted, now sick with sinus & upper respiratory infection due to filthy air filters and room

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This is a beautiful property with all the amenities that you need.  A great location within walking distance to many places, bus is very reasonable to take you to all of the others.  Staff was very friendly.

reviews.title: Group vacation
reviews.text: This accommodations were perfect for this large group. Our 2 bedroom unit easily held 6 adults comfortably. Like the location mid-strip and behind the Flamingo. You have all the amenities of the HGV plus the Flamingo without the smoking and noise that comes from staying in a casino property. The Market Place is a nice option and there are many options for dining out in the immediate area. We will stay there again.

reviews.title: Terrible experiences and I am not even there yet! UGH I wish I could change my reservation!!!!!
reviews.text: Warning!!!! I have ever been treated so bad in my life by a hotel. The folks at this place point blank lied to me about my reservation- 100% told me things that were not true. With the mistelling of the situation by the person representing the hotel, I was also treated like dirt and like a fleabag. I am Hilton Gold and really dont deserve that treatment! After they left for 10 minutes the person comes back on the phone laughing and having fun only to tell me yeah... sorry... cant help.... If you have any further questions you can call the hotel manager at this number. I asked, "okay whats his name?" The girl replied "I dont know and if I did I couldnt give it out". I am like alright.... you can give me his hone number but you cant provide a name for me to ask for when I call. Then I asked for her name and she wouldnt give it.... I am so angry right now for being treated like an idiot.... Seriously considering moving to Marriott!!!!!! OMG still fuming! I cant get out of the situation so I will update you all after my stay on how bad things really get!

reviews.title: Best Value I've Found on the Strip in my 20 years of Vegas!
reviews.text: Awesome Convenient location right off the Strip.  HUGE Suite with separate Kitchen/Dining area, Sitting Room and massive Soaking Tub.  Beds are like floating on a Cloud.  Everything was spotless, and the Staff was incredibly helpful.

reviews.title: No hot water
reviews.text: 3 of 7 days we had no hot water in our shower.  $200 resort fee for week.  And we picked the coldest week of the year in Las Vegas with no hot water.  Staff made a minimal effort to compensate us for our issues but not adequate at all.

reviews.title: February 2019 Stay
reviews.text: Pros- Its location and two bedroom lockout..Staff very pleasant and accommodating (1 in 4 Resort) Cons -The weather...SNOW ..but not the fault of the resort..The resort fee of $25 per day plus tax is an absurdity. When I asked "exactly what am I entitled to for the resort fee?" (Beware-You do not have an option for this charge.) the representative stated that your “special resort card” entitles you to a 20% discount on some local (yes, high ended) restaurants and other 10% in shops which one may never use. If used once on a $80 food bill, it did not cover our total cost of the resort fee for one week ..$198.45. Oh yes, forgot to say that it did give us a free DVD rental and two bottles of water. I indicated that they could cut our the resort fee and I will buy my own water for less than $198.45. (The other representative almost chocked and had to hide her laugh)..  :)  Thank goodness they did not charge amenity fees as other resorts do, as there were no amenities provided short of a pool. RCI members should keep this in mind when booking resorts which charge "resort and amenity" fees.Also, as in any timeshare resort, there is the push for getting discount tickets and discount attractions..all at a cost of seeing a timeshare presentation. The representative takes an interest in your stay at the resort and they take some time in trying to know you, what your plans are,etc. You all know the drill..They are savvier than most others. However, as an HHonors Member, a statement was made that I would get an additional 500 HHonors Bonus Points including our other party.This is a scam for Honor Member for staying at the resort which involves a it timeshare presentation.  You should receive the points regardless of attending a timeshare presentation as a HHonors Bonus Points Member and we had to pressure them for receiving those points. However, make certain that you have your membership card with you.

reviews.title: Watch for additional charges
reviews.text: An awesome place.  Awesome staff.  Great location to the strip.  Conceirge was most helpful when booking shows.If you book through RCI you will be charged on a daily basis -$25.00 -memo Resort Charge -RCI

reviews.title: Great Strip Location
reviews.text: The rooms are very clean and quiet. The bed was comfortable and we slept well. We have stayed before and love the ability to walk over to other large casinos and hotels as it is mid-Strip, across from Caesar’s and Bellagio. Eva was awesome at front desk and got us our room quickly so we didn’t have to wait for normal checkin time. We would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Great Service and wonderful condo
reviews.text: Perfect place to relax and stay in a beautifully furnished unit steps from the Las Vegas Strip. Pleasant staff and a clean, quiet condo make this a haven from the smoky, overwhelming casinos and busy Las Vegas sights.

reviews.title: Old hotel with updated outside.
reviews.text: Horrible place to stay!! You have to walk a very long distance no matter where you’re going. Uber pick up is crazy far away and the strip is really far. The hotel is seriously old inside, they have updated everything but the rooms. No water pressure and the place stinks of cigarette smoke. Worse spent time share points ever!! I will never stay here again. Hilton should be ashamed to even have their name brand attached to this place.

reviews.title: Very Clean Resort with modern rooms
reviews.text: The rooms were clean, well furnished and the beds and pillows were very comfortable.  I had a 2 bedroom unit while one of the units had a small kitchen/sink area the other unit had a full kitchen.  I had a great stay here and would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.title: LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION.
reviews.text: This vacation club sits right in the middle of the strip.  Yes, it is in the back of the Flamingo Hotel, but has a covered walk way to the Flamingo.   A short walk.  Very clean , quiet and accommodating.  Just beware, if u are a owner, they will bug u to death.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Hilton grand vacation Las Vegas is one of the best timeshares in the chain I’ve been an owner for over 20 years it is been a great experience with my friends and family I recommend of you to stay there would be one of the ultimate stays in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Where to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacation Flamingo was a great place to stay. Convenient location to most all on the strip. There was a lot to see and excellent choices for food. Hotel staff were friendly and out of their way helpful!!

reviews.title: Flamingo Hilton Grand Vacation Club
reviews.text: We return every January to the Flamingo HGVC and are always treated well and professionally.  The staff are the best asset of the Club and the property is well located nestled among the Ling, Caesar's, Bellagio, and Bally's.  The building is well maintained and the rooms are spacious, bright, and quiet.

reviews.title: HGV at the Flamingo
reviews.text: We have stayed at this resort before and love its convenient location.  They keep their pool and hot tub open all year which is fantastic because most hotels close their pools over the winter months (something not everyone is aware of).  Unfortunately  they don't tell you that the affiliated pool at the Flamingo Hotel is closed over the winter season.  The ground are clean and tidy.  The rooms are getting a bit dated but are clean and comfortable.  They have a pool table in the lobby to enjoy and the convenience store/snack bar has a good selection that is comparatively reasonably priced.We had asked for a quiet room as we were travelling with a child and we received a room in the back of the hotel-facing the ferris wheel and the Linq Promenade-and across from the garbage room.  It was not particularly quiet as you could hear the music from the Promenade at night and the entire hallway smelled rancid.  We have stayed in other areas of this resort before and never had either problem.Unfortunately we were harassed by the timeshare "welcome" people every day.  They did not recognize us, even after having spoken with them, and bothered us every time we passed their desk (which was several times a day to get to the elevator to get to our room).  The concierge desk was generally of little help and gave us incorrect information regarding the monorail/transport system between hotels/casinos.The front desk was pleasant, but also could not give us very good directions when trying to find a nearby pharmacy or with respect to the monorail/transport system between hotels/casinos.Parking was convenient and free.As much as we love this resort for it's location and for it's family friendliness, the cost of the resort fees on top of the price for the rooms makes this not a great value for the destination.

reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text: We were celebrating our 56th wedding anniversary and were very pleased with all aspects of our of our stay at these facilities. Not only was the room excellent you are on the strip and in the center of the action.

reviews.title: Excellent Value and Quality
reviews.text: We stayed at this location in January 2019. The staff are extremely friendly and provide excellent assistance if we had questions. We stayed in a one bedroom unit. It came with a full kitchen, living room, and a huge bedroom separate from the living room. There is also a washer and dryer included and the room overlooked the pool area. It was really nice - way nicer than a hotel room. One of the things I really noticed was how quiet the inside of the room was. I ended up feeling quite sick during my stay (the illness travelled to Las Vegas with me) so the ability to get some rest without being disturbed was truly appreciated. HGV at the Flamingo is directly behind the actual Flamingo resort meaning it is just steps from the strip. It’s also super close to the High Roller which is a major tourist attraction. However, the best thing about the location is that the monorail station is also steps away meaning that you can use the monorail to get up and down the majority of the strip to save yourself the walking (this is a big benefit when you are recovering from illness on your vacation like me). I would definitely stay here again. This place is awesome.

reviews.title: Home Away from The Big City
reviews.text: The HGVC at The Flamingo was such an oasis for us in Las Vegas.  We were there for a family event, so spent our days at events in and around Las Vegas.  It was so nice to return home to the quiet of our resort at the end of the day.  I loved that we didn't have to walk miles once we arrived to reach our room, and didn't have the dinging of slot machines and the flashing of lights all around us.  The resort is small by comparison, so didn't have a lot of amenities to offer, but had the necessary ones and was just right for our stay.

reviews.title: Comfortable and Quiet
reviews.text: We traded our timeshare and were quite pleased. The staff is so welcoming and only asked us once, if we wanted to hear/see the timeshare tour. Thank you!  Our room was very comfortable and clean. We loved the bed, slept well.  The monorail stop is right outside and it is a short walk through the Flamingo Hotel, to the strip. We hope to visit again.

reviews.title: Beware!
reviews.text: RCI now charges a $25 per night resort feeOn top of the exchange fee.Parking is difficult as well! Lots of stairs or long walk from elevator. They have a few handicap spots but lots of valet spots that they charge $18 a day for. And they are often empty...

reviews.title: Quiet, but close to all the action!
reviews.text: HGVC at the Flamingo is a great comfortable, quiet, but close to action place to stay in Vegas!  Fabulous rooms/condos, great on-site facilities for food, pool & hot tub.  Close to High Roller too!  I love staying there & my friends do too!

reviews.title: Convenient for CES
reviews.text: No casino, no restaurant and very quiet. If you want a vegas experience this is not for you. Rooms were perfectly fine if not a little old and in need of some TLC. We stayed there for CES and the location from that point of view is good - 20 minute walk. Breakfast is limited but there is a small shop on site where you can get bagels and coffee.

reviews.title: Great service and location
reviews.text: Great loacation directly behind the Flamingo. Less than a small city block walk. Has its own smaller private heated pool and hot tub, gym, market, everything you need. In the summer you hand access to the Flamingo pool, which has great DJs and parties. Also near the High Roller and Linq which is nice. Staff were very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great location and value.
reviews.text: Quiet oasis right behind the Flamingo hotel and you get to use some of the Flamingo's amenities.  Nice to be able to get away from the craziness of the Strip when you have had enough and want to unwind at the end of the day or night ! We had a great stay and the rates are very reasonable.  Easy walk to the Strip and locations like The Linq, Caesar's, Bellagio and anything near them.  Monorail stop is right next to the resort.  All that makes this a very convenient location to be staying WITHOUT paying some of the ridiculous room rates found along the Strip.

reviews.title: NOT SO GRAND
reviews.text: This property is in desperate need of an update.  Spartan, depressing and dorm-like suite.  Few amenities.  No room service.  The "Marketplace" had limited hours of operation over Christmas and limited food/snack choices.  Abysmal.  Property's $25 resort fee entitles you to two small bottles of Evian (the only upscale/luxury thing here) and daily housekeeping.  On the day we failed to receive this service, Eva at the front desk tried to put the blame on me by saying the Do Not Disturb sign was on the door.  (It had been removed at noon.) After deciding that the blaming the guest tactic was unsuccessful, Eva credited us the resort fee for the one day.I do, however, accept full responsibility for this big booboo of a booking.  Far nicer properties on the strip for far better value than the Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo.

reviews.title: great location and most comfortable bed
reviews.text: I loved the hotel it was a great location in the middle of the strip. The price was extremely reasonable. The bed was amazing if anyone knows what type of bed it is I would love to know.  I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds, Practically ON the strip
reviews.text: We had a very pleasant, comfortable experience at this property in Las Vegas.  The staff was friendly and helpful, grounds were well kept, and the bed was DIVINE.  Next time you visit Las Vegas, stay here!

reviews.title: Bad staff and service
reviews.text: Let’s start that there was no hot water in the shower or the bathtub. Maintenance was called came up couldn’t do anything about it other than tell us because we are on the seventh floor that’s just the way it is. That is completely  unacceptable  answer and nothing was done to correct it, or offer us to go to a different floor or different room nothing. Also two nights in a row people stomping and running in the room above us, it went on from 9 PM at night until 3 o’clock in the morning and again nothing was done to correct this. Called security as well and nothing... it still went on after several calls down to the front desk.

reviews.title: Very nice visit
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay and plan on visiting here again within one month. the only area i couldn't understand was the market place. overtime i went by they were closed. And the free DVD card was pretty flimsy making it difficult to slide into the machine. Should be like a credit card.

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: I traveled to Vegas for a vacation. The Flamingo Hilton grand vacation has a good location. I stayed 4 days and did not get requested early check-in, never had my room cleaned, trash removed or towel changed in a 2 BR unit. Parking across street

reviews.title: Central Positioned Strip Hotel - Well worth the visit.
reviews.text: We were in Vegas for a 50th birthday celebration and had 3 units, two 2 bedroom units and one 1 bedroom suites. Our rooms were 615/617, 623/625 and 611 was the single suite.The two-bed units offered a full kitchen which was nice. But I wish they included a Kettle. There was a dishwasher, a washer and dryer.The 2 bed units has a shared external door, that leads into a small lobby and door to each of the bedrooms. There are in-room safes, large enough to hold a tablet, 15inch laptop and other valuables. Room 611 also had a full kitchen.So it was great to have the others in the party drop by for pre-dinner drinks in our room.The hotel is literally right behind the Flamingo ( 3 min walk) and 5 mins to the Linq and 8 minutes to Bally.Beds were comfortable, and closet in both rooms had plenty of storage. Bathroom well appointed, linen/towel refresh was done once during the 7-night stay.The only complaint we had was the one-bed unit (#611) was right at the end of the corridor and the hot water did not flow to that room very well. We called maintenance on the first night, who told us to run the washer and run the water for 10 -15 mins beforehand.  It seemed like a standing instruction and really Hilton Vacation Club you need to fix that, as that is unacceptable during a 7-night stay. There is a small shop (Market Place) just off the lobby that supplies many items, like Milk sodas etc. and we received a 10% discount coupon to spend there. There was also a free DVD coupon as well.CVS is just a 15-minute walk away as well. if you need more items.The hot tub was open even in the first week of DecemberOverall nice hotel just "off" the strip by a block so economical but yet near enough to be amongst the action.Staff very helpfulRooms well appointed.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Location  is just behind the hotel and walking distance to strip thru hotel and casino. Rooms were perfect and expected one unit with two bedrooms.   Was delighted to find as you walked thru the door there were two more doors one with a full kitchen, bedroom etc and the other door for a studio unit with small kitchen area etc. so it was like having two separate units.  If you want to go to Old Vegas and Freemont street the monorail and taxi service is just a short ride.

reviews.title: Location is everything
reviews.text: Location is the main reason I stay there. It’s right behind the Flamingo, so access to the strip is right there. Don’t love the parking situation. You have to park across at the parking garage. Room had issues this year however they are working it out.

reviews.title: Great place to stay while in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Cordial and courteous staff.  Great location in Las Vegas. We felt very safe in this area and had access to many other locations.  Easy check in and check out.  Can't wait to get back.  We had 5 women for a two bedroom and really felt comfortable.

reviews.title: Nice location in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: This is a solid timeshare right of the strip. No hard sale or constant gimmicks trying to get you to a presentation. Access is a little weird.  Main entrance is on an alley that you enter via another alley. We walked everywhere and the easiest access was out the back but then you had to wander through the Flamingo pool area and the Flamingo Casino. The room has a set of double doors and the hallway door is so heavy I had to throw all my weight into it to open it.  The fitness room was not well marked and the small store was seriously overpriced.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: We love HGVC because it’s a great choice for hotel stays. Great rooms and location. We stay at Flamingo location where we are in a central area on the strip. I love the grounds as they are well groomed and attractive. The market has a good selection of food and beverages. Starbucks on sight.

reviews.title: Awesome location in the Vegas area
reviews.text: This resort has the best location for a timeshare on the Vegas strip.  Very private but extremely close to all the action.  Walking distance to so many casinos.  Very clean resort with a friendly staff.  Love the set up of their rooms.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Strip Vacation
reviews.text: The Strip was within walking distance.  No car needed.  Room was very clean and had comfortable bed with down pillows.  Excellent arrangement of unit with two vanities for a one bedroom.  Prompt service requests fulfilled.  Friendly, helpful staff.

reviews.title: Nice resort in great location.
reviews.text: This resort is in a perfect location in the middle of the strip directly behind the Flamingo.  We had a 2 bedroom lockoff unit which provides plenty of space for 2 couples while still providing privacy..  Hot tub was open in December and very nice pool area.

reviews.title: Hope Hilton Reviews This
reviews.text: After I asked for housekeeping (room cleaning service), I was told to review my contract because it did not come included with the a 4 day 3 night stay. NOTE, I felt like she called me "stupid".  Best way to communicate that to us. Would of being to do, one courtesy service, then explain to me how the contract works for future stays. Not only that, but when we called for towels we waited hours after we called 3 times.Last but not least  No elevators to and from building to get to the garage. ( 4th floor Is only space we could park).NOTE: building was under construction of some sort. Loud aggravating music coming out from the area as i walked by the hall way.I'VE NEVER COMPLAIN ON ANY OF YOUR OTHER RESORTS. But this one made me really mad. Room was beautiful. I would not stay there in the near future, unless staff is educated enough to make the guest feel good about there stay.

reviews.title: Stay at any OTHER property.
reviews.text: I have to say, this has been rather a disappointing stay.  We have had housekeeping issues, problems in marketplace, and things requested that never showed up.  The one bright spot has been Arnold at the front desk.  This young man has gone the extra mile to get shortcomings dealt with.I brought a couple friends with me to show them how nice HGVC is.  They have been singularly unimpressed. If this was my first experience with Hilton I would NEVER have become an owner.  We likely will not be staying at this property again.  ~CS HGVC @ Flamingo, rm 300

reviews.title: Truly Grand Vacation!
reviews.text: Visited Vegas for the Metallica concert and to do some gambling. I have been to Vegas many times and never visited the Flamingo casino and didn't even know anything about Hilton grand vacations at the flamingo. 2 bedroom condo was perfect for three friends and the flamingo casino was outstanding. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Good location for the price.
reviews.text: Location is just off the strip.  Price is very competitive especially when you get a room with a kitchen.  Clean rooms with a nice bed. For some reason this requires 200min characters because these folks don't know how to set up a comment box so I added this garbage at the end.

reviews.title: Thanksgiving break with my Family!
reviews.text: Hilton is such a great place to stay in. Very clean, friendly people and staff, very easy access to all the amenities. Also, easy access to the Las Vegas Strip in a great Location!  Quiet enough to stay asleep till late.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The HGV at Flamingo is centrally located to restaurants and other hotels/casinos. Parking in the Flamingo garage is complimentary. Valet is $18. Garage is well lit, but a bit eerie at night if you are alone.

reviews.title: Great costumer service
reviews.text: We stayed st this great Hilton property. At our arrival Eva checked us in. She was very courteous, professional, and helpful. The room was perfect. We stayed at a studio on the 16th floor with a view of the strip. We really loved the room, Eva, the location and the fact that the hotel is much quieter than the larger properties. A very classy and comfortable hotel.

reviews.title: strip central
reviews.text: great spot on the back of the flamingo!  great location! we had all the amenities available and a nice quieet room that had the amenities of a 1 bedroom condo on the strip!would recommend this place if you want quiet and or convenience

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: This was a wonderful, clean facility that allowed space that my family required (4 adults for a week) Staff was friendly and helpful.  Loading up the fridge with drinks, food, and snacks was a saving from the prices on the strip.  Great pool (wish the bar would have been open) and hot tub.  Great views of the private pool and the pool at the Flamingo.  Quick walk to the strip.  I read reviews before we went and there were complaints about the noise from the pool at the Flamingo, it can be loud, however, it did not disrupt our sleep.

reviews.title: Off the Strip and quiet.
reviews.text: If you want a hotel only, this is the place for you. Little market store but that is it. Studio King room was very nice. It is on the back side of the strip so very quiet. The pool and hot tub outside looked nice but it was cool during our visit.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: My sisters and I loved our experience at the Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo!  Our room was perfect, and allowed us to have a little breakfast in our room  with our mini kitchenette.   We had a bed, and fold out sofa, but the best part for three girls, is that we had two sink/vanity areas to get ready.   The bed was comfortable, we had a gorgeous view of the pools below, and enjoyed the large hot tub several times!  The staff was very helpful.   To us, it was the perfect mix.   We were glad we were not in some crazy resort - at least in November, it was a little quieter.   We loved being able to rent DVDs for free, if we wanted to chill out in the evening.   But if we wanted the restaurants, and shops, its next to the Flamingo, which had a gorgeous out door mall with lots of restaurants and shops.  We enjoyed walking through the beautiful gardens at the Flamingo, every day, en route to somewhere else.   The location is also perfect, about central on the strip.   Almost immediately across from Caesar's Palace (a favorite resort of mine), a few minutes walk from the Bellagio (a definite favorite) and Paris (awesome).   We loved this place, in every way.

reviews.title: Week at Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo
reviews.text: A very clean comfortable and serviced apartment which was the ideal size for six adults.  Also very centrally located just off the strip in Las Vegas. Bonus was that concierge parking was available onsite.

reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text: What a gorgeous property.  It truly is a magnificent and grand place to vacation.  Everything about it is immaculately clean, beautifully appointed, and the staff is so friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Our apartment was so beautiful that we hated to leave.

reviews.title: A great way to visit Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is our 2nd stay at this facility. We previously had a 2 bedroom suite, and this time it was a 1 bedroom suite. Both have been VERY nice! Our room (311) had a nice full kitchen complete with a table for 4-5 people. The living room had a couch, chair, and 55" TV. The bedroom had a nice bed, plenty of clothing storage, a nice sized bathroom with a vanity in 2 different parts of the bathroom. This bathroom also has a full shower, and a very large soaker tub. The room was up to date and clean. I like how you are a 3 min walk to the Flamingo, and about 5 minutes from the Linq promenade area. So you are very close to being in the action, but yet you are in a nice quiet spot. The staff is always pleasant and there to help. The Marketplace just off the lobby has many items you can grab from fresh salads and muffins, to packaged items, and a refrigerated area with sodas, beer, milk, and cheese. We were not in it, but the pool and hot tub looked very nice as well. The free DVD rentals in the lobby area is very nice as well. Tons of choices between the 2 machines. I recommend this as a place to stay in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Re doing gym so noisy woke us every day 😡 nothing on in hotel very quiet .except when get crowd hogging the Jacuzzi  and sitting drinking all day and management do nothing even when complained to tbem

reviews.title: Convenient Hotel, HUGE Rooms
reviews.text: We stayed at the HGV at the Flamingo on our recent trip to Vegas. We have stayed at the Elara (behind Planet Hollywood) before, but this is our first time at this hotel. The rooms are HUGE. We had one-bedroom, and it had a FULL kitchen, washer/dryer, large bedroom, 2 sink areas, and my personal favorite - a corner garden tub!!! You can walk out the back doors (toward the pool), then through the flamingo habitat and be on the strip in less than 5 minutes.
