We liked the views from the Elara better, but the rooms at the Flamingo are WAY better. The people are SUPER nice and the hotel is clean and updated. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet and comfortable
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay.  Beds and pillows were great.  Conveniently located to the strip.  Everything we needed.  Parking was free as long as you self-park, but they also have valet services.  Furniture is comfortable.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: An absolutely wonderful property.  Great rooms, very quiet and clean. The lobby is open and inviting and the staff is amazing.  Very amiable and ready to help.  Asked for a cab at 5:45 in the morning, and they had one ready for us at 5:50.  Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Great Place To Stay In Vegsd
reviews.text: We had a large group of family stay at The Hilton Grand Resort at the Flamingo. The staff was wonderful. Our rooms were clean. It was extremely convenient to the casinos on the strip. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: We enjoy the stay.
reviews.text: We had a good stay, and we liked the bird sanctuary. Our room smell like pooh lol ... we should have complained, but didn't. And I hoped for more pink in the room. If you have questions, it is too busy at the desk, to ask. So good luck. The location was good. If you go to coffee shop, keep your cup. For $1. you can refill it... which is awesome. There is a warm table out back close to swimming pool. I really liked stopping by. First time in LV. We enjoyed it and I would go again and stay at the Flamingo.

reviews.title: Our Nov. trip
reviews.text: SEMA and fun combined.  There stay was great.  There is a wonderful staff here.  You are close to everything, even the monorail is just steps out the door.  There are casinos and good food just steps away also.We always come back to this location.

reviews.title: Offers relaxation in the busy Paradise
reviews.text: On a business visit to attend AAPEX, I was a little hesitant to stay at HGV-Flamingo after reading all reviews  about the disturbance created due the high volume music from the Flamingo. But there was no such blaring music even in the gardens next to Flamingo pool and it was a quiet and peaceful stay. Although the checkin was 1600hrs but, getting our pool facing 1-BR suite (room#815) around 1300 hrs was so much relief after a 23hr journey from India via Toronto. The staff was courteous and we were provided with a daily cleaning service. The washing machine, dish-washer, iron stand were pretty useful and saved us doing a lot of washing on our return.The hotel has a marketplace selling daily use & food items and the stuff is pretty reasonable.All in all a good business & leisure trip with pleasant stay at HGV-Flamingo.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand at Flamingo - Five stars!
reviews.text: Great accommodations.  Outstanding location.  Super friendly and helpful staff.  I cannot say enough about how happy we were with the Hilton Grand at the Flamingo.  It was an easy walk to the Casinos or shows and a short Uber to the more distant casinos.  We were right next to the High Roller ferris wheel which was fun and interesting to look at at night.  Best of all though was the staff.  They were super friendly and truly went out of their way to be helpful.  Thank you Hilton Grand at the Flamingos for a great Las Vegas stay!

reviews.title: It’s not located on the strip
reviews.text: The hotel is actually located behind the strip.  So, don’t expect a strip view. The self parking garage is about a quarter a mile away so be prepared to valet.  Our rooms were bit outdated and smelled like diesel fuel.   The shower door leaked, the thermostat was broken, and the phone didn’t work. Nothing really special about this place.  Some staff members were pleasant while others were not.  But, they wanted to sell more timeshare. Enjoy.

reviews.title: Attitude and assistance from staff was top class.
reviews.text: Staff at this hotel were always helpful and friendly from day one, The lady in the small convenience store off the lobby who found some "drinkable" tea bags for me ,[I am Australian], the Fellow who rustled up some helium to inflate a surprise Birthday balloon for my daughter,[And found a couple more and tied with ribbon].The reception people who found a kettle so I could brew my tea and had it delivered to my room in a very short time.Very clean, roomy,good outlook,very central location.Had read negative reviews about noise from adjacent Flamingo pool party,but I thought not excessive for a party town and it stopped at sundown.Very good stay.

reviews.title: Great Suite, Close to Everything!
reviews.text: I started ot to write this review as I think it really is a hidden gem in Vegas! The rooms, at least the one I had was HUGE and had every amenity of a 1 bedroom condo including washer and dryer! Huge pool area and is nestled in-between the Falmingo and Linc. Nothing bad to say about this stay and ill be staying here again!

reviews.title: Outstanding condo accommodations almost on the Strip
reviews.text: We are owners at the HGVC Flamingo. Everything was wonderful about our week in Las Vegas. Staff was excellent. They accommodated my feather allergy by removing all feather bedding. Unit was clean and kitchen was well stocked. It is very safe with elevators requiring room key for access. Location is very convenient to many casinos, shows, clubs, restaurants, etc.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: This resort is very nice and in a good location.  Rooms are very clean and have nice views of the Flamingo pool area.  Easy to get to the Flamingo and Linq areas.  Onsite store has good food.  The pool and hot tub area is very nice.

reviews.title: Going above and beyond
reviews.text: I have been an owner with Hilton Grand Vacations Club for 18 years. Recently, my stepdaughter booked a trip with her friends for her birthday, using my points.Long story short. Her friends backed out at the last minute and she ended up going alone. While there, she became ill and ended up in the hospital. Her hospital stay took her past her reservation time, with her belongings in the room she had rented. The manager, Will Rodriguez was extremely understanding and went out of his way to help with the problem and even though her stay went a day longer than planned, Will made sure she had the room she was in for another day and stayed in touch with us to make sure that there wasn’t additional stress added to the situation. HGV Club employees, especially Will Rodriguez, went the extra mile to help out with a customer in need. Thanks.

reviews.title: GREAT CENTRAL LOCATION ON THE STRIP!
reviews.text: Great central location on the strip with nice rooms and accommodating staff.  Music is played by the pool each day from 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. as part of the Flamingo Casino entertainment, which sounds like drums beating in your room.  If you plan on taking any naps, be sure to choose a location away from the pool.

reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: My family and I  had 2 units the same week- Oct. 13th, and the entire family feels that this vacation was truly wonderful , thanks to the beautiful units and facilities, and to the totally wonderful staff there.  We thank the staff member- Antun Estrada , who went over and above to provide excellent service and to make our vacation so wonderful. He was exceptional and is a real asset to the resort. We also thank the staff member- Fontaine who also helped to make our vacation week wonderful.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Loved our stay!  Excellent location and service. Room was clean and quiet. Parking was provided on location. Staff was courteous and very helpful. We will definitely stay here when we are in Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: All the comforts of home except it's Vegas!
reviews.text: Great location at a great intersection to visit some of the coolest & greatest casinos on each corner. They has some loud entertainment but it was over before it got late for the early birds who retire for the evening.

reviews.title: First Time In Vegas!
reviews.text: Gonna' try to keep it short; we LOVED this place!! Wonderful staff and very clean! The best of both worlds at The Flamingo! If you want the famous party pool or the laid back relaxed pool, it's all right there. We had amenity access to both properties.  Right in the middle of the strip, this was our home for a week. Also it's right next to The Linq hotel(big ferris wheel). Do yourself a favor and buy Deuce passes (public transportation). Cheaper and much quicker than Uber and it'll take you ANYWHERE you want to go SAFELY, including Freemont Street, which in my opinion is better than the strip. Thank you Hilton Grand at the Flamingo for making my first Vegas stay just like I imagined it would be.

reviews.title: Hilton GV Flamingo
reviews.text: Beautiful property  located behind the Flamingo hotel.  Good location.  Enjoy the property and amenities.  Staff was super and attentive.  The pool was nice and the property overall was well maintained.  Would stay there again or another Grand Vacation spot.

reviews.title: Great location for the Strip
reviews.text: Rooms are spacious with all the home conveniences. Great location for the strip and didn't hear must noise. We over looked the Flamingo Party pool, but as this only goes 9am to 5pm - did not cause us a problem as we were out. You get free access to the Flamingo pool, just need to show then your Hilton room key. The Hilton also has its own pool with plenty of sunbeds. Convenience market onsite is okay for the essentials not too over priced. Pity the hotel does not offer a free airport shuttle, they wanted to charge us $40 for 4, so we got an Uber XL for $25.Staff are very helpful and they don't try a push timeshare selling on you, which is great. Would stay here again. Plus it helped that we booked before they changed the daily charge policy for RCI members. Now R~CI members also have to pay the $25 resort fee per day.

reviews.title: Scary experiences - Haunted Room 735?
reviews.text: Room 735 at HGV at the FlamingoIt's a girls trip and we have 2 connecting rooms for the 4 of us, we were there for 8 nights.  Of the 8 nights, 3 of them were not so great.  one night, I have woken up by a sensation that I was pulled sideways very quickly, didn't think much of it and went back to sleep.  Another night, the same thing happened again, but this time more intense, took me a while to go back to sleep.  On my last night, my roommate had left, I was up till about 3 am not able to fall asleep, woke up at 4, remembering myself saying 'leave me alone' over and over again.  I got up and turn on the bedroom and bathroom lights and went back to bed, at about 5am, woke up by feeling really painful in my upper back, felt like something grabbing me from behind.  I was really scared and jumped out of bed, ran to my friends' room next door, woke them up and told them what happened.  Needless to say, I did not go back there to sleep.  It's not 1 night, it's 3 nights, which makes me think something is wrong with that room.I contemplated whether I should call or not call, thinking they would probably not believe me?  Finally, I called HGV at the Flamingo Manager when I got back home and told him what happened, Danny said he had not heard of any complaints like that.  He's going to log in our conversation, no reports filed, nor do they intend to do anything about it since no one else has the same experience.  I have traveled around the world and stayed in many hotels, and never have I had such scary experiences in my 50+ years.  I really feel compelled to write about this.  So if any of you out there who had similar experiences, you should call them and let them know, and write a review to warn others, so that people would not have to suffer the scary and sleepless nights as I had.

reviews.title: Great Visit, Clean Rooms, and very friendly!
reviews.text: The hotel has a great location right behind the Flamingo, so it's technically off strip just slightly but it's a simple walk through the Flamingo or right around the edge and you're on the strip.  The rooms were very clean and the beds ohh so comfy (soft so if you're a firmer bed lover keep that in mind).   The front desk staff were very friendly when we checked in and anytime I had interaction with them.  They do not have a restaurant on property but they have a small market shop inside (it does close around 7 or 8 though).  They also have kitchens in the room so you can always choose to cook or heat up any leftovers you brought back.  And again the flamingo & the rest of the strip is right there for great dining choices.The rooms are also well insulated, we never heard anyone else even the kids when they were playing in the room right next to us!  The two 3 year olds ran between the two rooms quite often and we also never received any complaints of noise about it.

reviews.title: Vegas Hilton at Flamingos
reviews.text: We visited as a couple to experience Vegas for the first time.  Location of the hotel is great with easy access (walking distance) to the strip and malls.  Hotel doesn't have a full-fledged dining facility.  Breakfast offered (priced separately) is very basic - sandwich, Landor Juice and coffee and is not a buffet breakfast.  Wifi and concierge service is good.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Had a great room and a full kitchen and laundry in room. A bit hard to find the first time, since you have to go out behind the Flamingo Casino and walk around the pool area. Loved the smaller pool and hot tub associated with this property

reviews.title: HGV Property at the Flamingo
reviews.text: I have been coming here for many years and still look forward to it.  Positives are that the HGV is well maintained, clean and ALL of the staff are friendly and helpful. This location is central to  the strip which makes getting around a bit easier.  The kitchenettes are set up with everything you need without going out all the time to eat. (There is a good supermarket 2-3 miles away called Vons-highly recommended). The major drawback is the noise during the day of the incessant music pounding from the Flamingo property pool.  You cannot hear yourself think as you try and relax around the HGV pool or in the building.  It is that bad.  Good news is that it stops around 5-6pm.  The second is parking.  We are relegated to the 5th floor of the parking garage so you will be climbing a lot of stairs.  Upside is you get a great workout with 2-3 roundtrips a day to your car.

reviews.title: Great value for the cost
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by how large and nice the room was. For a decent price, they gave me a small suite with a nice kitchen and Jacuzzi tub overlooking the pool. I was worried that the pool might be noisy at night, but it was deserted by 5pm and as a result the room was very quiet.I was also happy with the two large televisions and good selection of channels. The HVAC system worked well and wasn't overly loud. The shower took a long while to get hot water, but it did eventually get there and the water pressure was good.The fitness centre was a bit on the small side and the equipment was a bit older, but it seemed to be in good working order. There isn't much of a restaurant here, but they provide you with a lot of free bottled water. And of course you are very close to the strip with all manner of restaurants.My only gripes are 1) there was no desk. the suite had a dining table which worked okay but didn't have any convenient electrical outlets, 2) there was no in-room safe, and 3) the bed was a bit on the soft side.

reviews.title: Great location, excellent accommodations and friendly staff
reviews.text: We spent a week at the HGV and the location behind The Flamingo Hotel/Casino is perfect. Our room was excellent with full kitchen, washer/dryer, king bed, 2 dressing areas and plenty of closet space. Valet parking saved us time and our car was always ready. We were able to walk to Paris, Bellagio, Cesear's, Flamingo which were all located in about a block. Our room was on the 15th floor overlooking the Flamingo Hotel pool. From 9 am - 6 pm, the music traveled up to our room. But we were not in the room very much so it didn't matter. The private pool, hot tub and bar just for guests of HGV is nice with plenty of lounge seating. On site there is a Starbucks, Marketplace grocery store and a concierge to assist with tickets. HGV is also located near LINQ Promenade and the High Roller. So lots to see and do in only a short walk.

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: This resort is actually behind the Las Vegas strip.  The furniture needed replacement.  Our unit smelled like diesel fuel from the vents.  Be prepared to valet your car; the self-parking garage is far away.

reviews.title: HGVC at The Flamingo, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Another great time at the HGVC at the Flamingo, Las Vegas. Stayed he several times, the location is great, resort is great. Privacy is great. All the staff in the building were pleasant as usual. I strongly recommend this resort !

reviews.title: great location
reviews.text: The location could not be better.  Right in the center of the Strip.  So close to the monorail.  Quiet at night, but loud music coming from the Flamingo pool area during the day.  Great, helpful staff.  We will return to this resort.

reviews.title: Noise from the pool at the Flamingo
reviews.text: I came back from a conference around 1 p.m. to go to the pool.  The noise was so loud and disturbing that I went back to my room, which was on the 4th floor in the tower furthest away from the Flamingo pool.  Even there my room was reverberating with the loud music.  I wouldn’t even consider staying here again with the noise levels that exist.

reviews.title: Great Vacation with Grandchildren ages 12-10.
reviews.text: We took 4 grandchildren to Las Vegas for days.  The convenience of a kitchen for snacks, breakfast and 3 dinners was perfect.   The pool is a little   tame but was still used.   Overall the facilty is centrally locsted.  We walked to the high roller, the Mirage, the Bellagio. Tons of stuff for kids.  You do need to budget for some attractions but eating dinnsr at condo was the trade off.  I made sandwiches when we went to Adventuredome at Circus Circus and the watet park.

reviews.title: Las Vegas vacation
reviews.text: Hgvc Flamingo is the most centrally located units of all sites in Vegas. I have been an owner since 1995. Also own two additional weeks at Hgvc on the strip across from SLS.  I alternate my staysbetween both sites.

reviews.title: Great location, big apartments
reviews.text: Great location in the middle of the strip. Big, clean apartments. Easy check in and check out process. Good Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Newly refurbished gym with cardio and weight equipment. The marketplace is handy for buying a few essentials but it is pricey and the service is slowGreat place to stay

reviews.title: Jewel in the rough
reviews.text: This beautiful property is tucked behind the Flamingo and conveniently nearby the Flamingo Monorail Station.  While an older property, it is clean, well maintained and equipped with many modern room  amenities such as a kitchen, coffee maker and laundry that you will not find at many of the newer more expensive hotels on the strip.

reviews.title: Fun family vacation
reviews.text: This resort is walking distance to the Linq, where you'll find restaurants and a bit of shopping. You can easily hop on the monorail to get to many major casinos. The High Roller is right next to the resort. You have access to the Flamingo Go pool, which is adult only and music is very loud. The Flamingo Beach pool is smaller and all ages. They have an area with slides, but we were very disappointed to find the " season" had just ended and that area was closed. Even though it was 100 degrees outside... No slide pool. Overall we had fun and were very happy with our rooms.

reviews.title: Home again
reviews.text: I bought here 20 years ago and keep coming back year after year. It is centrally located in the heart of The Strip. This is walking distance to Caesars Palace, Bellagio, Harrah's, Bally's, Paris, etc. Can't go wrong here!

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text: While visiting the Las Vegas area we stayed at the Vacation Club twice. We have stayed at Vacation clubs before with great results. We stopped at the HGVC-Flamingo for a single night stay. We were on the 4th floor and the room was clean and had the amenities expected. However we discovered that the shower door was installed backwards and would only open in, making it impossible to turn water on without standing in the initial cold water. Then the sink began bubbling with a distinct sewer odor. Maintenance came and dumped chemicals but admitted that a lower floor would get this air backup issue. Since we only stayed for 1 night we talked to manager and were assured no problems when we came back.Four days later we returned and given a 16th floor room. No shower issue or sink but the AC was struggling. Room was never cooler than mid 70s with the unit running constantly. Also the Hall and elevators were really warm. On the 2nd night the unit stopped cooling at all around midnight. Room reached 85. Finally fixed around 4am. But still never was able to get the room below 75.Also, we needed an early taxi to the airport and were assured twice that there was no issue even very early. Guess what, no cabs. Finally walked (with luggage) to Flamingo main entrance for cabs.Will never stay again!!

reviews.title: September 2018
reviews.text: Excellent customer service.  Good pool with access to Go Pool next door. Music is loud but it closes at 6:00pm.  Pool bar had happy hour and good drinks.  No on site restaurant for late night snacks or pool snacks.

reviews.title: Nice place, but don't expect an afternoon nap
reviews.text: Great place to stay, but the flamingo's pool party is so loud every day from 9-5 that you can't possibly get any afternoon R&R in your room. Staff is friendly and efficient. Nice pool and hot tub. Central location.

reviews.title: A Great Place
reviews.text: My husband and I were very satisfied with the location on the Vegas Strip.  The reataurants right outside the doors of the Flamingo were definealtly a plus for those days we did not want to venture too far.

reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom deluxe.  The unit was spacious and clean.  Furnishings and decor were in great condition and beautifully done.  Kitchen was well appointed with plenty of room to make quick lunches and coffee.   The pool was partly shaded which is a big plus in Vegas.  The crowd is definitely older but may just be because of the season that we visited. The only negative was the loud music from the adjacent Flamingo “Go” pool.  Fortunately that wrapped up by 6:00 pm each day.

reviews.title: Pleasant hotel in a fantastic location
reviews.text: There is so much to choose from in Vegas for accommodation, so I had spent time researching each location to see what suited our needs.  The Grand Vacations at the Flamingo suited us perfectly as a couple, and we chose the Studio so that we could have extra space and a couch/kitchenette.  Easy to get to, it is pretty much in the centre of the Strip with all the large Casinos nearby.   We totally enjoyed our stay at this hotel, the staff were always attentive and professional.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: My favorite hotel on the strip
reviews.text: We travel to Las Vegas A LOT and we like to try the different hotels but we will ALWAYS go to the Flamingo at least once a year, it is our favorite! Always clean, staff is always VERY nice and helpful! gives your the most AMAZING view of the strip at night and sunrise! We upgrade our room every other time we go and it is well worth it! We LOVE the Flamingo!

reviews.title: Girl’s Trip 2018
reviews.text: My 1st Time visiting this property; I enjoyed the location and the pool access. The staff at check in was very fast and our room was available early. The 1 bedroom king suite with a pullout bed was great. All rooms have been remodeled and there is access to a Marketplace that serves Starbucks coffee.The lobby is very big and accommodating if you arrive early and have to wait for check in or checkout. There is an ATM located in the lounge for your convenience. The concierge service area is available in the front lobby for any recommendations or great things to do while in Las Vegas!Hotel location very convenient to the Strip, you can Uber or get on the Monorail and explore the city.

reviews.title: Bring your earplugs and be an advocate for yourself.
reviews.text: Mind numbing "music" from the Flamingo hotel pool that starts @ 9am and is relentless until that pool closes.  There is a pounding beat with whatever lyrics may have been written so loud that you can hear it within the room @ the HGVC with the TV on, the drapes pulled, and earplugs in place.  No amount of complaints had any positive outcome.

reviews.title: We love it !
reviews.text: We love this Hilton location and come once, sometimes twice a year from the east coast. Smaller pool area than Elara but we love it ! A gym, outdoor and indoor jacuzzis, deli (sells alcohol of all kinds) and pool bar all available. Linq restaurants, High Roller, Brooklyn Bowl are a short under 5 minute walk away. Also Battistas Italian restaurant is top notch and also under a 5 minute walk away. This location is VERY convenient to popular strip casinos. It’s the best 👍.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Very nice property located behind the Flamingo Hotel and Casino. We didn’t feel it was necessary to rent a car for this location. We took the airport shuttle to the hotel and rented a car later in the week at The Bellagio Hotel which was in walking distance to the Flamingo. Ask the Flamingo front desk for the complimentary parking pass. My negative on this property was the obnoxious loud music at the neighboring pool from the Flamingo pool party which was daily/all day.

reviews.title: Wonderful to be back
reviews.text: One of the first owners here, have strayed recently, but was glad to be back! Property looked great, our rooms was perfect, and the staff is awesome! The music from the adjacent Flamingo pool is a bit loud, actually not the music as much as the bass.Overall a great stay, and we will be back!

reviews.title: Great Location, noise awful
reviews.text: Just returned from a week at HGVC.  Location of the property is perfect for Vegas activities. We spent a week here with a break midweek to Zion National Park. The unit amenities were perfect. If you are looking for a quiet pool day forget it. The pool is located directly behind the Flamingo. Everyday till 530 a DJ is playing extremely loud music.  While I like that type of music it was overwhelming.  Happy hour ended daily at 4:00

reviews.title: HGVC sucks
reviews.text: HGVC owner for almost 20 years and HGVC sucks. Couldn't get requested dates. Too much loud EDM from Flamingo pool. Property looking run-down. Whirlpool tubs being replaced with bathtubs. I own there and don't like it anymore.

reviews.title: Good Location But the Noise is terrible
reviews.text: Hilton is behind Flamingo pools.  Flamingo has pool party everyday starting at 10 am until 5 pm.  You don't hear music - all you hear is boom, boom from the music.  You can't stay in your room and relax/nap because of the noise and being at the top of the building (we were on floor 14) doesn't reduce the noise level.  We have stayed here many times over the past 20 years.  The resort is excellent, in a perfect location (can walk to the Strip in 5 minutes) and the staff is great.  We will probably look elsewhere to stay next time because of the noise level because we like to have some rest time during the day and you can't do this here.  But, if you are out of the room before 10 am and stay gone all day, this is really a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Always Enjoy Staying Here
reviews.text: We’ve been Hilton Grand Vacation Members since 2011 and thoroughly enjoy this Strip property. The proximity to the Monorail is very convenient and driving to Off-Strip attractions is easy.  The property itself is always clean and quiet. Although the Flamingo Pool can be noisy, we’ve been fortunate enough to be placed far away from the occasional Night-time Pool events.The rooms are always tidy upon arrival and well-maintained.  The hotel staff is very friendly and are a wealth of information for non-tourist sightseeing.  The lobby/reservation desk is rarely crowded and spacious.  Once you enter the Lobby, you don’t hear any noise from The Flamingo.  The Lobby offers fruit-infused water, daily, a Conference/Gathering area with an ATM, DVD Rental kiosks, two PC Desktops with Internet access, and an on-site mini-market with affordable meals, Starbucks Coffee, freshly made Pizza and a plethora of other convenient snacks, frozen foods, sundries and gifts. The mini-market is open from 6AM to 7PM.The pool tends to be shaded most of the time, but during the Summer it is perfect. Their gym is spartan,  but still offers enough variety to get a good workout if you’re disciplined. Parking is free if you self-park in the Flamingo’s Parking structure, but this last visit we ventured off The Strip daily and had them Valet our car. The only annoyance is the “Member Update” calls, where Grand Vacations offers you discount and dollars for attending an hour-long, captive, seminar.  No means No ;)

reviews.title: Very relaxing
reviews.text: Clean, quite, and just what we asked for.  The pool is nice with an attendant bar.  The hotel has nice shopping on the 1st level.  Restaurants are nearby ranging from basic to excellent.  We will be going there again during a cooler time of the year.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is right in the heart of the strip. The room was a little dated and the floor cleanliness was a 9 out of 10. The sound level from the Flamingo Pool area at times were too loud to stay at the Hilton's pool. We are also Hilton Elite members and were given ear plugs upon check-in. The hotel apologized at check-in for the possibility of loud noise from the Flamingo. The Flamingo had a guest appearance one night and it was extremely loud. We were going out on the town and when we returned at midnight all was quiet. Overall, we had a very nice vacation and would stay here again because of it's location on the strip.

reviews.title: Convenient, Clean, Quiet during evenings and weekends
reviews.text: Stayed in a King Suite while in town for business. The room was huge with a full kitchen, dining area, living room, 2 separate bathroom sinks, huge tub and walk in shower. The hotel has a pool and you can also use the Flamingos pool. At check in I was given coupons to use in their little store for 2 bottles of water per day. Parking is free in the Flamingos parking garage. The monorail station is right outside the door and up the stairs. It is a short walk past the Flamingo pools and through the Flamingo and you are on the strip. Shorter walk to the strip than most of the mega resorts. I have read other reviews that complain about the music from the Flamingo pool. During my visit the music from the pool ended around 5:30pm everyday. It did not bother me and I was on the 2nd floor. The evenings and nights were very quiet.

reviews.title: Horrible management
reviews.text: When I got home the same day of check out I saw an email stating I was charged $250 fee for smoking. Why? I reserved a smoking room but was charged $250 smoking fee. How does that make sense? Customer service received by hotel manager was horrible when I called and questioned him of the fee. Not what I expected from Hilton!

reviews.title: A Great Location for a Family
reviews.text: Our family vacation ended with three nights in Las Vegas at the Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo.  There were seven in our group and we had a 2 bedroom 2 bath unit that provided a nice space for our group.  Check in was very smooth and the desk staff was always very helpful.  Although the location is not directly on "the Strip" it was only a short distance from all of the action.  We were able to walk to all the attractions that we want to visit and could easily return back to the suite to take a break.  The unit was well furnished and very clean.  The day time noise from the Go-Go Pool was the only downside but the music did end at 6PM.

reviews.title: Nice property, good location
reviews.text: We stayed here to be close to Caesars to see Elton John.  We were upgraded to a king suite, which was very nice.  We were there in April and the loud pool parties had already started next door at the Flamingo, all you could here was bass.  Could not take a nap during the day because of this.  Pool was under construction 1/2 the time we were there, so that wasn't available.  Warning -  This is part of a time share also.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at Flamingo
reviews.text: Overall good value due to location and amenities. Loved the location of the facilities close to the strip and all the action. Only negative is that our room was so close to the Flamingo party pool the music was so loud!

reviews.title: Some Good, Some Bad.
reviews.text: This was our first visit to this property. Somehow, our booking was not scheduled correctly, and we thought our reservation was for Friday, but it was for Saturday. The desk clerk did not even ask us if we needed a place to stay, or did she express ANY concern for our predicament. We were on our own. When we did check in the following day, we found our room to be very pleasant.... until.... the CONSTANT EXTREME thumping of the music coming from the Flamingo pool 10 floors down. It was SO loud in our room that we could not turn up the TV loud enough to cover it. It was that way all weekend until 2 AM., and from 9 AM to 10 PM daily. The music was SO LOUD that one could not enjoy the Hilton pool, which was nearby. We could not even go to the Flamingo pool because of how LOUD they played the music. It hurt our ears. Our room was not clean... there was dripping dried food on the cupboard doors, and the top of the shelving for the hangers were filled with sticky dusty stuff that fell off into our suitcase every time we moved the hangers. One of the lights did not work at all in our room either. The tub had no Jacuzzi jets... it was just a big bathtub. However, I will say that the staff was quick to attempt to fix these things. Another thing that was not enjoyable was incessant asking if we had received our "welcome gift"  which was quite annoying. We never did get any welcome gift... because we explained that as timeshare owners, we did not wish to take a trip to see a new timeshare property for a trade for cheap tickets to a show, when we already own one . Either give us the welcome gift, or not, but do not trap people into a timeshare spiel to get a "gift". The Marketplace was very expensive as well. Grab an Uber to Albertson's grocery store about 8 blocks away. They had regular prices. There were 2 bottles of water on the dining table of the room... with a tag attached that said "$5.00".... each. SERIOUSLY????????? No thanks. I will drink out of the tap for free. The location to the strip is perfect. This is the saving grace to this place..... that and the bed pillows... those were divine. No one bothered to tell us that a FREE shuttle could be arranged 24 hours ahead of time to bring us to the airport, so we had to pay for a ride. The parking is free if you drive a car. Our stay was just OK. The booming music waking one up and not allowing one to go to sleep.... well.... it made our trip pretty frustrating. They could turn the music down 50% and it would still be loud enough for people to hear.

reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: We stayed in a very nice condo here.The entire building is nicely appointed. the lobby area is comfortable and clean. We enjoyed the room with nice beds, kitchen, and comfortable seating. The only down fall to this property is the Flamingo pool party every day. The booming music is heard every afternoon. The location is very convenient for the Strip. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Worst trip ever
reviews.text: If you are staying over on the weekend, make sure to ask if the Flamingo is going to have a late night pool party. They will play very loud music until 3 am. I made the mistake of not asking and did not sleep at all...don't make the same mistake I did...

reviews.title: Good hotel right next to the Flamingo
reviews.text: We felt that the hotel was a bit misrepresented because the hotel is a separate building from the Flamingo itself. It even has its own pool, although I believe guests are able to use the Flamingo pools as well. We had a bit of an issue at check-in where they gave away our 2-bedroom suite (we are a family of 6) and they had to provide separate rooms for the first night. However, they addressed the issue immediately the next morning and resolved it as fast as they possibly could. We appreciate the attention that was provided.

reviews.title: Resort stay
reviews.text: The concierge desk could have been more pleasant as well as the marketplace staff member. Other than that it was a marvelous stay. The room linens were luxurious which made me feel right at home. The surrounding ammenities were plentiful and was only a short walking distance. Overall, one of the most convenient places to stay.

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: We booked here thru RCI and had previously not stayed on the strip "in the thick of it", so we were a bit leery of what we'd find.  We had a one bedroom villa, and we found it to be very nice.  Big kitchen/living area and a nice dining nook.  The bedroom was spacious and was open to the very large soaking tub and large vanity and a big closet.  Through another door was a second large vanity, and the toilet and shower with a separate door to close them off.  Stackable washer/dryer and another closet in the entryway.  It was clean, and the staff we dealt with were very courteous and helpful every day.  If there was one negative thing to say, it would be that the sundries provided were quite skimpy and not great quality. We are DVC owners and when we stay in Disney resorts, they provide great quality soaps, shampoos, bodywash, etc.  Here we had two very thin bars of soap (Did I mention TWO big vanities, a tub and shower?) and one little tube of shampoo and conditioner.  For a weeks stay.  So that was annoying, but they did bring us more when we asked-it's just the quality that isn't great.     Now, if you are looking for quiet, ask for a room NOT in the north tower.  We were close to the pools and the thumping "music" from the GO POOL was unbelievable.  We like to come back to our room in the afternoon and rest up before dinner, and trust me, there was no resting with the bass coming from those speakers.  Would they have given us another room if we asked?  I'm sure they would have, but once you unpack a weeks worth of clothing and food, the thought of moving is just not appealing, so we decided to tough it out.  In retrospect-I'd have done more research on what area of the hotel to ask for.  But it's Vegas baby!  So you go with the flow.  The hotel is a short walk to the Linq Promenade which has restaurants and shops and bars and everything you'd expect.  We found it to be quite convenient to walk over for coffee or breakfast.  So in summary, yes, this is a very nice place to stay!

reviews.title: Lovely suite!
reviews.text: We have stayed twice in the last year.  It is a great hotel in a wonderful location.  The 2 bedroom suite is actually a one bedroom suite and a regular studio suite attached by a common entry. Our son loved the privacy in that his room/suite had its own fridge, microwave, and jacuzzi tub so he did not have to share the common area in our suite.  The one bedroom suite has a full kitchen with a stove and oven.  The one room suite and studio suite alone are each roomy accommodations for a couple or small family.  The pool is just for HGVC guests which is actually very nice because during the summer the Flamingo's main pool is a Day Club (21 and up) and their smaller pool is beyond extremely crowded with all the families and under 21 guests.  Note: during the summer the Flamingo's Day Club's music starts at 9am and ends at 6pm so there is no quiet in your  hotel room during the day.  We overcame it with turning the TV on low, keeping the drapes shut until everyone was awake, and then being out and about most of the day.  The benefit is you do get to enjoy the music from the Day Club when you are at the HGVC pool.   It is a very quiet hotel at night, which is when we need it.The location is right in the center of the strip, just back a little bit, behind the actual Flamingo Hilton.  Parking is close but in a parking structure across from the hotel and you can easily drop off./pick up at the front entrance.  There is a DVD machine to rent movies for free.  We did not use the gym or marketplace, but they are available.  The rooms are lovely and clean.  The hotel staff is very attentive.

reviews.title: Hilton Flamingo Grand Vacations Vegas
reviews.text: Very nice resort with clean comfortable rooms close to all the action on the Vegas Strip. The pool was great and the hotel staff friendly and very helpful. I would definitely stay here again next trip to Vegas!

reviews.title: SO LOUD. Really. Just go anywhere else.
reviews.text: I am a Hilton (formerly a Spire) member and chose this hotel hoping to be away from the 20 year old hackers at the conferences nearby. The pool music 10 AM-6 PM simply makes my room uninhabitable, even with earplugs. I was supposed to be studying for a certification exam this week, and that certainly isn't happening. I'm here for an 8 day stay and everything is sold out. There's not another room to move me to because everything faces the pool. I can't even stand the noise in the room, can't imagine how anyone can stand the decibels at the pool itself. There's simply no need for it to be this incredibly loud, even in Vegas. I've traveled the entire US and 23 countries for work and for pleasure and this is the worst week I've ever spent in a hotel. An enormous waste of my money and time. The front desk is pleasant and apologetic and one person said she wishes they'd call people when they register to make sure the place works with their needs to the noise, and she's correct. Also, they call you the day of your arrival on your cell phone and call you in the room to try to get you to go to their "90 minute" timeshare presentation. Seriously? Maybe if you told me it was quiet wherever it's held I might take you up on it. If you can't keep up Hilton standards at this property, you shouldn't carry the Hilton name.

reviews.title: Our annual family vacation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The overall experience was good but it could have been excellent. During our stay we had other family guest (non owners) come to stay and it was stressful when we asked the hotel staff to fully and thoroughly clean the rooms that they would be staying in. We were made aware that this is not the typical service provided during an 8 day reservation and changing of the sheets, pillow cases, wiping down tables/counters, cleaning the toilet were basically more than what is typically provided for a stay and this would be considered an extra fee to us as an owner. I ended up cleaning the toilet and wiping down the counters/tables myself because I wanted MY guests to have a clean room to stay in. I felt like I was more concerned about the guests

reviews.title: Loud!!!
reviews.text: I really wanted to like this hotel, but I can only give it three stars. The rooms itself was great, nice full kitchen, huge tub, separate shower, good sized everything. It just didn't seem clean and it wasn't fully stocked. Walked around with bare feet on the tile floor and the bottoms of my feet were filthy within a half and hour. I had to call Housekeeping for essential items like coat hangers, kitchen towels, dish soap and a sponge because our room hadn't been stocked with them. Housekeeping was awesome - they came very quickly and were very accommodating, even after hours. The other issue was the noise from the adjacent Flamingo 21+ pool. The incredibly loud techno music was pumping 7 days a week from 9 am to 6 pm. You could even hear it in the room. As the family pool for our hotel was literally just across the fence from the adult pool, you couldn't get away from the music. It was impossible to concentrate on a book or have a private conversation. On Fridays, there is also music from Carlos and Charlies that plays until 1:00 a.m. If you are looking to relax and enjoy peace and quiet when you're off the Strip, this isn't the place to stay. Otherwise, the location, rooms and proximity to the Linq Promenade were all pluses.

reviews.title: Great place for families
reviews.text: We were looking for something with more room to spread out than a typical hotel room, but didn't want to be far from the strip. This property worked perfectly and provided the best of both worlds in a family-friendly environment. NO CASINO and NO SMOKING made the experience better for the four of us! We were traveling with two kids, a 9 year old and a 13 year old, and would definitely stay here again if we're in Vegas in the future. Very close to the monorail, and friendly and helpful staff. After long days sightseeing, a well-stocked if overpriced (normal for the area) convenience store, lovely nice outdoor pool and hot tub, and plenty of room to spread out in a two-bedroom suite with full kitchen and FREE washer and dryer were just what this mom needed.

reviews.title: Worst HGVC experience EVER!
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: HGV Flamingo was Modern and well located
reviews.text: Such a lovely place to stay and experience the Las Vegas Strip close by. This was a spacious and very modern apartment with over friendly staff who were happy to answer any questions. I would definitely stay at a HGV again.

reviews.title: HGVC - Flamingo
reviews.text: Although this property is due for a facelift, it is centrally located and staff are always exceptional.  The pool area has gotten very popular with the 20's crowd, but this IS Vegas, so to be expected.  The do stop the bumping music by 6pm and most move on to other activities.  Overall, this is still our favorite Hilton location on the strip.

reviews.title: loved our stay
reviews.text: we stayed in a 2 bed 2 bath room.(with 2 kids) so spacious and better than i expected.this is located in the south of the strip. so convenient to walk everywhere  .there’s a day club next to this place as well if you are interested .staff was really friendly.loved this place and highly recommend.

reviews.title: Noisy pool during daytime
reviews.text: It was disappointing to have loud music all day during my 7 night stay.  I loved the room, bed, furnishings, decor and condo pool.  I could not be relaxed with loud booming outside from the Huge Flamingo Hotel Go Pool club experience.  The staff responded to my complaint with ear plugs and told me the pool closes at 6p and during winter months.

reviews.title: Great Choice!
reviews.text: I enjoyed this beautiful and well maintained property.   Close proximity to Flamingo, Cromwell and Caesars made many dining and entertainment options readily available.  Hilton Honors members- this is my 2nd stay at this property and I've had to call for stay credit and points both times.  Also- be prepared to fend off time share sales staff.

reviews.title: Love the room, mixed feeling with "welcome gift"
reviews.text: We got a room for a family with fully equipped kitchen, dining table which made our 6-night stay at Hilton was really enjoyable. It was located very centrally, and we can easily access the most interesting part of Vegas. It was very good for the price. It was hard to say negative as everything works as expected. There is one thing I appreciate about this hotel, given I bring the children to Vegas: no gambling area in this Hotel. We got WiFi, 2 bottles of waters daily and access to the swimming pool.We just felt "mix feeling" when trying to follow up the "welcome gift" card on our bed. We were invited to a promotional event with a free lunch which in turn actually was a promotional event to be a Hilton member which doesn't fit our vacation style at all -- for 90 minutes (actually we lose time almost 4 hours in total). We had no clue how to not waste the time of the one approaching us, and we also waste our time in Vegas that could have been used for other things. We felt stupid. We also finally cannot use the free tickets we got as a part of the welcome gift as we want to compensate our "missing" time with our goal.

reviews.title: Great Time in Vegas
reviews.text: We started off at the wrong location and were actually surprised when we got to the right place because it was sooooo much better.  Great place and great people. I look forward to doing this again in the future.  The room and facilities were all worth it.

reviews.title: The best location
reviews.text: This resort sits directly behind the Flamingo and shares the pool with the Flamingo. The pool is a club pool so it is always loud music and excitement until 6pm. All the rooms have a view of the pool. The staff here is very friendly and concerned about how things are going for you. This is at the heart of the strip and you couldn’t ask for a better location. It is directly next to the Linq Promenade and High Roller and just a block from the Mall. This is where you want to be young or old. It’s all about access and this location has easy access to everything.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I stayed here for two nights with my husband and brother in a family room for four people.We were more than disappointed when we figured that each room (even if it is for four people) does just allow two accessed to the WiFi. That did not change even after complaining about it. Would have expected more from them!

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Great experience.   Loved how peaceful the hotel was but so convenient to the casinos.   Nice to have the separate rooms.   Great lay out in the room with all amenities.    Having the full size refrigerator was so also a plus.  Only down side was that we could but bring in any outside beverages to the pool area.

reviews.title: Elara owner usded Flamingo resort
reviews.text: I usually stay at the Elara since I am Elara owner. I reluctantly booked the Flamingo simply because the Elara was full, and  I wanted to stay closer to the strip and my children wanted to be closer to the strip. The rooms aren't as luxurious and as large as the Elara but they were accommodating. The amenities are above-average, and everything was in working order. The resort was clean and the hosts were accommodating. The pool area is very loud, that's if you wanted to take an afternoon nap it would almost be impossible without ear plugs. It is a little difficult to access the hotel, and you have to walk through the Flamingo casino to get to the strip. You can get to strip bt walking outside, but it takes a longer route and time. Other than the loud music coming from the pool until about 9 or 10 at night this was an enjoyable and well priced stay per points from an owner.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great overall, awesome location. Price was good, everything’s by clean, and the flamingo GO pool was awesome. Steps from everything in the heart of the strip. Will stay again in future visit. Viva Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Comfortable and centrally located
reviews.text: We exchanged into this property with RCI for an extended family vacation. Getting to the Strip is very easy. We did t take the monorail, but hat was very close-by, too. There are many restaurants within an easy walking distance, but this property provides a quiet smoke-free oasis. This made for a very relaxing time. The staff is also excellent.

reviews.title: HGVC Flamingo escape
reviews.text: Excellent location service and accommodation. Within walking distance to a majority of casino resorts. Convenient monorail access. Private pool for HGVC guests only with bar and cabanas. Linq promenade easy walking distance. Beautiful foliage with several areas to sit out and relax.

reviews.title: A bit outdated but would we stay again?
reviews.text: Beautiful room and we enjoyed not having to walk through a casino to get to the elevator. The hallways were outdated and extremely hot! They turn the air off at night and during the day, it's very warm and very got by the elevators. The staff were very helpful. Our room was lovely and the bathroom was beautiful. They could really really use more lighting in the rooms as they are not we'll lit, especially the bathroom. The hotel is smack in the middle of the strip so you'll have access to each end of Last Vegas Blvd. So yes, I would stay here again and we look forward to going back.

reviews.title: Great place for family, with everything near.
reviews.text: This location is very family friendly.  They have a decent sized pool, and great lobby for all kids to enjoy.My only concern is that this hotel is next to the Flamingo pool club which has loud music from noon until about 6PM.  If this is something that would bother you, you may not even want to be in Vegas in the  first place, but I'd recommend the other Hilton location

reviews.title: Ideal location
reviews.text: Certainly not the greatest hotel, but in an ideal location. Very friendly and professional team. The ideał location to enjoy the pleasures of Las Vegas without any trouble. Access to the hotel is a bit complicated, but once you found your way it is easy and comfortable with parking just across.

reviews.title: In the heart of it all
reviews.text: This resort was great for many reasons; here are a few: awesome GoPool at the Flamingo plus private pool, next to High Roller, Linq Promenade, Ballys, Caesars, etc.   Location, Location, Location.  Great facility too with very helpful staff.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: This was our third stay at this resort and just as incredible as the previous stays.  The resort is centrally located and very well maintained.  The staff is great!!  We had some frustrations with the internet connectivity, but managed to deal with it.  We came with some friends and they also loved it. We highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay here. We got the 2 bedroom suite with a small kitchen and 2 separate king bedrooms and 2 baths. The pullout sofa bed was actually good for a sofa bed. I liked that it was a quiet respite right behind the Flamingo. The pool area was nice and quiet or you could use the busier Flamingo pool nearby.

reviews.title: Not for family vacations
reviews.text: Parking is  a nightmare.  No fans/ ventilation in the rooms or bathrooms.  Pool is decent, and the flamingo pool is available but mostly for 21+ adults.  Not kid friendly. No restaurant,  only deli/ market.

reviews.title: Fantastic Las Vegas Vacation - Young Couple Hanging With Old School Couple
reviews.text: Wonderful place to enjoy all that Las Vegas has to offer, on the Strip, next to the Flamingo and near other casinos including Caesars, Flamingo GO pool for 21+ and private resort pool to chill, large variety of dining options, ride share right at the corner.

reviews.title: Fantastic Las Vegas Experience - Old School Couple
reviews.text: This is a fantastic resort located right on the Strip next to the Flamingo Casino/ Hotel. It is a beautiful resort with great modern fully stocked units and spacious grounds.  You have the option of using the HGV private family friendly pool or the Adults only Flamingo GO pool with a Waterfall, DJs, Blackjack Tables, Food and Spirits. It is right next to restaurants and shops, and across the Strip from Caesars Palace.

reviews.title: Great Location, Nice Amenities
reviews.text: We stayed in a single bedroom unit with a King Size Bed. There was a large tub with a double sink/vanity and a separate bathroom with a shower, toilet and double sink vanity. There was a living room with a pullout sofa bend, a flat screen tv in both the living room and bedroom, a dining area and full kitchen (dishwasher, full size refrigerator, stove/oven, microwave, coffeemaker, dishes, pans, and silverware) and a washer and dryer. They also have a two bedroom unit that has a common entryway with a separate entry into each room. The second bedroom is a studio with two double beds a bathroom and a kitchenette. You can leave the inner doors open so that the studio has access to the living area of the other unit. Rooms are only serviced once during a 7 day stay and if you stay less than 4 days there is no service, however housekeeping will provide extra towels, coffee etc with a simple call. Parking is free in the Flamingo parking structure and there are parking spots reserved strictly for HGVC guests even if the lot is full which can happen on weekends. There is also Valet Parking available.The elevators require your key to access the rooms so have it ready when you enter the elevators or you might be taken to an unwanted floor if the call button is pressed on a higher floor before you make your floor selection. There is a health Club with 3 ellipticals, 2 treadmills, 1 recumbent bike, free weights, mats and water. There are restrooms just outside the Club but no towels. They provide free dvd "rentals" in the lobby and there is a business center with 2 computers and a printer. The lounge area has an ATM, large screen tv, pool table and ample seating. There is also a US mailbox in the lobby. They also have a concierge desk to help you with dinner reservations and discounted show tickets as well as suggestions for sightseeing and places to eat. There is a Marketplace shop on the first floor that sells freshly made sandwiches, salads, soft drinks, beer, wine, liquor, ice cream, single serve frozen dinners, snacks and various sundries. It is open from 6:00 am to 7:00 pm. There is a private outdoor pool with towels as well as access to the Flamingo GO Pool. The Flamingo Pool has a DJ and LOUD music especially on the weekends but we didn't spend a lot of time in the room so this did not present a lot of problems for us. Although the music is pretty loud, especially the bass sounds, it did not interfere with us taking a nap. It is quiet at night and the pool is not open in the Fall and Winter months.This property is centrally located on the strip and is across from Caesar's Palace, the Bellagio and Bally's and down the street from the Paris Casino Hotel. It is close to the LINQ Promenade which has many shops and restaurants as well as access to the High Roller, an enclosed, air conditioned ferris wheel that provides spectacular views of the Las Vegas Strip both during daylight and at night. The is a tram station on the property to take you up and down the strip with several stops along the way (you can purchase 1 ride tickets or daily or multiple day passes). This condo resort is available to all Hilton Grand Vacation Club members, RCI members and open for public rental based on availability. It is a time share type property so they do try to get you to sit for a tour but it is a no pressure tour with no expectations and you can get additional perks (dinner credits, show tickets etc.) for attending but it is not a requirement of staying at the property.If you want to stay in a condo style facility rather than a hotel room, want to be close to the action but out of the hustle and bustle of the casino atmosphere, this is a great option. We enjoyed our stay at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club at the Flamingo and would definitely come back.

reviews.title: Awful HGV
reviews.text: Not. Family. Friendly. Now, I know Vegas in a nutshell is not family friendly but I expected more from Hilton. Beautiful pool photos posted on their website. The catch? It's not part of HGV. It's some crazy club that blasts inappropriate music obnoxiously loud right next to the cruddy 'family pool' with no amenities. Probably the worst HGV I've been to in terms of having activities on site. Service wasn't friendly either. Arrived around 9:30pm, usually get the property rundown and water for Diamond status when checking in. Not here. I went back the next morning because nothing on this property is open after 7 anyway. Rooms are tired. Mattress cover and sheets on the pull out sofa were stained & disgusting. Of course they want to sell a timeshare. NO WAY. I've been to quite a few HGV properties, thought about a timeshare but after this disaster have lost all interest.

reviews.title: Cannot use much less enjoy rooms
reviews.text: There is so much noise from the hotel's pool area that severe headaches and nausea may occur. This happens from about 11am to 6pm. If you like booming bass pounding all day, this may not bother you. Other than that, rooms could use an update or redo, and the location is the best of HGVC in Vegas.

reviews.title: worst of the Hliton timeshares
reviews.text: The timeshare is average, BUT it has one incredible, insurmountable flaw:  This is a family resort, as are all timeshares.  This location has incredibly loud, pumping, constant, soul draining bass (not music, just bass) permeating throughout the unit, all day long, and then throughout the night until sometime after 2:30am.  I enjoy Las Vegas, but whenever I come to the unit, I want peace. There is no such thing at this location.After that, they are severely understaffed and their air conditioning doesn't extend to hallways.

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: We did an RCI trade to this resort for our recent week-long stay in Las Vegas.  We arrived at the resort around 10 am and were surprised that we could actually check in at that time.  We selected a one-bedroom unit on the 5th floor facing the Flamingo Go Pool.  Yes, there are times that you can hear the boom boom of the speakers at the pool and it only seemed to be really intense on Saturday afternoons when they have celebrity guest DJs.  Even then, my husband and I both had no problem taking a nap during that time.Our room was very up to date and clean.  We had one King size bed, a full kitchen, dining and living room area and laundry area.  Our unit was at the end of the hall, which is something we prefer.  We never had any issue finding a parking space in the parking structure across the street and we appreciated that it was free.  The staff at the resort are very helpful and friendly.We did access the Go Pool about 4 days during our stay.  It is best to arrive early although people come and go all day and if you are in the right spot at that time you will find lounge chairs.  The pool is surprisingly cool considering the temperature and is refreshing and by 11 am full of people.  They don't let you bring any containers inside, so you are forced to pay for the very expensive drinks inside (this includes water unless you want to keep walking to the water fountain).  The staff at the pool were very friendly as well - waitstaff and security.We were able to get extra towels, coffee, and laundry detergent while there.  It was a great stay in a convenient location.  We would come back again,

reviews.title: Great location but...
reviews.text: This is a great resort.  Clean, fantastic location, nice room, and extremely helpful staff.  We stayed a week and never left the walking area.  Lots of casinos, restaurants, and shows nearby.  Show tickets from the concierge were lower than most other outlets, including the same-day ticket kiosks.The only problem was the noise in the afternoon from the Flamingo pool.  Not sure why they need to play it so loud, but it made afternoon naps extremely difficult.I highly the Hilton Grand to anyone considering a trip to Las Vegas.  I would have given it a higher rating, except for the noise.

reviews.title: Hgvc at Flamingo
reviews.text: Hilton Grand Vacation at the Flamingo is upscaleaccommodations located right behind the Flamingo.  Rooms are well equipped and nicer than hotel rooms. Nice pool which always seems to have open seats.  The location is good and allows easy access to strip. There is restaurant.

reviews.title: Great Location - Just off the Strip
reviews.text: The location was amazing; you can walk to everything.   The rooms were very good but are a little dated.  The GO bar next door is loud but ends at 6:00 pm. One night they had a party that went until 3:00 am, and I did not have earplugs. (Big Mistake)  It was really loud, but it is Las Vegas.  I got earplugs that we did not have another night like that.  You may want to ask for a room on the wheel side of the building just in case.  Service was excellent.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: Best location on the strip! Beautiful accommodations at this resort...Except for the constant extremely loud bass thumping noise from the GO pool area during the day and a Thursday night outdoor restaurant party at the Flamingo hotel in front of this resort that continued until 3am Friday morning...this was one of the nicest places we have ever stayed in Vegas or otherwise! Bring your earplugs in case loud noise bothers you.

reviews.title: Not a relaxing or quite place to stay unless you enjoy very loud music
reviews.text: The resort is next to the Flamingo Hotel pool. Very loud music with a lot of bass is played at the pool from 9am to 5 or 6pm every day except Thursdays. On Thursday the music plays until 3am on Friday morning. We stayed on the top floor of the south tower.  It was not a great experience or a relaxing stay. After being kept awake until 3am, we had enough and left a day early because of the music. The room and the staff were excellent and it is unfortunate that the loud music is such a nuisance.

reviews.title: Great location, nice units
reviews.text: We were on the 5th floor of the north tower overlooking the pools in a 1 bedroom unit. The unit was furnished with comfortable furniture and had a ton of storage. The location behind the Flamingo casino was great for easy access to most of the strip and being next to the Linq Promenade offered numerous places to get food or drinks. As many reviewers have said there definitely was noise from the Flamingo’s party pool, but totally constrained to the hours of 10am to 6pm. The times I was in my room reading, I could hear music but I didn’t really find it that disturbing. The staff at the resort were fantastic, everyone friendly and helpful. The on-site Marketplace had a much larger selection of items than I had expected. Overall, a fantastic experience.

reviews.title: Average Hotel!
reviews.text: The rooms itself was very average, with the bathroom being small and old looking. We didn't get the room we really paid for, but by the time we finally found parking and fought all the crowds we were too tired to complain. The location of this hotel is probably the best thing about it, being right in The Strip. However, next time we would splurge a little and stay somewhere much nicer.

reviews.title: Great location and friendly staff.
reviews.text: We were there with our family, mother and father in law, brother and sister in law and 6 year old niece.  We love this location and the friendly staff.  This location is centrally located and you have access to the Flamingo large pool and enter through the VIP line.  Love the use of the grills, which most folks don't take advantage off during the stay.  We will be back again and our extended family had the time of their lives.  Awesome stay!

reviews.title: Round the world 2018
reviews.text: Family trip to Las Vegas. Resort is beautiful.  Bell boys were fantastic. All the other staff very friendly.Close to Flamingo pool which can get noisy, however it finishes up reasonably early. Amazed all the casino's we visited allowed smoking.

reviews.title: Disappointed.
reviews.text: Garbage was found in our room from prior occupant.  This garbage included a half-full bottle of water, tobacco, a ticket stub and a bottle opener.  Additionally, our shower was plugged and was only usable for one shower.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: They charge a 25.00 per day for internet, two bottles of water per day which you don’t get and some other jazz that’s not worth it. The pool bar service sucks. Rooms were clean and the location great. Don’t get the 49.00 buffet. You won’t get your moneys worth.

reviews.title: Get away R&R at Hilton Resort
reviews.text: My room at the Hilton Grand Vacation Resort by Flamingo has recently updated with newer tiled-shower, so as their indoor spa. The overall pool, spas, steam room were updated and kept clean, significantly improved compared to my last stay there 3 years ago. The location is convenient for walking to major attractions and casinos.

reviews.title: Excellent Non-Casino Hotel
reviews.text: This is a great hotel in the Hilton family. No casino, great pool, nice rooms.  Small marketplace for coffee, snacks, personal items and meals.  This is my go to place everytime I'm in Vegas for a conference.

reviews.title: More good than bad
reviews.text: We chose this hotel because of its positive reviews and proximity to the strip. Close enough to enjoy the strip but not overwhelming. Rooms were spacious and clean and nice. The only downside is that during the day (9a to 6p) all you hear in your room is pounding and thumping from the bass at the Flamingo Day Club Pool. It wasn’t a total turn off for us but it was a little annoying. The free continental breakfast was a joke though. 1 microwaved sandwich (with only the choice of meat) and a juice and coffee. For the value of the room and location we’d likely stay here again.

reviews.title: Front Desk - Top Service
reviews.text: Arnold is amazing!  90 days can pass by between a return visit and he not only remembers my face but also my name.  This Hilton Grand property exceeds the Hilton Grand property on on the blvd. also located in Las Vegas. While I am an Spire Elite with IHG, I go out of my way to use this Hilton property because Arnold makes me feel welcome.  Thank you, Tim

reviews.title: Fantastic stay !!  Great room and location
reviews.text: This was one of the NICEST places we have stayed in a long time.. before I go into any detail, in my opinion, who goes to Las Vegas and doesn't expect a little noise and bright lights??  I did NOT go there to sit and read a book or expect solitude... now that's me.. If it's you, perhaps the noise from the Flamingo pool would be an issue.  We were NOT in our room during 9AM-6PM time frame when there is pool music...WE WERE AT THE POOL !!   We traded our timeshare in Florida for this property, got a gorgeous 2 bedroom- we did ask for an upper floor facing the pool based on prior comments about the noise, which was really not a factor for us. (15th floor)  Check-in was a breeze, and we were not bombarded with requests to attend anything, other than a phone message which we ignored.  They even provided us with a card for the DVD rental machines- current movies, no charge- we only used it one night for a movie before we went out late.. nice touch however.  Also there are computers available especially if you need to print out boarding passes.  There is a small exercise room, convenience store, as well as their own small secluded pool on the property.  Very well maintained grounds.. Parking was free in the Flamingo garage, with their own parking section.  We used our Total Rewards card to exit the garage, but they provide their own card as well.    Our 2 bedroom was gorgeous... keyless entry.. 2 seperate entrances. One side had a small kitchenette, microwave etc., but the main side was fully equipped. both had large bathrooms, main had a washer and dryer, DVD players, large screen TV, TV in bedroom, large king sized bed, comfortable... nice view of the pool and part of the strip.. the High Roller was right behind the HGVC as well as a monorail station.    WE had such a GREAT visit, that I immediately tried to book again through RCI, but they have the rule that prevents you from returning right away... Not a problem, there are other HGVC properties to choose from in Las Vegas, but this one was special !!

reviews.title: Ideal location for the Strip!
reviews.text: Rooms and staff were better than expected.  Would definitely stay there again.  The pools are for adults!  We saw activities around the pool that small kids should not be exposed to.  Convenience to restaurants and shows was perfect for those who enjoy walking.

reviews.title: Great property but NOISY
reviews.text: The property and unit at HBVC Flamingo are very nice, well maintained and very conveniently located at the center of the strip. We were able to walk to many of the places we wanted to visit. Having not been to Vegas for over 5 years, we were surprised that the casinos now charge to park! So it was a great service that free parking is provided.Our main complaint is the constant pounding music from the adjacent Flamingo hotel pool. Our room is amazingly well insulated and quiet EXCEPT against the barage of loud pop music that starts at 9am at a moderate level but is turned up to concert level at noon and runs non-stop until 7 on weekdays and later on the weekends. The bass is so poundingly loud that we could feel our floor and walls vibrate on the 5th floor!  Our enjoyment of the resort pool was severely compromised by the constant noise......it even drowned out my earplugs w/ my own music.Staying here had a lot of positives, but to us, the loud music became a definite drawback. Be forewarned.

reviews.title: Great Hotel - Good Experience
reviews.text: From check in to check out, the HGV at the Flamingo was a great experience and one I would highly recommend.   They were gracious hosts and helped us get set up for our weeks stay and the suite was excellent.    The King bed accommodated two very well and the mattress was firm and the pillows were soft to firm.  HGV Flamingo was right behind the Flamingo and the Flamingo's pool was available to guests.    Really enjoyed our trip and would highly recommend.

reviews.title: HILTON GRAND VACATIONS AT THE FLAMINGO
reviews.text: Fantastic, Peaceful place to stay!.  Rooms are luxurious.  Staff is professional.   Plenty of food available within a minutes walk, within the Hilton.   The pool is beautiful, we did not use it, but many people did.

reviews.title: Good hotel with one major caveat
reviews.text: We are Hilton honors members and picked this hotel based on that fact along with it not having a casino.  We were very pleased when we arrived.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  Christian the bellman was especially helpful and very kind.  Our hotel room was clean and spacious.  It had a small coffee maker, a microwave and a refrigerator.  It had a beautiful tile shower and separate bathtub which was nice.  The bed slept well.  There was one major problem.  The hotel is part of the  Flamingo resort.  Everyday from 9am to 6pm there is an extremely loud pool party going on at the Flamingo pool.  I just now read another reviewer say that it was not bothersome.  He must be hard of hearing.  To be fair, we are in our mid 50's and booming base music is not our thing.  The techno music was so loud we could hear it on the 4th floor like it was right there in our room and we were at the opposite end of the hotel.  There was absolutely no way to enjoy the Hilton pool as it is adjacent to the partying Flamingo pool.  I did not read about this annoyance anywhere in any reviews prior to booking or I would absolutely not have booked this place.  However, the manager bent over backwards trying to make it right.  He tried to get us into another Hilton property on our second day but all rooms were booked because of the Billboard music awards in town.  He refunded our remaining 5 night stay, waived the resort fee and helped us secure another room.   My husband and I were very pleased with his customer service.  Because of his outstanding efforts, I rated this property 3 stars instead of one.

reviews.title: Great stay at a great place!!
reviews.text: This was my second time to Vegas and my second time to this property.. Since I've been here before, I had a good idea of what to expect.  The rooms are very clean... hotel staff is very attentive and friendly..   The hotel 'food pantry' had good food for a quick meal (sandwiches, wraps, etc) and a good assortment of other items and price wise, not a bad deal compared to the other locations on the strip.. No casino and no smoking was nice..  Great place and will be back!

reviews.title: Above Average
reviews.text: Stayed here for 7 nights and couldn’t identify any faults at all. Fantastic hotel adjacent to the Las Vegas Strip and one of few hotels without a casino- making the hotel ideal for families. All staff members were extremely helpful, cheerful and welcoming of us from the moment we entered the hotel to our final day. Cleaning teams are good and overall cleanliness of the hotel is satisfying. The rooms were extremely comfortable and the facilities are sufficient. We were joyful to realise we could rent DVD’s out for free to watch in the rooms. This especially pleased the younger members of the family! The pool are is small but cosy and next door to the Flamingo pool, which is an adult only pool where a pool party is located every day. The music from the party can be heard from the pool area at the Hilton, but it is not deafening and was enjoyed by the people at the pool. Our overall experience of the hotel was great! It is relatively quiet compared to the rest of Vegas, which is what we wanted. The hotel is clean, the rooms are fantastic and the staff are brilliant. Will be returning.

reviews.title: Great Location !
reviews.text: Spent a week staying here in a 2 bed/2 bathroom apartment and thought it was excellent. Great size apartment with everything you could need in a home from home accommodation. A few steps away from the Flamingo Casino right on the Strip and easy to walk everywhere. The only downside (as most others have pointed out) is probably the noise from the Go Pool at the Flamingo. VERY loud music ALL DAY from 9am to 6pm so not easy to relax by the pool at the HGV !!! Think this should be made clear and pointed out to customers when booking. Otherwise this is a great place to stay with many plus sides if you can cope with the noise !!!!

reviews.title: Less than impressed
reviews.text: Stayed here with my wife, the location was great but...first our room was located at the end of the hall right across from a door marked “trash”. And whenever we were outside our room, the smell of garbage was horrible.  There also is no bar on the property and no restaurant. They did have a store where you can purchase food and beer/booze and they could make some sandwiches but... There also is a pool but very small. on the good side, the location is awesome right next to the Flamingo and we had access to the Flamingo’s pool which was awesome. It’s also a short walk to lots of casinos and restaurants and bars.  The service was excellent. All in all, I doubt I would stay here again, very pricey for the value.

reviews.title: Even the Complimentary Ear Plugs don't drown out the noise!
