reviews.text: From 9 am until 6 pm the walls reverberated with the bass of the extremely loud music at the pools.  It was unbearable, but there are no rooms that don't overlook the pool so the noise can only be escaped by sitting outside in the hallway on the floor or leaving the location altogether.  I sat on the floor in the hallway for hours to get some peace and quiet.  Not even the lounge seating areas give the guests any quiet away from the constant loud thumping of the music.  Make sure to bring plenty of headache tablets and plan your day to be gone from the building for the daytime hours.  This is not a good place to try and sleep during the day, so if you normally take a nap during the day or have small babies, don't even waste your time thinking about staying here.  I for one will never return, in spite of the claim by one staff member that this is only a rare event for this weekend.  Today is Tuesday and it went on all day today.  I asked at the Front Desk if they have complimentary ear plugs and the staff person told me yes and stated that they realized with all the noise from the Flamingo they were going to have to provide complimentary earplugs. Unfortunately they did not drown out the noise and you can still feel the vibrations reverberating in the walls on the side of the building that faces the pool until the music stopped at 6 pm.The room was clean and well maintained, although the color scheme of the fabric was not to my liking.  Bright oranges and pinks in the couch and the bedskirt.  But these colors certainly carried through with the theme of loud obnoxious music.  Other than that, the room was nice. In fact, the large tub, a feature of Hilton, was a welcome feature, but due to the noise level could only be enjoyed in the evening. The tiny kitchenette in the studio supplies 2 cups, 2 glasses, etc. but no stove or dishwasher.  The mini-fridge has a fair-sized freezer, convenient for ice cream and much more that one may want to freeze.  No ice trays, but there is a good sized steel ice bucket in which to chill a bottle of wine, if one is so inclined.However, due to the constant noise levels and the necessity to flee my room at all costs, I do not plan to return.  I prefer a location where I can come and go, rest and relax in the room at my own leisure. However, for the person who prefers to party all day long with lots of loud music around the pool, this is probably ideal.  To any HGVC response:  I would suggest you place a warning on your site that owners can read before making a reservation about the noise level here and that you re-iterate this issue in the confirmation email as well.  I don't like having to take headache medication because of the place I have come to relax.  And I don't like being forced to flee the property to get away from noise.

reviews.title: Good location, walk everywhere needd
reviews.text: Location is close to the strip with only 1/2 block back, lots of options close by. Pool desk is a bit small and the Hilton Flamingo pool next door had pool party everday from morning to night, very loud music. In and Out Burger is right door and easy access.

reviews.title: Nice room.  Great location
reviews.text: Well appointed and maintained room.  Washer/dryer and very large bathtub  in the room!  We were able to walk to everything we wanted.  Some faint music noise from the pool, but never a problem.  Staff was excellent.

reviews.title: Best exchange we ever had
reviews.text: This place is beautiful,  convenient location, very clean and lots of room.  Great to get away from the crowds of Vegas to rest awhile . Would recommend this to any group. Very close to tram.  Only negative is from noon until 6 noise from Flimamingo pool.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Had a great stay as usual. Rooms are clean and staff is very friendly and accommodating. Great location. Close to numerous great restaurants and bars. Pool was very nice. The hotel next door could turn down there music, but otherwise it was awesome.

reviews.title: Stay at HGV Club - May 5-12
reviews.text: RonL2317King George, Virginia145Reviewed 3 weeks ago Quiet, but centrally located Las Vegas condo.Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo  is in the heart of the Las Vegas strip, without the noise. Very well maintained building and grounds with a pleasant and helpful staff. No time-share sales pressure. The resort is an oasis surrounded by the high energy activity of the Las Vegas strip. Within easy walking distance of most major strip attractions. We were on the 6th Floor of the North Floor which is located away from the Flamingo pool, which I think help with the noise level

reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for a week and really enjoyed it.  The one bedroom was large, comfortable and well kept.  Staff treated you like royalty.  We enjoyed the pool area because it was separate from the Flamingo pool which was packed most of the days we were there.  This Hilton pool was smaller but had lots of lounges in the shade and very attractive surroundings including a pool bar.  I do need to mention that the music from the Flamingo pool was, at times too loud.  Another convenience was an onsite store that served Starbucks coffee, breakfast and lunch items as well as beer, wine and some groceries.  We will definitely come to this resort again.

reviews.title: A Great Place But???
reviews.text: The rooms (we had a 2 bedroom) were great. The staff pleasant & helpful. The location is very central on the strip. But, if you anticipate any quiet time during the day and are not into the Flamingo Party Pool scene next  door over the fence - this is not the place you you. The music ( heard of course at the resorts smaller pool & in your room) starts at 9 AM but at noon the DJ comes on and the volume & the constant pounding of the bass is on till 6PM.

reviews.title: Quick stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Conveniently located near the strip.  Great staff. Great rooms.  No restaurant on sight which means no room service.  Nice gym. Great pool incl. a bar located right next to it.  Horrible sewage smell on the 1st floor near the gym that really is disgusting.

reviews.title: Not our best experience with Hilton.
reviews.text: Since I was arriving from Canada later than my niece from Scotland, I called the hotel to make sure that by adding her to the room and giving them details of my flight arriving 3 hrs later, she would have access to the room immediately after traveling for 15 hrs. I was informed that this would not be a problem. Imagine my surprise to arrive 4 hours later after a delayed flight to find my niece sitting in the lobby. The gentleman (and I use that term loosely) covering reception was extremely rude when I questioned why she was not allowed in a room that I had booked with my credit card on file that would take the first night, even if I did not show!  Apparently earlier, they had tried to put the whole room cost on her credit card (over $3,000), which was weird as you do not settle your room charge till check out!  Anyway, when I told the manager the next day about this mix up and how upset I was that she was left in the lobby, I was questioned about when and who I had called as he (Will) said there were no notes on their file. Fortunately, I had called from my cell so I could bring up the record of a 5 minute call to the hotel a week prior. I did not feel as if I was taken seriously, nor did they seem to care that a young lady spent four hours alone in reception after such a long travel day.  The other negatives were the awful smell of sewage that seemed to linger around the elevator area and the fact that they closed down the pool area during our trip with only a days notice. Yes, you can use the Flamingo pool but it is very busy, you cannot take anything to the pool, including your water (What?) and they also had the kids slide area closed and all the hot tubs were empty of water but dirty with debris. Lovely!  Other than the poor management, the rooms were nice and the maid service was great.

reviews.title: Pool area unusable
reviews.text: This is a tough review to write. The resort was immaculate, the staff were, without exception delightful, helpful and professional and the resort is perfectly located for the strip. BUT if you are planning to go to Las Vegas and for at least part of your holiday, spend time relaxing by the pool, I would have to advise staying away from this resort. Sadly the fantastic pool area, which again is perfectly kept and serviced by great staff, directly adjoins the Flamingo Pool area. As we understand it, from April through to October the Flamingo pool area turns into a ‘day club’, with visiting DJ’s visiting and it being literally like a club. The music is so loud that you can feel it vibrating through your body, let alone having any prospect of talking or relaxing. This is competent unavoidable and goes from about 9am until late in the afternoon. It is particularly bad on weekends. We were politely advised that this something you have to put up with if you want to stay this close to the strip and it’s the same in other central resorts. We tested this out in a number of them and found it absolutely was not the case. Every pool area we got access to had music playing, but to an acceptable level. So in summary a great place, with great staff, but find an alternative if you plan go through the warmer months and hope to use the pool/outside area.

reviews.title: Great stay overall!
reviews.text: My Mom and I were in Las Vegas to celebrate our birthdays and chose here due to its proximity to The Flamingo Casino and Showroom.  My Mom who is 84 cannot walk very far and we attended the Donny and Marie show at the Flamingo.  This was the perfect location for us and the room was updated and modern with two separate rooms and most importantly, two separate vanities and sinks for our make up application.  It was a great room to 'hang" and view the action at the Go Pool at the Flamingo.  If you are looking for a "condo" feel with a full kitchen rather than a motel room, this is the place for you!  My only negative comment is that the Go Pool plays loud music beginning at 8:30 until 5:00.  You definitely cannot escape the boom of the bass from anywhere in the hotel so no afternoon napping.

reviews.title: Everything Great Except the Bed
reviews.text: We had stayed the prior night at the Embassy Suites by UNLV and took their shuttle here just after 11 am.  We arrived not expecting a room but went to the desk.  They took our cell phone number and said they would text us when a room was ready.  We checked our luggage with the bag check room people and headed to the monorail and to its northern end at the SLS.  I had my best slot win there just after we arrived and just before I got the text just after noon that our room was ready.  I texted back that we would be there in about 45 minutes and received an acknowledgement to such.  We arrived just about 1 and were checked into Room #1417.  No sales pitches were thrown at us.  We received a coupon for our 2 bottles of Evian water from the in house store, got our bags, and headed up to our room.  We were near the north end facing west as, I think, all of the rooms do.  We had stayed here before so the room layout was the same as in the past with a little kitchen area in the entry way.  To the right is the main room with king bed, sofa, and table plus dresser with TV.  Going forward at the entry, the large tub is on the right, the sink/vanity area on the left and then a room with the toilet and shower.  Everything was clean.  Since we were higher this time, we had some great views of the Flamingo property plus more beyond!  My only issue this time, and the reason for just a 4 rating, was the bed.  I look forward to firm beds when I travel since I am in need of new mattress at home.  This one was worse than mine at home-sagging and limp-no firmness.  I had a hard time sleeping and had a very sore back most of the next day, which is when I was flying so that made matters even worse.  We got a great rate, even with the added resort fee, and will be back.  The location is fantastic just at the base of a monorail stop and central to the strip action plus not too far from our favorite little casino, the Tuscany.  I hope next time we get a room with a firmer mattress!!!

reviews.title: Great location and accommodations with a little distance from the Casinos.
reviews.text: As a Hilton Diamond member I have stayed at around a dozen of the Grand Vacation resorts. This resort is exactly what you would expect from the Grand collection without the elaborate grounds (although it does share a very large pool and grounds with the Flamingo property). The property has its own private pool as well which gives you a break from the major party pool if you need it (and I did). I only had one complaint and it had to do with my request for a late checkout. I have become spoiled by other Hilton properties and was disappointed they could only extend the checkout time by an hour. We will be returning to Vegas later this year and this property will be high on my list of places to stay.

reviews.title: We'd definitely stay here again.
reviews.text: The room exceeded our expectation by being large and well-appointed, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay; unlike what you get at the casino hotels. We're not gamblers, but this non-smoking hotel is in close walking proximity to restaurants and entertainment found in the numerous nearby casinos (which is convenient if you are interested in gambling). Also, no problems finding the Uber pick-up or drop-off spot: it's right out front where you'd expect it to be.

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: Of the HGVC resorts in Vegas this has the best location in my opinion.  Is is right behind the Flamingo Vegas Hotel and dead center of the strip almost.  The rooms are very nice and the views are even better.  You can get to the tram very quickly.

reviews.title: Disappointing stay
reviews.text: I had a great stay back in October and was excited to return. The first room we were put in I found white shavings all over the ground in the bathroom and around the toilet (had to use my phone light to see them) along with the bathroom light not working. The second room we were put in, we found dirty ear plugs in the bed and when I brought them down to the front desk, they didn’t even offer to change the sheets!!! So disgusting and disappointing.

reviews.title: Beautiful Vacaction Club Experience
reviews.text: Beautiful and quiet relaxing stay! Close to all casinos great food and shopping!A must stay if you prefer an exceptional place to stay! Full kitchens living and dining space and separate bedroom areas!! Our two bedroom suite was enjoyed by five people.WiFi , two complimentary bottles of water every day and a full service market with fresh foods too!

reviews.title: Nice place in the wrong location !!
reviews.text: The Flamingo HGVC is a great place to stay. Nice rooms, quiet at night and nice pool views. However, since about two years the owners of the Flamingo hotel on the strip started these afternoon " beach parties " at the pool from 2.00 pm through 6.00 pm . This is AWFULLY noisy, even using the HGVC reserved pool. They charge $ 10.00 / pers. + the booze that is sold at the pool. Las Vegas is now exclusively about " Money, more and more Money ". As we hate to be considered as " cash cows ", we decided that this would be our very last trip to Las Vegas. Restaurants are now way too expensive for the food quality they serve. Even the shows have lost the attraction.

reviews.title: First time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Booked online with knowing nothing of Las Vegas. This was a nice choice! Staff was always friendly and helpful. Property very clean. Nice location also. Found out that this Hotel is next to a stop for the Tram that takes you to the North Vegas area...up by Trump tower and the Stratosphere Casino. But by walking up the property path to the Flamingo, you're right in the middle of everything! Had a wonderful time and look forward to doing it again!

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: The 1 bedroom suite was excellent. The hallway from the front lobby to the hotel was a bit drab, but the room itself was great. Close to the action, but not in the middle of it. It would have been nice to have Lyft and Uber to the front entrance, instead of having to walk with luggage all the way to the Cromwell/Flamingo entrance. Better signage for the rideshare showing the location would have been helpful.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great location, but loud music from next door made it hard to relax during Flamingo Hotel Go Pool hour
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, great location, but loud music from next door made it hard to relax during Flamingo Hotel Go Pool hour

reviews.title: *Beware* - *Beware* - *Beware*
reviews.text: Great property and location, but they open the huge main pool to 21 and over general public. Extremely loud music from that pool can be heard everywhere, even inside the rooms! Most who stay here are huddled in a smaller side pool where the music is so loud that noise cancelling headphones don’t work. Children are also subject to the 21 and over music and alcohol fueled language from the main pool. A real shame because the property provides excellent rooms, but this daily cancer ruins a vacation.

reviews.title: Quiet, but centrally located Las Vegas condo.
reviews.text: In the heart of the Las Vegas strip, without the noise. Very well maintained building and grounds with a pleasant and helpful staff. No time-share sales pressure. The resort is an oasis surrounded by the high energy activity of the Las Vegas strip. Within easy walking distance of most major strip attractions.

reviews.title: Nice to stay somewhere that isn't a casino
reviews.text: We were in Las Vegas for my husband's work.  He had a training at the Sands Expo and he could walk there and back every day.  We brought our 9 month old and we definitely appreciated the cleanliness of the hotel.  No casino was a major plus, along with no indoor cigarette smoking! The hotel had a Pack & Play AND a high chair we used all week.  So nice.  The kitchenette was great, since baby and I ate breakfast and lunch in the room everyday. The baby and I spent a lot of time in the pool.  I'm in my late 30's and I actually really liked the music pouring over from the 21 & over pool at the Flamingo.  I didn't think it was too loud, but I know a lot of the other people at the pool didn't like it (they told me so!).  I could also hear the music inside our room during the day, but again, it didn't bother me.  The music stops in the late afternoon, I think around 5 or 6.  I went over to the

reviews.title: 10AM Checkout?! Beware!
reviews.text: If you’re like me, I enjoy sleeping in whenever I’m in Vegas. I booked this hotel because I’m a Hilton gold member and thought I would get the basic upgrades as other Hilton properties but it wasn’t the case. It’s not ran by Hilton but by a third party company. THE BADMost hotels have a standard checkout time 12pm but this hotel has a checkout time of 10:00AM! That doesn’t even give you time to grab a good breakfast. 10am is too early, especially for Vegas. Will not stay here again.

reviews.title: Wonderful plae to stay!
reviews.text: This resort is all that you could ask for...close to the strip, near the Flamingo and the Linq.  Lots of good restaurants around and perfect place to walk to nearly everything.  We could not have asked for more from our vacation stay at the Hilton!  The High Roller is in the backyard and a must if you visit Vegas!

reviews.title: except for the Flamingo pool noise, it was great!
reviews.text: We had a great one bedroom suite in the north building, quiet location in the hotel, but the noise from the big Flamingo GO pool area was a pain when you were trying to take an afternoon nap before heading out on the town again.Starting with the kitchen, fully equipped, oven, stove, microwave, full fridge, dishwasher, all as advertised.  Washer and Dryer too available.  LLiving/dining room OK too, dining table was not used by us, but the couch and chair and large TV was nice, with a big window overlooking the Flamingo noise pool where there was some nice scenery to be seen for both boys and girls (hint. take binoculars) but the music and pounding which starts up around noon but does end at 5pm does mess with any quiet afternoons you may have planned to work or sleep.Bedroom (typical Hilton bed) another large window overlooking the pool area, plenty of outlets bedside, OK wifi in entire suite, , with the bedroom tied into the bathroom, with large enough closet, tv, then a bathroom sink, large tub with no jets, then into the toilet/shower area around the corner with another sink there to clean up with too.Check in was a breeze, we were only asked once when offered the welcome gift about the timeshare stuff, we politely declined.  There is a small grocery shop (never went in) and a pool for only HGVC guests, which was nice and serene compared to next door!  And a special shout out goes to the night valet guy on duty the first week of April!  What a happy and pleasant guy, welcomed us, explained how things worked, helped set up a Lyft pickup and even called he Lyft driver to make sure he knew where he was going, because as other reviews indicated the entry to the HGVC is a bit hidden and obscured from the road.  He was great, but sorry, can't remember his name.Getting to the strip walking wasn't too bad, winding through the Flamingo garden area and then the casino, maybe 10 minutes, but it's Vegas and it's a long walk anywhere anyway.  I would consider staying here again, especially if I desire to collect Honors points and had business mid strip again.  The tram is right there at the hotel too, so getting to the convention center or south end of the strip is also easy.  If you like non casino hotels to stay at, this is a good Hilton option.

reviews.title: Family reunion
reviews.text: Hotel was very comfortable as always with any Hilton properties. I would definitely stay here again. Super close to the strip. Plus ample parking.This hotel is close to everything - shops, casinos, dining; even to the airport.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We were gifted with this room from my parents for our honeymoon.  We love the accommodations.  The staff was very friendly.  We had free access to the Flamingo pool which was awesome. The Flamingo has an all day pool party which was fun to be a part of.  The room was spacious and has two TVs.  Very close to the Vegas strip.

reviews.title: Convient Location
reviews.text: Stay at this location for my birthday weekend. From the outside, you can tell this is the first location of the HGVC portfolio but inside the rooms were very spacious! The location is connected to the Flamingo (which you can use their pool) and the Linq. This allowed us to be close to all of the action. But I did have one con, and that was their pizza at the cafe. For what we paid for, this pizza was not great at all. Reminded me of microwavable food. Avoid this at all cost!

reviews.title: Excellent time at Hilton Grand Vacations
reviews.text: Service was excellent, staff very friendly and unit was beautiful.  Enjoyed swimming in the heated pool with beautiful surroundings.  Unit was large, nicely decorated, full size kitchen with granite & stainless steel appliances.  Both bedrooms & baths were very spacious.  Second bedroom had it's own mini-kitchen.  Location was great.  Centrally located to hotels, restaurants, & casinos,

reviews.title: Perfect Family Hotel
reviews.text: While this hotel is located on the Flamingo property you do not feel like you are in Vegas. The room was a suite with a separate bedroom from the kitchen and living room. There was a washer and dryer with detergent provided. Pool and hot tub were great. And b/c it was right next to the Flamingo there were plenty of dining options.

reviews.title: Smelly room
reviews.text: Horrible smell in the room and they did nothing to fix the problem. The smell came from the bathroom and went throughout the whole room. I mentioned this to staff and they did nothing. I was there three days and went through 2 cans of air freshener.

reviews.title: Great accommodation, but relatively poor facilities for the price.
reviews.text: The suites are fantastic, and they should be for the price. The pool doesn’t get the sun until around 11 am, but you can use the adjacent hotel’s pool (Flamingo Hotel has a family pool and a 21+ party pool). Our favourite aspect of this hotel was the lack of a casino, which makes it a much, much better atmosphere for a family vacation than the majority of Vegas’ seedy venues.

reviews.title: Another Great Vegas Hilton Property!
reviews.text: We decided to try the 1-bedroom suite at the Hilton Flamingo Property for our wedding and latest trip to Vegas.  I last stayed at the Hilton Elara Vegas property in January, 2018 in their 1-bedroom suite, which is typically my go-to property when I travel to Vegas for a number of reasons included in my reviews of that specific property.  Below are my impressions of the Hilton Flamingo property.  I always provide a comprehensive review, including both positives and negatives, while my thoughts and impressions are fresh. My reviews are always fair and unbiased, and based on my actual travel experiences.Proximity to Vegas strip:  The property is well located mid-strip directly behind the Flamingo Casino, and adjacent to the High Roller observation wheel.  The Caesars property is on the other side of the strip.  It is short 10-min walk to the strip, Bally’s and the Bellagio Fountains.  There is a market cafe in the lobby that serves Starbucks mini-mart style, a kiosk for movie rentals, exercise room, and an elevated seating area surrounding a piano.The Resort Suite: Compared to the newer Hilton Elara Property the decor is slightly dated, but well maintained, comfortable, and well appointed.  The layout of the 1-bedroom suite is spacious and offers a full kitchen, full-sized fridge and other appliances, dishes and silverware, in-suite washer/dryer, in-room safe, and coffee maker, and a full-sized table suitable for a party of 4 to dine.  The bed, bedding, and pillows are very comfortable (10 out of 10).  By comparison I would rate the bedding at the Mandalay Bay, MGM, or Palms a solid 8 out of 10. The bathrooms were also very spacious.  The master bathroom features a good-sized shower, and a huge soaking tub.  Note:  We arrived early and our room was not ready yet; but the front-desk staff sent a text 90-min later letting us know that the room was ready, and had a nice bottle of wine waiting for us because we were there for our wedding.  Great customer service!Room Rates:  In comparison to the other comparable slightly off-strip resort properties the room rates are similar to slightly lower.  The suites are huge, the staff are very friendly and accommodating, and the location is great; so the property warrants the rates.Front Desk and Checkin:  The front desk staff were very friendly and, as I mentioned above, accommodated our early arrival.  The wait-time was minimal, and check-in process was quick and painless.  We checked-in and out early morning, so I cannot speak to the wait times during the peak checkin/checkout times.Dining:  The property has several nearby casual dining options in the Flamingo, adjacent to the Flamingo, as well as the nearby strip.  There are also several very cool bars serving many different varieties of cool beverages, including my favorite...Fat Tuesdays!  😉Property, Pool, and Fitness:  The property itself is very well maintained and the hotel staff are all very friendly and accommodating.  There is also plenty of available garage parking.  The pool area is small in comparison to the other Hilton Vegas properties, but sufficient, well maintained, has plenty of available lounge chairs, and good music from the adjacent Flamingo pool area.  The staff are also friendly and courteous.  The fitness center is well maintained, well equipped, and will accommodate all fitness levels.Negatives- Our suite faced the Flamingo pool area.  While the view was very nice, there is a DJ spinning the tunes at the Flamingo pool from late morning to 5pm daily.  The music (specifically the bass) is very loud which made it difficult to relax in the suite, or even hear the television, during those hours.  If you don’t want the noise during the day, request a suite facing the high-roller wheel.  Note: if not for the music noise from the Flamingo pool I would have rated the overall property higher.- Uber will drop-off in-front of the Hilton property, but will not pickup there.  The nearest Uber pickup is at the main entrance to the Flamingo at the end of the roundabout.  This is a minor inconvenience, but should be noted as you will need to walk off-property to catch your Uber/Lyft.Overall I would rate the Hilton property at the Flamingo a solid 8.5 out of 10, and would absolutely recommend it for its “suite rates”, quality, proximity, customer service, and overall guest experience.  It is great for families, business travelers, the budget conscious, and even those in need of a quick romantic getaway.

reviews.title: Fun visit
reviews.text: I stayed at this property with my wife and her parents in one of their two bedroom suites. We stayed for five nights and everything was great. The property was very clean, including the room which was one of the cleanest hotel rooms I’ve been in. The hotel staff were very friendly and went out of their way to accommodate us with early check in, daily housekeeping, etc. The small market/restaurant off of the lobby was perfect for a quick snack or breakfast sandwich. There is a walkway to the Flamingo and you are right by the Monorail, so the location is close to perfect. The only negative from the stay were the five phone calls we received trying to sell us on their timeshare program. I understand it is part of staying at a property like that, but one or two phone calls is enough. Being called every day about it was quite annoying. Other than that, this is really a perfect property to stay at in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Vegas with children
reviews.text: We we're traveling with children so it was important to find a quiet and family friendly hotel. This hotel was wonderful. It was clean and smoke free. The rooms were very large and quiet. The location was great and within walking distance to everything. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Vacation disappointmeny
reviews.text: Do NOT - repeat DO NOT make the mistake of booking this hotel. It is a misnomer to call it a Hilton. This hotel is to Hilton as a row boat is to the Queen E II. The rooms are dirty and the hallways long. We were tricked by them calling themselves The Flamingo Hilton. They are not. They are the Motel IV behind the Flamingo. No restaurant in hotel and no service to talk about. Simply the worse I have experienced of any Hilton property and I am Life Diamond member worldwide. The promised call from the General Manager never came. Simply the worse.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel - Hard to Find
reviews.text: Have stayed at this hotel several times and I seem to like it better each time. It is convenient to the strip. You simply walk out the back of the hotel and into the Flamingo. Walk thru the casino and you are on the strip. Always stay in the one bedroom suite which is large and comfortable. One of the best features is it is QUIET.Clean rooms, large rooms, quiet, convenient to the action and always reasonably priced. My only complaint is very few taxi cabs can find the place without giving them directions.

reviews.title: Outstanding as always
reviews.text: The Hgvc at the flamingo gives you the best of both worlds. You have the luxury, peace, quiet and outstanding staff at the Hilton but you are also a stones throw from the flamingo and all the strip has to offer. You can also choose to use the Hilton or flamingo pool depending on what you feel like. The one bedroom suit was as always outstanding. Having been when the room renovations were just beginning last time it was lovely to see the finished product which I can assure you did not disappoint. There are a few hgvc hotels in Vegas but this one is definitely my favourite for location and overall feel. I will be booking up again shortly as I cannot wait for my next visit.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: Located in the heart of the Vegas strip & adjacent to the Linq Promenade. Stayed in 1 bdrm. with full kitchen on 1st floor. Service was great & view of pool was nice. I've stayed at this resort multiple times & always come back. We couldn't believe how quiet the room was.

reviews.title: Great Location and Value
reviews.text: We had an above average stay at the HGVC at the Flamingo.  The location is great because you can walk out the back and go straight to the LINQ Promenade/High Roller where there is plenty of food and drinks.  The Monorail Flamingo stop is right outside the door too.  Our only real issue was the temperature of the bath water and a weird hallway smell, but I think those things happen at large resorts sometimes.  The room shower more than made up for it, and we didn't spend a lot of time in the hallway anyway.

reviews.title: Family get together
reviews.text: Visiting our son, daughter in law and grand baby the king suite gave us room to entertain. We had time to have dinners and visits that a normal hotel room would have made difficult.  This was a perfect option for our trip.

reviews.title: Excellent accomodations
reviews.text: Perfect location in Vegas with an excellent staff at all levels. The suites are spacious and well equipped with all the appliances. Place is very quiet and clean. The Market Place on first floor is adequately stocked to meet your needs for a quick lioght breakfast and coffee

reviews.title: Nice alternative
reviews.text: If you need to visit Las Vegas and don't like the big smoke-scented hotels this is a nice alternative. Located just behind the Flamingo it is convenient to everything...about 15 minute walk to most commonly visited places on the Strip and the convention center. Rooms are studios or apartments with kitchenette or kitchen. There is a small convenience store in the hotel and others not too far away.

reviews.title: 2018 WPPI Convention
reviews.text: Location, location, location. Smack in the heart of the strip within walking distance to MGM to the south to TI to the north and everything in between. The only struggle was sharing the parking structure with Flamingo where a daily hike was needed to get to and from the hotel.

reviews.title: we'll be back
reviews.text: all the staff were friendly and helpful, not intrusive. you cannot get a better location base for any activity you choose. make your vacation whatever you want tucked away behind the Flamingo you are taken away from the bustle of the strip and allowed to R&R in peaceful surroundings. rooms allow you to feel at home with more than enough comfort and luxury. we'll be back.

reviews.title: Get what you pay for
reviews.text: This property is not physically attached to the Flamingo Casino Resort. It's a short 2 minute walk from one of their entrances. Since the property is physically detached, you definitely get the privacy. The property itself is a typical Hilton Grand Vacation (HGV) setup, where the rooms are modern, expansive, and clean. The in room washer and dryer is always good especially if your length of stay is long or with a family. The service is a typical HGV service which is always excellent. For all the benefits and value, your wallet will be a lot smaller.Just don't waste your time and sign up for the HGV presentation, which 3-5 used car sales like people, on commission, will try to get you to buy into HGV.

reviews.title: Very clean and great location.
reviews.text: We so enjoy spending time at the Flamingo.  The location to everything strip is great. Pool is very nice, and all amenities are there.  The marketplace on site, has just about everything.Close to big name resorts, many are in walking distance.

reviews.title: Timeshare property in a great location
reviews.text: HGV at Flamingo is a perfect location if you're in Las Vegas for a convention - - monorail stop is a 5 minute walk, then two stops to the convention center.  Strip location is excellent - - in the middle of many activities, casinos, High Roller, etc.

reviews.title: Sam deserves a rise!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience! The room was clean and centrally located. The best part of this hotel was the valet guy, Sam! He made our stay personable and fun from the moment we arrived! We never used valet, but his greetings made our trip! This man deserves a serious raise! Thank you Sam! Will never forget you :)

reviews.title: ADA shower curtain.
reviews.text: No shower curtain in bathroom, leads to a water mess. Was told by staff that ADA did not allow shower curtains it was a safety issue. I did look this up under title 3 and ADA reg. and found they do allow shower curtains. Staff should use this shower.

reviews.title: Great cold weather getaway
reviews.text: This property was a great winter getaway!  The sunshine and the palm trees around the pool put us right in the vacation spirit and we could forget about snow and ice for a while.  Fontaine at the front desk was especially helpful - the example of great customer service.  We arrived after driving in ice and delayed flights and she just calmly took great care of us.  Much appreciated.

reviews.title: Love this Resort
reviews.text: We are Hilton Grand Vacation owners (since 2011) and we love staying here.  As mentioned in the description and reviews, it’s far enough from the Strip that it is quiet and clean.  The resort has its own Spa/Gym, Market, Coffee Shop, Freshly prepared foods or a menu to order from, Pool and separate entrance from The Flamingo.  The staff is very friendly, helpful and courteous.  If you’re a member, they do want you to sit through an hour presentation with promises of tickets, meals, vouchers, etc... They put on the “hard sell”. Aside from that, it is a great place to stay and worth becoming a HGV member. Oh, and the Monorail is just outside the gate.

reviews.title: Great Stay!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful accommodation.  The staff was super helpful and friendly.  The rooms were extremely clean and the suite I was in was spacious.  Everything you need and more plus centrally located on the strip.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: I love the Hilton Grand Vacation Club.  This property is in walking distance to several other properties.  The location is very central on the strip.  I have stayed here several times and the service has always been excellent.

reviews.title: Las Vegas HGV
reviews.text: Good location right off the strip.  The staff was courteous and helpful.  the property was clean and in good shape.  We came to see Elton John in concert.  It was just a short walk to Caesar's Palace where he was performing.  Great show!

reviews.title: A Grand time at Hilton Grand!
reviews.text: We were 3 women in town for the World Market/Furniture Show.The hotel is centrally located to everything on the Strip and the Linq next door was awesome.  Our accommodations were excellent; even the pull out couch in the living was comfortable!  Very spacious.

reviews.title: Great Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We are owners with Hilton Grand Vacation Club (HGVC) and have stayed at 9 properties including Orlando, Hawaii, and Las Vegas.  This property brings us back every January due to the professionalism, capability, and friendliness of the staff.  The property itself is the oldest in the HGVC portfolio, but the building and rooms are well maintained and the rooms are larger that the other properties.  We also have an ownership in another time share company, but we have not found the same level of staff excellence that we find at the Flamingo.

reviews.title: The timeshare people drove us crazy
reviews.text: We had a great time.  The big problem with this hotel is that they want you to buy their timeshare.  Every time you walk through the lobby, they want you to see their people.  There was no way not to see them.  They were so annoying.  The hotel itself is great.  The rooms are a nice size, there is a jetted tub.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We had our 7 year old with us and the accommodations were perfect! Nice to be within walking distance to entertainment and food yet away from the busy casinos. They were able to book us next to family in town making it super convenient. Would highly recommend!

reviews.title: In The Center Of Everything
reviews.text: We took a 7 day trip to Las Vegas and booked the HGVC through our RCI exchange program. The location is spectacular and abuts all of the main casino hotels in the area. Walking and tramming (no cost), allows you to hit Caesars, Cosmopolitan, Aria, Paris, Bally’s, New York, Bellagio, MGM and many more.. the resort itself sits directly behind the Flamingo Hotel and Casino off LINQ drive. It’s nicely removed from the noises and hubbub just steps away. Only a few steps from the High Roller. The rooms are first class and well appointed. We had a one bedroom which was as large as a suite. We summoned maintenance just once but they showed up in 15 minutes and fixed our issue. The Concierge downstairs can get you tickets to any Vegas show quickly. They were great. Nice little market onsite for incidentals. All in all a great location..

reviews.title: vegas vacation
reviews.text: Very friendly and excellent service ,good location and very clean and comfortable rooms ,The updates on rooms are okay  I think it's a little outdated  Having a movie to chosse was very nice ,only parking to far away and not on at really good condition very hard to use elevator on parking very far from the building ,not as close to the strip as I though will be.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Elegant, clean property right by the Flamigo. Great location- you can choose to walk to the strip and be in center of activity or enjoy the quiet at the resort. Studio rooms were well appointed and spacious. The staff was very helpful. We will stay here again on future visits.

reviews.title: HGVC at the Flamingo
reviews.text: HGVC at the Flamingo is the "Crown Jewell" of the Club's five Las Vegas resorts.  While it is not as elaborate as the Elara, the Flamingo resort is right on the Strip's "50-yard line" with easy access to everything.

reviews.title: Family Fun
reviews.text: This was the 2nd time we have stayed at this Flamingo. Our room was the first one off the elevator landing. We were concerned that it would be noisy, but to our surprise, we did not hear anything while in our bedroom. All staff very helpful. Will return!!

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo Las Vegas, Nevada
reviews.text: The location of this property was very good. Close to many resorts and casinos. It is a very clean property with good amenities and courteous staff.  We would definitely recommend this property for business or leisure trips.

reviews.title: Close to everything
reviews.text: Walking distance to the Vegas strip. Staff was friendly and place was very clean. The only comment I gave them was they should have coffee in lobby for early morning flights out. The cafe doesn’t open until 6:30 am but other than that this place is a win! Spacious 1 bedroom with kitchen!

reviews.title: Lovely spacious apartments
reviews.text: I did an exchange at this resort for a wedding I was attending in Vegas. My first trip. I was very impressed with the location, just off and in the middle of the strip. The rooms were large, very well equipped and comfortable and a plus the pool was heated and a great place to relax with a cocktail. Will definitely go back to this resort. Loved it.

reviews.title: Best location of Hilton Grand on the strip
reviews.text: Central on the strip- very easy to walk to Bellagio, Caesars. It is hidden behind the Flamingo with a separate entrance. Free self-parking is a big bonus about this place, especially with its central location.  The rooms are huge and clean- we had a 2 bedroom king suite-- kids could really spread out. Service was excellent.  Only did not give 5 stars because the entrance lobby makes it a little difficult to unload luggage from cars (need to park in only a few available 15 minute spots) and self-parking garage is a bit of a distance.  There is valet parking for a fee though.  Overall excellent value, but entrance not totally convenient. This was our second time staying here.

reviews.title: My New Favorite Place to Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay here. Close to everything mid-strip but nice and quiet. Didn't have to fight casino crowds to get to my room. Easiest access I have found to the monorail. Enough on the location, though, because the room itself was great.Stayed in a one bedroom suite with a really nice full (and real) kitchen, two separate rooms with comfortable furniture, spacious bathroom with two separate sinks. One of the biggest in-room safes, easily held all my gear.All the people were great, even texting from time to time (but not too much) to ask about my stay and if there was anything they could do.

reviews.title: Okay Place to Stay
reviews.text: It was very clean and staff very accommodating. However, hot water was definitely an issue. Even after getting it fixed, it never got really hot. We were there when it was cooler and rained, so a hot shower would have been great. Also, the times the marketplace were open on their pamphlets versus what they really were was not the same. It actually gave two different incorrect times on the pamphlet. Probably won’t stay there again, I like my showers hot.

reviews.title: a new years  experience
reviews.text: i really  appreciate  the  house keeping , the  bell person.  the  parking  staff.  and  some  front  desk  people.    just  one  front  desk person not  so  friendly.  and  they  are  the  people  i  should  expect   first  to  be  friendly .

reviews.title: New Years Eve
reviews.text: My fiance and I stayed here as owners for New Years Eve.  It was a great location in the center of the strip.  If you don't like being in the hustle and bustle of the strip this is a nice quiet place set behind the Flamingo.  Just be sure to get snacks for your room if you stay up late because the store closes early.Get directions before you arrive, because it is tricky to find the entrance.  Uber drivers are clueless when you tell then where you are staying, they only hear Flamingo.Typical top notch room and bed quality with the accommodations you would expect from an HGVC property.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Excellent view and amazing rooms.  Housekeeping not as good and some issues with showers, pillows and cushions.  Staff and attention to room requests were amazing.  Location was great as it was away from the main strip but still walking distance from everything

reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: This resort was in a great location.  Staff were very accommodating and friendly.  We definitely be back!!  Clean rooms, Starbucks coffee.  Onsite store with a sufficient supply of necessities, snacks, and even food prepped.  Short walk to the strip.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel over Christmas.  The bellmen, concierge, and service desk was extremely helpful.  After 4 days of walking, my knee went out and the concierge was able to get me a scooter for the rest of my stay.  Front Desk not overly friendly.  Hotel doesn't have a restaurant other than Starbucks and I found that a little troublesome but we managed to walk to other venues to eat.

reviews.title: las vegas strip
reviews.text: stayed in a room with a shared main door to the hallway and it was too noisy when people next door go in and out of their room, parking was very limited, too many parking spaces reserved for valet parking only.

reviews.title: All suite hotel kind of convenient
reviews.text: This is a time share location where you can rent rooms like any hotel. The suites are decent, with great master bedroom. I didnt like that they wouldn't give us a cot. Also the hotel doesnt really have amenities and Lyft and Uber dont have it as a pick up location. They want you to walk to the Flamingo roundabout to get picked up, but if you can talk drivers over to how to get there, they will come to pick you up. The hotel really should work with the ride share services to get that corrected.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay off the strip
reviews.text: My family loves staying here! This place is quiet, clean, and there is no gambling or smoking in the hotel. Conveniently located too! It is located behind the Flamingo Hotel and is right next to the Linq.

reviews.title: Terrible parking situation
reviews.text: Must walk in the busy street about 2 blocks to parking garage elevator, go to 4th floor where you hope to find a parking space, and will usually have to walk another block or so to your car  from the elevator. Or you can pay $15 to valet every time you want your car.  Not good if you are older and have walkng problems!  Will never stay here again.

reviews.title: Returning Owner of HGVC
reviews.text: Overall stay was great. Upon check in, room wasn’t ready but Gina helped out and went above and beyond. Our room smelled of smoke. Bell hop had someone come while we were gone and odorize the room. Much better. Water heater has trouble getting to the -6th floor. Had to run hot water, no joke 10 min in order to take a warm to hot shower. Called front desk they said they were aware and could move is to a lower floor but we had already settled in and was willing to run the water till hot. The restOf our time was great and used concierge to purchase tickets. Cheaper then online or the discount ticket booths around Vegas. Definetly return just on a lower level

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This is a nice hotel.  They do have a problem with obtaining hot water on the higher floors.   There is no view, just the top of buildings but that is because of all the huge buildings  in Las Vegas.  The staff is exceptional.  Always pleasant.

reviews.title: Great located non resort accommodation
reviews.text: This is great hotel located just behind the main Flamingo resort, next to the monorail station. Large rooms that are very clean and well equipped and a Starbucks shop that sells the basics. The hotel feels very secure.The Strip is a four minute walk past the Flamingo and Cromwell and your come out opposite Caesars Palace.The only downside is that some guests bring their pet dogs and one evening the noise from a nearby room was a problem.

reviews.title: Central strip location
reviews.text: Great location on strip. One bedroom condos are well maintained and beds are extremely comfortable.  Great place for any Vegas visit. Access to monorail station is a sones throw from the entrance. Great location next to the Linq and it’s numerous food and shopping options.

reviews.title: Quiet location near the strip
reviews.text: This was our 3rd HGVC property stay and the one we liked the least.  It's still very nice, large well appointed rooms, good location with an onsite deli, pool and hot tub.  The pool was closed but people were still using the hot tub.The market/deli wasn't as large as some Hilton property and it would be nice to have a restaurant on site.  Food was priced fairly high, but what isn't in Vegas?There were 2 things we did not like and I docked a star for each:- There was a stink in the hall going towards the north side.  It smelled like garbage or I don't know what but it was there the entire week and not due to extreme summer heat.  We also caught wind of other unpleasant smells in other hallways but at least our room had no smell.- They have timeshare people right next to the entrance and they hassle people every time they walk by.  They leave voicemails and a binder in the room saying 'welcome package'- don't fall for that because it's to get you to a timeshare presentation where they offer tickets to unpopular shows (that they brag incessantly about) and sub-par restaurants.  Think of it this way, if these were good they wouldn't need to hand out free tickets.  The other 2 Hilton resorts we stayed at (both in Orlando), you would never have known they were a timeshare but at this one, they don't let you forget it.

reviews.title: Great Location - Great Room
reviews.text: I was on business, but my wife joined me.  This is a great location if you want to be close to the Strip, but not on it.  Our room was amazing!  It had a separate bedroom, jacuzzi tub and very nice kitchen with island.  The pool was very nice!  It is located on the Flamingo property, but feels like you are in your own resort.  It has 8 floors that surround the pool.  It was pretty quite and the best part was, no casino to walk through when coming and going from your room.  Short walk to and through the Flamingo hotel and your on the strip.  I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: ok place to visit if u dont stay there
reviews.text: excellent location that's the only part deserving of 5 points, easy to get to everywhere from here.Room was good, service was a disgrace. Worst  service we have ever had in Las Vegas in 11 yrs of travelling there.No room cleaned for days on end. Called for towels and toilet paper. We were told she couldn't help right now but would let housekeeping know of my concerns. My concern was we had been without room service for a few days no clean towels and no toilet paper we saw room cleaner in hall when we were heading out to lunch and told her we needed room done and toilet paper. Think they would have put more than a quarter of a roll in there anyway when renting out a room, but there was barely any on the roll and no back up roll. We waited TWO FULL 24 HR DAYS to get any toilet paper!!!!We only got it after repeatedly complaining and them ignoring me  I marched down to front desk and really went off so they gave me some. Two whole days/nights without it is pretty disgusting especially since we told them about 12 times. Our room was so unclean we took photos no clean towels we had to go buy a couple towels so we could shower! Out of the first 7 days our room was only done after our first night the next six days it was NOT done at all. I cracked it and went to complain at  desk since ringing wasn't changing the situation, then they finally came on the 8th day. we stayed 12 nights and had room done 3 times in all.Fire alarms going off for over an hour early morning a couple days in a row. We are on holiday we want to relax not listen to this for over an hour then again two mornings later! Really ruined our holiday staying here.Even being high up couldn't drown out the disgusting fully loud thumping RAP music being played in pool area. it drove me mental. From around 9am till 3-4pm every single bloody day. It was just loud thumping beat beat  terrible thumping garbage it ended up giving me headaches. We were playing in tournaments late at night which is technically daytime for us in Australia so we stayed up till 7-8am each morning then slept till 1-2pm. We are pub owners so this is normal hours for us in Australia for last 6 years, but we couldn't sleep with the music from the pool being that high volume we were on 9th floor pool facing room. It wasn't singing just rap music at the highest volume u can imagine. Worst stay we ever had in Vegas but excellent location for middle of strip. Complaining didn't help they didn't care less, wouldn't assist us when we asked for simple things like coffee, toilet paper or clean towels.

reviews.title: family time
reviews.text: I have been to las vegas many times but have always stayed at the hotels in the casinos.  this was my first time to use Hilton grand vacation club. I chose the flamingo area because it is located in the center of the action.  I took my daughter and grandson with my husband and myself.  the space was adequate but the facility was just ok.  why would you put in those huge tubs without jets in them?? this was very disappointing. The beds were comfortable and the TV's were good.  the washing machine lid hit the dryer and make it difficult to use. The dryer never got anything completely dry.  I expected more

reviews.title: Location!
reviews.text: We love the location and all that is near.  Near the busiest corner on the Strip, next to a monorail station--yet a quiet haven from everything.  As far as the accommodations go, Hilton is all that needs to be said!

reviews.title: If you want to take a shower with hot water and have a working AC unit, DO NOT STAY HERE!!!
reviews.text: The first night the AC did not work, was repaired within 24 hours. We didn't have hot water (only tepid) for over two days, I had to walk down the hall in my bathrobe (carrying my towels, shampoo, razor, etc.) to another room just to take a shower...totally unacceptable. They kept saying they were "working on it" to get us hot water, but that never happened.  Finally, we had to pack up everything and were moved to another room.  The water was 'hotter', but not hot.  First, we were on the 12th floor, then the 9th floor.  The staff was very nice and professional, but we will never stay there again.

reviews.title: Center of Las Vegas!
reviews.text: This location is wonderful for walking around the strip. Center of everything.  Grat walking to the Casey nos and taking in shows, too! You really do not need a car.  Love having a kitchen! The view was great.

reviews.title: Just Like Home
reviews.text: My family and I have stayed at the Flamingo property for many different occasions. My daughters wedding reception was held here. The staff friendly and professional.  They always say “Welcome Home”. It is truly a home felt atmosphere.

reviews.title: Excellent HGVC
reviews.text: Wonderful accommodations, close to the Strip, pleasant, friendly staff!  My husband and I and our friend enjoyed our stay in a 2 bedroom unit  with a beautiful view of the pool. The unit was extremely clean and equipped with everything you need in the kitchen. The small food market has excellent an excellent deli with breakfast sandwiches and deli sandwiches, fresh fruit and basic groceries. Also, the food market has a selection of beers and wines. This is a very handy amenity of this HGVC.

reviews.title: DE-LUXE! Such an Awesome and convenient spot!
reviews.text: I am a Hilton girl from way back, but I just can't say enough nice things about how gorgeous this property is! First, it is just steps from a monorail station. So convenient! Just hidden away behind the Flamingo, we went to the Flamingo spa which was awesome! But the rooms were spotless, the kitchen was a full kitchen, the views were amazing. and when you came home it was quiet and peaceful. The beds were super comfy. Great pillows. I wasn't a fan of the pocket door for the toilet, it just didn't feel private enough for "those" moments....But that was really my only quibble. The convenience store was stocked with ANYTHING you could ever need.GREAT coffee, Staff were super nice. It WAS shockingly hard to find this place, but once you do- it's really really nice. I would come back in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Hilton Flamingo Grand Vacations Hotel
reviews.text: This is a great hotel with a great location!  Don't confuse this with the Flamingo Hotel.......Wonderful, friendly staff and the rooms are setup so you feel right at home.  As an owner, appreciate the free self-parking.

reviews.title: Another Great Stay and the HGVC Flamingo
reviews.text: Excellent location just behind the strip.  Hotel is well kept and the staff is extremely courteous.  Have stayed here at least four times and this facility never disappoints.  I like that it is not a casino setting, but that those amenities are within a very short stroll.

reviews.title: We will definitely return!
reviews.text: Very quiet, away from the crowdy strip, near monorail. Hotel and site very clean, rooms were perfect and quiet.   Perfect to rest after a long day in the strip.  Nice restaurant to eat pizza (we took it to the room, even more convenient!)  just besides the Flamingo, more peaceful

reviews.title: Great Location, Pool open when other places pools were closed
reviews.text: Had a great time.  Clean.  Location was great.  Self parking a little far.  Using texts for requests was awesome.  2 bed room was very spacious for my large family with plenty of space for the 3 kids to spread out

reviews.title: Property is hard to find but nice and clean
reviews.text: Nice and clean room. Courteous and friendly staff. We were there in November after the pool music blast already stopped. So we enjoyed our stay in the oasis of peace here. The location is convenient to everything. Just make sure you use the back road to get to the property to avoid traffic. The hotel needs better signage because our GPS took us the Flamingo and we could not tell the property was right behind it.

reviews.title: Centrally located
reviews.text: This hotel is an ideal location with short walk to monorail station & Strip. Short walk thru the Flamingo for the Strip. Marketplace café available from early morning until 10pm, a big plus. Well appointed room and very comfortable bed. Quiet hotel. Very welcoming friendly staff. Definitely would stay here again if in Vegas.My only negative & also commented by others is the entrance.

reviews.title: Full in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Hilton grand vacation‘s was in a great location to enjoy everything on the Las Vegas strip, and restaurants, shopping, and gambling were very close to where we are staying. We could park our car and walk everywhere, to all the Las Vegas shows and entertainment.

reviews.title: Conveniant stay
reviews.text: The hotel in the middle of the strip which is very convenient. It was pretty much a 5 - 15 min walk to anywhere. The rooms were very nice and the customer service was great. Only complaint was its weird entries. There is no easy way to access the hotel. It is behind the flamingo and its entrance doors are located on both side of it instead of street access.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: It was a great stay. Hotel location is great, very close to strip and other LV attraction. Quiet and comfortable hotel. Big, spacious rooms, comfortable bed, very clean. Nice caffe/shop open from early morning to late evenings. Friendly and helpful hotel staff. Definitely I would go for this hotel again :)

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay here and it was right on the Vegas Strip in the middle. The Marketplace was a great place for breakfast at reasonable prices and always clean with happy employees.Everyone at the resort was smiling all the time and they looked like they really liked their jobs.

reviews.title: Excellent Location & Value
reviews.text: Loved my stay at Hilton Grand Vacation @ Flamingo. Rooms were very comfortable and location is strip adjacent. It was great having a stacked washer/dryer in one-bedroom unit. Hotel pool is heated and open year around although pool-side bar is seasonal (closes in early November).

reviews.title: hilton grand vacations at the flamingo
reviews.text: 10 day stay in a very well appointed and spacious studio.Very good location steps from the strip which allowed for peace and quiet while being in the mix.Only negative ...parking structure which is free requires walking up LOTS of stairs...valet $15.00 a day.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas
reviews.text: First time staying at this location.   While the hotel has been here many years, you wouldn’t know it as it was very well maintained and updated.  Very clean and comfortable.  While it is located behind the Flamingo, it is a short walk out to Las Vegas Blvd.  it would be nice if the LYFT and Uber pickups were located outside the lobby.

reviews.title: Hilton Grand Vacations
reviews.text: Excellent! Good location, close to many restaurants and shops.  Within walking distance to the strip. Staff so friendly and accommodating. Room size perfect for grandparents and children. Would return here again.

reviews.title: Great location ... great service!
reviews.text: Located behind the Flamingo Hotel, HGVC at Flamingo offers great suite-style accommodations right near the center of the LV strip. The service was great and I enjoyed the access to the Go Pool, although this adult pool can be loud at times. The Marketplace has everything I needed and this HGVC is near the Linq, which offers many food and entertainment options. I will definitely return!

reviews.title: Another Great Stay
reviews.text: We are HGVC owners at their property on The Strip, but choose The Flamingo for the proximity to everything around the Center Strip. Check in was easy and fast. We arrived early but our room was ready so the family we traveled with was able to drop their bags in our room and off we went for groceries. By the time we returned, both rooms were ready.  One of the valets helped us get everything to the room. The rooms are well equipped and everything worked. Bed was comfortable and linens were soft and comfortable. Housekeeping did a wonderful job and fulfilled every request efficiently. We spent some afternoons at the quiet pool. Some days were fairly quiet, but some days the "music" from the Go Pool was a bit much. we managed.I used the gym most mornings and the equipment was in good shape. It's not a total gym but served the purpose. Having some hand towels available would be a nice addition.We noticed a funky smell in some of the hallways, especially on the first floor some days. The staff did have some blowers on the floor for a few days.All staff we encountered wee friendly and efficient and a pleasure to deal with. We enjoyed every day of our stay.

reviews.title: Excellent location, very close to the strip. Bed are comfortable. Hotel is very clean. Highly recommended.
reviews.text: Excellent location, very close to the strip. Bed are comfortable. Hotel is very clean. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Short Getaway to see Elton
reviews.text: My Mom and I stayed in a two bedroom unit at the HGVC Flamingo for 4 nights the third week of October.  She is an owner and needed to use her points for the year.  The staff at the timeshare is attentive and always willing to help!!  As others have mentioned from the end of April through the beginning of October there is a DJ at the Flamingo Go Pool, which is what used to be the Flamingo Hilton.  The noise can be deafening even when in the condos, but especially at the HGVC pool as they back to one another.  This is not the fault of HGVC. We only had one day of the noise.  When my parents first bought into HGVC 20+ years ago, Hilton still owned the Flamingo hotel; however, it is now owned by the Caesar's group.The location of HGVC is centrally located on the Strip across from Caesar's Palace, which is what I needed as I went to see two performances of Elton John.  My Mom gambled at the various nearby casinos and we walked up and down both sides of the Strip.  There is a convenience store/deli on site, with plenty of other restaurants nearby if needed.The positive of this property is that you are not attached to a casino, but there are many nearby; therefore, there is not constant smoke.  The Linq Ferris Wheel is right outside the backdoor.We had a fantastic employee on our last day (10/21) that I believe was the valet.  He flagged down a cab for us down at the corner, rather than us having to drag our luggage to the Flamingo Hotel pickup area, which was very much appreciated!!

reviews.title: Birthday in Vegas!
reviews.text: Went on a birthday trip with my sister and a couple of friends and stayed at HGVC at the Flamingo. Great Staff, overall great experience. The units are well appointed with a good layout. My faced the GO Pool, and to be honest, I did not hear a thing. Got a great night's sleep every night in a very comfortable bed. The staff are particularly helpful. The building is a short walk (about 5 min) to the strip, just in the middle of the strip, so was easy to walk around to literally every where. I look forward to going back.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: This resort was great. Barley off the strip. But off the strip enough to have quite down time and a hip skip and I jump to party, sight see and shop. I went with 2 Kids and it was great. Couldn’t ask for a better place.

reviews.title: Great Strip Location and Great Stay
reviews.text: We have been using the Flamingo Hilton Grand Vacation Club for decades.  Yes, we have stayed an many other places in LV ... but for location to all major casinos and activities ... this is by far the best.

reviews.title: Not the facility it was advertised to be
reviews.text: I was disappointed in my stay.  I was disappointed in the spa.  I was disappointed in the indoor Jacuzzi and sauna.  I was sold on all HGV being the same, but this one was far below what I have seen in the past.  Very disappointed in my stay with this resort.

reviews.title: Great location and spacious apartment
reviews.text: Ideally located in the middle of the Las Vegas Strip. Well appointed and roomy apartment. Staff are lovely and really willing to help with suggestions of places to go etcThis is our sixth visit to LV but they've pointed out things we can do for free that we didn't know about Choice of two great pools and full use of the Flamingo amenities (a two minute walk through the gardens). Free parking again a couple of minutes walk. Would highly recommend this for a LV stay

reviews.title: Down rated Hilton
reviews.text: We found property challenging to find as we were driving and visiting first time.  It is located off the strip, in the rear side of the Flamingo resort.  Poor signage.However, staff was very pleasant and the self-parking across the street was free.  The room was very clean.  Property could have deserved a better rating, but the "tired" bed... has seen a lot of usage.No restaurant in property and the deli shop has limited hours, limited food choices and it was closed arrival day (renovations?...but open departure day).  The strip is about a block away and many eating places.Loud pool music during day time, but quite after 6:00PM.  This is a timeshare property, not your regular Hilton.

reviews.title: Horrible check in experience but a mostly decent stay
reviews.text: I arrived early after a long flight from the East Coast but the suite was not ready.  They said they would call to let me know when it would be ready.  I waited for three hours to hear from them so I called the front desk myself.  The rather rude front desk person stated: we can't tell you if your room is ready unless you show up in person.  HUH? I was extremely tired so I stated: it would be great as a Diamond Hilton member if you could just let me know if it's ready without my having to walk/take cab back to the hotel.  She persisted with the lunacy about not having the ability to communicate my room status over the phone.  I then requested a manager who she told me was in the restroom and I would have to stay on hold.  The manager was much more polite and explained to me that only "part" of my room was cleaned.  It seems that when you book a two bedroom suite, you are actually getting two separate units that share a common entryway.  Only one of the units was clean.  I told him I'd be happy to check into the one unit and he was kind enough to allow me to do that.When I returned to the hotel, I was coldly greeted by the woman who had refused to assist me.  Still no thanking me for my Hilton status (not sure why I bother being Hilton Diamond anymore) but at least she explained to me that I wouldn't be receiving a complimentary breakfast instead additional Hilton points. The units are well kept up, albeit pretty standard condo timeshare units with little there to make it unique or different.  The onsite gift and snack shop is ridiculously over-priced but a nice convenience to have.  This hotel's proximity to the Flamingo would be nice but the Flamingo isn't the best of the strip hotels (by far) and almost devoid of any good restaurants. The Flamingo pool (available to guests 18 and older) is a big hit with the party crowds.  The regular hotel pool was more my style---quiet and empty. The push for timeshare buyers was very slight.  Other condo timeshare hotels should follow that lead.  But still: why tell me to go get my "free gift" at the welcome desk when you darn well know that the free gift is a timeshare presentation and sales pitch? If it weren't for the horrible check in experience, I'd probably give 3 stars but first impressions mean a lot to this frequent traveler. I would still tell anyone with a family or anyone wanting to be on the Strip but away from the crowds to consider this establishment.

reviews.title: Vacation at Vegas
reviews.text: Enjoyed my family vacation at Vegas it was a total Girl's Trip we did exactly what we wanted to we went to restaurants retail outlets went to the pool every day  saw the famous water show only place we didn't get to see was a show we plan to return very soon

reviews.title: A great holiday location
reviews.text: What a find!! Situated on the strip, not a casino with great facilities. Safe, secure, clean and excellent staff. You can walk to many of the shows shops and restaurants easily from here. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Lovely stay
reviews.text: The staff were nice people, the little deli rescued me from hangriness, and the room was perfect.  The water pressure and temperature were great, the bed didn't sag, the pillows were fluffy soft, and we didn't hear any noise in our fifth floor room.  The property was spotless.  I'd definitely stay here again.Be forewarned - the signage to find the hotel left a lot to be desired.  We went to the Flamingo and waited 30 minutes in line only to find out we were on the wrong side of the building.  No line no waiting at the Hilton Grand Vacations at the Flamingo.

reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: I've been here many times the location is superb the staff are lovely the little shop is super handy, pool is nice and it's a great escape from the madness of the strip but so close it can't be beaten. There is one downside that other people have mentioned in the last few years the flamingo pool which is next to this pool has pool party's daily 9am to 6pm and boybits loud some times ok  but sometimes hardcore rave such a shame but it does  stop at 6

reviews.title: Great Accommodations and Location
reviews.text: Mostly for business this time.  3rd time there and a great place to stay. The accommodations are great overlooking the Flamingo pool and right next to "LinQ" Avenue by the High Roller.  Has a convenient deli too. Gina at the front desk is awesome.

reviews.title: September Vegas getaway
reviews.text: Awesome play is centrally located and definitely one of the better places I've stayed at The pool was clean and the wait staff was very friendly drinks a little overpriced but all in all very nice place

reviews.title: Full kitchen on Strip, horrible pool music
reviews.text: What makes this hotel worthwhile is a full kitchen and you are right in the heart of the Strip.  All for less than $200 / night.  So what?  Gone are the days of the $4.99 Roast Beef Dinner at San Remo, Steak or Lobster advertised at every property on the Strip for under $10.  Eating at a local taqueria will cost you $15-20 per person.  With a family spending a few days to a week, this hotel pays for itself.  Stop by the grocery and pickup $150-200 of food and you are set for the week.There is a monorail stop here and you can easily walk to Caesars, Mirage, Treasure Island, Ballys, Bellagio, Paris, Vegas Eye (or whatever it is called) ,etc.  All within 2 blocks.  McCarren is 10 minutes away.  Free self-parking (for now), although it is a little bit of a pain still, free.Our one complaint was the music from the Flamingo Pool.  During the day it was hideously obnoxious.  The windows of the room literally shake and I half expected to hear the sound of a rattling license plate.  It makes the pool extremely child-unfriendly.  Perhaps that is the point.  But it makes hanging out in the room equally unappetizing.

reviews.title: Friendly staff
reviews.text: The staff was amazing and super friendly however, as soon as we arrived the hot water wasn't working. Then the next day I noticed that the bathtub doesn't clog. Every time I took a bath I had to sit on the clog. There is also a strange scratching sound that honestly sounds like a mouse in the kitchen area. The AC unit is also extreamly loud. I would give this less reviews if the staff wasn't amazing and going above and beyond for us.

reviews.title: Nice digs ... just off the strip
reviews.text: Affordable great location not in a casino.  Convenient and fun.  Close to everything.  Uber has the location wrong so you frequently have to tell the driver where you are really located. Pool is nice and peaceful ... usually a bit of an older crowd ... only distraction if the musing from the Flamingo pool ... it becomes background noise after a while ... I have stayed here 10-15 times the last 10 years and the convenience and nice rooms overcome any negatives.  Enjoy.

reviews.title: Wonderful "condo" on the strip
reviews.text: This is a wonderful place in the middle of the "Strip" for those looking for a full kitchen.  Thankfully the pounding base of the music at the adjacent Flamingo Hotel Pool ends at 6 pm.it is difficult to find.  It is difficult to find.  Signage is poor.   Enter from Linq Lane, one block off Flamingo Road.  Take and immediate right onto what looks like a service road.

reviews.title: As Always Excellent
reviews.text: The HGVC Flamingo is as always excellent, perfectly located yet a calm oasis away from the hustle & bustle of the Strip.We stayed at the resort last year, and requested the same room again because of it's location, though it wasn't guaranteed management managed to do it, so a very big thank you for this.If people are reading the reviews on tripadvisor then don't go complaining about the noise from the pool of the Flamingo Hotel, it is noisy from around 9/10am up until 5/6pm so you have been warned.  On the plus side the HGVC pool is open from 6am to 10pm, so a good number of hours peace.If we go back to Las Vegas, this property is always our first choice.

reviews.title: Excellent location in Vegas!
reviews.text: We are club owners who chose this property in Vegas because of its location and were not disappointed.  It is very convenient to everything but is also an "oasis" among the madness that is Vegas.  Beautiful pool area is lined with many lovely shade trees and is exceptionally clean and well maintained.  Great bed and comfortable room.  Our studio was ample for two guests.  All staff members were very helpful and courteous. Elevators were efficient and quick.  I consider it to be a "boutique" hotel--smallish, well planned, comfortable, and well maintained.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Right near strip great staff very accommodating rooms were very clean and quiet pool was nice right near Flamingo use of their pool close to places to eat yard house,bars etc walking distance to Bally's Caesarea and many others

reviews.title: Relax and Enjoy!
reviews.text: What a great place for a vacation.
