Centrally located on the Strip at the Flamingo Hotel and Casino, HGVC at the Flamingo is the place to be!The HGVC has it's own amenities, pool, DVD rental, the desert bar market and cafe, concierge and room service, but there are additional privileges at the Flamingo including the use of it's giant pool with water park and DJ! The top 50 hits are played for your enjoyment and heat DJ's and artists visit often. And the casino and several restaurants and food court are steps away. The HGVC staff is pleasant and efficient. We stayed in a two-bedroom, lock out unit with family and it was wonderful. We had enough room to spread out, have privacy and share meals! Great visit, great time in Vegas!

reviews.title: Nice Property, Booking Issues
reviews.text: When you stay near the Las Vegas strip, you're paying for the location.  Nonetheless, when I pay a premium for a hotel room, I do expect a higher level of service.  We had booked a long weekend getaway with two adjacent non-smoking rooms at this Hilton "Grand Vacation" property.  When we arrived in the evening after our late flight, we found that the rooms we had been assigned had a great view, but the evidence of our noses told us that they were (or had been) smoking suites.  One of our party has significant allergic reactions to smoke, so we asked to be moved.  The hotel said they did not have record of a request for a non-smoking suite (I had the request on my copy of the reservation, printed out).  They were able to find a room for our friend for the first night, but it was nowhere near ours; my wife and I stayed in the smoking suite.  On the second and third nights, they moved us all into adjacent non-smoking rooms as originally requested.  At the end of the stay, we requested a price reduction for the inconvenience and they declined to give that to us, instead offering reward points through the Hilton Honors program.  All in all, I thought the handled the mix-up in an OK fashion, but I felt they could have done better.  The rooms in the hotel are clean, stylish and well-appointed.  The location is immediately adjacent to The Flamingo and the Strip, so it's very convenient.  The views from the upper levels are nice, but we had to be moved to a lower level to accommodate the non-smoking request.  P.S.  I've listed the price below as mid-range, but it really depends on what you're comparing it to.  It's mid-range for Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Pool music
reviews.text: Pool music was unbearable, there is no need to have it operating at decibel levels akin to a. Night club that I would never attend. If I had one other thing to be dissatisfied with it would be the comfort of the bed.  Room was very nice otherwise and the location was very good.

reviews.title: Great property
reviews.text: Have stayed here before - music loud from pool but finally quieted down.  Greatly enjoy this property and will return.  Easy walk to the strip with great restaurants all around.  Very pleasant.  Highly recommend

reviews.title: Great place and location
reviews.text: Good location centre strip but also far enough away from the hustle and bustle for a quiet stay. The room is very spacious and modern with great amenities such as a full kitchen with dishwasher and washing machine and dryer

reviews.title: MRS
reviews.text: WAS AN EXCELLENT STAY.  I would recommend your place to anyone headed to Las Vegas.  the pool area was excellent all the people working at the Flamingo were excellent.  house keeping was excellent.  the location of the Flamingo was excellent as far as getting around the strip.  perfect location for  going to other casinos and nightly entertainment

reviews.title: Fantastic place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This was our second stay at the Hilton Vacation Suites at the Flamingo. We had a one bedroom suite. Great location at the back of the Flamingo in the middle of the strip, great rooms, with a large bedroom, plus a fold out bed in the living area, 2 TVs, spa bath and shower,  great kitchen facilities (stove, fridge, dishwasher, microwave, plates and utensils), great facilities (shared pool with the Flamingo, handy shop).

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: HGVC has proven to be a home away from home.  We have vacationed here every year since 1997. It truly is a stress free getaway.  The staff is friendly and always eager to help. It is nice to relax in a calm oasis within a city full of excitement

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This is one block behind the strip, in the middle of the strip.  So it is kind of perfect if you want a little more quiet but still want to be in the thick of it.  I stayed a little while ago, so as in Vegas I am sure a lot has changed, but all the people were nice, check in was simple.  Room was clean.  What else do you want

reviews.title: Family trip multipull rooms rented
reviews.text: Customer service was bad. No hot water for a day. Broken fridge remotes with dead batteries, plugged up tub drain smelly sheets we bought fabreeze to cover the odors. Front desk do not understand hotel policy. No free handy cap Parking.  If you are handy cap you will have to park across the street in the parking garage and walk our call uber to get back to the hotel. Hotel staff could care less.

reviews.title: expected more
reviews.text: Had issues with keys to room on multiple occasions, no hot water on arrival day. They had issues with the system which I understand but after a long day that was a bit of a shock to learn. Nice hotel if you are NOT looking for the ultimate Vegas experience!

reviews.title: Spacious rooms
reviews.text: We stayed here in June 2017 with friends and like it do much we booked it for my daughter's 21st birthday. Loved having a kitchen. It's also a nice break from the Vegas scene, but still located close enough to the strip when do want that experience.

reviews.title: Exceptional Service and Perfect Location
reviews.text: We have been staying at the HGV Flamingo Hilton for over 10 years and always find the facilities and staff to be of the highest standards.  Can't beat this location on the Las Vegas Strip on the corner of Las Vegas Blvd. and Flamingo Blvd.  Close to everything that is a must see on the strip.

reviews.title: Second visit
reviews.text: Another fine hotel with great rooms with great service. Be resourceful when booking your rooms and save some decent money. They offer a wide range of prices for the same rooms.People working in the casino are quite nice and helpful.
